jobs.title: Aerospace Verification Engineer
jobs.description: *Aerospace is at a turning point — costs are rising, supply chains are strained, and old ways of building can't keep up. At Neon Aero, we're breaking that mold. We move fast, think big, and combine start\-up agility with aerospace expertise to design, build, and scale aircraft in ways the industry has never seen. Our team leverages automation, AI\-driven tools, and a fully connected digital backbone to accelerate innovation and reduce barriers to production.* *Here, you won't just take a job — you'll help reinvent how the world flies. If you're ready to solve complex problems, push technology further, and work alongside some of the brightest minds in aerospace, this is your chance to make a real impact.* You will be the technical owner of the hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL) test environments used to verify Neon Aero's flight\-critical actuator control software: architecture, build\-out, qualification strategy, and day\-to\-day operation. This is a Staff\-level individual contributor role. You set technical direction for verification environments across the company and are accountable for the decisions that come out of it, but you do it through your own work and your influence on peers, not through a reporting line. You will write the architecture documents and you will also crimp connectors, debug timing on a real\-time target, and get a test script to pass before a formal test readiness review. The environment you build will be used as certification credit evidence, so everything you design has to be traceable, repeatable, configuration controlled, and defensible in front of a DER or certification authority. **What you will do** **Architect and build the environment** * Define the end\-to\-end architecture of the HIL environment: real\-time platform, IO, signal conditioning, breakout and fault insertion, wiring harnesses, and the rig\-to\-UUT interface control document (ICD). * Lead the platform trade study and selection of real\-time test hardware (from candidates like dSpace, NI, etc.), and defend the recommendation on technical, schedule, cost, and tool qualification grounds. * Specify and integrate a real\-time motor and load model (electrical, mechanical, and thermal as required) with step rates sufficient to close the loop against the controller's current and position loops. * Design position sensor feedback strategy, including fidelity and failure injection requirements. * Design the CAN command interface to support multiple architectures (COM/MON, COM/COM, etc.) * Design instrumentation for the digital cross\-channel data exchanged between the command and monitor processors, including passive monitoring and controlled corruption or delay. **Build the test automation framework** * Own the Python test framework and its hardware abstraction layer so that test scripts are written against generic operations and are retargetable across environments without modification. * Define the signal database and environment descriptor scheme that maps generic signals to physical channels, scaling, and platform\-specific APIs. * Define test case structure, result formats, logging, time synchronization, and traceability from high\-level software requirements to test procedures to results. * Establish the strategy for tool qualification under DO\-330 for any part of the framework or environment that is used for certification credit, and minimize what needs to be qualified through architecture choices. **Support certification** * Ensure the environment and process satisfy the applicable DO\-178C verification objectives, including requirements\-based testing on target hardware (Section 6\.4\), test coverage analysis, and the justification of any differences between the test environment and the target environment. * Contribute to the Software Verification Plan (SVP), Software Verification Cases and Procedures (SVCP), test environment description, and Software Configuration Index items related to the environment. * Support Stage of Involvement (SOI) audits, test readiness reviews, and formal test witnessing. **Operate, scale, and raise the bar** * Own configuration management of the rig: hardware revision, firmware, model versions, calibration, and framework releases. * Establish rig bring\-up, calibration, and periodic health check procedures. * Serve as technical lead for external vendors delivering environment components or prototypes, including scope definition, statement of work review, acceptance testing, and hand\-over. * Set the standard for how requirements\-based tests are written at Neon Aero, review test designs from software and test engineers, and coach them toward it. * Define the roadmap from a single prototype rig to multiple production rigs and variants. **What we are looking for** **Required** * Bachelor's degree in electrical, computer, aerospace, or mechanical engineering, or equivalent experience. * Minimum of 10 years in embedded or aerospace systems, with at least 5 years designing or leading HIL or systems integration lab environments, and a track record of owning an environment from concept through use in formal testing. * Direct experience with DO\-178C verification objectives and producing evidence that has passed certification authority or DER review. Working knowledge of DO\-330 tool qualification. * Hands\-on experience with at least one real\-time test platform (dSPACE, NI VeriStand or LabVIEW RT, Speedgoat, or a self\-built RTOS or PREEMPT\_RT system) including its Python or scripting API. * Strong Python skills, including designing frameworks and APIs used by other engineers, not just writing scripts. * Understanding of motor control fundamentals (BLDC or PMSM, current and position loops, commutation) sufficient to specify and validate a real\-time motor model. * Experience with CAN bus (and ideally CAN FD or ARINC 825\) at the frame, timing, and error injection level. * Experience with encoder interfaces (incremental quadrature and at least one absolute protocol such as SSI, BiSS, or EnDat, or resolver) and with their emulation. * Comfortable with lab hardware: oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, signal conditioning, harness design, grounding and noise mitigation. * Clear technical writing. You will produce documents that get audited. * Demonstrated ability to drive technical decisions across teams without formal authority. **Strongly preferred** * Experience with dissimilar dual\-processor (command/monitor or dual\-lane) architectures and their verification challenges. * FPGA or real\-time IO experience for high\-rate signal emulation. * Experience with model\-based development toolchains (Simulink, Simulink Real\-Time, or similar) and with qualifying or validating plant models. * Familiarity with DO\-254, ARP4754A, and DO\-160 as they relate to integrated test. * Experience with pytest or similar frameworks, CI integration for hardware test, and requirements management tools (DOORS, Jama, Polarion). * Prior work on flight control actuation, electromechanical actuators, or similar safety\-critical servo systems. * Experience writing statements of work and technically managing external engineering vendors. **Working Conditions** * Fast\-paced, highly collaborative engineering environment. * Occasional travel to vendor sites, test facilities, and partner locations. * Hands\-on lab work alongside architecture and documentation responsibilities. * Role may involve regulated, export\-controlled, or classified environments. **Why Join Us** * Work alongside elite engineering talent and innovators across aerospace and technology. * Be part of a team moving faster than the industry standard and shaping solutions that are lower\-cost, autonomous, and scalable. * Help deliver the future of aviation while building your career in an environment that values ownership, innovation, and meaningful impact. * Competitive compensation, including equity participation, growth opportunities, and comprehensive benefits, helps support you in and out of work. *Neon Aero, Inc is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable law.* *We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation, and we welcome candidates from all backgrounds to apply.* *All final candidates must successfully complete a background check and drug screening as a condition of employment.* **At this time, Neon Aero and its divisions are not accepting unsolicited resumes from third\-party recruiters or staffing agencies.**

jobs.title: Data Center Engineer – Windows Infrastructure

jobs.title: Field Service Controls Engineer

repair of machine tool control systems, PLCs, HMIs, drives, sensors, motors, and related components. * Configure, diagnose, and optimize Siemens control systems including SINUMERIK, SIMATIC PLCs, TIA Portal, STEP 7, WinCC, and Siemens drive technologies. * Conduct machine startup activities including system verification, I/O checks, safety circuit validation, and operational testing. * Diagnose electrical, controls, communication, and automation issues using schematics, software diagnostics, and testing equipment. * Modify and troubleshoot PLC logic, HMI screens, machine parameters, and control configurations as required. * Perform machine acceptance testing and support customer buy\-off activities. * Train customer maintenance personnel, operators, programmers, and engineering teams Commissioning, Mechanical Service, and Customer Service teams to resolve technical issues. * Generate detailed service reports documenting work performed, findings, corrective actions, and recommendations. * Support machine upgrades, retrofits, control modernization projects, and software enhancements. * Assist with development and improvement of commissioning procedures, troubleshooting guides, and technical documentation. * Ensure compliance with all customer safety requirements and EMAG safety policies while working on\-site. * Maintain professional customer relationships and represent EMAG in a positive and professional manner. \*\*Education/Experience: \*\* * Associate degree or Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Automation Engineering, Industrial Controls, or related technical field preferred. * Journeyman Electrician certification or equivalent industrial electrical experience considered in lieu of degree. * Minimum 5 years of experience in industrial controls, machine tool service, automation, or electrical commissioning. **Required Knowledge \& Skills** (Included but not limited to the following) * Highly organized * Ability to multi\-task and work in a fast\-paced environment * Ability to handle high stress situations with emotional maturity and professionalism at all times * Personable, professional and friendly communication skills * Dependable, reliable and trustworthy * Ability to work in a team environment or independently * Strong knowledge of Siemens automation platforms * Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, ladder logic, and technical documentation * Experience troubleshooting industrial machine tools, CNC equipment, robotics, or automated manufacturing systems * Familiarity with Fanuc, Siemens or other industrial control platforms * Basic knowledge of ISO 9001/14001 **Physical/Mental/Environmental Demands** The characteristics described below are representative of those encountered while performing the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations will be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. * Frequently be required to stand, walk, sit, reach with hands and arms, climb or balance, stoop or kneel, talk and hear, and use fingers and hands to feel objects, tools or controls. * Must occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. * Specific vision abilities required include close vision, distance vision, depth perceptions, and the ability to adjust focus. * Plant manufacturing may be noisy from time to time, especially when visiting customer sites. This may include weekdays, weekends and/or holidays. * Job will require travel to and visit a customer’s office, production facility or job site. Conditions will vary at each location, but the conditions listed above will generally apply. * Ability to travel internationally and domestically 70\-90% of the time You should be proficient in: * PLC Troubleshooting Skills * Industrial and Manufacturing Engineering * Electrical Schematics * 120/208/240/480 Voltage Systems * CNC Machine Installation * Electrical Installation * Troubleshooting Industrial Automation Equipment * PLC Programming Experience * Electrical / Electronic Systems * Field Service Readiness * Industrial Electrical Systems * Electrical Schematic Reading * Equipment Installation \& Wiring Machines \& technologies you'll use: * CNC Automation Solutions (Fanuc, Siemens, Dmg Mori Seiki) * CNC Laser Cutter * CNC Lathe (2\-4 axis) * CNC Grinder * CNC Lathe (5\+ axis) * Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) (Fanuc, Siemens)

jobs.title: Founding Customer Lead
jobs.description: **About Jampack** Jampack builds AI agents that run wholesale operations, replacing spreadsheets, email chains, and manual data entry with automated workflows. We power brands like Fishwife, immi, and PATH, handling everything from purchase orders and freight coordination to invoicing and payment reconciliation. We’ve raised a $3\.2M seed round led by Maveron, Timber Grove Ventures, and industry operators. We’re a small team working closely with customers to build the AI\-native operating system for wholesale. **About the role** We are seeking a passionate and strategic Customer Lead to own our customer experience end to end, working cross functionally with our founders, engineering, and product. You'll be equal parts strategic leader and tactical executor: building our customer function from the ground up, resolving issues quickly, implementing new tooling, improving processes, and making sure what we learn from customers shapes what we build. This is the first hire of its kind at Jampack, which makes it a defining role. Until now, our founders and engineers have supported every customer directly. You'll take that on and set the standard for how Jampack shows up for its customers: the processes, the tooling, the tone, and eventually the team. What you build in your first year will shape this function, and our customers' experience of Jampack, for years to come. This position is critical to our mission and is an incredible opportunity to join a fast\-paced, high growth startup as one of its earliest hires. If you enjoy working on complex operational problems, excel at creating delightful customer experiences, and have a knack for elegant solutions and scalable processes, we'd love to connect with you. **Responsibilities include** * **Build the playbooks that let us scale:** SOPs, a customer help center, and internal documentation, using AI tooling wherever it removes manual work. * **Implement strategies to scale our customer function** as the company grows, including hiring and training additional team members as needed. * **Develop a deep understanding of customer needs**, pain points, and day\-to\-day operations, collaborating with product and engineering to turn that insight into roadmap priorities. * **Track, analyze, and report on support and customer health metrics**, including response and resolution times, product adoption, and retention. * **Set up and manage our support infrastructure**, including ticketing, shared customer channels, help center, and reporting. * **Act as the primary point of contact for our brand customers**, responding to support requests across email, Slack, and calls, and owning each issue through to resolution. **Skills and qualifications** * **4\+ years of experience in customer support, customer success**, implementation, or operations, preferably in a leadership position or as an early hire at a B2B SaaS company. * **Strong data analysis skills** and comfort working with messy customer data in spreadsheets. SQL knowledge is a plus. * **Strong communication skills** with a knack for clear, direct, and compassionate customer communication, including being precise about who owns what when several parties are involved in an issue. * **Tech\-savvy with the ability to quickly learn new systems**. Exposure to tools like QuickBooks, NetSuite, Cin7, Fishbowl, Shopify, ShipHero, Extensiv, or SPS Commerce is a plus, as is enthusiasm for using AI tools in your own workflow. * **Experience working directly with small and mid\-sized business operators (B2B)** and in a high\-growth startup environment is a plus. * **Passionate about CPG**, emerging food and consumer brands, supply chain, or applied AI. * **Experience in CPG, wholesale, supply chain, or logistics is a strong plus.** Familiarity with purchase orders, EDI, retailer and distributor compliance, 3PLs, or LTL and parcel freight will help you ramp quickly. **Location** This is an in\-person role in Brooklyn, NY. **Benefits** Base salary range of **$90,000 – $120,000 plus meaningful equity**

jobs.title: General Maintenance Engineer
jobs.description: **Summary** ----------- Join our dynamic team and work in a beautiful setting with an unobstructed view of the ocean! We are looking individuals who can provide authentic and memorable experiences that deliver the Southern California Dream to our guests as a General Maintenance Engineer. This is a full\-time position with benefits. This role is fully onsite and requires open availability to work any shift as needed, included weekends and holidays. This position will rotate working overnight shifts. The General Maintenance Engineer will: * Perform routine maintenance throughout both properties and will monitor, operate, and maintain the mechanical equipment in all areas. * Regularly required to stand walk and occasionally lift or move 50 pounds. * Possess general troubleshooting skills to repair kitchen equipment, laundry equipment, and HVAC equipment. * Must be able to do general facilities maintenance to include but not limited to replace light switches, outlets, light fixtures, and work on basic electrical, mechanical and plumbing equipment. * Have familiarity with basic OSHA safety requirements, and fire life safety systems. * Complete some painting and patching work. * Complete guest calls as needed and properly document in the Engineering software system. * Complete projects as needed. *This list is not all\-encompassing and that daily work tasks may and can be altered to meet business needs.* *The rate for this position ranges from $22\.49\-$27\.59/hour.* **Hyatt has a very competitive benefit package for colleagues, which may include:** * 12 Complimentary hotel room nights at Hyatt hotels world\-wide * Unlimited colleague and friends \& family discounted room rates at Hyatt hotels world\-wide * Bereavement and jury duty pay * Vacation, sick, and new child leave * Medical, dental and vision Insurance, discounted prescriptions, life and disability insurance, flexible spending account, * Retirement Savings Plan option (401K) with employer match * Employee Stock Purchase Plan * Complimentary employee meals * And so much more! **SAFETY REQUIREMENTS:** OSHA laws require the use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) when performing work duties that have a potential of risk to your health or safety. The following is a list of some of the devices required. This is only a sample list and is not to be all\-inclusive do to the nature of the work conductive to the Engineering Department. * Protective gloves, eye protection, breathing protection, hearing protection, lock\-out/tag\-out protection and any other equipment as necessary to provide a safe working environment. All work duties conducted by Engineering personal will be evaluated and regular scheduled training and refresher training will be conducted as required by law. Associates will be trained as to the use and care of any and all required PPE equipment. The hotel provides this required PPE and it is the responsibility of engineer to wear this equipment as it relates to daily work assignments. It is your responsibility to report defective, damaged or lost PPE to your Manager. * Follow all Safety Policies and Procedures. **Qualifications** ------------------ * Possess good electrical and mechanical troubleshooting skills. * Able to read blueprints, wiring schematics and technical manuals. * Ability to read and write the English language fluently. * Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to communicate effectively with the public and other associates. * Strong computer skills including Word, Excel and Energy Management System. * Interpersonal skills necessary to provide the highest level of guest satisfaction. * High School graduate or equivalent required. * Valid drivers’ license. * Applicants with additional language skills a plus * Must be able to work on their own with little or no supervision * This person must have good communication skills and be somewhat proficient with computers. *Physical Demands:* * Long hours sometimes required, including nights and weekends. * Ability to stand for long hours at a time and to work in confined spaces as necessary. * Ability to lift up to 50 pounds. * Ability to walk and stand for long hours and comfortable working with all heights. Must be able to climb ladders, etc. *All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.*

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff, Agent Engineer
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ New York **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Department** -------------- Engineering **Compensation** ---------------- * $175K – $240K • Offers Equity ### **About Us** Edison Scientific builds and deploys AI scientist agents to accelerate science and the development of new medicines. We are an ambitious team run by scientists and engineers from leading institutions across biology, physics, chemistry, and AI. ### **About the Role** We're looking for an Agent Engineer to join the team responsible for building Edison's AI agents. This team owns the development and design of our AI scientist agent, Kosmos. You'll own the development and maintenance of production agents, prototype new capabilities with our internal science and engineering teams, and shape how our platform evolves. You'll spend some time with customers to understand real workflows and validate what you're building, but your primary focus is on the agents themselves – making them more capable, more reliable, and more useful across the life sciences. ### **Key Responsibilities** * Architect, implement, and maintain the AI agents that power Edison's platform, from prototype through production. * Work with our internal science and engineering teams to explore new agent architectures, prompting strategies, tool integrations, and evaluation frameworks. * Develop reusable infrastructure – agent skills, tool\-use pipelines, benchmarks – that improves every agent on the platform. * Spend time with R\&D partners (\~30%) to understand their workflows, test what you've built in real environments, and bring insights back to the team. * Translate field insights and internal research into product direction – help the team prioritize what to build next. ### **Required Qualifications** * Typically, 4\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with production experience shipping systems that real users depend on. * Experience building LLM\-powered tools or applications: prompting, context engineering, agent architectures, evaluation frameworks. * Strong engineering foundation in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, Data Science, or a related technical field. * Proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript, with comfort picking up new tools and frameworks quickly. * Able to work across engineering, science, and product teams. * Comfortable building from scratch, driving clarity in ambiguous situations, and wearing multiple hats. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience in life sciences, biomedical research, scientific computing, or technical R\&D workflows. * Experience building agent systems, tool\-use pipelines, or evaluation/benchmarking frameworks for AI applications. * Contributions to open\-source scientific or AI tooling. ### **Why join us?** We're a fast\-moving, mission\-driven culture where smart people do their best work and actually enjoy doing it. We also offer full\-time employees the following: * Competitive salary and equity * Full healthcare coverage; we pay 100% of premiums for you and your dependents * Support for growing families, including a yearly new parent stipend and fertility coverage through Carrot * Mental health support through Rula, our in\-network therapist and psychiatrist network with fast availability * 12 weeks of paid parental leave for maternity, paternity, and adoption * Pet care support with a yearly employer\-funded stipend for your animal companions * Commuter benefits so you can pay for transit and parking with pre\-tax dollars * 401(k) company matching * $300 health and wellness benefit quarterly * Lunch is on us every day you're in the office, and dinner is on us when you're working late * Regular team off\-sites and company events *Edison Scientific is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.* Compensation Range: $175K \- $240K

jobs.title: NOC Technician Tier 2
jobs.description: **Job Title: NOC Technician Tier 2** **Department:** Technical Operations NOC **Reports to:** Director of Technical Operations **Position Summary:**The NOC Technician 2 plays a key mid\-level support role within the Network Operations Center. This position bridges the gap between frontline alert responders and senior engineering staff. The NOC Tech 2 is responsible for handling complex remediation of alerts, assisting with onboarding processes, and supporting infrastructure stability across managed clients. This position is ideal for a technician with advanced troubleshooting skills and a proactive approach to improving monitoring reliability and documentation.  **Roles and Responsibilities:** =============================== **Alert Remediation \& Escalation Support** =========================================== * Respond to and resolve alerts escalated from Tier I technicians. * Troubleshoot backup failures, disk space issues, offline agents, and performance anomalies. * Apply fixes directly in RMM tools (NinjaOne) or escalate to NOC Engineers as needed. **Onboarding \& Configuration** =============================== * Assist with the setup of monitoring profiles for new clients. * Configure standard policies and thresholds in NinjaOne. * Support deployment of software agents and onboarding runbooks. **Backup Oversight** ==================== * Review and report on Acronis backup job status. * Initiate recovery testing in coordination with NOC Engineer. * Document recovery steps and provide feedback on backup workflows. **Documentation \& Communication** ================================== * Update ticket and remediation documentation in ConnectWise Manage. * Create and maintain SOPs related to RMM alert remediation. * Participate in daily team syncs to report progress and share updates. **Tool Proficiency** ==================== * NinjaOne RMM: Alert response, scripting, remote access * ConnectWise Manage: Ticket handling and documentation * Acronis: Backup status review and escalation * Microsoft 365, SentinelOne (basic understanding for correlation) * Systems administration using Microsoft PowerShell on Windows **Qualifications \& Skills:** ============================= **Required Skills \& Experience:** ================================== * Associate’s Degree in IT, Networking, or equivalent experience. * 2\+ years’ experience in NOC or Help Desk Tier II role. * Strong troubleshooting skills across Windows Server systems and advanced networking. * Familiarity with RMM tools and backup platforms. * Experience with Microsoft PowerShell. **Preferred Skills \& Experience:** =================================== * CompTIA A\+, Network\+ * NinjaOne certification (preferred but not required) * Microsoft 365 Fundamentals **Soft Skills:** ================ * Excellent written documentation and ticketing hygiene. * Analytical thinker with a team\-first attitude. * Able to multitask and prioritize under time\-sensitive conditions. **Job Type:** Full\-time **Salary:** $75,000 \- $85,000 per year (commensurate with experience) **Benefits:** Dental Insurance, Health Insurance, Vision Insurance, Life Insurance, PTO, and 401(k) **Schedule:** Monday to Friday (participation in on\-call or extended shift coverage as needed) **Work Location:** In\-person (West Caldwell, NJ **OR** Cherry Hill, NJ, **OR** Brooklyn, NY, **OR** Boca Raton, FL **Disclaimer****:** **This document outlines the key responsibilities and expectations for the NOC Technician II role. Responsibilities may evolve based on company priorities, technical operation needs, and business requirements.** ======================================================================================================================================================================================================================================= **EEO Statement** We are an equal employment opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: PLC Systems Integration Engineer (Siemens TIA Portal)
jobs.description: **PLC Systems Integration Engineer (Siemens TIA Portal)** ========================================================= Picture your morning at 7:00 am in Apple Grove, WV. You badge in, open a blank TIA Portal project, and begin shaping the control logic that will drive a brand\-new production line for a global metals and industrial automation leader. By late afternoon, your code is talking to real hardware, I/O is verified, loops are tuned, and the HMI is telling a clear story of the process you brought to life. **The Work You’ll Lead** ------------------------ * Author PLC programs from the ground up using ladder logic, function block diagrams, and structured text guided by control narratives and process needs. * Build out I/O maps, data structures, and program architecture for new control systems. * Develop and connect HMI/SCADA screens with PLC tags and databases. * Commission your code on\-site: execute I/O checkout, test sequences, and perform loop tuning and debugging. * Interpret P\&IDs, electrical schematics, and panel layouts to ensure accurate design and implementation. * Partner with electricians and controls technicians on wiring, sensor installation, and panel integration. * Independently troubleshoot control\-system issues in the field. * Practice Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) and follow NEC/IEC electrical safety protocols. * Document logic, I/O lists, and system architecture for smooth handoff. **Toolset \& Platforms** ------------------------ * Primary: Siemens Step 7 / TIA Portal (S7\-300/400/1200/1500\). * Also welcome: Allen\-Bradley RSLogix 5000 / Studio 5000 and other major platforms (Omron, Mitsubishi, Schneider). **What You’ll Bring** --------------------- * 3\+ years creating PLC programs from scratch (beyond edits or maintenance). * Hands\-on, professional experience in Siemens Step 7 / TIA Portal (strongly preferred). * Proficiency reading P\&IDs, wiring diagrams, and panel schematics. * Working knowledge of I/O wiring, control panels, and NEC/IEC standards. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * HMI/SCADA development (Siemens WinCC, Allen\-Bradley FactoryTalk/PanelView, or similar). * Experience with Profibus, Profinet, EtherNet/IP, and DeviceNet. * Motion control, VFDs/drives, and safety PLC programming. * Background in heavy manufacturing or large industrial builds. * PLC cabinet assembly and field device troubleshooting. **Compensation \& Logistics** ----------------------------- * Pay: $50–$55/hour (DOE) * Per Diem: $120/day for hotel and meals * Schedule: 40 hours/week with overtime potential * Shift: 1st shift, 7:00 am – 4:30 pm * Employment Type: Contract\-to\-hire * Location: Apple Grove, WV (just outside Huntington, WV) **About the Project** --------------------- Join a major build with a global leader in metals and automation manufacturing, where you’ll own greenfield PLC programming and on\-site commissioning that directly impacts performance, reliability, and operator experience. **Why Mural Industrial Staffing** --------------------------------- Mural Industrial connects skilled automation professionals with top\-tier manufacturers and industrial contractors nationwide. Expect competitive pay, dependable support, and access to long\-term roles that grow with your expertise.

jobs.title: Principal Data Engineer
jobs.description: Job Posting Title**Principal Data Engineer** =========================== **Job Description** \*Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.\* **Location:** Charlotte, NC/Detroit, MI **Work Arrangement:** Onsite **Job Type:** Full\-Time ### **Job Overview** We are seeking an experienced Principal Data Engineer to design, develop, and maintain scalable data solutions supporting enterprise data engineering and analytics initiatives. This role will work across data engineering, data warehousing, data integration, and cloud technologies to build reliable and high\-performing data platforms. The ideal candidate has strong hands\-on experience with AWS, Snowflake, Python, SQL, ETL/ELT, and modern data engineering practices, along with the ability to work across complex enterprise data environments. ### **Key Responsibilities** * Design, develop, and optimize scalable data pipelines and data integration solutions. * Develop and maintain data architectures supporting enterprise data warehouses, data lakes, and analytics platforms. * Build and optimize ETL/ELT processes using modern data engineering tools and technologies. * Develop solutions using AWS services including S3, Lambda, and DynamoDB. * Design and implement data solutions within Snowflake and other cloud\-based data environments. * Develop and maintain data models, including Data Vault modeling methodologies. * Write and optimize complex SQL and Python code for data processing and integration. * Work with dbt to develop, transform, test, and manage data workflows. * Support data replication and integration using tools such as Qlik Replicate. * Work with enterprise data platforms including IBM InfoSphere DataStage and CP4D. * Develop and integrate APIs to support enterprise data and application needs. * Establish and maintain data quality, governance, metadata management, and data lineage processes. * Collaborate with engineering, architecture, analytics, and business teams to translate requirements into scalable data solutions. * Troubleshoot performance, data quality, and integration issues across complex data environments. * Provide technical leadership and guidance on data engineering architecture and best practices. ### **Required Qualifications** * Strong experience in data engineering and enterprise data environments. * Hands\-on experience with AWS, particularly S3, Lambda, and/or DynamoDB. * Strong experience with Snowflake and cloud data warehousing. * Advanced Python and SQL development skills. * Experience developing ETL/ELT and data integration solutions. * Experience with data warehousing and data modeling, including Data Vault. * Experience with dbt or similar modern data transformation frameworks. * Experience with data quality, governance, metadata management, and data lineage. * Strong understanding of relational and non\-relational databases. * Experience with enterprise data integration platforms and tools. * Ability to work independently while providing technical leadership to other engineers. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with Qlik Replicate. * Experience with IBM InfoSphere DataStage. * Experience with IBM CP4D. * Experience developing and integrating APIs. * Experience with NoSQL databases. * Experience working with Git and DevOps practices. * Experience in large\-scale enterprise environments. * Strong communication and cross\-functional collaboration skills. **Work Environment** This is an onsite position that requires the ability to work from the client site on a regular basis. **Kaleidoscope, an Infosys Company, is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, spouse of protected veteran, or disability.**

jobs.title: Registered Professional Land Surveyor
jobs.description: **Overview** Join our dynamic team as a Registered Professional Land Surveyor and play a vital role in shaping accurate, reliable land boundaries and mapping solutions. This energetic position offers the opportunity to lead surveying projects, utilize cutting\-edge technology, and collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to deliver precise survey data. As a key contributor, you will oversee field operations, manage survey data collection, and ensure compliance with legal and regulatory standards. (BLE), you will play a crucial role in advancing excellence within our growing Regional Geotech Group. Your responsibilities include serving our long\-term clients, expanding our current geotechnical capabilities, fostering a collaborative and innovative environment, and cultivating enduring professional relationships. This role offers a favorable work\-life balance while providing opportunities to contribute to challenging and distinctive engineering projects. Our Geotechnical group focuses on serving projects for our solid waste, mining, and power industry clients. strength testing. **Skills and Competencies** * Maintain and apply advanced expertise in geotechnical science. * Exercise sound judgment and decision\-making in evaluating complex technical challenges risk management strategies to mitigate potential liabilities and protect the firm’s reputation. **Performance Analytics** * Evaluate project outcomes and departmental performance against defined and quality objectives. * Analyze data from completed projects to identify trends, potential risks, and opportunities for process improvement. * Develop and present technical performance reports to senior management. **Technical Expertise** * Maintain recognized expertise in geotechnical regulations, ASTM standards, and emerging methods. * Contribute to technical publications, white papers, and industry presentations. * Serve as a thought leader within the firm and industry, sharing expertise through training and mentoring. * Continuously enhance technical knowledge through professional development and industry engagement. **Leadership Behaviors** * STRATEGIC – Take a long\-range, broad approach to problem\-solving and decision\-making through objective analysis, thinking ahead, and disciplined planning and execution. * COMMUNICATION – Explaining things clearly and thoroughly; expressing thoughts and ideas readily; keeping others well informed; setting forth viewpoints; being high\-activity environment. * MANAGEMENT FOCUSED – Making things happen; being influential; taking control of a situation; providing guidance to others; and acting as a facilitator; Always leave or duties, functions, or procedures that may be required. Most importantly, we honor every commitment we make and believe that no challenge is too complex when the right people work together. These values define who we are, how we operate, and the kind of team we continue to build. **Notice to applicants:** Background checks are carried out as part of any conditional offer made, including (but not limited to \& role dependent) education, professional registration, employment, references and global watchlist screening. **To be a considered applicant:** Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship and able to interview on site where the position is located. **Benefits** * Vehicle allowance (conditions apply) * Medical/Vision/Dental * 401(K) with partial company matching. * Life Insurance * Short/long term disability * Paid vacation * Paid sick leave. * Eight (8\) paid holidays. * Employee Stock Ownership Program (conditions apply)

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ **MintMCP** helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. That has to start from trust. Our first product is an MCP gateway that gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on. We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how. **AI\-Native Startup** We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team, write code, review PRs, and handle sales, marketing, and deal ops on the same gateway we sell to customers. We are building an entire company operating system around them, and you will help build it. **Traction** Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera. **The Job** You will own features end to end, from conception to production, across our gateway infrastructure, enterprise deployments, and agentic systems. The work leans backend and infra, but nothing is off limits: when the product needs a better UI you build it, and when a connector breaks during a security review you fix it. Claude and Codex are your primary working environment, and you use a fleet of agents to move faster than a team this size has any right to. Agents write much of the code and review PRs, so your real job is the judgment they cannot make: shaping the problem, making architecture, product, and UX calls, hardening enterprise paths, designing connectors, protecting security\-sensitive surfaces, and catching generated code that is quietly wrong. Roles are blurred and we ship within hours, and you will learn directly from the founders and from customers. We hire across levels, from strong early\-career builders to seasoned engineers, and we set level and pay to match. What matters most is judgment, range, and how fast you ship. **About You** * You are a builder with a track record of shipping to real users, whether that is a product, an internal tool, an open\-source project, or a serious side project. You ship, then iterate, without waiting for specs or approvals. * You have strong fundamentals and learn fast. How quickly you pick things up matters as much as years of experience. * You care about product value and customer needs over technical purity. * You take infra seriously. You think about blast radius, trust boundaries, and what happens when your code is in the path of every customer's agents. * You can read unfamiliar code, reason from first principles, and explain your tradeoffs. * You are comfortable across the stack (TypeScript, Python, CockroachDB), or you pick up new languages, protocols, and domains fast. * You are excited to build with agents, and to learn when they help and when they hide a problem. * You already build with AI every day and want room to move without heavy process. **Nice to have:** * Developer\-facing products, protocol or gateway work, or infrastructure at scale. * Background in security, identity, or permission systems. * Contributions to open source, MCP servers, or agentic frameworks. * Design sensibility: engineers who care about design, designers who think about infrastructure. **What we offer:** * Competitive compensation and meaningful equity. * Unusual scope and ownership of features that ship to enterprise customers. * Building and deploying agents on the same platform we sell. * Direct access to the founders, customer context, and product direction, with mentorship as you grow. * Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first. *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

jobs.title: Sr Content Partner Mgr
jobs.description: Technology is at the heart of Disney’s past, present, and future. Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product \& Technology is a global organization of engineers, product developers, designers, technologists, data scientists, and more – all working to build and advance the technological backbone for Disney’s media business globally. The team marries technology with creativity to build world\-class products, enhance storytelling, and drive velocity, innovation, and scalability for our businesses. We are Storytellers and Innovators. Creators and Builders. Entertainers and Engineers. We work with every part of The Walt Disney Company’s media portfolio to advance the technological foundation and consumer media touch points serving millions of people around the world. **Here are a few reasons why we think** **you’d** **love working here:** 1\. Building the future of Disney’s media: Our Technologists are designing and building the products and platforms that will power our media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come. 2\. Reach, Scale \& Impact: More than ever, Disney’s technology and products serve as a signature doorway for fans' connections with the company’s brands and stories. Disney\+. Hulu. ESPN. ABC. ABC News…and many more. These products and brands – and the unmatched stories, storytellers, and events they carry – matter to millions of people globally. 3\. Innovation: We develop and implement groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms, and solve complex and distinctive technical problems. Content Platforms \& Operations is responsible for the development and ongoing advancement of the technical and operational functions driving the worldwide distribution and monetization of Disney’s linear networks and theatrical content. This includes Disney’s media supply chain and storage, network and theatrical distribution operations, media localization, network transmission and origination, and more. The global team also plays a critical role as the primary collaboration point for Product \& Technology with Disney’s EMEA, APAC, and LATAM regional business teams. Content Partner Management (CPM) is a cross\-functional, technology and business\-facing team within the Content Platforms \& Operations team, and part of the Disney Entertainment \& ESPN Product \& Technology organization. CPM is responsible for the operational execution of Disney’s streaming content agreements with both internal and third\-party content providers. The team is responsible for managing the full content lifecycle, inclusive of partner integration, content delivery, launch planning and scheduling, content remediation, and building product requirements against partner agreements. Serving as a central point of contact between content partners and internal stakeholders, the team ensures seamless execution of contractual obligations, technical specifications, and both technology and business priorities across the organization. As super\-users of Disney’s content management systems, CPM plays a critical role in driving continuous platform improvement by providing feature feedback and operational requirements. **Job Summary:** As Senior Content Partner Manager, you are accountable for executing program requirements outlined in the partner agreements, technical specifications, and business objectives. You will build and maintain cross\-functional relationships with content providers and ensure the successful launch, and in\-app experience, of their brand and content on Disney’s streaming products. A qualified candidate will have the technical and business fluency to lead multiple projects, partnering with stakeholders across technology, operations, product, and business to facilitate conversations and execute deliverables. You will drive the content launch plan, execute short and long\-term projects, while maintaining the agility and responsiveness to quickly and effectively address ad\-hoc issues. In this role you will also play a leading part in establishing new operational frameworks to support high\-volume content partnerships at global scale—including content that launches first in the U.S. and subsequently expands to international markets. This requires deep fluency in MovieLabs (MDDF) specifications, content localization and multi\-territory delivery, and the ability to partner seamlessly across technical and business teams to formalize and document workflows that do not yet exist. **Responsibilities** **and Duties of the Role:** * Build, integrate, and manage high\-priority and/or high\-volume partnerships with our content providers, accountable for ensuring all relationship goals are met and contractual requirements are executed. * Independently identify and implement new and improved processes, frameworks, and governance that reflect team feedback, are agile, and will scale to meet business needs * Partner with Operations, and other PMO and delivery teams, to ensure successful delivery and launch of con t global scale, partnering with Content Acquisition, TPM, and Media Platform teams where established processes may not yet exist. * Serve as an operational lead in coordinating global launches across phased, first\-of\-kind rollouts—including U.S.\-first launches with subsequent international expansion, multi\-territory avails and takedowns, and market\-specific compliance—partnering across business and technical teams to deliver on time. * Lead operational and strategic process improvements across day\-to\-day workflows and cross\-functional initiatives, enhancing operational efficiency while ensuring scalability and alignment with business needs. * Proactively identify and manage risks, issues, and dependencies. Independently develop plans to escalate and mitigate. * Monitor partner compliance against terms and conditions. * Keep up\-to\-date with new technologies and recognize how it can impact CPM work/relationships. **Required Education, Experience/Skills/Training:** * BA/BS or equivalent experience * 7\+ years of partner management experience collaborating with both internal and external partners * Strong leadership skills with the proven ability to direct team members across multiple internal departments * Proven ability to build and maintain strong external partnerships, manage operational deliverables, and drive effective cross\-functional communication * Advanced knowledge of the streaming industry, streaming technology, content rights, content management systems, and other tools, processes and technologies involved in executing a world\-class streaming product * Ability to translate complex concepts between technology and business partners, including technical specifications related to content delivery and localization, and effectively communicate status updates to senior leadership * Deep working fluency in MovieLabs specifications (MDDF), including Media Manifest Core (MMC), Media Entertainment Core (MEC), and EMA Avails, with the ability to guide partners through their application to complex, component\-based content delivery * Hands\-on experience with content localization at scale—including dubbed audio, subtitles/timed text, forced narratives, and audio description—and the operational requirements of delivering localized content across multiple international territories * Experience supporting global or international content launches, including phased or day\-and\-date rollouts across multiple markets, and familiarity with territory\-specific compliance, ratings, and localization requirements * Proven ability to build, formalize, and document new cross\-functional processes in ambiguous, first\-of\-kind environments, partnering across technical (engineering, product, TPM) and business (content acquisition, partnerships, legal) stakeholders * Demonstrated excellence in an agile, fast\-paced and cross\-functional technology environment * Experience with platforms and tools such as JIRA, ServiceNow, content management systems, and program/product management software **Preferred:** * Experience in streaming, broadcast, or digital media distribution operations, including familiarity with streaming technologies and related operational workflows, strongly preferred. * Direct experience onboarding streaming content partners at scale, and familiarity with high\-volume, evolving content delivery models, strongly preferred The hiring range for this position in Santa Monica, CA is $105,100 to $140,900 per year based on a 40 hour work week. The amount of hours scheduled per week may vary based on business needs. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long\-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered.

jobs.title: Sr. Full-Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Title:** Sr. Full\-Stack Engineer **Team:** Engineering **Location:** Onsite \- Sawtelle (Between Santa Monica \& West LA) or San Francisco, CA **Employment Type:** Fulltime, Salary, Exempt **Reports To:** Engineering Lead **About Plug** -------------- Plug is an automotive fintech startup building the marketplace for electric vehicles. Consumers, dealers, and commercial partners trade in, sell, and auction used EVs through a platform built exclusively for electric, with nothing adapted from legacy automotive. Consumers can get an instant cash offer in minutes, backed by data\-driven pricing, battery state\-of\-health analysis, with pickup, payment, and title transfer handled end\-to\-end. Franchise and independent dealers across the United States bid in real time on inventory sourced directly from these consumers, dealers, and commercial partners. The result is a single platform that gives sellers a fast, fair exit and gives dealers a dedicated channel for sourcing used EV inventory. Founded in 2023 and led by former Tesla executives, Plug has facilitated $100M in EV sales since launch and is backed by a $20M Series A from Lightspeed Venture Partners. We're building the most AI\-native startup team in Los Angeles, full of operators, engineers, and ML researchers laying the transaction rails for the used EV market's exponential growth. **Why Plug** ------------ * You'll own a piece of the biggest infrastructure opportunity in automotive. * You'll work on a platform built exclusively for EVs, with nothing adapted from legacy automotive. * You'll be part of an AI\-native company. We're rethinking how work gets done at a fundamental level. * You'll work directly with operators who have scaled multi\-billion dollar businesses in automotive, EV, and marketplaces. * You'll have real ownership, high autonomy, and a direct line to company outcomes. **The Opportunity** ------------------- We are looking for a Senior Engineer to join our growing team! A senior full\-stack software engineer who will report to our engineering lead, and who will own entire customer\-facing or internal products. We're building systems like AI\-powered pricing intelligence, real\-time connectivity to vehicle manufacturer APIs, auction application, and data pipelines that aggregate EV\-specific information from dozens of sources \- all to make the wholesale EV market faster, smarter, and more transparent. As a member of the team you'll help lay the technical and product foundation for our growing business. We're building a culture that cares about collaboration, encourages intellectual honesty, celebrates technical excellence, and is driven by careful attention to detail and planning for the future. We believe diversity of perspective and experience are key to building great technology and a thriving team. Sounds cool? Let's work together. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * Collaborate with colleagues and be a strong voice in product design sessions, architecture discussions, and code reviews. * Design, implement, test, debug, and document work on new and existing software features and products, ensuring they meet business, quality, and operational needs. * Take ownership of features and products, and support their planning and development by understanding the ultimate goal and evaluating effort, risk, and priority in an agile environment. * Use agentic coding tools to write clear, efficient, and scalable code with an eye towards flexibility and maintainability. * Own and contribute to team productivity and process improvements. * Use and develop APIs to create integrations between Plug and 3rd party platforms. * Actively raise the technical bar of the team through thoughtful code review, pairing, and knowledge sharing \- including how you use AI tools. * Be an integral part of a close team of developers; this is an opportunity to help shape a nascent team culture. The ideal candidate will be a high\-growth individual able to grow their career as the team grows. **What You’ll Bring** --------------------- * 5\-8 years of hands\-on experience developing and delivering production applications. * Demonstrated proficiency in TypeScript across the full stack \- backend, frontend, relational databases, and API/webhook integrations. Temporal experience is a strong plus. * Hands\-on experience deploying and operating cloud\-hosted applications; comfort with infrastructure\-as\-code (we use Terraform), CI/CD pipelines, feature flags, and observability tooling. * Operates in agent\-first development workflows \- comfortable orchestrating multiple agents, defining clear acceptance criteria, and reviewing AI\-generated output with a high quality bar. * A strong engineering quality bar \- writing tests, conducting code reviews, producing code that is readable by both humans and AI agents, and communicating clearly in writing. * Considers cross\-surface and downstream implications of technical decisions \- writes code and designs systems that other engineers can understand, extend, and depend on. * Prior startup experience and a track record of owning work end\-to\-end: scoping, shipping, and measuring impact. * Authorized to work in the US for any employer. * Prior experience in automotive or EV systems is a plus. **Compensation and Benefits** ----------------------------- Annual salary: $175,000\-$215,000 *Salary ranges reflect independent, third\-party benchmarking against national compensation data. Where an individual's actual offer falls within that range depends on a combination of factors, including relevant experience, specialized skills, training and qualifications, current business needs, and prevailing market conditions. Ranges are reviewed periodically and may be adjusted to reflect changing market conditions.* **Benefits \& Perks:** * Health, Vision, and Dental insurance * 401(k) plan * Daily lunch stipend * Equity (based on role and performance) * 30\-day remote work from anywhere policy * Unlimited PTO * Fully stocked kitchen * Dog\-friendly office * Ongoing opportunities for growth and development This full\-time position is an in\-person role ideally based in Sawtelle (between Santa Monica and West Los Angeles). We are headquartered in Los Angeles and is our preferred location, with relocation assistance provided for successful candidates who need to relocate. Candidates already based in the San Francisco area will also be considered; relocation is not required for these candidates. Sponsorship is not available at this time. **Acknowledgments** Plug is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We believe diverse teams build better products \- full stop.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ FlowGen Labs is a frontier enterprise AI company building the zero\-touch enterprise: context\-aware agents that operate inside highly customized SAP environments at machine speed, grounded in each company’s ontology, live operational data, and operating procedures so complex workflows can run autonomously instead of relying on manual support teams. FlowGen is focused on turning legacy ERP from a system of record into an execution layer for finance and operations. Deployed at Fortune 500 companies across CPG, distribution, high tech, and oil and gas, FlowGen Labs brings together a frontier AI and SAP team from DeepMind, SAP, Meta AI, and Amazon AGI Labs. **Role Summary** ---------------- Define architecture, standards, and deliver solutions end to end. You will lead builds across Node.js services, AI and agent workflows, and integrations with enterprise systems, owning quality and reliability. Your work will directly impact how agents reason, take actions, and deliver outcomes at scale. **What We Are Looking For** --------------------------- * Strong experience building distributed systems or backend platforms in production environments. Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code using Terraform or CDK and strong observability with metrics, tracing, logs, and SLOs. * Proficiency with Postgres and experience with vector databases such as pgvector, Pinecone, or Milvus for retrieval and semantic search. * Experience orchestrating agentic workflows and retrieval augmented generation. * Hands on use of AI tools with clear ideas for applying AI to development, testing, data, and support. * Ownership mentality, crisp communication, comfortable deciding with 80 percent information. * Move fast without breaking things, not afraid to learn new stacks, bring a we will figure it out attitude. **Why Join** ------------ * Direct product and company impact with minimal bureaucracy. * High bar for craft, velocity, and pragmatic shipping. **Logistics** ------------- * Location: In person, San Francisco Bay Area * Visa Support/Sponsorship available Compensation Range: $225K \- $450K

jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
jobs.description: **About us** ------------ MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust. Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on. We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how. We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them. Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera. **The job** ----------- You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work. From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check\-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved. You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer. You are our first dedicated post\-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers. **About you** ------------- * You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job. * You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client\-delivery role. * You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum. * You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations. * You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew. * You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one. * You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy. * You are AI\-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them. * You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team. **Bonus** --------- * AI solutions engineer or forward\-deployed engineer background. * You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers. * Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi\-threading are part of the relationship. * Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on\-site meetings with technical and security leaders. **What we offer** ----------------- * Competitive base, variable, and significant equity. * Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership. * Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions. * Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first. *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

jobs.title: Transmission Engineer - I/II
jobs.description: Toth \& Associates, Inc. (TOTH) has an opening for a Transmission Engineer \- I/II. As a Transmission Engineer, you will design, analyze, and implement the conceptual, preliminary, and final design of transmission and distribution lines to ensure safe and reliable power delivery. You will work under the direction and mentorship of a Project Engineer to develop design calculations, drawings, specifications, and other documents for construction. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities:** * Conceptualize and design high\-voltage transmission lines, poles, and substation structures, performing structural, electrical, and load flow analyses to ensure system performance and reliability. * Utilize PLS\-CADD and other specialized software to create virtual models of transmission lines, generate structural designs, and develop staking plans. * Prepare appropriate materials lists for transmission components, considering factors like terrain, weather, and electrical load. * Ensure designs meet safety, reliability, and regulatory standards, including local, state, and federal regulations and industry codes like NESC. * Develop detailed staking sheets that specify pole or structure locations, dimensions, and configurations, providing critical information for field crews. * Assemble complete construction packages that include the plan and profile sheets, stringing charts, bills of materials, staking sheets, and foundation details. * Interface with clients, contractors, and other engineers to communicate technical details and support project execution. * Coordinate project timelines and provide technical support during construction and implementation of phases. * Review and provide quality assurance for engineering deliverables, ensuring the accuracy of all technical documents. * BSCE, BSME, or BSEE from an ABET\-accredited engineering program is required. * 1\+ years of experience in transmission line design preferred. * EIT certification and plan to obtain PE license. * Fundamental knowledge of transmission and distribution engineering principles, codes, and standards. * Strong organization and planning skills. * Excellent interpersonal and written communication skills. * Ability to work in a team environment. * Commitment to quality and accuracy. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills. * Good working knowledge of Excel and AutoCAD a plus. **Benefits:** * Paid time off (PTO) * Eight paid holidays * Paid bonding leave and paid bereavement leave * 401(k) w/company Safe Harbor, matching, and profit sharing * Discretionary bonuses * Cell phone plan * Company\-paid medical and dental insurance with buy\-up options * Company\-paid life/AD\&D insurance and long\-term disability insurance * Vision insurance * Short\-term disability insurance * Supplemental life/AD\&D insurance * FSA and HSA options * Educational assistance **Company Overview**: Toth and Associates, Inc. (TOTH) is a full\-service consulting engineering firm offering a broad range of services, including electric utility engineering, structural engineering, civil engineering, land services, GIS/mapping, utility rate services, and joint\-use/make\-ready support. Since our founding in 2003, we have grown to serve public and private utilities, municipalities, architects, developers, educational institutions, and other clients across the country. At TOTH, we believe strong relationships are the foundation of successful work. Our team is built on professional expertise, collaboration, and a commitment to serving both our clients and one another well. We value people, encourage continued growth, and strive to provide a workplace where employees can build meaningful, rewarding careers. TOTH offers competitive compensation, a comprehensive benefits package, professional development opportunities, and a supportive work environment. Visit www.tothassociates.com to learn more about our company.

jobs.title: Transmission Engineer - III/IV
jobs.description: Toth \& Associates, Inc. (TOTH) has an opening for a Transmission Engineer III/IV. As a Transmission Engineer III/IV, you will independently perform the design, analysis, and implementation of transmission line projects to ensure safe and reliable power delivery. You will apply advanced engineering principles to develop conceptual, preliminary, and final designs while coordinating with project teams, clients, and contractors. In this role, you will take increasing ownership of project deliverables, provide technical guidance to junior engineers and designers, and contribute to project planning and execution. Working under the general direction of a Project Engineer or Senior Project Engineer, you will lead portions of projects, support quality initiatives, and help develop engineering best practices across the organization. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities:** * Independently design high\-voltage transmission lines, poles, and related structures while performing structural, electrical, and line performance analyses. * Utilize PLS\-CADD, PLS\-POLE, AutoCAD, and other engineering software to develop detailed transmission line models and construction designs. * Prepare design calculations, engineering reports, construction packages, foundation recommendations, and material specifications. * Develop and review staking sheets, plan and profile drawings, structure loading trees, stringing charts, and bills of materials. * Ensure designs comply with applicable local, state, and federal regulations, NESC requirements, client standards, and industry best practices. * Serve as the engineer responsible for specific project tasks, schedules, budgets, and technical deliverables. * Coordinate with survey, environmental, geotechnical, and construction personnel to support project execution. * Perform quality control reviews of engineering drawings, calculations, and design packages. * Provide engineering support during construction, respond to field questions, and assist with resolving technical issues. * Interface directly with clients, contractors, utilities, and project stakeholders to communicate design solutions and project progress. * Mentor and provide technical guidance to Engineer I and II employees, supporting training and professional development efforts. * Assist Project Engineers and Senior Project Engineers in developing project scopes, schedules, proposals, and client relationships. * Identify opportunities to improve design processes, efficiency, and technical standards within the transmission engineering group. **Required Qualifications:** * BSCE, BSME, or BSEE from an ABET\-accredited engineering program required. * Engineer\-in\-Training (EIT) certification required. * 3–6 years of progressive transmission line design experience. * Demonstrated experience utilizing transmission design software, including PLS\-CADD and related applications. * Working knowledge of transmission engineering principles, structural analysis, NESC requirements, and utility design standards. * Ability to independently perform engineering calculations and develop complete design packages. * Strong communication, organization, and project coordination skills. * Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with project teams and mentor junior staff. * Actively pursuing Professional Engineer (PE) licensure. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Engineer\-in\-Training (EIT) or Professional Engineer (PE) licensure, or ability to obtain licensure. * Experience designing medium and high\-voltage substation systems for utility or industrial clients. * Working knowledge of ANSI, IEEE, NEMA, and NESC (ANSI C2\) standards related to substation design. * Experience in ground grid design using SES\-CDEGS software. * Experience reviewing and mentoring junior engineering staff. **Benefits:** * Paid time off (PTO) * Eight paid holidays * Paid bonding leave and paid bereavement leave * 401(k) w/company Safe Harbor, matching, and profit sharing * Discretionary bonuses * Cell phone plan * Company\-paid medical and dental insurance with buy\-up options * Company\-paid life/AD\&D insurance and long\-term disability insurance * Vision insurance * Short\-term disability insurance * Supplemental life/AD\&D insurance * FSA and HSA options * Educational assistance **Company Overview**: Toth and Associates, Inc. (TOTH) is a full\-service consulting engineering firm offering a broad range of services, including electric utility engineering, structural engineering, civil engineering, land services, GIS/mapping, utility rate services, and joint\-use/make\-ready support. Since our founding in 2003, we have grown to serve public and private utilities, municipalities, architects, developers, educational institutions, and other clients across the country. At TOTH, we believe strong relationships are the foundation of successful work. Our team is built on professional expertise, collaboration, and a commitment to serving both our clients and one another well. We value people, encourage continued growth, and strive to provide a workplace where employees can build meaningful, rewarding careers. TOTH offers competitive compensation, a comprehensive benefits package, professional development opportunities, and a supportive work environment.
