jobs.title: Technical Support Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Overview** Experlogix is a leading provider of Configure, Price, Quote (CPQ) software solutions that empower businesses to streamline their sales processes and drive revenue growth. Our innovative technology integrates seamlessly with ERP and CRM systems, providing our clients with comprehensive solutions to optimize their sales operations. **Position: Technical Support Engineer** **Location:** US or Canada Remote Do you enjoy digging into technical problems and finding creative solutions? Are you passionate about technology and interested in learning how complex software systems work? If so, we'd love to hear from you. This is an exciting opportunity to develop your technical troubleshooting skills while working with enterprise software used by organizations around the world. You'll gain hands\-on experience with leading CRM and ERP platforms, SQL Server, web technologies, and cloud\-hosted applications—all while building highly transferable technical skills. This is not your typical call center support position. You'll work alongside experienced technical professionals to troubleshoot customer issues, collaborate with Engineering and Professional Services, and continually expand your technical expertise in a supportive, team\-oriented environment. Experlogix is seeking a Technical Support Engineer with strong technical aptitude and a passion for solving software problems. The ideal candidate enjoys understanding how software works, is comfortable troubleshooting databases, web applications, and integrations, and has experience with .NET technologies—or a strong desire to learn them. In this role, you'll provide high\-quality technical support for our CPQ software and its integrations with ERP and CRM platforms while working closely with teammates to resolve customer issues and grow your technical knowledge. This is a remote position and can be located anywhere within the United States or Canada. **Responsibilities** * Serve as a technical support resource for customer deployments and upgrades, providing timely and effective resolutions that contribute to customer success. * Diagnose and troubleshoot issues related to Experlogix CPQ software, SQL Server databases, ERP and CRM integrations, and web\-based applications. * Collaborate with Product Development, Professional Services, and other cross\-functional teams to investigate and resolve technical issues. * Develop and maintain technical expertise in Experlogix products, Microsoft technologies, ERP systems, CRM platforms, and SQL Server. * Document troubleshooting steps, root causes, and resolutions within the company knowledge base. * Identify recurring issues and provide feedback that improves product quality, support processes, and customer experiences. * Participate in ongoing technical training and knowledge\-sharing sessions to continually expand your technical skill set. * Escalate complex or product\-related issues appropriately while maintaining ownership of customer communication and follow\-through. **Skills \& Qualifications** * 1\+ year of experience in technical support, application support, software development, IT support, or a similar technical role. * Experience supporting enterprise software solutions such as Microsoft Dynamics, Salesforce, NetSuite, or other ERP and CRM platforms is preferred but not required. * Basic to intermediate understanding of Microsoft SQL Server, including the ability to write SQL queries for troubleshooting and data analysis. * Working knowledge of web server technologies such as Internet Information Services (IIS), Windows Server, Apache, or similar platforms. * Familiarity with web technologies including XML, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and REST\-based APIs. * Exposure to object\-oriented programming concepts or scripting languages is helpful. Experience with .NET is a plus, but a willingness to learn is equally valued. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to investigate technical issues, identify potential causes, and determine appropriate solutions. * Experience configuring virtual machines and remote desktop connections is helpful. * Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences. * Curiosity, persistence, and a passion for learning new technologies and solving technical problems. * Customer\-focused mindset with a commitment to delivering exceptional service. * Certifications related to Microsoft SQL Server, Microsoft Dynamics, Salesforce, Azure, or CPQ technologies are a plus but not required. **Find Your Passion at Experlogix** At Experlogix, we strive to create a culture of engaged, collaborative team members who are passionate about solving problems and helping customers succeed. We believe in building careers—not just filling jobs—and provide opportunities for continuous learning, professional development, and internal growth. Our purpose is to fuel your passion through rewarding work, meaningful challenges, and opportunities to make an impact. See why we were recognized as a Top 10 Microsoft Dynamics Marketplace solution and one of the best software and service companies in Silicon Slopes. **Our Company** Experlogix is a rapidly growing, award\-winning leader in Configure, Price, Quote (CPQ) technology. We specialize in fully integrated quote and order automation solutions for Microsoft Dynamics, Salesforce, and NetSuite. With offices in the United States, Canada, Belgium, and the Netherlands, along with remote team members around the globe, we're committed to delivering innovative solutions and exceptional customer experiences. **Benefits** * Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance * Life Insurance * Voluntary Disability Insurance * Health Savings Account (HSA) and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) * 401(k) with Company Match * Teladoc Virtual Healthcare * Health Advocate Program * Paid Holidays and Generous PTO—we encourage you to use it! * Flexible work environment with accountability and trust * Opportunities for ongoing technical learning and career advancement

jobs.title: Associate Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: ***\*\*\* Please note that this is a HYBRID role, requiring this person to work at our Cottonwood Heights office in SLC three days a week. We are not able to provide work sponsorship (i.e. OPT or H\-1B visa) for this role \*\*\**** Site Reliability Engineers keep the platforms behind Extra Space Storage's applications available, fast, and secure. SRE owns the AWS environments those applications run in, the pipelines that deploy them, the telemetry that proves they are healthy, and the response when they are not. This is the entry level of the SRE track. You will own scoped infrastructure and automation work inside established standards, pipelines, and runbooks, and grow into owning initiatives start to finish. You will spend more time automating operational work than performing it. **Duties \& Responsibilities** * Operate and improve AWS infrastructure across a multi\-account environment, covering compute, containers, networking, databases, and identity, using infrastructure as code rather than console changes * Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions, including reusable workflows, composite actions, and OIDC\-based deployment roles, and help migrate remaining legacy pipelines onto that platform * Instrument service level indicators and objectives in Datadog, and improve dashboards, alerting, log pipelines, and APM coverage so problems surface before customers report them * Take a full share of the team's on\-call rotation, drive incidents to restoration, and contribute to blameless postmortems and the follow\-up work they generate * Remediate security findings from sources such as Tenable, CrowdStrike, and AWS Security Hub, and own a piece of monthly patching and vulnerability work through production deployment * Automate recurring operational work such as access provisioning, credential rotation, patch cycles, and environment standup and teardown, with the goal of removing the task rather than speeding it up * Support product teams as an infrastructure partner on environment builds, deployment troubleshooting, and cost and performance questions * Write and maintain runbooks, architecture notes, and self\-service documentation so other engineering teams can move without waiting on SRE * Use AI\-assisted development and triage tooling as part of normal engineering practice, and help evaluate where it can safely reduce operational toil **Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education, training, and hands\-on experience. Non\-traditional paths including bootcamps, military technical training, internal transfers, and self\-taught candidates with a demonstrable portfolio are considered. * 2\+ years of software engineering, IT operations, or infrastructure experience preferred. Internship, service desk, or systems administration experience with demonstrated automation work counts toward this. **Competencies** * Proficient in at least one language used by the team: PowerShell, Python, TypeScript, or C\#/.NET * Working knowledge of a public cloud, preferably AWS, including core compute, storage, networking, and identity services and how they fit together * Infrastructure as code experience or strong demonstrated interest (AWS CDK, CloudFormation, or Terraform), plus comfort with Git\-based workflows, pull requests, and code review * Familiarity with containers and serverless patterns (ECS/Fargate, ECR, Lambda) and with relational databases on a managed service such as RDS * Exposure to observability tooling (Datadog, CloudWatch, or equivalent) and an instinct for what makes a system measurable * Understanding of network and security principles, including least\-privilege IAM, secrets handling, and frameworks such as CIS and OWASP * Clear written communication. Documentation, ticket updates, and incident notes are a substantial part of the job * Willingness to carry a full share of the 24/7 on\-call rotation described below, and to work occasional scheduled maintenance windows outside business hours **On\-Call** Every engineer on the team, at every level, carries an equal share of the on\-call rotation. The cycle runs in three stages: * One week as 24/7 primary, taking first response for all pages * One week as 24/7 secondary, backing up the primary and picking up escalations * Off rotation until the cycle comes back around to you **Work Environment \& Physical Requirements** Performs sedentary work in an office environment with limited lifting (less than 10 pounds) or walking required. Close visual acuity required to perform work at computer terminal. No exposure to adverse environmental conditions. Requires repetitive typing motion, talking, hearing, grasping and feeling. Disclaimer *The job description outlines the general nature and scope of work employees perform in this role. It's not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications required for the position. The company reserves the right to modify, revise, or update the job description to meet business needs* **If you are a current Extra Space employee, please apply through Jobs Hub in Workday.** ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Applications Deadline: Applications will be accepted until the position is filled.

pipelines for ingesting, processing, and transforming large\-scale datasets. * Assist with logical data model development, and update where applicable (nice to have) * Develop, maintain, document and building and maintaining scalable data pipelines (batch and streaming). * Advanced knowledge of data modeling, ETL/ELT design patterns, and data architecture best practices. * Experience with cloud data platforms and distributed data processing frameworks. * Hands\-on experience with relational and/or NoSQL database technologies. * Experience implementing data quality, validation, and monitoring frameworks. * Hands\-on experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines for data workflows. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with Azure data services (e.g., Azure Data Factory, Synapse, Databricks). * Experience with Snowflake or other equivalent data warehouse or data platforms * Strong SQL expertise, including performance tuning and security model implementation. * Experience with big data technologies such as Spark or Kafka. * Familiarity with data orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow). * Experience integrating observability and monitoring into data pipelines. * Knowledge of data governance, lineage, and metadata management tools. * Prior experience working with Python\-based data processing or optimization workflows. * Experience with Palantir Foundry, Ontologies, or similar enterprise data platforms * Strong problem\-solving skills and ability to work in fast\-paced, Agile environments. * Excellent communication and collaboration skills across technical and business teams. **Your benefits** ----------------- An ExxonMobil career is one designed to last. jobs.title: Property Damage Specialist
jobs.description: The Property Damage Specialist position reports to Tampa, FL, or Nashville, TN, with the potential to work remotely full\-time. As a **Property Damage Specialist**, you will be responsible for investigating, evaluating, negotiating, disposing, and settling specialized auto and/or renters property claims and determining legal liability, damages, and coverage. Assigned specialty claims may involve adverse subrogation received on a single\-vehicle or multiple\-vehicle losses, uninsured/underinsured PD motorist claims, auto fire and theft claims, personal property and personal liability renters’ claims, and/or complex coverage issues requiring direct involvement in property damage claim handling with minimal supervision. Position develops all potential exposures in the file and properly sets expense and indemnity reserves. The property damage specialist is responsible to protect our Insured and the Company’s financial exposures. **RESPONSIBILITIES** * Plans and conducts investigations, including but not limited to, interviewing parties involved, collecting and evaluating documentation, securing evidence and protecting the chain\-of\-custody, determining inspection needs, ordering police reports, scene investigation, taking witness statements, obtaining affidavits, and contents sheets, and reviewing damage photos; * Analyzes coverage and determines liability, compensability, and the extent of damages. Assumes responsibility for assigned claims, including attorney\-represented and non\-represented parties, for both first\- and third\-party claimants. * Demonstrates a high level of investigation, analysis, evaluation, and negotiation, including interpretation of coverages. * Adheres to proper procedures relating to inspection and evaluation of property damage claims and making recommendations for the disposition of claims more than individual settlement authority. * Evaluates policy coverage contact insureds, claimants, attorneys, body shops, and/or other insurance carriers while determining and establishing reserve requirements. * Document computer log with results of review and intentions for handling Compiles information for decision\-making with a discussion of the claims committee where appropriate. * Maintains accurate records and handles administrative responsibilities associated with processing and payment of claims, records and updates status notes, and documents results of contacts per best practices. * Determines the need for independent adjusters, cause and origin experts, economists, accident re\-constructionists, and engineers. * Responds timely and appropriately to all settlement demands. * Keeps internal and external customers advised of file status and other matters, as required. * Evaluates claims for potential fraud and works with Special Investigations Unit, as required. * Assesses actual damages associated with claims and conduct negotiations to settle claims. * Determines if subrogation exists and takes steps necessary to initiate recovery efforts. * Works seamlessly between multiple claim systems and platforms. Performs other duties as assigned. **JOB REQUIREMENTS** * Bachelor’s degree in a related field is preferred or equivalent experience; * High school diploma or equivalent required. * Minimum of two (2\) years of property claims handling experience or related fields. * Exceptional evaluation and judgment skills are required. * Must possess strong customer service skills and behaviors. * Ability to make decisions in an informed, confident, and timely manner. * Ability to maintain constructive working relationships despite differing perspectives. Strong organizational and time management skills. * Ability to negotiate skillfully in difficult situations with both internal and external groups. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, which promotes and facilitates free and open communication. * Understanding of applicable statutes, regulations, and case law. * Critical thinking skills and ability to anticipate, recognize, identify, and develop solutions to problems promptly. * Experience with subrogation laws and platforms such as Arbitration Forums preferred. * Experience with renters or homeowners and other personal liability exposures preferred. * Experience with auto fire or theft investigations preferred. * Ability to easily adapt to new or different changing situations, requirements, or priorities. * Demonstrated ability to cultivate an environment of teamwork and collaboration. * Ability to work independently and operate with latitude for un\-reviewed action or decisions. * Computer proficiency (MS Office, excel, word, etc.). * Must have or secure and maintain appropriate state adjuster license(s) and continuing education credits. **PHYSICAL DEMANDS**: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to perform the essential functions of this job successfully. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to do manual tasks, which may include the use of hands to finger and handle controls. Tasks may also require the ability to talk or hear. The employee will frequently sit, bend, and reach with hands and arms and is occasionally required to stand and walk. The employee may occasionally lift and/or move up to 10 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, and the ability to adjust focus. Other abilities include possessing the capacity to learn, concentrate, think, and read. Oftentimes the employee will be communicating and interacting with others while working. ***To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. jobs.title: Solutions Architect
jobs.description: **About Flow** Flow Engineering is an AI\-native requirements platform for modern engineering organizations, enabling hardware teams to collaborate with AI agents to design, validate, and evolve complex systems with speed and rigor. **About the role** Flow is seeking a Solutions Architect (Sales Engineer) to be the technical partner in our sales process. Our buyers are systems and engineering leaders at aerospace, defense, automotive, and hardware companies, and they need to see how Flow fits their real workflows before they commit. You will run technical discovery, demos, and pilots, and you will be the person who can answer the hard questions in the room. This role pairs closely with our account executives. They own the commercial relationship, and you own the technical win: showing the product, mapping it to the customer's engineering process, and making sure a pilot proves out what it needs to. **What you'll do** * Partner with account executives on discovery calls, technical demos, and pilots, from first technical conversation through to a signed deal. * Understand each customer's engineering workflow and requirements process, then show how Flow fits it. * Build and run demos and proofs of concept that reflect the customer's actual use case rather than a generic script. * Answer technical and security questions from engineering, IT, and security teams, and complete security questionnaires with support from the team. * Work with product and engineering to feed back what customers need and where the product should go next. * Partner with forward deployed engineers to hand off pilots cleanly into deployment. **About you** * 4\+ years in sales engineering, solutions engineering, forward deployed engineering, or a technical customer\-facing role. * Comfortable running a technical room, from individual engineers up to VPs, and adjusting the conversation to each. * Strong technical foundation: you can reason about APIs, integrations, and how software fits into an existing engineering stack. * Able to translate between what a customer says they need and what the product actually does. * Comfortable in a fast\-moving environment where the sales motion and the product are both still taking shape. **Nice to have** * Familiarity with requirements, systems engineering, PLM, or ALM tooling (Jama, DOORS, etc.) * Background in or selling into defense, aerospace, or regulated hardware environments. Compensation Range: $160K \- $210K

Do you thrive on building high\-performing engineering teams while staying close to the technology itself? jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer – Core OS, Vehicle Compute
jobs.description: **Job Description** *At General Motors, our product teams are redefining mobility. Through a human\-centered design process, we create vehicles and experiences that are designed not just to be seen, but to be felt.* *We’re* *turning* *today’s* *impossible into tomorrow’s standard —from breakthrough hardware and battery systems to intuitive design, intelligent software, and next\-generation safety and entertainment features* *.* *Every day, our products move millions of people as we aim to make driving safer, smarter, and more connected, shaping the future of transportation on a global scale* **The Role** The Core OS group is a newly formed team building the operating\-system foundation GM's next generation of vehicle software runs on: hypervisors and virtualization, safety partitioning and health management, container runtime and workload orchestration, and the boot and secure\-boot chain that let Linux, Android, and QNX share a single high\-compute platform safely and efficiently. As Principal Software Engineer, you are the senior technical authority and system architect for that layer — you'll determine which platform problems matter most, then define the architecture and drive the solutions that solve them, setting long\-term direction for virtualization, partitioning, and platform services across GM's vehicle compute. Your influence extends well past your own code: establishing the technical interfaces to the silicon, guest OS, and functional\-safety organizations, driving decisions with hypervisor and silicon partners, and guiding engineers across multiple teams toward a foundation that must hold up to production performance, reliability, and safety requirements in millions of vehicles. **What** **You’ll** **Do** * Define and drive the architecture and long\-term roadmap for GM’s Core OS layer, including hypervisors, virtualization, virtual machine lifecycle, resource partitioning, inter\-virtual\-machine communication, and the boot and secure\-boot chain. * Architect the multi\-operating\-system foundation that enables embedded Linux, including Yocto\-based distributions, Android, and QNX to run on shared vehicle compute with consistent platform services and interfaces. * Establish the platform safety architecture, including freedom from interference between partitions, health monitoring, fault detection and recovery, in partnership with functional safety and cybersecurity organizations. * Define the container and workload\-management architecture for on\-vehicle execution, including isolation, lifecycle management, resource governance, and updateability. * Own the system\-level performance strategy across compute efficiency, latency, boot time, memory footprint, and deterministic behavior, and lead optimization efforts across software and hardware boundaries. * Drive build\-versus\-buy and technology\-selection decisions for hypervisor, real\-time operating system, and runtime components, and lead technical relationships with the corresponding suppliers. * Provide technical mentorship and direction to Staff and Senior Software Engineers while establishing engineering standards and review practices for the new organization. * Lead complex investigations and root\-cause analyses across virtualization, operating\-system , and silicon boundaries. Represent Core OS in technical councils, architecture reviews, and cross\-functional design forums, and define ownership boundaries with adjacent platform teams. **Your Skills \& Abilities (Required Qualifications)** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer S cience , Electric al Engineering, Com puter E ngineering, or a related field; or equivalent experience. * Fifteen or more years of experience in embedded, kernel\-level, or systems software development, including produ ction\-gra de systems. * Proven experience architecting operating\-system or virtualization plat forms for high\-performance or safety\-critical systems. * Deep expert ise in at least two of the following areas: * Type 1 hypervisors and virtualization * Real\-time operating systems * Embedded Linux internals * Secure boot and platform integrity * Strong knowledge of Arm system\-on\-chip (SoC) architecture, including memory management, interrupt and input/output virtualization, and hardware\-enforced isolation mechanisms. * Experience leading multi\-team or cross\-functional technical programs from concept through production. * Proficien cy with modern development tools and practices, including Git, GitHub, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), automated testing, and performance profiling. * Strong communication and influence skills across technical , cross\-fun ctional, and executive audiences. **What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)** * Master’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Co mputer En gineering, or a related field. * Hands\-on architecture experience with hypervisor technolog ies such as Gunyah, QNX Hypervi droid Automotive, and QNX Software Development Platform (SDP) as guest or host environments. * Familiarity with health monitoring, fail\-operational and fail\-safe mechanisms, and platform\-resiliency design. * Experience with Adaptive Automotive Open System Architecture (AUTOSAR), Software Defined Vehicle Open Architecture for Embedded Edge (SOAFEE), or comparable automotive platform standards. * Experience with over \-the\-air (OTA) and continuous\-update architectures . * Contributions to open\-source virtualization or operating\-system projects. * Proven ability to set technical vision, influence across organizations, and represent a company in cross\-industry engagements. **Compensation:** The compensation information is a good faith estimate only. It is based on what a successful applicant might be paid in accordance with applicable state laws. The salary range for this role is **$216,400 –$450,400** . The actual base salary offered within this range will vary based on factors relevant to the position, as well as the selected candidate’s geography. **Benefits:** GM offers a variety of health and wellbeing benefit programs. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google Cloud's needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast\-paced business grow and evolve. You will anticipate our customer needs and be empowered to act like an owner, take action and innovate. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full\-stack as we continue to push technology forward. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $207000 \- $300000 (USD) \+ 20% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Lead the design and implementation of solutions in specialized ML areas, optimize ML infrastructure, and guide the development of model optimization and data processing strategies. * Define the multi\-year technical vision and architectural roadmap for high\-efficiency, formally verified systems across Google Cloud CISO. * Lead the end\-to\-end architecture and implementation of distributed transactional systems, storage layers, and query engines built in Rust and verified with Verus. Formulate verification strategies for complex, multi\-component distributed protocols, proving correctness, fault tolerance, and data integrity under arbitrary failure modes. * Lead initiatives to replace bug\-prone, resource\-heavy legacy components with formally verified, resource\-efficient alternatives across internal and open\-source infrastructure. Partner with VP\-level and Principal engineering leadership to establish organization\-wide verification standards, security baselines, and developer tooling. jobs.title: Senior Solutions Engineer, Acquisition | West Coast | Remote
jobs.description: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40\+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X. We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open\-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation\-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do. You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career\-defining opportunity. #### **The Opportunity:** #### **Make a difference.** Are you looking for something new in your career? Enjoy a challenge? Love to innovate and learn? This is an exciting opportunity to join a technology startup in a high growth phase. Our Enterprise Solutions Engineering team are our in\-house, customer\-facing product experts. The Enterprise SE team enables Grafana Labs worldwide growth by educating potential and existing customers to ensure they are happy and successful. We share our technical and product expertise with customers through demos, hands\-on enablement, presentations, technical evaluations and ongoing interaction. We also partner closely with our Sales team to help qualify and close opportunities. The Enterprise SE team is also one of the primary routes of communication from our customers through into the Product Management and Engineering teams. **What You’ll Be Doing:** * Join as an early member of a high growth team working together to solve technical and customer problems the right way * Partner with our Sales team to articulate the overall Grafana value proposition, vision, and strategy to customers * Own the technical engagement with customers and help to close high\-velocity opportunities through advanced competitive knowledge, technical skill, and credibility * Deliver product and technical presentations to potential and existing customers * Proactively communicate with customers and internal teams to provide a feedback loop on our products and the competitive landscape * Drive product conversations based on need and problems learned during customer interactions * Work with the team to enhance documentation, write blog posts, record videos, contribute knowledge base articles, and create other public and internal enablement material **What Makes You a Great Fit:** * Ideally located on the West Coast * 5\+ years of technical pre\-sales experience, ideally with Open Source technologies, or in the Metrics/Monitoring space while we will be adding more junior folks later on, right now we just need team members that can hit the ground running. * We’re a startup so your job duties will be varied and complex and will require strong judgment, collaboration, and leadership * We are a remote\-first company so you would need to learn to work and collaborate with an international team * You will need first class written and oral communication skills to collaborate with our remote\-first internal teams and with our worldwide customers. You will need to be able to skillfully articulate our value proposition and the technical advantages of our products * You will love solving technical challenges and thrive on bringing creative solutions to our customers * You should have a technical mindset and a desire to grow technically. Great candidates may be a recent grad of a coding bootcamp or have previous post\-sales or engineering experience–we are excited to see what unique experiences and skill sets you bring to the table! * You are self\-motivated, initiative, creative, and maybe you’ve already done a brave thing or two in your life! **Compensation \& Rewards:** In the United States the OTE (On\-Target Earnings) compensation range for this role is $204,000 \- $254,000\. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally. * *Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range \& benefits at the beginning of the process.* **Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:** * **100% Remote, Global Culture \-** As a remote\-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose. * **Scaling Organization** – Tackle meaningful work in a high\-growth, ever\-evolving environment. * **Transparent Communication** – Expect open decision\-making and regular company\-wide updates. * **Innovation\-Driven** – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things. * **Open Source Roots** – Built on community\-driven values that shape how we work. * **Empowered Teams** – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics. * **Career Growth Pathways** – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career. * **Approachable Leadership** – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human. * **Passionate People** – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do. * **In\-Person onboarding** \- We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it. * **Balance is Key** \- We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *\*We will comply with local legislation where applicable.* **Equal Opportunity Employer:** *Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.* *Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.* \#LI\-Remote *For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our* *privacy policy**.*

jobs.title: Engineer Intern Applicant - Engineer Intern 2
jobs.description: **About this Job** ------------------ At the Louisiana Department of Transportation and Development (DOTD), we plan, build, maintain, and protect the transportation systems that connect communities, support commerce, and keep Louisiana moving. Please visit our DOTD Career Center for more information about our agency. DOTD is seeking a **Construction Engineer** to support transportation projects and programs through construction project delivery, field engineering, construction documentation, contractor coordination, and review of work performed in accordance with DOTD standards and specifications. This position supports the development, delivery, maintenance, or improvement of transportation infrastructure by applying engineering principles, conducting technical analysis, coordinating projects, and conducting compliance\-related reviews. No prior engineering experience is required — training is provided, with opportunities for career progression and advancement through the Engineering job series. Positions are located in Bossier Parish**,** and report to the **Engineer 6**. **Minimum Qualifications** -------------------------- Eligibility for a Louisiana Engineer Intern Certificate. NOTE: This is a temporary position to be utilized while the incumbent is securing a Louisiana Engineer Intern certificate. Permanent status shall be denied to incumbents occupying this position. NOTE: Louisiana Engineer Intern Certificates are issued by the Louisiana Professional Engineering and Land Surveying Board. Licensing requirements may be viewed at www.lapels.com. **Job Specification** --------------------- The official job specifications for this role, as defined by the State Civil Service, can be found here. **Job Duties and Other Information** ------------------------------------ **Job Duties:** Depending on level and assignment, Engineer Intern Applicant\-Engineer Intern 2 may: * Performs engineering studies or analyses related to traffic operations, safety, signals, or traffic control. * Reviews or prepares traffic reports, signal plans, safety studies, operational analyses, or technical documentation. * Supports evaluation of traffic patterns, safety concerns, roadway operations, or mobility improvements. * Coordinates with DOTD districts, project teams, consultants, local officials, and other stakeholders. * Uses traffic engineering software, data systems, or technical tools to analyze operational needs. * Assists with recommendations related to traffic control, signal systems, safety improvements, or operational changes. * Applies applicable standards, policies, and procedures related to traffic engineering and transportation operations. * Supports emergency or incident response activities as needed. **Position Specific Details:** **Career Progression:** This position is part of a Career Progression Group and may be filled as an Engineer Intern Applicant, Engineer Intern 1, or Engineer Intern 2\. **Compensation:** The following reflects the beginning biweekly salary for each level. A Special Entrance Rate (SER) may apply to qualifying positions. * Engineer Intern Applicant – $1,923\.20 biweekly * Engineer Intern 1 – SER at $2,692\.80 biweekly * Engineer Intern 2 – SER at $2,881\.60 biweekly **Appointment Type:** This position may be filled as a job appointment or probational appointment. A job appointment is a temporary appointment that may last up to 36 months. If filled as a job appointment, the position may be converted to a probational appointment in the future. **Upcoming Graduates:** Applications will be accepted from applicants who are within 90 days of graduation. Any offer of employment will be contingent upon verification and confirmation that the applicant has received a qualifying degree. If selected, the applicant will be eligible to begin work the day after graduation. The selected candidate will be required to submit an official transcript confirming graduation within 60 days of hire. **Additional Information:** This posting may be used to fill multiple vacancies. Applicants with the following are encouraged to apply: **How To Apply:** **No Civil Service test score** is required in order to be considered for this vacancy. To apply for this vacancy, click on the "Apply" link above and complete an electronic application, which can be used for this vacancy as well as future job opportunities. Applicants are responsible for checking the status of their application to determine where they are in the recruitment process. Further status message information is located under the Information section of the Current Job Opportunities page. Applicants can check the status of their application at any time by selecting the ‘Application Status’ link after logging into their account. **\***Resumes WILL NOT be accepted in lieu of completed education and experience sections on your application. Applications may be rejected if incomplete.**\*** **Contact Information:** For further information about this vacancy, contact: DeMarcion Evans Project Engineer/Bossier 318\-747\-5470 Demarcion.evans@la.gov *The Louisiana Department of Transportation and Development (DOTD) is an equal employment opportunity employer and serves as a model employer for individuals with disabilities. DOTD does not discriminate in employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, political affiliation, disability, age, or pregnancy, and prohibits harassment of any type.* *Information on the Louisiana Workforce Commission, Louisiana Rehabilitation Services is available:**https://www.laworks.net/workforcedev/lrs/lrs\_rehabilitation.asp* Louisiana is a State As a Model Employer (SAME) that supports the recruitment, hiring, and retention of individuals with disabilities.

jobs.title: IT STATEWIDE APPLICATIONS SENIOR DEVELOPER 1/2/3 (APPDM SAFETY POS #50699104)
jobs.description: **About this Job** ------------------ The Division of Administration/Office of Technology Services has a vacancy. This position is located in the Applications and Data Management Section. Req. 226086 The Office of Technology Services (OTS) aims to be a responsible partner in delivering innovative, effective, and reliable solutions that support and enhance the IT functions within the Executive Branch Departments. The Office of Technology Services will work to increase the return on the State's investment in technology by promoting smart decision\-making, solving problems intelligently, increasing the rate of project success, and fostering a skilled and professional staff. The incumbent is responsible for working closely with third\-party vendors and executive management to ensure the consistent delivery of IT services. The Division of Administration is the state government’s management arm and the hub of its financial operations. Division offices perform a wide variety of activities, including the following: * Overseeing the state’s capital construction program * Working to provide state and federal grants for community development * Development of the state budget * Providing technology services * Giving agencies guidance in the state purchasing and contracting process as they seek goods and services * Administering a program that provides federal funds to help Louisiana residents recover from a series of devastating hurricanes **Minimum Qualifications** -------------------------- Five years of experience in information technology; OR Six years of full\-time work experience in any field plus three years of experience in information technology; OR An associate's degree in information technology plus three years of experience in information technology; OR A bachelor’s degree plus three years of experience in information technology; OR A bachelor’s degree with twenty\-four semester hours in an information technology, computer science, engineering, mathematics, or business analytics field plus two years of experience in information technology; OR A master’s degree plus two years of experience in information technology. EXPERIENCE SUBSTITUTION: Every 30 semester hours earned from an accredited college or university will be credited as one year of experience towards the six years of full\-time work experience in any field. The maximum substitution allowed is 120 semester hours which substitutes for a maximum of four years of experience in any field. NOTE: A certification in an approved area may be substituted for the education and/or experience requirements at the time of hire or promotion, provided the appointment is made from a Certificate of Eligibles. **Job Specification** --------------------- The official job specifications for this role, as defined by the State Civil Service, can be found here. **Job Duties and Other Information** ------------------------------------ Job Duties: Performs technical consultant functions for multiple, highly complex assigned program areas and applications. Provides systems and technical expertise on project to various management levels involving the development of information technology to support various program sections. Reviews requests for information services, recommend the most efficient and effective of accomplishment and present findings to various management levels. Provides technical expertise in analyzing, defining, acquiring, and implementing application software packages, office automation software, security and administration programs, and quality assurance reviews. Provide consulting services of effective use of the development methodology for information systems to ensure that the most effective designs are utilized to best support the needs of management. Provides development, maintenance, and troubleshooting of highly complex computer applications systems as required. Provides expert advice, assistance and guidance for development of applications and recommendations for database architecture. Designs, codes, compiles, tests, debugs, modifies and documents new or existing applications using the OTS technology stack to conform to AppDM accepted standards, procedures and guidelines. Conducts meetings, creates action items, compiles meeting summaries and follows up with team members for completion of those tasks critical to project success. Functions in the capacity of higher level Information Technology management, as directed, in their absence. Responds to computer system emergencies and resolves problems independently or in consultation with other Information Technology applications staff and/or end user personnel. Researches and resolves program, machine, data, or system software problems of a highly technical nature, frequently interacting with other employees, supervisors, or users. Performs all other tasks, special projects, analysis, studies, and plans as directed. Position\-Specific Details: **Appointment Type:** This vacancy will be filled by a new hire or by promotion of a current permanent status classified employee. **Career Progression:** This vacancy participates in a career progression group and may be filled from this recruitment as an IT Statewide Applications Senior Developer 1, 2, or 3\. **Location**: This is a full\-time, on\-site position located in the Greater Baton Rouge area. This position may require travel to other work locations to perform job duties, attend meetings, and participate in training, which will require a current, valid driver's license. *Louisiana is a "State as a Model Employer" for People with Disabilities.* Substitution: Applicants who do not meet the minimum education or experience qualification may receive experience credit from Civil Service approved certifications for up to two years of experience, which may substitute for the bachelor's degree. Please see the list of approved Certifications for Substitutions athttps://www.doa.la.gov/doa/ots/careers/certifications\-for\-substitutions. How To Apply: **No Civil Service test score is** required in order to be considered for this vacancy. To apply for this vacancy, click on the “Apply” link above and complete an electronic application, which can be used for this vacancy as well as future job opportunities. Applicants are responsible for checking the status of their application to determine where they are in the recruitment process. Further status message information is located under the Information section of the Current Job Opportunities page. \*Information to support your eligibility for the position must be included in the application (i.e., relevant, detailed experience/education). Resumes will not be accepted in lieu of completed education and experience sections. Applications may be rejected if incomplete. Prior to a new hire, a background check, including criminal record history, will be conducted. jobs.title: Construction Assistant Project Manager
jobs.description: ***Job description:*** Commercial construction and development company seeking a detail\-oriented Assistant Project Manager to join our construction consultant team supporting a national build\-to\-suit retail program. Our team represents the developer as the owner's construction representative — the client holds us accountable for delivery, and we hold the general contractor accountable for the work. The ideal candidate will be assigned projects during preconstruction and will be responsible for reviewing construction documents, establishing the building permit path with the local authority having jurisdiction, and then carrying that project through construction as the developer's eyes on site. This role requires a strong understanding of construction processes, sharp attention to detail in document review, comfort dealing directly with municipal officials and general contractors, and the ability to manage several projects at different stages at once. The Assistant Project Manager will play a vital role in identifying problems in the documents before they reach the field and in holding the general contractor to scope, schedule, and quality once work begins. ***Reports to:*** *Project Manager* **Primary Duties \& Responsibilities:** ***Preconstruction*** * Review plan sets, permit sets, and specifications for scope gaps, missing details, and coordination conflicts * Review construction documents against the approved program prototype and project design criteria * Contact the authority having jurisdiction to establish the building permit process for each project, including submittal requirements, review timelines, fees, required third\-party reviews, and inspection sequencing * Review lease exhibits and scopes of work to confirm document compliance * Review geotechnical reports, civil drawings, and site plans for constructability and cost exposure * Track compliance with landlord and developer requirements * Support the bid process as directed, including contractor outreach, bidder question tracking, and addenda distribution ***Construction*** * Conduct site visits throughout construction for kickoff, progress observation, and punch walks — typically 15 to 20 visits over the life of a project * Walk the work and compare observed progress against the schedule, approved plans, and specifications; document and report discrepancies * Track submittals, RFIs, change order requests, and pay applications * Review general contractor schedules and identify slippage early * Monitor permit status and inspection results through certificate of occupancy * Coordinate with client representatives, general contractors, architects, civil engineers, utility providers, and local jurisdictions * Maintain project documentation, meeting agendas, minutes, and site visit reports * Work within the project management platform used on each project (Procore, Autodesk Build, Bluebeam, or similar) ***Candidate should possess the following skills and abilities:*** * Ability to read and interpret construction drawings and specifications * Ability to analyze complex project documents and identify scope gaps, conflicts, and cost exposure * Comfort communicating directly with building departments, permit offices, and municipal officials * Clear, professional written communication for correspondence with general contractors, consultants, and clients * Organized and self\-directed, able to track numerous open items across multiple projects without follow\-up * Strong Excel and document management skills for tracking logs, permit status, and site observations * Understanding of construction processes, terminology, and site operations * Familiarity with contracts, project management principles, and risk assessment in construction projects * Willingness and availability to travel out of state on a regular basis ***Preferred Qualifications:*** * Degree in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Building Science, or a related field * Ground\-up retail or commercial construction experience * Prior experience navigating permitting across multiple jurisdictions * Procore, Bluebeam Revu, and other construction software experience * Experience supporting a multi\-site or national rollout program ***Minimum Requirements:*** College degree preferred. Candidate must have dependable transportation and a valid driver's license. ***Physical Demands:*** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. * While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk and hear. * At times this position is very active and requires standing and walking for 10 hours/day. * Bend/kneel, stoop/crouch, twist/turn, grasp/reach overhead and outward frequently. * Frequent travel by vehicle and air to out\-of\-state project sites. ***Environment:*** While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently exposed to fumes or airborne particles, weather (heat, rain, snow…etc.) and basic construction site working conditions. ***Schedule:*** * 8\-hour shift ***Travel Requirement:*** * Up to 50% travel. This position carries site responsibility for multiple concurrent projects nationwide and involves frequent overnight and multi\-day trips. ***License/Certification:*** * Driver's License (Preferred) Pay: $65,000\.00 \- $75,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Health savings account * Life insurance * Paid time off * Professional development assistance * Vision insurance Work Location: Hybrid remote in Augusta, GA 30909

jobs.title: Architecture - Designer III
jobs.description: **Job Title:** Designer III **Department:** Architecture **Reports to:** Managing Director/Studio Director **FLSA Status:** Exempt **GENERAL SUMMARY** The Designer III is an experienced design professional who performs architectural design and technical documentation assignments with increasing independence and judgment. Working under the direction of a Project Engineer, Project Captain, Project Manager, or Studio Leadership, this role is responsible for developing and coordinating portions of projects through all phases of design and documentation. The Designer III applies advanced technical knowledge, assists with quality control efforts, coordinates with consultants and internal team members, and serves as a resource to junior staff. This position is expected to take ownership of assigned project tasks and deliverables while contributing to the overall success of the project team. **SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES** This position does not have supervisory responsibilities. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES** To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements below represent the required knowledge, skill, and/or ability. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions. General duties and responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following: **Design and Technical Development** * Plans and conducts architectural design and documentation work requiring the application of professional judgment, technical knowledge, and established design standards. * Independently develops portions of project designs, technical solutions, and construction documentation for a variety of project types. * Utilizes sound understanding of building systems, materials, construction methods, and applicable design standards in the development of project documents. * Assists in evaluating design alternatives and recommending solutions that support project goals, schedules, and budgets. * Contributes to presentation materials, design studies, renderings, and client deliverables as required. **Construction Documentation and Quality Control** * Produces comprehensive contract documents that comply with applicable building codes, zoning regulations, client requirements, and firm standards. * Coordinates architectural documentation with consultants to maintain consistency and completeness of project deliverables. * Reviews project documents for accuracy, constructability, and coordination prior to submission. * Performs quality control reviews of assigned work and assists in identifying and resolving design or documentation conflicts. * Reviews shop drawings, product data, and submittals for conformance with project requirements. **Project Coordination** * Coordinates assigned project tasks with internal team members, consultants, and project leadership. * Participates in project meetings and assists with documenting action items and follow up activities. * Communicates project information effectively to team members and assists in resolving routine project issues. * Supports project schedules by completing assignments within established timelines and communicating potential concerns promptly. **Construction Administration** * Conducts site visits, field observations, and punch list reviews to evaluate construction progress and document project conditions. * Assists project leadership in responding to requests for information, reviewing construction related documents, and resolving field issues. * Documents site observations and communicates findings to project leadership and consultants as appropriate. **Team Leadership and Professional Development** * Provides technical guidance and mentoring to junior designers and interns. * Assists in onboarding and training team members on project standards, processes, and software tools. * Shares knowledge and best practices that contribute to project quality and team development. * Demonstrates accountability, professionalism, and a commitment to continuous learning and professional growth. **REQUIRED SKILLS AND ABILITIES** * Strong knowledge of the architectural project development process, from schematic design through construction administration. * Working knowledge of building codes, zoning requirements, accessibility standards, and construction documentation practices. * Understanding of building systems, materials, construction methodologies, and consultant coordination requirements. * Ability to work independently while effectively collaborating within multidisciplinary project teams. * Strong organizational, communication, problem solving, and time management skills. * Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail. * Proficiency in current versions of Revit, AutoCAD, Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel, and other design and presentation software utilized by the firm. * Maintains a professional presence during v icable federal, state, or local law. **PAY TRANSPARENCY** Where required by applicable law, the pay range for this position is provided in the job posting. Compensation is determined based on a variety of factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, education, internal equity, geographic location, and business needs. This position may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses and or benefits in accordance with applicable plans and policies. **PAYROLL** Employees paid on a bi\-weekly basis, consisting of 26 pay periods annually, and is issued in arrears. Direct deposit is available. **AT\-WILL EMPLOYMENT** Employment with GF is **at will**, which means that either the employee or GF may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without cause or notice, subject to applicable law. Nothing in this job description or posting creates a contract of employment or alters the at\-will nature of employment. **WORK ENVIRONMENT** Work may be performed in a standard office setting, onsite at client locations, and or on active construction or project sites. Work environments may include exposure to weather conditions, uneven terrain, construction equipment, and other site\-related conditions. **PHYSICAL DEMANDS** This position requires sufficient physical ability, with or without reasonable accommodation, to perform essential job functions. These may include sitting or standing for extended periods; walking on uneven surfaces; stooping, bending, kneeling, crouching, reaching, and twisting; lifting, carrying, pushing, and or pulling light to moderate amounts of weight; operating office and field equipment requiring repetitive hand movement and fine motor coordination; communicating verbally and in writing; visual acuity within normal range with or without correction; and hearing within normal range with or without correction. This position may require physical mobility on and around active construction sites before and after installation of infrastructure and site improvements. **REASONABLE ACCOMMODATION** We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities and to applicants throughout the hiring process. If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a position or to perform essential job functions, please notify us. Reasonable accommodations may include modifications to the application process, work procedures, equipment, or work environment, in accordance with applicable law. **BACKGROUND CHECK** Employment may be contingent upon successful completion of a background check, reference check, and or drug screening, consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws, including fair chance and ban\-the\-box requirements. **SAFETY \& COMPLIANCE** Employees are required to comply with all Company and client on\-site safety policies and procedures. Personal protective equipment (PPE) may be required when working on construction or project sites. **WORK AUTHORIZATION** Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. GF participates in E\-Verify and will verify employment eligibility in accordance with federal law. **HARASSMENT\-FREE WORKPLACE** We are committed to maintaining a professional work environment free from discrimination, harassment, retaliation, and inappropriate conduct. All employees are expected to uphold these standards and will attend annual harassment prevention training. **DISCLAIMER** This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of duties, responsibilities, or qualifications and may be modified at any time to meet business needs. **Thank you for your interest in applying for a position at GF. We appreciate you taking the time to submit your information. Our team will review your qualifications, and if your skills and experience align with the needs of the role, a member of our recruitment team will reach out to begin the next steps in the process.** **We look forward to reviewing your information.**

jobs.title: Civil Engineer - Entry-level Highway Design
jobs.description: **Launch Your Career in Transportation Engineering** Are you ready to help design the roadways that connect communities, support economic growth, and improve daily travel? Is seeking seeking a motivated **Entry\-Level Highway Engineer** to join our transportation team. This is an excellent opportunity for a recent graduate to gain hands\-on experience working on highway, roadway, intersection, and traffic improvement projects while learning from experienced transportation professionals. As an **Entry\-Level Highway Engineer**, you will contribute to the planning, design, and delivery of transportation infrastructure projects that improve safety, mobility, and accessibility for the traveling public. You'll work in a collaborative environment that values professional development, mentorship, and technical excellence, providing a strong foundation for a successful engineering career and future PE licensure. **GPI** is a multi\-discipline engineering firm providing planning, design, and construction services for transportation infrastructure and building system projects throughout the United States for over 50 years. Ranked in the Top 100 Firms by Engineering News Record, GPI is a forward\-thinking, innovative firm with a culture committed to excellence and fosters staff empowerment. For more information, visit: www.gpinet.com **Responsibilities:** * Assist in the design of highways, roadways, intersections, and transportation infrastructure projects. * Prepare engineering calculations, plans, specifications, and technical reports. * Develop geometric roadway designs using industry\-standard engineering software. * Support drainage, stormwater management, erosion and sediment control, and utility coordination efforts. * Assist with traffic analysis and transportation studies. * Perform field visits to collect data, evaluate existing conditions, and support project development. * Coordinate with project managers, senior engineers, surveyors, environmental specialists, and other design disciplines. * Review construction plans and contractor submittals for compliance with project requirements. * Assist with permit applications and regulatory submissions. * Participate in meetings with clients, contractors, and transportation agencies. * Support construction phase services, including responding to requests for information and reviewing field conditions. * Maintain project documentation and follow quality control procedures. **Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering from an ABET\-accredited university. * Engineer\-in\-Training (EIT) certification or ability to obtain certification within one year preferred. * Internship or co\-op experience in transportation or civil engineering is a plus. * Basic understanding of highway design, transportation engineering, and roadway construction principles. * Familiarity with AutoCAD Civil 3D is a plus. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and organizational skills. * Ability to work effectively in a team\-oriented environment. * Willingness to perform occasional field work and site visits. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Coursework in transportation engineering, traffic engineering, highway design, or drainage design. * Familiarity with DOT design standards and specifications. * Experience with traffic analysis or roadway modeling software is a plus. * Desire to pursue Professional Engineer (PE) licensure and long\-term career growth in transportation engineering. * Maintain a valid driver's license with a clean motor vehicle report (MVR) for final consideration * Read, write, and understand plans and directions given in the English language * Basic computer skills with the ability to create and edit Microsoft Word and Excel documents, create Outlook emails and utilize SharePoint and Microsoft Teams to communicate with other team members * Able to traverse a construction job site consisting of uneven ground varying in height and consistency of material, with a variation of elevation 19" or less (mud, gravel, rutted ground, etc.) * Able to wear GPI required PPE, i.e., hard hats, safety vest, work boots, and/or safety glasses/goggles while working * Able to move equipment or inspection specimens weighing up to 50 pounds GPI offers excellent benefits, including a 401(k) plan, ESOP, medical/dental/vision plans, paid time off, and more. GPI is an equal\-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. D/V **Notice To Third\-Party Agencies** GPI does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters and/or agencies. Any staffing employment agency, person, or entity that submits an unsolicited resume to this site does so with the understanding that the applicant's resume will become the property of GPI and has the right to hire that applicant at its discretion and without any fee owed to the submitting staffing/employment agency, person, or entity. GPI will not pay a placement fee unless the agency or recruiter has a signed contract with GPI’s Corporate Human Resources department in advance of submitting a candidate for consideration. Staffing/employment agencies must submit applicants to the designated GPI recruiter to be eligible for a placement fee. Verbal and written approvals will not be considered a valid contract for service. **Work Authorization** In compliance with the Immigration Reform and Control Act of 1986, we will hire only U.S. citizens and aliens lawfully authorized to work in the United States (if the position is or will be one that is subject to U.S. law). Verification of employment eligibility will be required at the time of hire. Visa sponsorship is typically not available for entry\-level positions. GPI participates in E\-Verify. Know your Right to Work. **Email Communications** Thank you for your interest in Greenman\-Pedersen, Inc. (GPI). By applying, you may receive periodic email notifications about career opportunities. These communications are designed to keep you informed of new and exciting openings across our organization. You can opt out of these notifications at any time.
