jobs.title: Staff Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Role** ------------------ We're looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer who is equally at home writing production software and running the infrastructure it lives on — and who wants to take ownership of one of the hardest, highest\-leverage problems on our platform: intelligently managing a large fleet of GPU\-backed models. We run nearly 30 models across heterogeneous hardware, and keeping that fleet fast, reliable, and cost\-effective is a serious engineering challenge. You'll build the GPU management and scheduling platform that sits at the center of it — collecting utilization and load metrics, interpreting what they actually mean, and using them to make real\-time decisions about admission control and scaling. The goal: route and schedule inference calls so we use our capacity efficiently without exceeding it, and scale model replicas up and down automatically as demand shifts. This is a senior role for someone with a decade in the field who can move fluidly between systems engineering and software development, and who is excited to own a complex, evolving system end to end. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Design and build our GPU management and scheduling platform — the system that decides when, where, and how inference calls run across a fleet of \~30 models on heterogeneous hardware * Build the metrics pipeline that collects GPU load and utilization data, and the logic that turns those signals into decisions * Implement admission control to protect capacity — deciding when to accept, queue, or shed inference requests so we operate within fleet limits * Build autoscaling that adjusts the number of model replicas in response to real\-time demand and utilization * Develop cloud orchestration systems and operators in Python and Go to manage the model fleet * Architect and operate scalable, fault\-tolerant, secure production systems on AWS, GCP, or Azure * Design and build infrastructure automation and deployment pipelines (Terraform, CI/CD) as first\-class software * Stand up and maintain monitoring, logging, and alerting that keep the platform reliable and performant * Develop and enforce security and compliance policies appropriate to a healthcare AI platform * Partner with engineers and research scientists to diagnose and resolve complex infrastructure, deployment, and operational issues * Mentor engineers and raise the technical bar across the team **What You Bring** ------------------ *Must\-Have* * 10\+ years of professional experience across site reliability / DevOps engineering and software engineering * Computer Science Degree Required from a top CS program. * Strong software engineering fundamentals — you build orchestration and scheduling systems in Python and/or Go, not just configure off\-the\-shelf tools * Experience designing systems that make decisions from operational metrics — collecting signals, interpreting them, and driving control loops such as autoscaling, load shedding, or admission control * Deep experience with infrastructure automation and CI/CD (Terraform, GitLab CI/CD, or similar) * Hands\-on production experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) * Strong knowledge of containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) * Experience with monitoring and logging stacks (ELK, Grafana, Datadog, or similar) * Familiarity with secrets management and security tooling (HashiCorp Vault, AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault) * Excellent problem\-solving skills and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively * Strong communication and interpersonal skills *Nice\-to\-Have* * Experience managing GPU fleets or scheduling workloads across heterogeneous accelerators * Familiarity with ML inference serving and model deployment (e.g. Triton, KServe, Ray Serve, or similar) * Experience with Kubernetes autoscaling internals (HPA/VPA, custom metrics, custom controllers) * Experience implementing HIPAA and SOC 2 compliance * Experience operating in an HPC environment * Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field Join our team at Hippocratic AI and help shape the future of clinically safe, production\-grade AI systems. **Why Join Hippocratic AI** --------------------------- **Reinvent healthcare with AI that puts safety first.** We’re building the world’s first healthcare‑only, safety‑focused LLM — a breakthrough platform designed to transform patient outcomes at a global scale. This is category creation. **Work with the people shaping the future.** Hippocratic AI was co‑founded by CEO Munjal Shah and a team of physicians, hospital leaders, AI pioneers, and researchers from institutions like El Camino Health, Johns Hopkins, Washington University in St. Louis, Stanford, Google, Meta, Microsoft, and NVIDIA. **Backed by the world’s leading healthcare and AI investors.** We recently raised a $126M Series C at a $3\.5B valuation, led by Avenir Growth, bringing total funding to $404M with participation from CapitalG, General Catalyst, a16z, Kleiner Perkins, Premji Invest, UHS, Cincinnati Children’s, WellSpan Health, John Doerr, Rick Klausner, and others. **Build alongside the best in healthcare and AI.** Join experts who’ve spent their careers improving care, advancing science, and building world‑changing technologies — ensuring our platform is powerful, trusted, and truly transformative. **Equal Opportunity** --------------------- Hippocratic AI is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are committed to building a team that reflects the patients we serve. We actively encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds. If you require accommodations during the hiring process, please contact people@hippocraticai.com. ***Please be aware of recruitment scams impersonating Hippocratic AI. All recruiting communication will come from @******hippocraticai.com*** ***email addresses. We will never request payment or sensitive personal information during the hiring process.***

jobs.title: AWS AgentCore Platform Engineer - 67417
jobs.description: **Function** Cloud \& Data Engineering **Our Company** =============== We’re Hitachi Digital Services, a global digital solutions and transformation business with a bold vision of our world’s potential. We’re people\-centric and here to power good. Every day, we future\-proof urban spaces, conserve natural resources, protect rainforests, and save lives. This is a world where innovation, technology, and deep expertise come together to take our company and customers from what’s now to what’s next. We make it happen through the power of acceleration. Imagine the sheer breadth of talent it takes to bring a better tomorrow closer to today. We don’t expect you to ‘fit’ every requirement – your life experience, character, perspective, and passion for achieving great things in the world are equally as important to us. **Job description** =================== ### **Meet Our Team** Join a forward\-thinking Engineering and AI Platform team focused on building the next generation of enterprise AI solutions. Our team is pioneering agentic AI ecosystems powered by AWS Bedrock, AgentCore, MCP servers, and modern cloud\-native technologies. As a Senior AWS AgentCore Platform Engineer, you'll work alongside Cloud Architects, AI Engineers, Platform Engineers, and Security specialists to establish scalable, secure, and observable AI platforms. You'll play a critical role in defining the operational foundation that enables enterprise teams to deploy AI agents with confidence, governance, and efficiency. This is an exciting opportunity to shape enterprise AI infrastructure, drive innovation in LLMOps, and influence platform standards across multiple business units. ### **What You'll Be Doing** AI Platform Observability \& Reliability * Design and implement enterprise\-grade observability solutions for AI agent ecosystems built on AWS Bedrock, AgentCore, and MCP servers. * Assess and optimize CloudWatch, X\-Ray, Bedrock logging, and AgentCore tracing capabilities against agentic workflow requirements. * Conduct gap analyses and implement observability solutions using Dynatrace and other monitoring platforms. * Develop distributed tracing frameworks for AI workloads, including: + LLM decision paths + Tool invocations + Sub\-agent interactions + MCP server communications * Build structured logging frameworks to support troubleshooting, governance, and performance optimization. * Design post\-deployment validation pipelines for AI agents and MCP servers, including deployment health monitoring and registration verification. Cost Governance \& Optimization * Architect cost visibility and governance frameworks across AI workloads. * Extend cloud tagging strategies to include agent runtimes, vector databases, MCP services, and Bedrock token consumption. * Develop cost allocation models to provide spending transparency by team, department, and application. * Build dashboards and reporting solutions for AI platform cost tracking and forecasting. * Configure AWS Budgets, automated alerts, anomaly detection, and optimization recommendations. * Deliver automated cost reporting through Microsoft Teams and email channels. Monitoring \& Incident Management * Define enterprise monitoring standards and alerting frameworks across AI platform services. * Create and manage P1\-P4 alerting strategies covering: + Deployment failures + Runtime exceptions + Tool invocation errors + MCP connectivity issues * Integrate monitoring and notification workflows with Microsoft Teams and email. * Develop operational runbooks and self\-service documentation within Confluence. * Evaluate AWS\-native and third\-party monitoring solutions and recommend target\-state architectures. Security \& Platform Governance * Assess IAM architectures and multi\-team access models for enterprise\-scale AI environments. * Design Attribute\-Based Access Control (ABAC) frameworks to support secure multi\-team isolation. * Evaluate Cedar policy engine capabilities within AgentCore for fine\-grained authorization models. * Develop reusable Terraform modules to enforce governance, security, and compliance standards. * Identify scalability risks and implement secure platform design patterns for enterprise AI adoption. Platform Engineering \& Automation * Build and maintain Infrastructure\-as\-Code solutions using Terraform. * Design and enhance CI/CD pipelines supporting AI platform deployments. * Collaborate with engineering, security, architecture, and business stakeholders in Agile environments. * Drive platform standardization, automation, and operational excellence initiatives. ### **What You'll Bring to the Team** Required Qualifications * 8\+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or Cloud Infrastructure Engineering. * Strong expertise in AWS cloud services including: + IAM + CloudWatch + AWS Lambda + AWS Bedrock + Cloud\-native monitoring and governance services * Hands\-on experience implementing observability and distributed tracing solutions using tools such as: + Dynatrace + Jaeger + Honeycomb + OpenTelemetry * Experience designing and managing Infrastructure\-as\-Code using Terraform. * Strong background building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines in enterprise environments. * Experience working in Agile teams utilizing Microsoft Teams, Confluence, and modern collaboration tools. Preferred Qualifications * Experience supporting AI, Generative AI, or LLM\-based platforms. * Familiarity with AgentCore, LangChain, LangFuse, LiteLLM, MCP servers, or similar AI orchestration frameworks. * Understanding of LLM lifecycle management, prompt execution flows, token consumption tracking, and AI workload optimization. * Knowledge of cloud cost management, FinOps practices, and governance frameworks. * Experience designing enterprise\-scale security architectures using ABAC and policy\-based authorization models. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to translate complex technical challenges into scalable platform solutions. Success Factors * Passion for emerging AI technologies and cloud\-native engineering. * Ability to balance reliability, security, performance, and cost optimization. * Strong communication skills with the ability to influence technical and business stakeholders. * Proven ability to lead platform modernization initiatives and establish engineering best practices. **Location:** Reading, PA (Hybrid – 2\-3 days onsite per week) **About us** ============ We’re a global, team of innovators. Together, we harness engineering excellence and passion to co\-create meaningful solutions to complex challenges. We turn organizations into data\-driven leaders that can make a positive impact on their industries and society. If you believe that innovation can bring a better tomorrow closer to today, this is the place for you. **Fostering innovation through diverse perspectives** ===================================================== Hitachi is a global company operating across a wide range of industries and regions. jobs.title: Senior Data & AI Engineer
jobs.description: ***Join Arizona’s largest, most prominent not\-for\-profit hospice, serving the valley since 1977\.*** Hospice of the Valley is a national leader in hospice care and has been serving the Phoenix metropolitan area since 1977\. A mission\-driven, not\-for\-profit organization, Hospice of the Valley employs compassionate, skilled professionals who are committed to excellence, enjoy teamwork, and contribute daily to our mission and culture of caring. Team members experience a friendly, supportive atmosphere, leadership support, autonomy, flexibility, and the privilege of doing meaningful, rewarding work. **Benefits:** * Supportive work environment with a culture of caring for patients and one another. * Competitive wages and excellent benefit program. * Generous Paid Time Off. * Flexible schedules for work/life balance. **Position Profile** The Senior Data \& AI Engineer will need to have deep handson experience in Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric (incl. OneLake), and healthcare data ecosystems. The ideal candidate understands data modeling, data integration, and data transformation across structured and unstructured sources, and can build machine learning pipelines that operate on claims and clinical data. You’ll design secure, scalable data platforms; map and normalize data across payers, providers, CMS datasets, EHR systems, and HIEs; and operationalize AI tools to drive measurable outcomes in cost, quality, and member/patient experience. **Responsibilities** Data Platform Engineering * Architect, implement, and optimize data solutions in Snowflake and Microsoft Fabric (incl. OneLake, Lakehouses, Warehouses, and Data Engineering pipelines). * Build robust ingestion frameworks for batch and streaming data (e.g., ADLS, EventHub, APIs, SFTP) with lineage and governance. * Manage data security, privacy, and compliance (HIPAA/PHI; rolebased access, masking, tokenization, deidentification). Data Modeling \& Integration * Design conceptual/logical/physical models (normalized, dimensional/star, data vault where appropriate). * Implement data mapping and transformations for structured (claims, eligibility, provider, enrollment) and unstructured (clinical notes, PDFs) data. * Harmonize healthcare data using FHIR/HL7/CCDA, X12/EDI 837/835, NCPDP, and CMS standards; reconcile and link records across EHR and HIE sources. Analytics \& Machine Learning * Build ML pipelines for risk stratification, cost/utilization forecasting, fraud/waste/abuse detection, quality measure computation (e.g., HEDIS), and care gap identification. * Operationalize models with MLOps (experiment tracking, reproducibility, CI/CD, monitoring, drift detection). * Leverage LLMs/AI tools for data quality, entity resolution, summarization, and clinical insights—ensuring safety, bias checks, and auditability. Governance \& Observability * Implement data cataloging, lineage, and metadata (e.g., Microsoft Purview or equivalent). * Establish quality SLAs, validation rules, profiling, and automated anomaly detection. * Instrument pipelines for cost, performance, and reliability (e.g., Snowflake resource monitors, Fabric capacities). Collaboration \& Delivery * Work with product owners, clinicians, actuaries, and analytics teams to translate requirements into scalable solutions. * Produce clear documentation, data dictionaries, and mapping specs; mentor engineers and analysts. * Contribute to architectural roadmaps, reference patterns, and best practices across the enterprise. Maintains and enhances professional skills. Adheres to high standards of personal and professional conduct. **Minimum Qualifications** * 8\+ years in data engineering/analytics; 5\+ years handson with Snowflake (compute, storage, virtual warehouses, tasks, streams, Snowpipe, Time Travel, RBAC, row/column masking, data sharing, Dynamic Tables). * 2\+ years with Microsoft Fabric (including OneLake, Lakehouses, Warehouses, Dataflows Gen2, Notebooks, Pipelines; capacity management). * Strong data modeling expertise (dimensional/star, 3NF, data vault; surrogate keys, SCD types, conformed dimensions). * Data integration \& transformation proficiency: SQL (advanced), dbt or Fabric Dataflows/Power Query M, ADF/Synapse/Fabric Pipelines, Python for ETL/ELT. * Mapping from CMS data (e.g., Medicare datasets, claims/encounters), X12/EDI, FHIR/HL7, provider and eligibility. * Experience with structured (tables, CSV, Parquet) and unstructured (clinical notes, PDFs, blobs) data; NLP pipelines (optional but valued). * Machine learning: feature engineering, model training/evaluation, and deployment (e.g., scikitlearn, PyTorch/TensorFlow, Fabric ML/Notebook, Azure ML); production monitoring. * Security \& compliance: HIPAA, PHI handling, auditing, data residency, BAAs; practical access control in Snowflake/Fabric. * Strong communication; ability to author mapping specs, lineage docs, and present tradeoffs to technical and nontechnical stakeholders. **Preferred Qualifications** * Interoperability: FHIR R4, HL7 v2, X12/EDI (837/835\), NCPDP; experience with HIEs and EHR integrations (Epic, Cerner, etc.). * CMS \& payer/provider data: Medicare feeforservice, MA, Medicaid, CCW, APCD, and quality programs; risk adjustment (HCC), HEDIS measures. * MLOps \& DevOps: MLflow, DVC, GitHub Actions/Azure DevOps, containerization (Docker), orchestration (Airflow, Fabric Pipelines, or ADF). * Governance: Microsoft Purview (catalog, lineage, classifications), data quality tools. * Visualization: Power BI and Fabric Direct Lake; semantic modeling and rowlevel security. * Cloud: Azure (ADLS, Event Hub, Functions, Key Vault, Databricks), optional AWS/GCP exposure. * Certifications: Snowflake SnowPro Core/Advanced, Microsoft Certified (Azure Data Engineer Associate, Fabric Analytics Engineer). Hospice of the Valley is an equal employment opportunity employer. EOE/M/F/D/V Location: Hospice of the Valley · Information Services Schedule: Full Time 40 hrs/week, Day Shift, 8am \- 5pm

jobs.title: CONTROLS ENGINEER
jobs.description: As a Controls Engineer at ASI, a Division of Livingston \& Haven, you will play a pivotal role in the design, programming, commissioning, integration, and support of custom automated and robotic systems. This role involves hands\-on work with both hardware and software, supporting projects form initial concept through installation and post deliver support. Prospective candidates must demonstrate strong technical aptitude, experience with programming and on control system engineering, as well as a commitment to maintaining L\&H’s reputation for delivering innovative and high\-quality automated solutions. The ideal candidate will be self\-motivated and capable of working within a team as well as independently; able to manage multiple assignments simultaneously. * **Primary Responsibilities include but are not limited to:** + **Collaboration** - Report directly to the Controls Manager regarding most daily tasks. - Take indirect supervision and tasks from others on the ASI management and engineering teams as needed for project specific work. - Coordinate with sales, project, controls, and mechanical teams to design and implement automation projects. - Interface directly with customers to address and solve their needs and provide high\-quality services. - Provide oversight and technical guidance on control panel and system wiring and fabrication. + **Engineering and Integration** - Design, develop, and troubleshoot automated electromechanical control systems. - Program and troubleshoot PLC, HMI, VFD, servo, robot, vision, and other automated control systems both in house and in the field. - Support system runoffs and equipment installations, ensuring functionality aligns with contractual requirements. - Conduct quality control inspects and maintain safety standards in alignment with company and national codes. - Hands on integration, modification, and repair of robotic, mechanical, and controls equipment to meet customer specifications. - Assist in maintaining a clean and organized work environment throughout the fabrication area as well as the entire ship. This includes general housekeeping duties such as trash removal, floor sweeping, and part/material organizing. + **Installation and Support** - Provide hands\-on support as needed for the building, commissioning, and installation of automated manufacturing equipment. This work will regularly require the use of electrical and other hand tools - Troubleshoot, diagnose, modify, and repair electromechanical control system at ASI and our customer’s facilities. - Keep accurate and up to date records on all aspects of work being completed, utilizing existing documentation and processes. - Perform quality control inspections on electrical controls systems. To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. * **Education** + Associates degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Industrial Automation, or related field. + Preferred: Bachelors degree * **Experience** + Minimum 2 to 4 years of controls programming experience or similar industrial controls experience. This can include developing, troubleshooting, and editing existing programming and ladder logic. + Experience with PLC, HMI, VFD, robot, servo, or other controls programming. + Experience reading and understanding electrical print sets. + Experience in designing and developing electrical prints is preferred. + Experience in hands\-on integration, modification, and repair of controls systems * **Skills** + Strong computer skills + Strong written and verbal communication skills + Experience with Allen Bradley, Omron, Siemens, GE, and/or other PLC platforms + Experience with HMI, VFD, servo, robot, and/or vision programming is preferred. + Self\-motivated and organized + Ability to bend and lift 50 plus pounds. + Must be able to travel to work at customer facilities as necessary. + Able to pass a background check as well as pre\-employment and random drug screenings. + Able to multitask and work with minimal supervision. + Possess and maintain a clean driving record and valid US driver’s license. + Strong communication and computer skills. * **Physical Requirements** + Ability to lift up to 50 pounds + Ability to stand and work on your feet for extended periods + Ability to work safely around industrial equipment. + Ability to wear required personal protective equipment. * **Why join our team?** + Opportunity to develop valuable and diverse engineering and automation skills + Stable, full\-time employment with opportunities for growth + Work alongside experienced engineers, technicians, and other professionals *We will consider all qualified applicants regardless of age, race, color, national origin, sex, religion, veteran status,* *disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other legally protected status.*

jobs.title: SENIOR CONTROLS ENGINEER
jobs.description: As a Senior Controls Engineer at ASI, a Division of Livingston \& Haven, you will serve as a technical leader and mentor within the Controls Engineering Department. This role is responsible for designing, programming, and supporting automation systems while overseeing project execution and ensuring compliance with company standards. The Senior Controls Engineer plays a pivotal part in supervising, mentoring, and developing both Controls Engineers and Technicians while also driving innovation, efficiency, and project success. * **Primary Responsibilities include but are not limited to:** + **Technical Leadership** - Lead complex controls system designs, including electrical schematics, panel layouts, and PLC/HMI programming. - Develop and implement advanced automation solutions requiring high\-level design, integration, and troubleshooting expertise. - Drive system architecture discussions and standardization efforts for hardware and software. - Validate and optimize system functionality and performance through simulation and on\-site testing. - Take ownership of the most technically challenging and mission\-critical design tasks that go beyond the scope assigned to Controls Engineers. While ControlsEngineers may assist with component layouts and mid\-level system development, Senior Controls Engineers are expected to manage high\-stakes designs involving multi\-system integration, safety interlocks, legacy system upgrades, and large\-scale automation strategies. + **Project Oversight** - Serve as lead controls engineers on key and technically complex projects, managing all phases from design to deployment. This includes defining project scope, leading design reviews, and serving as the primary decision\-maker for all control\-related technical matters. - Oversee and actively manage project timelines, cost estimates, labor allocation, and milestone tracking to ensure successful delivery within scope and budget constraints. Escalate and resolve issues quickly to minimize project disruption. - Coordinate closely with mechanical, electrical, and applications engineering teams to ensure all aspects of the system work cohesively. Represent the controls function in project meetings and drive alignment across all technical disciplines. Provide guidance and feedback to improve integration across departments. + **Associate Development** - Directly supervise Controls Engineers and Technicians, assigning technical and developmental tasks, reviewing work quality and technical accuracy, and providing in\-depth, constructive feedback tailored to each team member’s growth path. - Identify skill gaps through formal assessments, peer reviews, and project debriefs. Develop and implement structured training programs, including technical workshops, job shadowing, and one\-on\-one coaching, to ensure continuous improvement and team advancement. - Facilitate structured knowledge\-sharing sessions, document best practices, and ensure dissemination of technical lessons learned across the department. Champion a culture of mentorship, accountability, and technical excellence. + **Process Improvement** - Develop, document, and refine comprehensive engineering standards, code libraries, design templates, and checklists to ensure consistency and efficiency across all controls projects. Ensure all materials are regularly reviewed and updated to reflect industry best practices and lessons learned from past projects. - Lead department\-wide initiatives to optimize workflows and reduce project cycle time. Analyze engineering bottlenecks and inefficiencies through data tracking, conduct root cause analysis, and implement corrective strategies. Monitor KPIs such as rework rates, on\-time delivery, and engineering hours per project to drive continuous improvement. - Research, test, and implement cutting\-edge technologies such as emerging PLC platforms, industrial IoT, advanced diagnostic tools, and smart instrumentation. Conduct pilot programs and technical evaluations, lead vendor collaboration meetings, and deliver departmental training on adopted tools and practices to ensure smooth implementation and maximum value. + **Safety \& Compliance** - Ensure strict adherence to national and international electrical codes (e.g., NEC, IEC), OSHA safety regulations, and all internal ASI safety protocols. Serve as a subject matter expert for interpreting and applying these standards to all controls projects. - Conduct thorough reviews and audits of safety\-critical components, including detailed evaluations of risk assessments, safety PLC logic, emergency stop configurations, lockout/tagout (LOTO) procedures, and machine safeguarding implementations. Ensure designs meet or exceed required safety integrity levels (SIL/PL). - Collaborate with the Health and Safety team to lead hazard analyses and facilitate pre\-startup safety reviews (PSSRs) for automation systems. - Stay current with evolving safety legislation and recommend updates to departmental processes to ensure ongoing compliance and best\-in\-class safety practices. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. jobs.title: Electrical Power Engineer III
jobs.description: At ICM, our engineers don’t just design systems—they help fuel a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. As an Electrical Power Engineer III, you’ll play a critical role in shaping the electrical infrastructure behind industrial operations across our organization. If you’re energized by problem‑solving, thrive in a collaborative environment, and are passionate about meaningful engineering impact, this is the role for you. This position provides electrical design services for the construction of industrial projects and provides electrical support for issues related to the installation and operation of electrical equipment associated with an industrial production process. This is an in\-office position. **Essential Functions and Basic Duties:** * Provide electrical designs and drawings for projects including primary electrical distribution, low voltage distribution, equipment specifications, equipment layout, lighting, grounding, and other related electrical issues. * Perform various electrical studies such as load flow analysis, fault studies, arc\-flash evaluations and/or co\-generation application studies. * Work with Projects department in determining electrical equipment requirements including specifications, power requirements, layout, and control requirements. * Communicate with vendors to develop equipment evaluations, specifications, and workable delivery schedules for electrical equipment installation. * Coordinate with Projects department to ensure accurate specification and procurement of electrical equipment in a timely manner to meet construction schedule. * Work with electric utility companies to develop electrical service requirements and designs to provide adequate electric power to plants and to address co\-generation issues. * Develop ideas and methods for the continuous improvement in the design process and equipment applications. * Provide engineering support to existing plants in analyzing and resolving problems or addressing other electrical issues. **What You Bring:** * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering (required) * Electrical Engineering PE license (required) * Minimum 4 years of electrical engineering experience (required) * Background in electrical power systems (preferred) * Proficiency with MS Office and AutoCAD * Strong attention to detail and problem‑solving mindset * Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication * Independent work capability and a high level of integrity * Fluent in written and spoken English **Work Environment \& Physical Requirements:** This role blends office‑based engineering with occasional onsite visits. Conditions may include loud noise, temperature extremes, humidity, airborne particles, or electrical hazards. Tasks may involve working at heights or lifting up to 70 lbs. (seldom).

jobs.title: Head of FinOps & Cloud Billing
jobs.description: IREN is a vertically integrated AI Cloud provider, delivering large\-scale data centers and GPU clusters for AI training and inference. IREN’s platform is underpinned by its expansive portfolio of grid\-connected land and power in renewable\-rich regions across North America, Europe and APAC. With 100% renewable energy, we build, own and operate our data centers and take pride in being at the forefront of sustainable solutions for the ever\-evolving applications of high\-performance compute. We believe that human progress is invaluable, but it should be done in the right way: responsibly, sustainably and having a positive impact on the communities we operate in. The Head of FinOps \& Cloud Billing bridges operations and finance for IREN's AI Cloud. The role owns the end\-to\-end path from usage telemetry through rating to invoice and audit; owns cost allocation, unit economics and gross margin per GPU\-hour; and runs the compliance program for cloud operations. It is a build role: the leader defines the function, hires the team, stands up the tooling and controls, and embeds cost and billing accuracy as operational metrics reviewed alongside availability. * 10\+ years across cloud operations, FinOps, cloud billing or infrastructure finance, including 3\+ years leading a team; experience building a function from scratch. * Hands\-on ownership of a usage\-based billing or metering pipeline at a cloud, hosting, colocation or SaaS provider — telemetry ingestion, rating, invoicing and reconciliation. * Demonstrated FinOps practice: cost allocation, showback/chargeback, unit\-economics modelling and forecast\-versus\-actual reporting for large infrastructure fleets. * Direct experience taking an organization through SOC 2 and/or ISO 27001 — control design, evidence, auditor management. * Comfortable working with engineers and data: SQL and data\-pipeline literacy, ability to specify metering requirements and challenge implementations. * Executive\-level communication; able to present margin and compliance posture to a CTO, CFO and enterprise customers. Preferred * GPU / HPC / AI\-infrastructure economics: power\-driven cost structures, GPU generation lifecycle, utilization and commitment models. * FinOps Certified Practitioner (FOCP) or equivalent; familiarity with the FOCUS billing\-data specification. * Experience in a company transitioning business models or scaling rapidly, where controls were built while the business was live. * Exposure to FedRAMP or other regulated\-market frameworks; experience with revenue\-recognition considerations for usage\-based contracts. Leadership attributes * Builder's bias — defines the function, hires well, and gets controls in place without slowing the operation. * Independence — willing to report uncomfortable margin or billing findings to peers whose teams they measure. * Systems thinker who connects metering, cost, pricing and compliance into one coherent operating picture. Billing integrity \& metering * Own the usage\-metering\-to\-invoice pipeline: reconcile telemetry, rating and invoicing; define and run the billing\-accuracy audit; eliminate revenue leakage. * Partner with the control\-plane software organization and the Sr. Director of Cloud on metering requirements for new products, SKUs and GPU generations. * Establish billing dispute handling with Cloud Support and Finance, including root\-cause and remediation of systemic errors. * Partner with SOX compliance, both internally and with customers, on SOX billing compliance and reporting to ensure a seamless stream of revenue integrity pipeline. FinOps \& unit economics * Build cost allocation and showback/chargeback for the AI Cloud: cost per GPU\-hour by site, cluster, GPU generation and customer. * Own forecast\-versus\-actual reporting for cloud operating cost and utilization; provide the cost lens on capacity and fleet\-lifecycle decisions with the Capacity \& Fleet Planner. * Drive gross\-margin improvement programs — utilization, power, idle capacity, commitment structures — and report progress to the VP and CTO. Compliance * Run the SOC 2 (Type I then Type II) and ISO 27001 programs for cloud operations; own control design, evidence collection and auditor management for the operational controls in scope. * Maintain a live view of certification status for the CISO and Sales; ensure certification gaps never surprise an enterprise deal. Leadership \& operating model * Hire and lead the FinOps \& Cloud Billing team (2 FinOps Analysts, 2 Billing \& Metering Engineers, 1 Cloud Compliance Lead); set the team's roadmap and operating cadence. * Represent cost, billing and compliance in the Cloud Operations leadership team alongside the Sr. Directors of SRE and Cloud, the Director of Cloud Support and the AD, Service Management. * Be the primary Cloud Operations interface to Finance (revenue accounting, SOX, FP\&A), Sales Operations (pricing and contracts) and Security (CISO). At IREN, we offer a highly competitive compensation package that includes base salary, annual performance incentives, and opportunities to build long\-term wealth through equity programs. These offerings are part of our broader Total Rewards package, thoughtfully designed to support your health, well\-being, and long\-term success. Compensation * The expected base salary for this role USD $250,000 – $290,000/annum. + Actual compensation will be determined based on factors such as experience, qualifications, and market data for the region. * Total Compensation package may be inclusive of annual incentive bonus, equity (long\-term incentive). * Relocation or Living\-out\-allowance / per diem (as appliable and based on successful candidate circumstances) Health \& Wellness * 100% company paid health insurance premiums (medical, dental, and vision) for employees, 75% company paid coverage for dependents * Company\-paid short\-term and long\-term disability insurance * Voluntary life, critical illness, and accident coverage available * Health Savings Accounts (HSA) – when combined with the High Deductible Health Plan * Employee Assistance Program and wellness resources Retirement \& Financial Wealth * 401(k) retirement plan with company match * Access to financial planning and legal services Time Off \& Leave Programs * Paid Time Off (PTO) and paid holidays Growth \& Development * Internal skills training and advancement pathways * Professional development to support certifications, continuing education, or role related training Community \& Culture * Company events and team\-building activities We value diverse perspectives and believe that skills can be developed. If you’re passionate about this role, we want to hear from you — whether you meet every criteria or not. Your unique experiences might be exactly what we need! IE US Operations Inc., the employing entity and proud member of the IREN group is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to creating an inclusive workplace. We are committed to evaluating qualified applicants and do not discriminate against protected characteristics under applicable legislation. IE US Operations, Inc. “IREN” participates in E\-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I\-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the United States. By applying for this position and submitting your resume and application materials, you consent to the processing of your personal information in accordance with our Job Applicant Privacy Statement available on our website at www.iren.com.

jobs.title: Community Management District Manager - Southeast Region
jobs.description: Join Inframark's Community Management Services Team! At Inframark Community Management Services, you’re not just starting a job — you’re building a career. We serve hundreds of master\-planned communities and districts with top\-tier support, and we invest just as much in our employees. Join a dynamic, innovative team where your growth and success matter. Grow Your Career. Build Stronger Communities.Apply Today! Why Work for Inframark? Our dedication to sustainability and community impact drives us to ensure clean, safe water for future generations. Whether you're at the start of your career or looking for advancement, Inframark offers purpose\-driven work and opportunities for growth. We offer an attractive salary package, including a generous benefits package with health, dental, and life insurance, 401(k) plan, paid time off, sick leave, holidays, and wellness plan. District Manager Community Development District (CDD) Management \| Board Relations \| Operations Leadership Build Strong Communities. Lead with Impact. Are you a relationship\-driven leader who enjoys working with Boards, managing projects, and helping communities thrive? This is a remote position with travel required within the assigned district. Qualifed candidates must be based out of Southern Florida. We're seeking a professional and highly organized District Manager to oversee the operations, governance, and financial management of assigned Community Development Districts (CDDs). In this role, you'll serve as the trusted advisor to District Boards, lead vendor and project oversight, manage budgets, and help ensure communities remain well\-maintained, financially sound, and compliant with Florida regulations. This is an excellent opportunity for professionals with experience in community association management, local government, property management, client services, project management, account management, HOA management, or public administration who are looking to advance their careers with a growing organization. What You'll Do Board \& District Leadership * Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned Community Development Districts. * Build strong relationships with Board Members, residents, consultants, and stakeholders. * Prepare for and facilitate Board meetings, workshops, public hearings, and community meetings. * Prepare agendas, meeting materials, and Board correspondence. * Document Board actions and maintain official records. * Provide ongoing guidance and updates to Board Members regarding District operations and projects. Operations \& Project Management * Oversee the day\-to\-day operations of assigned Districts. * Conduct regular inspections of community amenities, infrastructure, and common areas. * Identify maintenance needs, capital improvement opportunities, and operational enhancements. * Coordinate projects from planning through completion. * Monitor contractor and consultant performance to ensure service excellence. Vendor \& Contract Administration * Manage vendor relationships and service agreements. * Oversee contract negotiations, renewals, procurement activities, and performance expectations. * Review invoices and ensure services are delivered according to contract requirements. * Partner with contractors, engineers, attorneys, and consultants to achieve Board objectives. Financial Management * Assist with the development and administration of annual District budgets. * Review financial reports, invoices, purchase orders, and expenditures. * Support long\-term financial planning and capital improvement strategies. * Provide recommendations and budget guidance to Boards. Resident \& Stakeholder Engagement * Respond to resident questions and concerns in a professional and timely manner. * Maintain District websites and communication platforms. * Promote transparency, communication, and positive community relationships. * Communicate effectively with residents, governmental agencies, vendors, consultants, and Board Members. Compliance \& Governance * Ensure compliance with Florida Statutes, District policies, and regulatory requirements. * Coordinate required filings, reports, and official District records. * Support ethical governance and best practices in public administration. What We're Looking For Required Qualifications * Bachelor's degree preferred or an equivalent combination of education and experience. * Two (2\)\+ years of experience in: * Community Association Management * Community Development Districts (CDD) * Property Management * Local Government * Client Relationship Management * Account Management * Public Administration * Project Management * Valid Florida Driver's License with an acceptable driving record. * Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint. Preferred Qualifications * Florida Notary Public Commission or ability to obtain within six months of hire. * Experience presenting to Boards, commissions, committees, or public groups. * Experience managing budgets, contracts, vendors, or capital projects. * Knowledge of Florida Statutes governing Community Development Districts. Key Skills for Success * Board Relations * Community Management * Public Administration * Project Management * Budget Administration * Vendor Management * Contract Management * Financial Analysis * Stakeholder Engagement * Community Relations * Problem Solving * Leadership * Communication \& Presentation Skills * Organization \& Time Management Why Join Us? As a District Manager, you'll play a critical role in shaping and supporting some of Florida's most dynamic communities. You'll work directly with community leaders, oversee meaningful projects, and make a visible impact on the quality of life for residents while building a rewarding career with opportunities for advancement. Physical Requirements * Travel regularly to assigned Districts, Board meetings, and company offices. * Conduct outdoor inspections of community facilities and infrastructure. * Frequently sit, stand, walk, bend, and reach. * Occasionally lift and move up to 30 pounds. * Attend occasional evening Board meetings and community events. To support a safe and secure workplace, all offers of employment are contingent upon the successful completion of background screening, drug testing, and driving record review where applicable. Inframark is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against based on disability. Learn more about us at Community Management \- Inframark

jobs.title: Research Data Scientist
jobs.description: Innodata (Nasdaq: INOD) is a global data engineering company. We believe that data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) are inextricably linked. Our mission is to enable the responsible advancement of artificial intelligence by providing the data, evaluation frameworks, and human expertise required to build AI systems that can be trusted at scale. We provide a range of transferable solutions, platforms, and services for Generative AI / AI builders and adopters. In every relationship, we honor our 36\+ year legacy delivering the highest quality data and outstanding outcomes for our customers. **Scope of the Role:** We are looking for a highly skilled Research Data Scientist – GenAI/LLM to join our AI/LLM Delivery Unit and work on research\-driven AI/ML initiatives involving Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), NLP, multimodal AI, model evaluation, and AI data. The role combines strong research and analytical capabilities with hands\-on AI/ML expertise, requiring the candidate to design experiments, develop evaluation methodologies, analyze complex datasets, build research prototypes, and translate research findings into practical AI/ML solutions. The ideal candidate will have a strong research orientation, excellent statistical and analytical skills, and the ability to work collaboratively with researchers, data scientists, AI/ML engineers, domain experts, and client\-facing teams. **What You'll Own:** AI/ML \& Generative AI Research: * Conduct independent and collaborative research in Generative AI, LLMs, NLP, multimodal AI, machine learning, model evaluation, and AI data. * Formulate research questions and translate complex AI/ML problems into structured research methodologies and experiments. * Design, execute, and analyze experiments to evaluate and improve AI/ML models and solutions. * Build analytical models, prototypes, and research pipelines using Python and relevant ML frameworks. * Stay current with emerging research, methodologies, papers, and developments in GenAI, LLMs, NLP, multimodal models, and AI evaluation. *LLM \& Model Evaluation:* * Develop and implement LLM evaluation frameworks, benchmarks, datasets, and evaluation criteria. * Evaluate models for accuracy, robustness, bias, hallucination, reasoning, relevance, response quality, and other performance dimensions. * Conduct model benchmarking, error analysis, comparative analysis, and performance evaluation. * Work on areas such as RAG, SFT, RLHF/DPO, prompt engineering, fine\-tuning, embeddings, and LLM optimization, as applicable. * Identify model and data gaps and recommend improvements to enhance model performance and reliability. *Data Science \& Statistical Research:* * Collect, clean, analyze, and interpret large and complex structured and unstructured datasets. * Perform EDA, statistical analysis, hypothesis testing, significance testing, correlation analysis, sampling, and error analysis. * Develop data\-driven insights and identify patterns, trends, and relationships relevant to AI/ML research. * Apply appropriate statistical and quantitative methodologies to validate research findings *AI Data \& Dataset Development:* * Develop and evaluate datasets, sampling methodologies, taxonomies, annotation frameworks, data quality frameworks, and evaluation criteria for AI/ML models. * Analyze data quality and identify issues affecting model performance. * Collaborate with annotation, data engineering, and AI/ML teams to improve AI training and evaluation data. * Translate data and research findings into actionable recommendations for improving AI system *Research \& Innovation:* * Contribute to research papers, technical reports, whitepapers, patents, benchmarks, internal publications, and other research outputs, where applicable. * Identify opportunities to apply emerging research and technologies to real\-world AI and data challenges. * Explore new methodologies, models, datasets, and evaluation approaches to improve AI capabilities. * Contribute to capability building and innovation within the AI/LLM practice *Collaboration \& Stakeholder Engagement:* * Work closely with researchers, data scientists, AI/ML engineers, data/annotation teams, domain experts, and delivery teams. * Present research findings, analytical insights, and technical recommendations to senior technical stakeholders. * Translate complex research and technical concepts into clear, actionable recommendations. * Where required, participate in client\-facing technical discussions and presentations and help translate business requirements into AI/ML solutions. **You'll Thrive in This Role If You Have:** * Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computational Science, or a related discipline. * Bachelor's/Master's degree from IITs, NITs, or other premier engineering/research institutions is strongly preferred. * 4–7 years of hands\-on research experience in AI/ML, Data Science, NLP, Generative AI, LLMs, or related areas. * Strong demonstrated research experience with the ability to independently formulate research questions, design experiments, analyze results, and communicate findings. * Demonstrated research track record through research publications, patents, conference presentations, open\-source contributions, or significant AI/ML research projects. * Candidates with publications in reputed conferences/journals and a strong academic/research profile will be preferred * Strong proficiency in Python and SQL. * Strong hands\-on experience with NumPy, Pandas, Scikit\-learn, and preferably PyTorch/TensorFlow. * *Strong understanding of:* + *Machine learning algorithms* + *Statistics and experimentation* + *Data analysis and feature engineering* + *Model evaluation and performance metrics* + *Hypothesis testing and statistical inference* * Hands\-on exposure to LLMs, NLP, Generative AI, and multimodal AI. * Experience with one or more of RAG, LLM evaluation, prompt engineering, fine\-tuning, SFT, RLHF/DPO, embeddings, or model benchmarking. * Experience working with large\-scale structured and unstructured datasets. * Familiarity with Git and cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP is desirable. *The expected salary range for this position is $160,000 \- $185,000 p/year, based on experience, skills, and qualifications.* *Please be aware of recruitment scams involving individuals or organizations falsely claiming to represent employers. Innodata will never ask for payment, banking details, or sensitive personal information during the application process. To learn more on how to recognize job scams, please visit the Federal Trade Commission's guide at* https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/job\-scams. *If you believe you've been targeted by a recruitment scam, please report it to Innodata at* verifyjoboffer@innodata.com *and consider reporting it to the FTC at* ReportFraud.ftc.gov*.*

jobs.title: Staff Data Scientist: Intelligent Process Automation Solutions Designer
jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ Join Intuit's Intelligent Process Automation (IPA) team within the Customer Success organization. As an Intelligent Process Automation Solutions Designer, you will bridge business strategy and technical execution — designing, automating, and optimizing end\-to\-end workflows that drive transformation across Intuit's service and operational ecosystems. This role combines strategic systems architecture with deep technical implementation expertise in automation, AI/LLM integration, and cloud\-based process design. You will act as both a business process strategist and a hands\-on automation engineer, ensuring that every automation directly enhances business outcomes, scalability, and customer experience. **Responsibilities** *End\-to\-End Automation Design \& Architecture* * Lead the design and deployment of intelligent process automation solutions across Customer Success and adjacent business units. * Architect integrated systems connecting CRM, data pipelines, APIs, and AI services using AWS infrastructure, Jenkins, and microservice (MSAAS) environments. * Translate business requirements into solution blueprints and software design documentation that define data flow, integration points, and automation logic. * Oversee solution design from conceptualization to production, ensuring alignment with the company's automation strategy and governance frameworks. *AI and Agentic Systems Development* * Build, train, and validate functional models — both classical ML (classification, regression, ranking) and LLM\-based (fine\-tuning, prompt engineering, RAG) — not just orchestration layers on top of third\-party APIs. * Build Agentic AI capabilities that can autonomously perform business processes or support human decision\-making. * Design and implement LLM\-based interfaces and workflows for process orchestration, text understanding, and automation triggering. * Prototype, evaluate, and deploy new AI/ML and natural language processing solutions, ensuring measurable business value and compliance with data governance standards. *Technical Implementation \& Integration* * Develop, test, and deploy Python\-based automation frameworks, scripts, and microservices for workflow optimization. * Implement robust CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and AWS tools for automated deployment and version control of process automations. * Ensure automations are secure, compliant, and scalable, leveraging AWS security frameworks and best practices. *Business Partnership and Ownership* * Collaborate closely with business leaders, product managers, and data engineers to identify automation opportunities and define success metrics. * Act as a translator between business needs and technical execution, ensuring every automation aligns with key performance indicators (CSAT, efficiency, ROI). * Exhibit strong ownership and accountability — from ideation through implementation and performance monitoring. *Continuous Innovation \& Enablement* * Contribute directly to a culture of continuous improvement and innovation across automation initiatives. * Evaluate new technologies, frameworks, and AI capabilities relevant to intelligent process automation. * Lead proof\-of\-concepts and pilot programs for cutting\-edge automation use cases. * Mentor peers and contribute to the center of excellence for automation design, governance, and best practices. **Qualifications** *Technical Skills* * Demonstrated hands\-on experience building, training, and deploying functional models across both classical ML and LLM\-based approaches — this is weighted more heavily than API integration or orchestration experience alone. * Strong programming experience in Python (required); experience with JavaScript, Go, or similar languages a plus. * Experience in process automation, process mining, data pipelines, and system integrations using APIs and cloud\-native tools. * Expertise building and fine\-tuning Large Language Models (LLMs) and Agentic AI systems that interact with APIs, data, and end\-users — beyond simply calling third\-party LLM APIs. * Proficiency in AWS services (Lambda, S3, API Gateway, DynamoDB, Step Functions, CloudFormation, etc.). * Experience with Jenkins, microservices, and MSAAS architectures. * Understanding of event\-driven automation, and data governance/security principles. *Business \& Leadership Skills* * Proven ability to design solutions that blend technical feasibility with business impact. * Strong business acumen and understanding of operational processes, metrics, and automation ROI. * Skilled communicator — able to articulate technical strategies to non\-technical stakeholders. * Demonstrated ownership, accountability, and influence in cross\-functional environments. * Experience in driving process transformation initiatives across large\-scale organizations. *Preferred Experience* * Exposure to contact center, CRM, or customer service technologies. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; advanced degree or MBA preferred. Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers \| Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender. The expected base pay range for this position is: San Diego $185,500 \- $251,000

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer\-Digital intelligence in the Digital Intelligence team, you will be collaborating with a high\-caliber team of software developers and deep learning experts, you will specialize in large language modeling, optimization, interpretability, and related algorithms The ideal candidate brings a strong software engineering foundation combined with hands\-on, **zero\-to\-one machine learning development** experience. Above all, you will have a demonstrated ability to operate at the intersection of research and engineering, turning promising ideas into scalable, real\-world products within a fast\-paced, collaborative environment. **Job Responsibilities** * Research and prototype next\-generation architectures for structured and unstructured data * Develop novel pre\-training objectives tailored to financial event sequences and heterogeneous profile data * Implement research ideas in production\-quality code * Mentor engineers on ML best practices; jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: City: Denver Division: Corporate \- CFO Why work for us? A career at Janus Henderson is more than a job, it’s about investing in a brighter future together. Our Mission at Janus Henderson is to help clients define and achieve superior financial outcomes through differentiated insights, disciplined investments, and world\-class service. We will do this by protecting and growing our core business, amplifying our strengths and diversifying where we have the right. Our Values are key to driving our success, and are at the heart of everything we do: Clients Come First \- Always \| Execution Supersedes Intention \| Together We Win \| Diversity Improves Results \| Truth Builds Trust If our mission, values, and purpose align with your own, we would love to hear from you! Your opportunity This is a business\-facing engineering role. You will sit with business users, work out what is slowing them down, and turn those problems into AI and data solutions that reach production. The work starts with a conversation at someone’s desk, not a ticket in a queue. Janus Henderson is undertaking a firm\-wide AI transformation to become the most technologically sophisticated asset manager in the industry. Our AI capability sits in a single centralised function under the Head of AI, and Forward Deployed Engineering is the part of it that embeds with the business and builds what business units cannot stand up alone. You will work alongside the AI Enablement Partners, who surface and triage demand: where they establish what a team needs, you build it. Reporting to the Principal Forward Deployed Engineer, you own your solutions from first conversation to live running. The work spans the full stack — sourcing internal and external data, curating it into views that answer the questions a desk actually asks, and making it reusable through Accio, our centralised MCP server. The most advanced work is investment engineering: building quantitative capability on Nexus, our agentic workspace, and taking it from one desk to a firm\-wide offering such as relative\-value signal generation. Your toolkit spans Python and SQL, LLMs and agent frameworks, MCP, Azure AI Foundry through the AI Team’s model gateway, Snowflake, and Azure with Terraform, Docker, and CI/CD. What success looks like * You ship. What you build reaches production, is used by the business unit you built it for, and stays healthy once live. * Business users come to you early enough that you shape the problem rather than receive finished requirements. * Capability proven on one desk is exposed through Accio and Nexus so other teams consume it rather than rebuild it. * You need less direction over time, taking on engagements that are less defined and more technically demanding. Your responsibilities **Embed with the business** * Sit with business users — portfolio managers, analysts, traders, marketing, sales, HR, and operations — to understand their workflows, their data, and their day\-to\-day friction. * Partner with the AI Enablement Partners on escalated demand that business teams and citizen developers cannot deliver themselves. * Set realistic expectations on what is feasible, what it will take, and what it will not do. **Deliver solutions end to end** * Design, build, and productionise bespoke, higher\-complexity AI solutions, owning them through to live running. * Prototype with the business close at hand, then harden what works into production rather than leaving a demonstration. * Own the architecture and design decisions for your solutions, keeping them secure, scalable, and aligned to the enterprise core stack. * Take solutions through evaluation, observability, and our AI governance checkpoints, and keep them healthy afterwards. **Build investment capability on Nexus** * Build advanced investment capability on Nexus and make it available across the firm. * Work with quantitative researchers and investment teams to take models and signals from one desk into a supported, firm\-wide capability. * Put validation, monitoring, and reproducibility around signal output investment professionals rely on, and help take citizen developer workflows through to production. **Make data and capability reusable** * Source data through APIs, vendor feeds, and enterprise systems, and build the ingestion pipelines that keep it flowing. * Curate raw data into business\-focused views, and own its lineage, quality, and freshness. * Expose data and capability through Accio, and as skills, tools, and connectors on Nexus, so any approved agent or application can reach them. * Build reusable components rather than one\-off integrations, and feed the patterns back to AI Architecture and AI Engineering. **Work across the AI function** * Co\-build enterprise core\-stack deliverables with Percepta and AI Engineering, designed for transfer into business\-as\-usual. * Work with AI Security and AI Governance Implementation so solutions meet our security, data\-privacy, and responsible\-AI standards. * king knowledge of a major cloud, ideally Azure, with CI/CD, containers, and infrastructure as code. * Excellent stakeholder skills. You can run discovery with a portfolio manager in the morning and write the pipeline in the afternoon. * High agency and comfort with ambiguity, and genuine interest in the business problem rather than only the technology. Experience in a regulated environment where governance, compliance, and data sensitivity shape how solutions are built. * Nice to have skills * Asset management or financial services domain knowledge, particularly the investment process, front office workflows, or fixed income. * Quantitative investment concepts such as fair value, relative value, signal generation, or portfolio construction. * Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric / OneLake, or comparable enterprise data platforms. * Azure AI Foundry, model gateways, inference routing, or AI evaluation and observability in production. * TypeScript or a second production language, and front\-end experience for user\-facing AI applications. Supervisory responsibilities No. This is an individual\-contributor role. Forward Deployed Engineers lead delivery of their own engagements and mentor less experienced engineers, but do not line\-manage. * Potential for growth * Mentoring * Leadership development programs * Regular training * Career development services * Continuing education courses Compensation information The base salary range for this position is $145,000 \- $180,000\. This range is estimated for this role. Actual pay may be different. This position will be open through October 11, 2026\. **Colorado law requires an estimated closing date for job postings. Please don't be discouraged from applying if you see this date has passed.** At Janus Henderson Investors we’re committed to an inclusive and supportive environment. We believe diversity improves results and we welcome applications from candidates from all backgrounds. Don’t worry if you don’t think you tick every box, we still want to hear from you! The profit pool is funded based on Company profits. Individual bonuses are determined based on Company, department, team and individual performance. **Benefits:** Janus Henderson is committed to offering a comprehensive total rewards package to eligible employees that includes; competitive compensation, pension/retirement plans, and various health, wellbeing and lifestyle benefits. **Janus Henderson Investors is an equal opportunity employer**. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status. All applications are subject to background checks. jobs.title: Sr. UX Writer
jobs.description: **Who we are** Jellyvision makes ALEX®, the employee decision\-support platform trusted by thousands of employers and millions of people to make smart benefits choices. We've done that profitably, at scale, for a long time—over $600M in lifetime sales, without losing our soul or our sense of humor. Now we're taking on an even messier problem: Medicare. A small, senior team is building **MyALEXHealth™**, a digital Medicare guide designed to help people move from employer coverage into Medicare with clarity, confidence, and dignity. Our goal is simple and ambitious: reduce decision stress, improve plan fit, and help people feel good—not overwhelmed—about one of the most important health and financial decisions they'll ever make. This is an incubation\-stage product. Translation: ambiguity is a feature, not a bug. **What's the role?** We need someone who can write the way people actually talk (warm, clever, human), about Medicare (a subject that fights back), inside strict federal compliance (poetry with your hands tied), while architecting the branching logic beneath the words, coaxing an AI voice into sounding like someone you'd trust, and steering the whole thing through carrier and CMS review without a single detail slipping. If that list made you tired, we understand. If it made you a little excited, keep reading. You are, first and last, a great writer. Everything else serves that. Quick gut check on the voice we're after: someone decided the Part D coverage gap should be called "the donut hole," so a hole in your drug coverage would sound like a pastry. That move, making the scary thing feel like an inside joke the two of you are in on, is the whole gig. If you already have three better nicknames for Medicare's weirder corners, we should talk. **What you'll do to be successful** **1\) Write like a human being** * Draft interactive, branching advisor conversations that feel like a smart friend, not a robot reading a policy. Write the linear stuff too: teaser and marketing videos, articles, and UX copy down to the button label and the error state. * Keep voice and tone consistent so product and marketing read as one brand. The bar: people forget they're being walked through Medicare and just feel helped. **2\) Structure the branching and conditional logic so it's followable, buildable, and testable** * Hand engineers requirements, not riddles: here's the script, and here's what it needs the system to do. * Understand how data comes back from APIs and write so the words hold up against the real, messy data, not just the happy path. The bar: fewer "wait, the logic doesn't work that way" moments after handoff. **3\) Direct the sound** * Generate and shape AI voiceover for our host so it sounds like a person, not a GPS. * Direct live VO talent when a project calls for it, and pick the takes that land. * Edit, mix, and caption to a clean, launch\-ready standard. We'll train the technical mechanics; the ear is on you. The bar: the voice sounds real, and audio never becomes the bottleneck. **4\) Get it live, and get it cleared** * Own content in our CMS from first draft to live URL, and QA it against your own script. * Prep scripts for compliance review so they're accurate to the Medicare program and true to the letter of federal rules. * Work with team leadership on carrier and CMS feedback: sorting what needs a real change from what needs a clarifying reply, and making the change without killing the writing. The bar: content clears review in few rounds, with the charm intact. **And the part that ties it all together:** you own the script, then you coach it to life. Designers, engineers, and collaborators build with you, not for you. The vision and the translation come from you, and you bring people along by making them want to nail it. Think showrunner, not assembly line. **Experience \& skills you'll need** * 5\+ years of experience in a writing\-led, multi\-disciplinary role spanning some combination of interactive content, UX writing, conversational design, content strategy, or digital storytelling. * You write like people talk, and you're funny without visibly trying. * You think in systems. Branching logic and messy data don't scare you; they kind of delight you. * You have an ear. You can hear when a VO line runs a beat too long or lands a shade too chipper. * You sweat the details. In compliance, "close enough" is how brands get in trouble, and you catch the thing everyone else skims. * You treat AI as a power tool, not a threat. You know where it speeds you up and where it makes slop, and you never ship the slop. * You have the portfolio to prove it: real work where you made something complicated feel simple and something dry feel alive. Interactive, editorial, advertising, or education backgrounds all fit. We'll teach you the rest: Medicare's rulebook, our in\-house tools (some with zero documentation), and the audio\-mixing mechanics. Bring the instincts. We'll bring the manuals. **The Details** * **Location**: Remote * **Salary Range:** $115,000 \- $130,000 **What Jellyvision will give** ***you*** **Check out our benefits****here****!** Jellyvision is committed to continuous evolution and fostering a more diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone is welcomed, valued, and respected. It doesn't matter your race, ethnicity, religion, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity/expression, country of origin, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), criminal histories consistent with legal requirements or any other basis protected by law...we just want amazing people who are willing to grow along with us. Although we have a Chicago\-based HQ that employees are welcome to work out of whether they're local or just visiting, this position is also eligible for work by a remote employee out of AZ, CA, CO, CT, FL, GA, IL, IN, KY, MA, MI, MN, NC, NY, OH, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, WA or WI. **How to apply: write to us** We're looking for writers so a resume alone won't cut it for us. Skip the "why I'm a great fit" generic cover letter and submit this info instead to that section (in one document): * A short sample of you. About 150 words, any format, that shows us your voice. Make us feel something, or make us laugh once. * Since you're attaching your portfolio, choose two of your favorite pieces from it and write one line each on what was actually hard about them.

These include world\-class licensed process technologies, differentiated advisory services, deep technical domain expertise, energy transition solutions, high\-end design capabilities, and smart solutions to optimize planned and operating assets. KBR is seeking an experienced **Senior Project Engineer** to lead full‑lifecycle delivery of midstream assets supporting unconventional oil development and enhanced oil recovery (EOR) programs for locations in the Alberta, Canada. This role focuses on the engineering development and execution of midstream infrastructure projects, including pipelines, facilities, and thermal recovery operations such as SAGD (Steam\-Assisted Gravity Drainage) along with the related oil recovery systems. maintain risk registers and management of change (MOC). * Oversee the development and approval of basic PFDs/P\&IDs, HMBs, hydraulic calculations, line sizing, pipeline class/location analysis, materials selection, and corrosion/chemical treatment strategies. * Ensure strict compliance with HSE regulations, promoting a safety\-first culture across all project phases **Construction \& Field Execution** * Support and provide oversight of contractor bid, award, and construction; manage field engineering, RFI resolution, redlines/as‑builts, pre‑commissioning, and start‑up. * Commercial, Regulatory \& Stakeholder Management * Interface with clients, regulatory agencies, and stakeholders to ensure compliance with Alberta Energy Regulator (AER) and environmental standards * Interface with production, operations, HSE, subsurface, completions, measurement, and marketing to align designs with production targets and reliability KPIs. * Lead technical inputs for procurement activities (vendor selection, bid evaluations, and contract management) and commercial agreements (interconnects, tariffs, measurement/custody transfer, allocation and balancing). **Reliability, Integrity \& Optimization** * Identify opportunities for operational efficiency improvements and debottlenecking within midstream and upstream integrated systems. * Drive continuous improvement—benchmarking CAPEX/OPEX, standardizing designs, implementing digital tools (SCADA, historian, pipeline simulation, facility digital twins). **Required Education, Experience, \& Skills:** * Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Chemical, Petroleum, or Civil Engineering. Non\-engineering degreed professionals may also be considered with extensive proven relevant experience. * 10\+ years of relevant experience in oil \& gas project engineering, with strong exposure to midstream operations in Alberta. * Direct experience with SAGD facilities * Experience in brownfield modifications and facility expansions * Demonstrated experience managing engineering and construction projects for remote or oil sands environments. * Strong knowledge of pipeline systems, fluid handling, thermal systems, and oil processing infrastructure. * Familiarity with Canadian codes and standards (CSA, ASME, API) and AER regulations * Superior field presence, safety leadership, communication, and cross‑disciplinary coordination. * Proven ability to manage budgets, schedules, and multidiscipline teams effectively. * Proficiency in using standard office software like Microsoft Office Suite. **Preferred Education \& Skills:** * Professional Engineer (P.Eng.) designation in Alberta (APEGA) or eligibility to obtain within 12 months of employment. * Exposure to water treatment, steam generation (OTSG/HRSG), and heat integration systems. * Familiarity with AFE development, cost control, scheduling (Primavera P6 or MS Project), and contractor oversight. **Physical/Field Requirements** * Ability to visit remote field sites, walk ROWs and facilities, and work in all seasonal conditions in Alberta, Canada. * Comfortable with routine PPE and safety protocols; valid driver’s license and clean driving record. **Decarbonization – Energy Transition – Sustainability** **KBR Benefits** KBR offers a selection of competitive lifestyle benefits which could include 401K plan with company match, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, AD\&D, flexible spending account, disability, paid time off, or flexible work schedule.
