jobs.title: Software Deployment Engineer
jobs.description: About KPI Solutions KPI Solutions is a national supply chain consulting and warehouse automation systems integrator, helping some of the biggest names in e\-commerce, retail, and distribution move product faster and smarter. Formed in 2021 through the combination of Kuecker Logistics Group, PULSE Integration, and QC Software, KPI brings together decades of material handling and systems integration experience — rooted in material handling integration dating back to 1971\. From initial design through go\-live and ongoing support, KPI delivers engineered solutions that blend automated technologies (MHE, robotics, conveyor, ASRS, AMR/AGV) with intelligent warehouse execution software to optimize productivity, increase fulfillment speed, and build operational resilience for clients. **Position Summary** The Software Deployment Engineer I/II is an individual\-contributor role responsible for the end\-to\-end delivery, configuration, installation, and support of Kommand warehouse execution/control systems and related material handling hardware (pick\-to\-light, overhead illuminators, AutoStore, and T\-sort integrations). This role owns project\-level system configuration, commissioning, installation, upgrade, and live troubleshooting work independently, with minimal oversight, across both on\-site and remote/office phases of the project lifecycle. It combines software commissioning, hardware coordination, database scripting, environment configuration, and formal test/sign\-off responsibilities that have historically been distributed across multiple roles and a dedicated installation team. This position carries broadened scope following the consolidation of hardware installation and commissioning functions previously performed by a dedicated Systems Integration \& Commissioning (SI\&C) team, which has since been dissolved. The Software Deployment Engineer I/II is expected to operate as the primary and, in several functions, sole point of ownership for the responsibilities outlined below. **Key Responsibilities** **On\-Site Delivery** * Lead software commissioning of Kommand and peripheral hardware systems at customer sites; serve as primary technical owner, with hardware\-side support from junior/peer staff. * Own full\-scope installation of pick\-to\-light systems, including wiring, physical installation, configuration, and functional testing — a scope absorbed from the former SI\&C team. * Own full\-scope installation of overhead illuminator systems, following the same end\-to\-end responsibility as above. * Conduct IQ (Installation Qualification) and UAT (User Acceptance Testing) following installation, including preparation of formal test documentation and customer sign\-off. * Serve as the sole owner of Kommand and system\-level troubleshooting for live, in\-production issues during on\-site engagements. **Remote / Office Delivery** * Independently deliver new Kommand installations, including application pre\-configuration, database scripting, and pre\-deployment testing. Sole personnel on this workstream, currently managing 4 upcoming and 1 active installation. * Independently deliver Kommand version upgrades, including SSDT (SQL Server Data Tools) schema comparisons, version control, local pre\-install testing, and direct customer coordination. Sole personnel on this workstream, with approximately 22 major upgrades planned in the current year. * Production upgrade execution is performed after standard business hours to minimize customer downtime. * DEV, QA, and Sandbox environment work is performed during standard business hours. * Validate, diagnose, and remediate reported defects; route confirmed fixes to QA prior to merge and deployment. Escalation to other engineering resources is rare. * Participate in the on\-call rotation covering Kommand, AutoStore, and T\-sort system escalations. * Provide post\-go\-live project support on an as\-needed basis, including system migrations (e.g., bin/location migrations), integration testing with customer ERP/WMS platforms (e.g., SAP/WMS), and multi\-site rollout support. **Project Configuration \& Deployment** * Gather all Kommand configurations and system parameters required for a given project. * Translate the Business Requirements Document (BRD) and customer conversations into the Kommand system settings spreadsheet, network spreadsheet, and system parameters. * Educate the client on use of the host interface. * Not required for all projects — dependent on whether the customer's integration involves interface changes (e.g., AutoCase, Pack \& Hold). * Configure the client's Kommand sandbox environment to be project\-specific for customer testing, and support the client through that testing. * Configure the Kommand production environment ahead of go\-live. * Assist with training on any new features requiring customer or internal education. **Scope \& Independence** This role currently operates as the sole owner of several critical workstreams, including all new Kommand installations, all Kommand upgrade delivery, and all live Kommand/system troubleshooting. The role requires the judgment and technical depth to manage customer\-facing delivery, testing, and sign\-off without a dedicated support team, and to make sound decisions under time pressure during after\-hours production changes and live escalations. **Requirements** * Demonstrated experience commissioning warehouse execution/control software and associated hardware peripherals. * Working knowledge of SQL Server\-based application environments, including SSDT schema comparison and version control practices. * Experience with formal software testing methodology (IQ/UAT), including documentation and customer sign\-off processes. * Ability to independently diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve live production issues under time pressure. * Comfort with hands\-on installation work (wiring, hardware configuration) for pick\-to\-light and overhead illumination systems, or willingness/ability to develop this competency. * Willingness to work after hours and participate in an on\-call rotation. * Ability to translate business requirements documentation and customer conversations into structured system configuration (settings, network, and parameter specifications). * Strong customer\-facing communication skills; comfortable coordinating directly with customer stakeholders during upgrades, go\-live support, and system/interface training. **Preferred Qualifications** * Prior experience with AutoStore and/or T\-sort systems. * Experience with ERP/WMS integration testing (e.g., SAP). * Background in material handling, warehouse automation, or industrial controls environments. **Benefits** **What we Offer:** * + Medical Insurance * + Dental Insurance * + Vision Insurance * + Health Care Concierge Service * + 401(k) Retirement Plan (Pre\-tax \& Roth) * + Company paid Basic Life Insurance, Short\-Term Disability \& Long\-Term Disability * + Voluntary Life \& AD\&D Insurance * + Voluntary Accident, Critical Illness \& Hospital Indemnity Insurance * + Pet Insurance * + Milk Stork Program * + Wellness Program with gift card redemption and wellness challenges * + Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick \& 10 Holidays) * + Training \& Development **Why KPI Solutions?** At KPI Solutions, you’ll be part of a team that values innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement. This is more than a reporting role—it’s an opportunity to make a measurable impact on project success and business performance. *KPI Solutions provides equal employment opportunity to all individuals regardless of their race, color, creed, religion, gender, age, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by states, federal, or local law.*

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Technical Lead
jobs.description: **About Karoo Health** ====================== Cardiovascular care is often the \#1 cost for health plans and employers, with the current fee for service model incentivizing providers to maximize volume and throughput at the expense of clinical outcomes and patient satisfaction. Karoo’s mission is to improve the lives of every cardiac patient in America by transforming the current care model to improve patient outcomes at significantly lower cost. Karoo deploys a value\-based approach which combines a blend of traditional, guideline\-based medicine and state of the art digital tools to accomplish this important mission by enabling the conversion to, and success in, value\-based care arrangements for cardiovascular networks, health systems and payers. Karoo is backed by leading venture capitalists, including First Trust Capital Partners and BIP Ventures, and has near and medium\-term plans for further rounds. **Senior Software Engineer \- Technical Lead** ============================================== Job Description **Overview** ============ **Location:** Pittsburgh preferred, or remote, U.S.\-based**Type:** Full\-time technical leadership role**An Industry Defining Company** ================================ Karoo is a venture\-backed startup, prior to Series A, on a mission to transform cardiovascular care. Our platform is designed to empower large provider groups and health systems to succeed in value\-based care contracts with payers by improving patient outcomes and reducing cost of care through better coordination, analytics, and disease management. While our initial focus is cardiology, we are building a scalable operating system for managing complex conditions across the healthcare spectrum. This is a rare opportunity to join a mission\-driven founding team at a pivotal stage and help define the future of healthcare technology, with the power to improve the lives of patients with cardiovascular disease, the number one cause of death in America today.**The Role** ============ Karoo Health is seeking a skilled and dedicated Technical Leader to guide our core engineering efforts. In this role, you will maintain hands\-on contribution while stepping up to lead a small team of software engineers. You will be responsible for setting technical direction, driving agile processes (daily standups, sprint planning, retrospectives), and fostering a high\-performance culture. In order to do this job well, you must be a curious, pragmatic problem solver and an empathetic technical leader. You strive to produce simple solutions to complex problems and know how to lead constructive technical discussions to guide your team toward the best path forward. When applying, please include a description of why you’re interested in this role.**What You'll Do** ================== * **Lead and Mentor:** Set technical direction, unblock developers, and drive continuous improvement. * **Orchestrate Agile Processes:** Facilitate daily standups, weekly sprint planning, backlog grooming, and team retrospectives to ensure predictable and timely delivery. * **Execute**: Craft clean, testable, and maintainable code in collaboration with the team. * **Deliver**: Own the software from requirements development through deployment and maintenance. * **Operationalize Data**: Architect, optimize, and maintain databases to ensure reliability and performance * **Architect**: Design and deploy scalable, secure, cloud infrastructure leveraging infrastructure\-as\-code best practices * **Safeguard Data**: Ensure compliance with healthcare data regulations (e.g., HIPAA, HITRUST) **What We're Looking For** ========================== * At least 4 years of experience leading small technical teams with direct responsibility for deliverables. * Minimum 6 years of dedicated professional experience in backend or full stack engineering, ideally in a startup or fast\-paced environment. * Experience with healthcare data regulations (e.g., HIPAA, HITRUST) and data formats (e.g. FHIR). * Strong communication skills with an ability to translate product requirements into technical task breakdowns. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field, or equivalent work experience. * Deep understanding of cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and cloud\-native development. * Proficiency with relational and NoSQL databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB) and API design (RESTful, GraphQL). * Proven capability in system architecture, scalability, security best practices, and CI/CD pipelines. * Must be legally authorized to work in the United States and not require employer sponsorship now or in the future. **Why Join Us** =============== * Competitive salary and equity in an early\-stage startup * Opportunity to define the technical solution from the ground up * Possibly fully remote work environment with flexible hours * Health benefits, learning stipends, and professional development support * A collaborative and transparent company culture that values creativity and ownership **Equal Opportunity Statement** =============================== At Karoo Health Inc (“Karoo”), we believe that improving healthcare starts with creating a more equitable and inclusive world, both inside and outside our organization. We are committed to fostering a diverse workforce that reflects the communities we serve, and to building a culture where every team member feels valued, supported, and empowered. Our commitment to inclusion is reflected in initiatives such as equitable compensation practices, employee resource groups, inclusive benefits, and more. Karoo Health is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We maintain a strict policy of non\-discrimination for all applicants and employees. What does that mean for you? It means that we are dedicated to providing a workplace that is inclusive, respectful, and free from discrimination or harassment of any kind. Employment decisions at Karoo Health are made based on merit, qualifications, and business need, without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, marital status, veteran status, political affiliation, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law. This policy applies to every aspect of the employment journey, from recruitment and hiring to compensation, benefits, training, promotion, performance evaluation, and beyond. We’re committed to doing the right thing, always, and that includes creating a fair and inclusive hiring process and workplace for all.**Karoo Health welcomes all.** ============================== In the United States, compensation is determined by factors including location, role level, job\-related skills, experience, and market conditions. Some positions may also be eligible for bonuses, equity, or other benefits. To learn more about Karoo Health’s benefits, please contact our People Team.

jobs.description: **Requisition ID:** 182418 **Job Level:** Entry Level **Home District/Group:** Kiewit Infrastructure Engineers **Department:** Data Services **Market:** Transportation **Employment Type:** Full Time **Position Overview** --------------------- Do you have a passion for leveraging data to solve interesting business problems? At Kiewit, we believe analytics can create an exceptional experience for our most valued resource – our people. On our team, you’ll have the opportunity to see more, touch more, and do more than you ever imagined. With top\-notch health benefits, a wealth\-building 401(k) plan, and unbeatable growth opportunities, joining Kiewit ensures a lifetime of success. **Location** ------------ This position is based in our Omaha, NE office. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Design, develop, and maintain data pipelines using Python and SQL to ingest, transform, and load data into Azure SQL and other cloud platforms. * Integrate data from APIs and external sources, ensuring accuracy, reliability, and scalability. * Automate data workflows and processes to improve efficiency, reduce manual effort, and optimize data models. * Monitor data workflows and troubleshoot issues to ensure continuous availability and performance. * Ensure data integrity, security, and compliance across systems while improving performance and scalability. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams and stakeholders to understand data requirements and deliver robust technical solutions. * Research emerging and deliver results under deadlines * Highly motivated, with a demonstrated passion for learning and taking initiative * Strong work ethic, willing to do what it takes to get the job done right the first time Demonstrated commitment to ethics and integrity * Strong interpersonal skills and ability to communicate technical concepts to non\-technical audiences Technical Skills * Python for: o Connecting to APIs and ingesting data o Automating data workflows and processes o Exposure to AI/ML tools and concepts (preferred) * SQL for querying and managing relational databases * Familiarity with cloud platforms (Microsoft Azure, Snowflake) * Understanding of ETL processes and data lineage concepts * Knowledge of data modeling using tools like Power BI * (Preferred) Experience with Azure DevOps and Git\-based repositories for version control \#LI\-JP1 Other Requirements: * Regular, reliable attendance * Work productively and meet deadlines timely * Communicate and interact effectively and professionally with supervisors, employees, and others individually or in a team environment. * Perform work safely and effectively. Understand and follow oral and written instructions, including warning signs, equipment use, and other policies. * Work during normal operating hours to organize and complete work within given deadlines. Work overtime and weekends as required. * May work at various different locations and conditions may vary. jobs.description: Overview: Kimley\-Horn's Phoenix, AZ office is seeking a Civil Engineer\-in\-Training (EIT) with 3\+ years of experience to join their Surface Water team. This is not a remote position. Responsibilities: * The successful candidate can expect to work in a dynamic team environment on a range of projects including: + Surface water management studies + Hydrologic and hydraulic modeling + Analysis and design + Flood studies, resiliency and vulnerability assessments + Green infrastructure planning and design * As a critical member of the team, you will perform a variety of engineering tasks and will receive both on\-the\-job and formal training as well as mentorship and exposure to plan production, project financials, and client interactions Qualifications: * 3\+ years of experience with surface water modeling and/or design * Bachelors or Masters from an ABET accredited university in the field of Civil Engineering * "Engineer\-In\-Training" or "Engineering Intern" certification (or ability to obtain within 12 months) * Experience building and calibrating Hydraulic/Hydrology models such as ICPR4, HEC\-HMS, HEC\-RAS (1D and 2D), and SWMM * Working knowledge of ESRI ArcGIS (AutoCAD Civil 3D or Microstation a plus) * Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal skills * Strong sense of urgency and self\-initiative to meet client deadlines * Detail\-oriented with an ability to contribute to a positive work environment * Ability to work independently and as a team * Python programing experience desired but not required Why Kimley\-Horn?: At Kimley\-Horn, we do things differently. We take pride in how our employee retention, robust benefits package, and company values have led to Kimley\-Horn’s placement on the Fortune “100 Best Companies to Work” list for 19 years! *Key Benefits at Kimley\-Horn** Exceptional Retirement Plan: 2\-to1\- company match on up to 4% of eligible compensation (salary \+ bonus) and additional profit\-sharing contribution. * Comprehensive Health Coverage: Low\-cost medical, dental, and vision insurance options. * Time Off: Personal leave, flexible scheduling, floating holidays, and half\-day Fridays. * Financial Wellness: Student loan matching in our 401(k), and performance\-based bonuses. * Professional Development: Tuition reimbursement and extensive internal training programs. * Family\-Friendly Benefits: New Parent Leave, family building benefits, and childcare resources.

jobs.title: Sr. Geotechnical Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Summary** --------------- Under the direction of the Technical Services Manager, the Senior Geotechnical Engineer provides all underground geotechnical engineering activities for the Curlew mine to support safe, efficient, and productive mining operations. This role provides technical expertise for mine design, ground control, underground infrastructure, and operational planning while developing and maintaining geotechnical standards, programs, and best practices for the life of the mine. The Senior Geotechnical Engineer works closely with Operations, Technical Services, and contractors to identify and manage geotechnical risks, optimize mine performance, and ensure compliance with company standards and regulatory requirements. This position also provides technical leadership and mentorship while supporting the successful development, ramp\-up, and long\-term operation of the Curlew mine. **Essential Functions** ----------------------- * **Ground Control Management Planning:** Lead the design, implementation and continuous improvement of the Ground Control Management Plan (GCMP). * **Ground Support Design:** Lead ground control planning and design for underground excavations, including selection and optimization of rock bolts, mesh, shotcrete, cable bolts, and other support systems suitable for complex ground conditions. Work with mining teams to ensure effective application. * **QA/QC:** Lead Develop, implement and maintain the underground backfill and ground support QA/QC Program. * **Stope Sequencing and Design:** Use numerical modeling (FLAC3D, Map3D or other) as appropriate along with other analytical methods to support stope design, backfill performance, pillar stability, and sequencing. * **Instrumentation \& Monitoring:** Implement and manage underground monitoring systems including all types of best practice underground mine instrumentation. Analyze data to track ground performance and inform mine planning. * **Geotechnical Risk Management:** Identify ground control hazards, develop and maintain the mine’s Ground Control Trigger Action Response Plan (TARP) and work with all stakeholders to mitigate ground control hazards. * **Integrated Planning Support:** Collaborate closely with all stakeholders, including external consultants, corporate leadership and mine engineers, geology, and operations to provide geotechnical input into stope designs, development layouts, extraction sequencing, and backfill strategies. * **Project Management:** Manage scopes of work, budgets, and timelines for geotechnical components of capital and operational projects. * **Regulatory \& Compliance Support:** Prepare documentation in support of MSHA\-compliant ground control plans, permitting, and internal audits. * **Mentorship \& Team Leadership:** Provide mentorship and technical support to other engineers and geologists; participate in internal knowledge sharing and continuous improvement initiatives. * **Underground Field Work** This position works approximately 30% of the time in the underground. Underground work includes field observations on foot, driving underground, engaging with and collecting information from employees in the field, and providing education to employees. * **Additional Mining Engineering Duties** Regularly perform other mining engineering practices including but not limited to underground mine design, short term planning, ventilation, longhole stope D\&B design, stope reconciliations, operational support, etc. * **Surface and/or office work** This position works approximately 70% in an office setting on the surface. The majority of the office duties include performing essential functions on a computer screen, and attending or facilitating meetings. **Qualifications and Skills** ----------------------------- * **Required Qualifications:** + Bachelor’s degree in geological engineering, geotechnical engineering, geology, mining or civil engineering or equivalent. + Geotechnical Experience: Underground 5\+ Years. + Familiarity with U.S. mining regulations under 30 CFR and its PPMaProficiency in rock mechanics design, numerical modeling, and ground monitoring techniques. + Strong field presence and practical problem\-solving skills. + Strong verbal, written, analytical and persuasive skills and the ability to interact effectively with all levels of employees and management. + Ability to work independently and as a member of the Technical Services team. + Prior practice in other mining engineering practices such as short term planning, stope design and ventilation. + Demonstrate strong administrative, organizational and technical writing skills. + Requires a valid driver’s license. * **Preferred Qualifications:** + Experience with instrumentation data systems (e.g., GroundProbe, IDS, Vibrating Wire sensors). + Strong understanding of common U.S. mining methods (e.g., longhole stoping, cut \& fill, ). + Experience with backfill systems ( cemented rockfill, uncemented fill) and their interaction with excavation stability. + Working knowledge of Deswik preferable and Rocscience and Map3D software desirable. **Health, Safety, and Environmental Requirements** -------------------------------------------------- * Adheres to all safety and environmental considerations. * Has a strong commitment to safe working practices. * Wears Personal Protective Equipment at all times while in the production environment. * Is alert and observes, corrects, and reports unsafe conditions. * Follows operating procedures and complies with all regulatory requirements. **Kinross Leadership Practices** -------------------------------- * Creates an environment where nothing is more important than every employee returning home safe and healthy every day. * Creates an environment in which people are unfailingly treated with respect * Fosters the talent and potential of all employees by enabling them to grow, develop, and make a difference in the organization. * Demonstrates that leadership in the areas of environmental performance and community and stakeholder relations is fundamental to the way we plan and manage our business. * Holds self and others accountable for the decisions, commitments, and behaviors required to deliver outstanding results. * Uses judgment to manage business complexities, prioritize and balance conflicting demands to make timely decisions that best advance Kinross strategy. * Builds and brings teams and people together to achieve organizational goals. Models’ humility by going beyond self\-interest for the good of the group. * Understands the economic implications of decisions and consistently uses all resources effectively and efficiently to maximize shareholder value. * Relentlessly champions, develops and embeds best practices. **Kinross Competencies** ------------------------ * **Strategic Effectiveness** Developing and communicating rigorous and creative business strategies that drive sustainable value. * **External Engagement** Understanding and building relationships with external parties that strengthen and sustain competitive advantage. * **Business Focus** Applying commercial rigor and discipline to all business decisions and customer relationships. * **Living the Kinross Values** Aligning behavior, decisions, and actions with Kinross values and principles. **This description is a general statement of required major duties and responsibilities performed on a regular and continuous basis. It does not exclude other duties as assigned.** **Reporting Relationships** --------------------------- Reports to the Technical Services Manager **Language Requirements** ------------------------- English **Compensation Data** --------------------- Salary Range: $115,000 \- $135,000 * Medical, dental, and vision insurance * 401k with match * Paid time off * Stock purchase option * Basic life insurance * Short Term Incentive

jobs.title: Web Designer/Developer III – .NET / Front-End (REMOTE)
jobs.description: This position may be filled prior to the posted deadline. Interested candidates are encouraged to apply as soon as possible. Koniag Operations Services, LLC a Koniag Government Services company, is seeking a Web Designer/Developer III – .NET / Front\-End to support KOS and our government customer. The position is remote. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) retirement plan, paid time off, paid parental leave, life and disability insurance, flexible spending accounts, commuter benefits and tuition reimbursement. The Web Designer/Developer III is an integral member of a team supporting a federal client’s application development and modernization efforts. This role is responsible for designing, developing, testing, maintaining, and documenting secure web and database applications. The ideal candidate brings strong .NET and front\-end development experience, UI/UX capabilities, API integration experience, and the ability to work effectively with technical teams, security personnel, and business stakeholders. The position is 100% remote within CONUS, with Eastern Time Zone candidates preferred but not required. Essential Functions, Responsibilities \& Duties may include, but are not limited to: * Design, develop, test, maintain, and document secure web and database applications using .NET technologies. * Develop responsive, user\-focused front\-end solutions incorporating sound UI/UX principles. * Work within Agile development processes across requirements, design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance. * Gather and translate customer and stakeholder requirements into technical solutions. * Develop and securely integrate APIs, databases, and external data feeds. * Apply secure development practices, including OWASP\-aligned coding standards. * Develop and support cloud\-based applications in Azure, leveraging Azure and AWS development experience as required. * Maintain source code, technical documentation, configuration information, and deployment artifacts in approved repositories. * Participate in code reviews, vulnerability scanning/remediation, troubleshooting, and root\-cause analysis. * Collaborate with systems, security, database, cloud, and administrative teams. * Support GIS/geospatial integrations where applicable, preferably using ESRI/ArcGIS technologies. * Contribute to testing, stakeholder feedback cycles, knowledge transfer, and continuous improvement. **Work Experience, Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities:** * Demonstrated experience in Agile web and database application development. * Strong proficiency in .NET/C\# and modern front\-end development. * Experience with UI/UX design and implementation. * Experience developing and integrating APIs, including RESTful APIs. * Experience architecting or developing applications in Azure and AWS. * Knowledge of secure software development practices and web application security standards such as OWASP. * Strong troubleshooting, debugging, and analytical skills. * Ability to independently design and own technical solutions with limited oversight. * Strong written and verbal communication skills and ability to work with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Bachelor's degree or equivalent. * Application Development certification (.NET required). * Secure development certification. * Federal government or FISMA\-regulated environment experience preferred. * GIS/ESRI integration experience preferred. * Experience leveraging AI\-enabled capabilities within applications or business processes is a plus; heavy AI/ML development is not required. Our Equal Employment Opportunity Policy The company is an equal opportunity employer. The company shall not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, color, religion, creed, ethnicity, sex, sexual orientation, gender or gender identity (except where gender is a bona fide occupational qualification), national origin or ancestry, age, disability, citizenship, military/veteran status, marital status, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. We are committed to equal employment opportunity in all decisions related to employment, promotion, wages, benefits, and all other privileges, terms, and conditions of employment. The company is dedicated to seeking all qualified applicants. If you require an accommodation to navigate or apply for a position on our website, please get in touch with Heaven Wood via e\-mail at accommodations@koniag\-gs.com or by calling 703\-488\-9377 to request accommodations. Koniag Government Services (KGS) is an Alaska Native Owned corporation supporting the values and traditions of our native communities through an agile employee and corporate culture that delivers Enterprise Solutions, Professional Services and Operational Management to Federal Government Agencies. As a wholly owned subsidiary of Koniag, we apply our proven commercial solutions to a deep knowledge of Defense and Civilian missions to provide forward leaning technical, professional, and operational solutions. KGS enables successful mission outcomes for our customers through solution\-oriented business partnerships and a commitment to exceptional service delivery. We ensure long\-term success with a continuous improvement approach while balancing the collective interests of our customers, employees, and native communities. jobs.title: Sr Software Engineer II, AI
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Denver, CO; New York, NY **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- On\-site **Department** -------------- Engineering **We require people to be on\-site, 4 days/week at our Denver or NYC office and are unable to offer relocation support.** **About LG Ads:** LG Ads is a leading global ad solutions company, transforming the advertising landscape through innovative technologies. We are building the future of AdTech with our A.I. Data System (ADS), our proprietary AI agent designed to enhance every aspect of our business, from internal operations to external partner experiences. **Job Summary:** LG Ads is seeking a motivated AI Platform Engineer to join our AI team and help build the in\-house platform powering generative AI agents deployed business wide. You'll contribute to the end to end stack; LLM serving and inference, RAG pipelines, evaluation harnesses and the APIs and infrastructure that put agents in production driving efficiency, unlocking new revenue streams and enabling self\-service data capabilities across the organization. The role is hands\-on: you'll write production Python, integrate with services like AWS Bedrock and vector stores, instrument systems for observability and tune for latency, throughput and cost. We're looking for someone with a foundation in platform engineering and a working understanding of intent detection, query decomposition and context engineering, who is comfortable with agile delivery and can thrive in an ambiguous, fast\-paced environment. **Responsibilities:** * Build and maintain LLM\-powered services and APIs (FastAPI, webhooks, LangGraph), translating prototypes into production\-ready endpoints with proper error handling, retries and timeouts. * Develop evaluation harnesses and offline/online eval pipelines to measure quality regressions, hallucination rates and task specific accuracy as models and prompts evolve. * Instrument services with logging, tracing, and metrics (latency percentiles, token usage, error rates) so production behavior is observable and debuggable. * Design and develop intelligent AI agents capable of intent recognition and decomposing complex queries into smaller, executable tasks that run in sequence or parallel. * Implement and optimize context engineering techniques to ensure agents leverage relevant short and long\-term memory, as well as our aggregated knowledge base, for accurate and insightful responses. * Integrate AI agents with internal systems such as ACR, Mosaic, and Salesforce, and third\-party services like SpringServe and DSPs. * Utilize and contribute to the development of standardized tooling protocols to streamline integration and maintenance of AI agents. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including product, and business units, to identify and build AI solutions that span the entire company. * Develop and implement solutions for operational efficiencies, such as automating media planning and integrating agents into Mosaic (Home Grown DSP). * Build client\-facing tools for voice and natural language data queries, supporting custom data and contributing to data monetization efforts for the ACR platform. * Automate repetitive tasks in General \& Administrative (G\&A) functions, starting with Finance, and expanding to HR and IT Operations. * Enable self\-service data access and analysis using AI agents, supporting diverse data sources. * Participate in agile development sprints, actively contributing to planning, execution, and review. * Manage ambiguity and adapt to evolving requirements in a rapidly developing AI landscape. **Required Skills and Qualifications:** * Proven experience in designing and developing Generative AI agents. * Strong expertise in intent detection and complex query decomposition. * Demonstrated experience with context engineering for AI models. * Proven understanding of knowledge graphs and/or vectorization as it relates to LLMs * Experience building RAG systems including low level design and implementation of such systems. * Solid understanding of large language models (LLMs) and their application in enterprise solutions, including foundational models like Llama 4 Maverick, Claude, and OpenAI. * Experience with cloud platforms, particularly AWS, for scalable compute and storage resources. * Familiarity with Databricks for processing structured and unstructured data, and its use as a runtime for agents and MCPs. * Experience working in an agile development environment. * Experience in Databricks / Snowflake and all the associated AI components * Experience in AWS ( or the two other big clouds) and the associated AI Services **Education:** * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related quantitative field. LG Ad Solutions provides equal work opportunities to all team members and applicants, and it prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type on the basis of race, color, ethnicity, caste, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by our policies or federal, state, or local laws. We want to ensure that our hiring process is accessible. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process because of a medical condition or disability, please send an email to careers@lgads.tv to let us know the nature of your request. **Application Deadline:** September 30, 2026 **Compensation \& Benefits** * Tier 1\* (San Francisco Bay Area, New York City Tri\-State Area, Los Angeles Metro Area, and Seattle Metro Area)$185,000 \- $264,000/year * Tier 2\* (all other U.S. Locations outside of Tier 1\) $162,000 – $231,000/yr * Offers Bonus * Benefits \& Perks: 100% employer\-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and eligible dependents. Company\-paid life and AD\&D, STD and LTD insurance, plus optional supplemental coverage. 401(k) with company match. Flexible Time Off (FTO). Paid parental leave. * Certain markets, including the San Francisco Bay Area, New York City Tri\-State Area, Los Angeles Metro Area, and Seattle Metro Area, are aligned to Tier 1 compensation bands. All other U.S. locations \-including Denver \- are aligned to Tier 2 compensation bands. The compensation offered will take into account internal equity and may vary depending on the candidate's geographic region, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

jobs.title: CAD Detailer
jobs.description: LJ Inc. is a leader in providing cutting\-edge industrial, commercial, and residential turn\-key solutions and dedicated to delivering exceptional services to our valued customers. With a strong commitment to innovation, quality, and customer satisfaction, we have established ourselves as a trusted name in the industry. Our team is comprised of talented professionals who are passionate about what they do. We believe in providing our employees with the necessary tools, resources, and support to excel in their roles and reach their full potential. At LJ Inc, we strive for excellence in everything we do. We embrace new technologies, methodologies, and industry trends to stay ahead of the curve. Our commitment to continuous improvement and customer satisfaction sets us apart and drives our success. Join our team and become part of a company that values your skills, knowledge, and contribution. The CAD Designer / Detailer is responsible for creating, modifying, and maintaining detailed engineering drawings and 3D models for fabricated equipment, structural steel assemblies, and industrial machinery. This position works closely with engineers, manufacturing personnel, project managers, and vendors to develop accurate documentation that supports fabrication, assembly, installation, and procurement activities. **Essential Job Functions:** **Design and Drafting** * Create detailed 2D drawings and 3D models using CAD software (Creo, SolidWorks, AutoCAD, or similar). * Develop fabrication, assembly, and installation drawings from engineering concepts and calculations. * Generate bills of materials (BOMs), cut lists, weldment details, and drawing packages. * Create and maintain part, assembly, and drawing files in accordance with company standards. * Produce detailed component drawings for machining, fabrication, and purchased parts. * Apply GD\&T principles and dimensioning practices as required. **Engineering Support** * Collaborate with engineers to transform conceptual designs into manufacturable products. * Support design reviews and incorporate feedback into revised drawings. * Assist with design improvements focused on manufacturability, cost reduction, and standardization. * Participate in prototype development, testing, and troubleshooting activities. **Documentation and Change Management** * Maintain engineering documentation within the company's PDM/PLM and ERP systems. * Process engineering change requests, AAR change notice and revise drawings accordingly. * Ensure document control procedures are followed. * Support development and maintenance of engineering standards and drafting practices. **Manufacturing Support** * Provide technical support to fabrication, welding, machining, and assembly teams. * Resolve drawing discrepancies and manufacturing issues. * Assist with shop floor layout reviews and fit\-up evaluations. * Coordinate with purchasing regarding material specifications and vendor requirements. **Quality and Safety** * Verify drawing accuracy and completeness before release. * Ensure designs comply with applicable industry standards, codes, and safety requirements MIOSHA, MSHA and OSHA. * Participate in continuous improvement initiatives related to engineering processes and documentation. **Qualifications:** * Associate Degree in Mechanical Design Technology, Drafting Technology, Engineering Technology, or related field. * Minimum 3 years of CAD detailing and mechanical design experience. * Proficiency with 3D CAD software such as Creo, SolidWorks, Inventor, or similar. * Experience creating detailed fabrication and assembly drawings. * Strong understanding of engineering drawing standards and drafting principles. * Ability to read and interpret engineering specifications and technical documents. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office products. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with structural steel, heavy equipment, process equipment, or industrial machinery. * Knowledge of weldments, fabricated assemblies, machining, and manufacturing processes. * Experience with ERP, PDM, or PLM systems. * Knowledge of GD\&T. * Experience working in a project\-based manufacturing environment. * Familiarity with finite element analysis (FEA) concepts. **Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities** **Technical Skills** * 3D solid modeling * Mechanical design principles * Sheet metal and weldment design * Structural steel detailing * Mechanical assemblies * Bill of Materials development * Engineering change management * Design for Manufacturability (DFM) * Welding symbols and how to apply them. **Soft Skills** * Strong attention to detail * Excellent organizational skills * Effective verbal and written communication * Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously * Problem\-solving and analytical thinking * Strong teamwork and collaboration skills **What we offer:** * Competitive compensation * 100% company paid health insurance for employee and dependents * 100% company paid dental and vision for employee and dependents * 401k with 3% company match * Overtime after 8 hours * PTO * And much more!

jobs.title: Senior Data & Analytics Engineer
jobs.description: Founded in 1981, Lanter Delivery Systems is a national logistics company and a leader in overnight, unattended delivery of auto, agricultural and industrial parts from their customer's distribution centers to dealer locations. In the 21st century we live in a business culture that demands cost and logistical efficiencies combined with increased productivity. Lanter's strategic, process driven approach has been embraced by the marketplace and is setting new standards in the automotive and agricultural manufacturing marketplace. We see a bright future on the road before us and we are very excited about bringing our solutions to a variety of new industries. The ideal candidate will embody our company's Non\-Negotiables:* **Walk in Humble Confidence** \- We are experts at what we do, but we never assume we know everything * **Be Open, Honest and Respectful** \- We say what has to be said in a tactful, courteous way * **Be Fearless** \- We never fail, we only learn * **We are One Team** \- We achieve more together by collaboration and consensus * **Delivery on Commitments** \- We do what we say we will do * **We have a Passion to Serve** \- We are dedicated, hardworking individuals who provide exceptional service to our customers and to each other * **We put Safety First** \- We prioritize the safety of our team members and customers above all else in our business * **We Strive for Operational Excellence** \- We are dedicated to a culture of continuous improvements, driving quality and productivity **Position Summary:** The Senior Data \& Analytics Engineer supports the continued development and reliability of Lanter’s enterprise data platform. Working within an Azure and Databricks environment, this position builds and enhances data pipelines, integrates new data sources, develops reporting\-ready datasets, and implements automated testing to protect the integrity of production ETL/ELT processes. This hands\-on role works across data engineering, analytics, data modeling, governance, and reporting. The position partners with business and technical stakeholders to translate complex requirements into accurate, scalable, and understandable data solutions. **Essential Duties and Key Deliverables:*** Build and operate ETL/ELT pipelines using Databricks, SQL, Python, Spark/PySpark, and Azure Data Lake. * Develop an integrated enterprise gold\-layer model spanning source systems, customers, and operating companies. * Build dimensional serving\-layer and data\-mart models with deliberate decisions regarding grain, keys, conformed dimensions, historical data, and slowly changing dimensions. * Implement automated regression testing using defined inputs and expected outputs to validate pipelines and transformations. * Own orchestration, observability, performance, failure diagnosis, replay and recovery, root\-cause fixes, and cost management for assigned production solutions. * Partner with stakeholders to reconcile business definitions and establish data requirements, rules, ownership, and governance standards. * Apply disciplined engineering practices, including Git, code review, reusable components, automated testing, controlled deployments, and technical documentation. * Develop analytics and reporting solutions using Sigma, Power BI, or comparable platforms. * Support strategic data initiatives across Lanter’s business units and industry verticals, including AI, operational visibility, and analytics enablement. * Independently own deliverables and provide technical guidance on complex data and analytics needs. **Required Experience and Skills:*** 5\+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, BI engineering, or a related field. * Strong, recent, hands\-on experience developing production pipelines with Python and Spark/PySpark. * Advanced SQL skills and hands\-on experience with Databricks, Azure Data Lake, and Azure DevOps or comparable technologies. * Experience designing integrated enterprise models and dimensional data marts, including grain, keys, conformed dimensions, history, and slowly changing dimensions. * Experience implementing automated testing, regression testing, data\-quality controls, and pipeline validation. * Experience operating production data solutions, including monitoring, optimization, troubleshooting, recovery, and cost management. * Experience with Git, code review, CI/CD, reusable development practices, and technical documentation. * Ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable data and analytics solutions. * Strong communication, collaboration, problem\-solving, and independent ownership skills. **Preferred Experience:*** Experience in logistics, transportation, supply chain, or another operationally complex environment. * Experience supporting data governance, AI, or advanced analytics initiatives. **Supervisory Responsibilities:** This position has no direct supervisory responsibilities but is expected to provide technical guidance and serve as a resource for complex data and analytics needs.**Position Type:** ================== This is a full\-time, remote position. Proximity to Lanter’s St. Louis headquarters is preferred but not required, and there is no regular onsite work requirement.**Travel:** =========== Travel may be required periodically for company meetings, training, or other business needs. **Work Environment:** This job is performed in a professional remote or office environment. The role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, and other job\-related technology or systems. The team member may be required to sit for extended periods of time while working at a computer and communicating with internal and external business partners. **Physical Demands:** The team member is regularly required to listen, communicate verbally and in writing, sit for extended periods of time, use a computer and other office equipment, and occasionally lift up to 15 pounds at a time. **Other Duties:** **This job description is not designed to cover a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities required of the team member for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may vary by location based on business needs and may change at any time with or without notice.** ======================================================================================================================================================================================================================================================================================================= **EEO Statement:** ================== Lanter Delivery Systems provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all team members and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, Lanter Delivery Systems complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training. Lanter Delivery Systems expressly prohibits any form of workplace harassment based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status. Improper interference with the ability of Lanter Delivery Systems team members to perform their job duties may result in discipline up to and including discharge.

jobs.title: Product Security Engineer
jobs.description: #### **About the Job:** LaunchDarkly's Product Security team is hiring a Product Security Engineer II to strengthen how we secure the platform engineers build with every day. You'll bring depth in security fundamentals and program design as a member of a small, high\-leverage team with strong engineering instincts. LaunchDarkly is critical infrastructure. Our security team keeps it safe for the global systems that depend on us. You'll spend most of your time on threat modeling and cloud security posture, with rotating exposure to the rest of the ProdSec surface area. Your work will help developers move fast without sacrificing security, through automation, guidance, and the kind of partnership that makes the secure path the easy one. You'll report to the Director of Security and work closely with software engineers, product managers, and other security engineers. We expect you to bring a sharp point of view on where AI can take work off the team's plate and make our coverage deeper. #### **Responsibilities:** * Lead threat modeling engagements on the features and services where the risk warrants it. * Partner with the ProdSec lead to evolve the practice from on\-request to repeatable, with clear criteria for when an engagement is worth running. * Own day\-to\-day triage of CNAPP findings end to end. Investigate, prioritize, route to service owners, and close the loop. Look for patterns that point to systemic fixes instead of one\-off cleanup. * Contribute to SDLC tooling, SAST/SCA workflows, and bug bounty triage as the team's work demands. * Partner with product engineering teams as a trusted reviewer. Catch issues early, explain the why, propose paths forward. Say no when needed, with reasons and alternatives. * Bring AI to the work. Help the team build durable patterns for safe and effective use, not one\-off prompts. * Push the security floor up over time through documentation, office hours, small tooling improvements, and the kind of compounding work that prevents incidents rather than responds to them. #### **About You:** * You're proactive by default. You'd rather spot drift early and fix the cause than chase symptoms after an incident. * You believe security is a craft of habits and systems. Small consistent improvements beat heroic one\-offs. * You invest in relationships with the engineering, product, and leadership teams you work with. * You know security work moves at the speed of trust. * You're a good partner. You're helpful and direct, you say no with reasons and alternatives, and you don't mistake gatekeeping for rigor. * You're security\-first by background but engineering\-curious by nature. You want to understand how the systems work, not just what's wrong with them. * You treat AI as part of the toolkit. You're skeptical where you should be, aggressive where it pays off, and you want to work somewhere that's serious about both. #### **Qualifications:** * 2 to 4 years of full\-time experience in a security\-focused role. AppSec, ProdSec, or cloud security preferred. * Comfortable reading and critiquing pull requests in a modern stack. You don't need to ship production services, but you should follow the code, ask sharp questions, and write small tools when it helps. * Experience participating in or leading threat modeling exercises. Familiar with at least one structured approach (STRIDE, attack trees, or equivalent). * Working knowledge of cloud security posture. Exposure to a CNAPP is a strong plus. * Strong fundamentals: OWASP Top 10, authentication and authorization patterns, secrets management, common cloud misconfigurations. * Hands\-on experience applying AI tooling to security or engineering work. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location.* * *Within the United States, our geographic pay zones are defined by counties surrounding major metropolitan areas.* *\*\*Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), health, vision, and dental insurance, and mental health benefits in addition to salary.* #### **About LaunchDarkly:** Modern software delivery was supposed to be the foundation for a thriving digital business but reality has proven otherwise. The Lead Data Engineer will provide technical leadership to our Product Team. This is done by helping design and implement our next generation data and analytics platforms and products using Data engineering best practices. The Lead Data Engineer also will implementing engineering solutions along with the team. jobs.title: Principal Engineer Data Network Planning
jobs.description: About Lightpath Lightpath is building the fiber infrastructure the digital economy depends on \- owning, operating, and expanding dense, high\-performance networks for enterprises, public institutions, carriers, and cloud innovators. Our all\-fiber network supports mission\-critical environments, from financial markets and healthcare systems to AI platforms and next\-generation cloud architectures. As we expand across the Northeast and into high\-growth markets nationwide, we invest ahead of demand \- building infrastructure with precision, resilience, and accountability. To support that growth, we’re building a team of people who take ownership, think long\-term, and take pride in tackling complex work with care and integrity. At Lightpath, every role contributes to infrastructure that powers critical systems and real\-world outcomes. We look for individuals who value precision, accountability, and collaboration and who want to help build networks, processes, and partnerships that are engineered to last. **Job Summary** The Principal Engineer Data Network Planning at Lightpath plays a critical role in shaping and executing network strategies to optimize the company's next\-generation fiber\-optic network. This role requires a blend of technical expertise, strategic vision, and leadership skills to oversee the design, architecture, and implementation of scalable and secure network solutions. Key responsibilities include developing and enforcing network policies, leading network platform decisions, and ensuring the network meets performance and reliability standards. The role also involves collaborating closely with various business units, including Sales Engineering, Product, and Operations, to design and deliver custom network solutions that exceed customer expectations. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in telecommunications, with extensive knowledge of network protocols (such as MP\-BGP, OSPF, LDP, ISIS, SR and MPLS), experience with network devices and services, and a proven track record in managing large\-scale network projects. They will also possess strong project management skills and the capability to stay ahead of industry trends and technological advancements. The Principal Engineer will be instrumental in ensuring that Lightpath’s network infrastructure is robust, scalable, and aligned with the company’s strategic objectives, all while maintaining a focus on cost\-effective solutions and continuous improvement. **Responsibilities** * Develop and execute network strategies that align with Lightpath’s business goals, focusing on expanding and optimizing our next\-generation fiber\-optic network. * Analyze and drive key decisions regarding network platforms, ensuring alignment with Lightpath’s strategic goals. * Oversee the design and architecture of network solutions, ensuring they are scalable, secure, and capable of meeting the demands of diverse customer needs. * Experience configuring, deploying, and integrating network devices and services. * Establish and enforce network policies, technical standards, and configuration protocols to maintain network integrity and security. * Collaborate with the sales and customer service teams to design and deliver custom network solutions that exceed customer expectations. * Stay abreast of the latest industry trends and emerging technologies and integrate innovative solutions into Lightpath’s network infrastructure. * Develop and manage Capital Expenditure (CapEx) budgets, ensuring cost\-effective deployment of network infrastructure. * Assess the functionality of hardware, software, and tools, ensuring they meet the network’s performance and reliability standards. * Oversee the certification process for hardware and software systems and lead the selection of new tools and technologies to support network operations. * Evaluate new products, manage RFI/RFP processes, and oversee new feature testing to ensure compatibility with existing network infrastructure. * Lead proof of concept initiatives and remediation testing to validate new technologies and resolve any issues before full\-scale deployment. * Develop and maintain relationships with equipment suppliers and industry research departments to keep up knowledge on technological roadmaps. * Responsible for the support of legacy technologies and alternative replacement when needed. * Develop and project manage programmed circuit migrations to improve the state of the core network. * Prepare Engineering Cost and Planning estimates \& Projections for Large Scale Projects and Customer Solutions. **Qualifications** * BS Degree – Engineering, Telecommunication or Computer Science or equivalent experience. Masters preferred. * 7\-10\+ Years of telecommunications experience **Technology and Hardware Knowledge** * Extensive and demonstrable knowledge of MP\-BGP, OSPF, LDP, ISIS, SR, MPLS, TCP/IP in a service provider/carrier network required. * Proficient troubleshooting L2/L3 skills required. * Adept understanding of internet routing security techniques and tools including IRR and RPKI required. * Knowledge of QoS/CoS including traffic classification, marking, policing and shaping, queuing and hardware/software buffers required. * Working knowledge and experience with Cisco ASR and NCS platforms, IOS\-XE and IOS\-XR are preferred. Knowledge of Juniper Junos and Arisa EOS is a plus. * Extensive and demonstrable knowledge of MEF Carrier Ethernet products and standards, OAM tools including Y.1731 statistics collection, Interconnection, and Wholesale Mobile Backhaul required. * Understanding of various service testing methodologies (RFC2544, Y.1564, RFC6349\), and their key use cases and differences required * Experience with field\-based work in POPs, carrier hotels, data centers, cable head ends, and telco central office environments preferred. * Understanding of active and passive xWDM transport systems, colored and tunable transceivers, DOM/DDM diagnostics, power and thermal management, and troubleshooting preferred * Network lab test equipment (Keysight, Ixia, Spirent) experience desired. * Optical circuit switch/cross\-connect (OCC/OXC) experience desired. * On\-premises DDOS mitigation technology (Radware, Corero, etc.) knowledge and experience desired * SD\-WAN (Meraki, Versa, etc.) knowledge and experience desired * Azure ExpressRoute, AWS Direct Connect, Google GCP, Oracle OCI as a service provider/carrier knowledge and experience desired. * Python, Bash, Golang, Perl, API scripting language experience desired **Systems and Software Knowledge** * Experience with Netcracker or similar Planning and Provisioning tool * Knowledge and working experience with network orchestration tools. * Knowledge of performance management tools * Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office, Google Maps, Streets \& Trips, Visio \& various operational Support Systems for internal and external presentations and complex network schematics. * This position will also accept qualified applicants who live throughout the United States. Lightpath is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to recruiting, hiring and promoting qualified people of all backgrounds regardless of gender, race, color, creed, national origin, religion, age, marital status, pregnancy, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, military or veteran status, or any other basis protected by federal, state, or local law. This information is collected for employment purposes, including identification, work authorization, FCRA\-compliant background screening, human resource administration and compliance with federal, state and local law. This position is identified as being performed in/or reporting to company operations in New York State. The pay range at the time of posting in the specified locations is $145,000 \- $185,000/year. Pay ranges are supplied in compliance with New York State law. Pay is competitive and based on a number of job\-related factors, including skills and experience. jobs.title: Head of Loyalty
jobs.description: Who We Are: Lucky Strike Entertainment, formerly Bowlero Corp, is one of the world’s premier location\-based entertainment platforms. With over 360 locations across North America, Lucky Strike Entertainment provides experiential offerings in bowling, amusements, water parks, and family entertainment centers. The company also owns the Professional Bowlers Association, the major league of bowling and a growing media property that boasts millions of fans around the globe. For more information on Lucky Strike Entertainment, please visit ir.luckystrikeent.com. Overview: **On\-Site \| Miami, FL** The Head of Loyalty owns the loyalty program after launch: its economics, its roadmap, and its evolution into a product guests use every visit. You set the strategy that drives members to activate and come back; cross\-functional partners in Lifecycle, Creative, Paid, and a field program manager execute against the briefs and targets you set. You own the number. **What You'll Do** * Own the loyalty P\&L (earn rate, reward ladder, breakage, liability, giveback) and defend the economics to the CFO; own the member funnel end to end: sign\-up, register capture, first redemption, ladder progression, reactivation. * Define the program roadmap (tiers, status, gamified earning, partner and sponsored offers, stored value, referral), and set the capture\-rate and growth targets the field program manager deploys against. * Write the specs and own the loyalty backlog alongside the Connected Play engineering team; own the Punchh configuration and integration surface (POS/PixelPoint, app, web, in\-venue screens, CRM, data warehouse); integrate loyalty identity into Connected Play so gameplay and social features earn against a single member profile. * Set the member activation and retention strategy (segments, moments, offers, channels), and write the briefs (objective, audience, offer, trigger logic, success metric) that Lifecycle, Creative, and Paid execute against; run the loyalty campaign calendar with Lifecycle. * Own the results: read performance, decide what changes, and re\-brief. Execution quality is a partner conversation; outcomes are yours. * Own loyalty reporting and measurement with the data team in Snowflake (member counts, capture rate, ladder completion, incremental visits and spend, reward cost per incremental visit), and design the tests that prove incrementality, killing rewards and campaigns that don't pay for themselves. **What You'll Bring** * 8\+ years in loyalty, CRM, or membership products, including one program taken from design through launch and post\-launch optimization at multi\-unit scale (restaurant, entertainment, retail, hospitality, or fitness). * Hands\-on experience with a loyalty platform such as Punchh, Paytronix, Thanx, or Talon.One, including POS integration and reward configuration: you've been in the admin console and on the vendor escalation call. * Product management depth: PRDs, backlog ownership, sprint work with engineers, shipped guest\-facing software, and comfort reading an API doc and a data model. * Ownership of loyalty economics (reward cost, breakage, liability, incrementality), with the ability to build the model and present it to a CFO. * Multi\-unit experience running a program at the register in hundreds of locations, and proven ability to drive activation and retention through teams you don't manage, using strategy and brief quality (not headcount) as your levers. * Analytical fluency in SQL or with data\-warehouse analysts, able to design a clean incrementality test; direct, fast, hands\-on, comfortable owning a number alone. * Preferred: gamification/engagement\-loop experience; exposure to stored value, wallets, or regulated gaming; experience migrating a program across brands. **What** **You’ll** **Get** * At Lucky Strike Entertainment, we’re committed to supporting your well being both on and off the job. Lucky Strike Entertainment offers performance\-based incentives and a competitive total rewards package which includes healthcare coverage and a broad range of other benefits. Incentives and/or benefit packages may vary depending on the position. More details regarding benefits are available here: www.bowlerocorp.com/careers/benefits

jobs.title: Clinical Business Intelligence Analyst

jobs.title: Engineer 3 - Project Manager Choose How You Move
jobs.description: **Position Description** ------------------------ This position, **Engineer 3 \- Project Manager**, leads Choose How You Move (CHYM) project management within the Nashville Department of Transportation and Multimodal Infrastructure (NDOT) primarily focusing on sidewalk, signal, and complete street projects. The Engineer 3 will assist with program oversight of CHYM and lead the NDOT CHYM project management team with responsibilities to include staff management, contract management, scoping, plan review and approval, and growing in\-house project management capabilities. The position will follow Vision Zero best practices to provide safe streets for all modes of transportation, monitoring program and project budgets, and facilitating critical decision making to meet approved scopes, budgets, and schedules. The Engineer 3 will also be responsible for planning, organizing, and overseeing a broad variety of project management functions. The candidate may deliver projects through leading staff Transportation Project Managers or directly manage projects themselves. This position is expected to function largely independently of direct supervision in all complexities and facets of their assigned work. Performs related duties as required. CHYM, approved by 66% of voters in 2024, is Mayor O’Connell’s transportation improvement program and the largest capital program in geographic scope and scale to be undertaken in Nashville’s history. Implementation of the $3\.1 billion in CHYM capital projects requires extensive collaboration among multiple Metro departments, project managers, and vendors; coordination of $111 million worth of annual operating expenditures; and robust engagement with neighbors. CHYM will transform how people move around the city for decades to follow. CHYM includes installation of smart signals at nearly 600 intersections. It adds 24/7/365 transit service and builds 54 miles of high\-capacity transit with more frequent, reliable, and accessible service. It builds 86 miles of sidewalks to ensure Nashville completes the WalkNBike Nashville priority sidewalk network and connects our busiest neighborhoods to major transit routes. The program makes safety improvements on 78 miles of the Vision Zero High\-Injury Network, creating safer streets for pedestrians, bicyclists, drivers, and transit users alike. **Typical Duties** ------------------ * Develops standards, criteria, policies, and overall long\-range plans for project management directly related to infrastructure development and delivery * Manages the project management of major projects as they progress from planning through design, right\-of\-way management, and utility coordination into construction completion and hand\-off to NDOT capital inventory and asset management * Evaluates efficiency and cost effectiveness of infrastructure projects * Prepares, assists, and advises in preparation and review of CHYM budgets * Supervises or provides technical assistance with in\-house contract administration services from scope development, initial approval, right\-of\-way acquisitions, and advertisements through final inspection and project closeout * Interprets and enforces local, state, and federal regulations affecting CHYM projects and initiatives * Collects an interprets project and program data in the preparation of various reports, charts, graphs, and presentation materials * Reviews and assists with grant applications * Represents department at various meetings concerning CHYM * Provides advice and problem\-solving expertise on especially difficult technical planning and engineering problems in area of specialty. * Coordinates the activities of consultants in development and implementation of CHYM delivery projects * Presents information on projects to internal and external stakeholders and serves as the subject matter expert * Confers with consultants and contractors on project progress * Manages projects through a capital management system from initiation to completion * Performs supervisory duties related to the selection, training, work assignment and evaluation of employees within the work unit, which may include other engineers, planners, transportation project managers, inspectors, and administrative staff * Develops and updates policies and metrics of project management and project delivery methods for both CHYM and NDOT capital infrastructure needs **Minimum Qualifications** -------------------------- Bachelor's Degree or higher in Engineering from an accredited college or university andeight (8\) years of progressively responsible post degree engineering experience, including four (4\) years as a licensed Professional Engineer and two (2\) years of lead or supervisory experience. **"For this specific position, substitution will not be considered"** *Employees in supervisory positions must complete the in\-service supervisory training prior to completion of the work test.* **LICENSES REQUIRED** **Valid Driver License** ***NOTE: A Professional Engineering License from any state is required to apply for this position however, a Tennessee Professional Engineering License must be obtained prior to completion of the six\-month probationary period.*** **Failure to obtain the Tennessee Professional Engineering License will terminate employment.** *Candidates with accreditations earned in a foreign institute are encouraged to apply.* **Note: Per Metro Ordinance No. SO94\-1078\. All employees of the Metropolitan Government shall be residents of the State of Tennessee or become residents of the state within six (6\) months of employment as a prerequisite to employment with the Metropolitan Government.** **Preferred Experience, Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities** ---------------------------------------------------------- * PMP Certification Preferred * Experience working with TDOT Specifications and Guidelines * Experience working with NDOT’s manuals, specifications and guidelines for building projects * Current TDOT Local Programs Training for; Consultant Engineering Inspection (CEI) and/or "Local Government Manual and Right\-of\-Way" certification * Knowledge of construction contract administration/management *We are an equal opportunity employer. All individuals, regardless of personal characteristics, are encouraged to apply. Metro Nashville is committed to selecting the most qualified candidate for each of our roles.* Metro Nashville Government respects the religious beliefs and practices of all employees and will make, on request, an accommodation for such observances when a reasonable accommodation is available that does not create an undue hardship on business operations. **Requests for ADA or other protected accommodations for the recruitment process should be directed to Human Resources at 615\-862\-6640\.** **Full\-time, Civil Service positions** **\-** **10 Vacation Days per year (increasing after 5 years of service)** **1 Sick Day per month** **12 Paid Holidays per year** **Public Safety \- Sworn and Civilian positions** **\-** **20 vacation days per year** **3 Personal days per year** **1 Sick Day per month** **12 paid holidays per year** **Part\-time, Non Civil Service positions** **\- Visit HR and Benefits webpages for more information.** **Full\-time, Non Civil Service positions** **\- contact hiring department for benefits information** **Seasonal/Temporary positions** **\- no benefits offered.**
