jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About Orchard** Orchard is transforming the way people buy and sell their homes. Simplifying it, to the way it should have always been; fair and true to market, straightforward, easy. Every year in the U.S., $1\.5 trillion of single family homes transact, generating over $120 billion of fees in a process that has changed little in decades. For the average American, the home purchase and sale process takes months, creates anxiety and is filled with uncertainty and hassle. Orchard offers a modern alternative, making one of life's biggest decisions \- the sale and purchase of a home –so stress free, fair and simple that people cannot imagine any other way. Orchard is headquartered in New York City, has 150\+ employees, a network of 600 agents and has grown nearly 2x year over the last 2 years. We have raised equity financing from top tier investors including: Firstmark, Accomplice, Revolution Growth, Navitas and Juxtapose. **About the Role** Orchard's engineering team values clarity, collaboration, and ownership. Our team builds the systems behind Orchard's website and the tools that help agents reach new customers. We focus on helping people explore homes, book consultations, and connect with our agents. Our site serves over 150k unique visitors each month and sees about 700k pageviews. The team partners closely with marketing, product, and design to support new campaigns, track performance, and ensure the site is fast and reliable at scale. You'll work on the systems that make this possible \- backend, frontend, or both, depending on where the work takes you. That means building and improving APIs, data services, and integrations that support both customers and agents. Your work will touch many parts of the systems our team owns. We build and maintain the services that bring new customers into Orchard, from the public website and intake flows, to scheduling and consultation booking. We also support the tools that help our agents work with those customers, like managing and syncing leads, powering outreach, and maintaining privacy and consent systems that keep customer data safe and compliant. You'll work closely with product managers, designers, engineers, and business stakeholders to plan and ship projects. The team is small and moves quickly, so you'll have real ownership and visibility in your work. Most of our engineering work today is agent\-driven: we use tools like Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, and Codex daily, and the job is less about typing code yourself and more about scoping the work well, directing AI tools effectively, and catching it when they get something wrong. We're looking for engineers who are good at that loop, not just comfortable with AI tools existing. This is a full\-time role that will report into our Senior Software Engineer and be based out of the New York office, where we are in office on Tuesdays and Wednesdays. **What You'll Do Here** * Build and maintain the services and interfaces that power Orchard's website and internal tools. Most of our stack uses Qwik on the frontend and Python with Postgres and OpenSearch on the backend, though some other services use React and TypeScript. * Work with product and design to turn ideas into clear, well\-scoped projects. * Debug and improve core services to make them faster and more reliable as we prepare for national growth over the next 12\-18 months. * Ensure our systems can scale smoothly as our user base continues to grow. * Write clean, tested code that's easy to understand and maintain. * Help improve developer workflows, testing, and documentation. * Take part in on\-call rotations and own the systems you build. * Work with a small team that values communication, trust, and practical solutions. * Use AI coding tools like Claude Code, Copilot, and Codex as part of your daily workflow to build and ship features efficiently. * Comfortable reviewing code you didn't write **We'd Love to Hear From You if You Have** * At least 2\+ years of experience as a software engineer. * Strong skills in at least one language relevant to our stack (Python, TypeScript, or Go), with solid knowledge of APIs and data modeling. * Experience with tools like AWS, Postgres, SQL, Kafka, Airflow, Docker, or CircleCI is a plus. * Experience directing AI coding tools effectively * A low\-ego, problem\-solving mindset. You take ownership, improve what you touch, and ask for help when something doesn't add up. * Interest in a hands\-on team where engineers ship quickly and have real impact. *For NYC residents only: The pay range for this position in New York City is $130,000\-$150,000/year. The actual base pay offered may vary within the range provided depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and location. Stock options and other incentive pay may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, depending on the position offered. This information is provided per the New York City Human Rights Law. Please note that the range provided is applicable only to New York City\-based applicants. Base compensation may vary if the work location is outside of New York City.* *Orchard is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We provide employment opportunities without regard to age, race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other protected status in accordance with applicable law.*

jobs.title: DevOps Manager, Platform
jobs.description: Overview: A great platform team is defined not by how many tickets it closes, but by how little friction stands between an engineer's idea and a running service, because the team built the pipelines, golden paths, and AI\-augmented workflows that make delivery self\-service. The DevOps Manager, Platform is the people leader and hands\-on technical operator who makes that true at Origami Risk. This manager leads the team that builds, runs, and continuously improves the developer platform and delivery automation that Engineering teams depend on to ship every day, spanning CI/CD pipelines and shared templates, service\-layer Terraform, the EKS container platform and capabilities golden path, application connectivity and service data stores, environment promotion, and the AI tooling layered on top. Everything runs in AWS, on top of the landing zone the Cloud Infrastructure team owns. This is a hands\-on technical leader who coaches Engineers on platform\-engineering craft, sets a high bar for delivery reliability and operational discipline, drives AI adoption into daily DevOps workflows, and partners with Engineering, Release, SRE, and Cloud Infrastructure so that the path to production is a source of competitive advantage and not a constraint on what Engineering can deliver. On this team, manual work is a problem to be solved, automation is the default, and every Engineer is expected to use AI to work faster and diagnose more accurately. Starting base pay for this role is between $145,000 and $185,000\. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as transferable skills, work experience, business needs, training, location, and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role will be eligible for a bonus as well as competitive medical, dental, and vision benefits, wellness reimbursement, life insurance, and a 401(k) with company match. We offer vacation and sick leave benefits (under a flexible time off policy in most states). Responsibilities: **What this team runs:** This is the developer platform and delivery layer that sits on top of the AWS landing zone — the systems Engineering uses to build, ship, and operate services every day. The team owns the platform for application and service delivery, not the landing zone underneath it. The team owns: * **Delivery Pipelines \& Build:** the CI/CD build and deploy pipelines, and the shared pipeline templates that Engineering teams across the org use to ship every day. * **Service\-Layer IaC:** the infrastructure\-as\-code that defines each service's cloud resources, versioned and deployed through Terraform. * **Kubernetes \& Container Platform:** the EKS container platform and the self\-service golden path that lets a new service onboard with no bespoke infrastructure work. * **Application Connectivity:** the application\-facing API gateways, service DNS, and certificates that make services reachable and secure. * **Service Data \& Configuration:** the application data stores, configuration, and secrets that each service depends on. * **Environment Promotion:** the promotion path that moves a change safely from lower environments to production. * **AI \& Internal Tooling:** the AI tooling across the development lifecycle that speeds service onboarding, pipeline authoring, and day\-to\-day delivery. **Key responsibilities:** ***People Leadership \& Team Development*** * Leads, develops, and retains a team of DevOps Engineers building the developer platform, cultivating a high\-performance culture defined by technical excellence, an automation mindset, and operational ownership. * Sets clear goals, role expectations, and success criteria for each engineer; conducts regular 1:1s and gives direct, constructive feedback with a visible path for growth. * Conducts structured performance reviews that recognize strong delivery contributions, address quality or reliability gaps specifically, and grow both AI fluency and platform\-engineering depth. * Identifies capability gaps across the team, encompassing CI/CD, service\-layer Terraform, container orchestration and EKS, API and connectivity patterns, and AI\-assisted operations, while building targeted hiring, upskilling, and cross\-training plans. * Fosters a culture where every manual process is a temporary state, automation is the permanent solution, and AI tooling is an expected part of how each engineer works. * Supports Engineering hiring across the organization by participating in technical interviews and helping calibrate the platform\-engineering bar. ***Developer Platform \& Delivery Operations*** * Owns the end\-to\-end path from “we are building a service” to “it deploys to production on its own pipeline”, repository scaffolding, ECR, Terraform workspace, pipeline, variable groups, secrets paths, hostname, gateway wiring, and alarms, reducing the elapsed time and ownership ambiguity in new\-service onboarding. * Leads the team's service\-layer infra , and effective coordination. ***Preferred Qualifications*** * AWS certification at the associate or professional level (e.g., AWS Solutions Architect, AWS DevOps Engineer – Professional). * Experience building a self\-service developer platform or golden path for service onboarding. * Experience with Kubernetes platform engineering, Helm chart libraries, ExternalDNS, and gateway/authorizer patterns. * Experience with Terraform Cloud / HCP and migrating workspaces to S3 and DynamoDB backends. * Experience implementing SRE practices, SLOs and error budgets, in partnership with an SRE team. * Familiarity with Temporal or AWS Step Functions for workflow orchestration in deployment pipelines. * Experience supporting compliance frameworks, SOC 2, NIST 800\-53, or ISO/IEC 27001, including control evidence and audit readiness for delivery systems. * Experience evaluating and adopting AI\-native developer\-productivity or deployment\-intelligence tools, AI\-assisted deployment risk scoring or LLM\-powered operational runbook generation. Benefits: * Medical and Dental coverage available for employees, dependents, domestic partners, and spouses * Paid Time Off – Flexible options plus 10 paid company holidays where available\*\* * All full\-time positions are hybrid, with many eligible to be completely remote * Fully Paid by Origami Risk – Vision insurance, Short \& Long\-Term Disability Insurance, and Basic Life Insurance * Generous family leave options—including adoption and foster care placements * Pre\-Tax Savings Accounts – Flexible Spending Account, Health Savings Account, Commuter Benefits, Dependent Care Savings Account * Retirement Savings – 401(k) with company match up to 4% * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) – Confidential \& Free support offered to colleagues facing personal or work\-related complications * Education Assistance Program – to help colleagues pursue industry/role\-specific certifications * Wellness Benefits – reimbursement program to invest in healthy habits as well as support better colleague productivity and stress management * Additional coverages available – Pet Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, and Voluntary Life \& AD\&D coverage *\*\*Flexible PTO not available in California or the UK* Who We Are: Origami Risk delivers single\-platform SaaS solutions that help organizations best navigate the complexities of risk, insurance, compliance, and safety management. Founded by industry veterans who recognized the need for risk management technology that was more configurable, intuitive, and scalable, Origami continues to add to its innovative product offerings for managing both insurable and uninsurable risk; facilitating compliance; improving safety; and helping insurers, MGAs, TPAs, and brokers provide enhanced services that drive results. A singular focus on client success underlies Origami’s approach to developing, implementing, and supporting our award\-winning software solutions. *Origami Risk is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We thrive and benefit from diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive and equitable environment for all employees. We do not discriminate against any individual based upon race, religion, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, color, sex, national origin, age, marital status, military or veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.* ***Caution****: Be alert to recruiting scams. We have received reports of individuals impersonating Origami Risk recruiters to deceive candidates into disclosing personal information. These impostors use fake Origami Risk domain names and email addresses. Please double\-check that any email address from an Origami Risk recruiter ends with* *origamirisk.com* *or* *talent.icims.com**. And to confirm the legitimacy of any recruiting communication, feel free to email* *transparencycheck@origamirisk.com**.*

jobs.title: Senior Estimator
jobs.description: The Senior Estimator supports Parkhill’s Construction Management (CM) team by leading the preparation and evaluation of cost estimates for a variety of architectural and engineering projects. This role ensures the financial feasibility of projects throughout the construction phase by collaborating with design teams, contractors, and clients. The position contributes to value engineering efforts, construction change management, and contractor negotiations. This is an exempt position paid on a salary basis. **Life at Parkhill** At Parkhill, Building Community is the reason we exist. We invest in extraordinary people who love investing in their communities. We are more than planners, architects, and engineers — we are neighbors who choose to live and work in the communities we serve. Increase your impact with our team of passionate collaborators. Whether you are a recent graduate with untapped potential or a professional with proven experience, we invite you to discover a career path designed for you. Parkhill is one of the largest architectural and engineering firms in the Southwest with 14 offices located throughout Texas, New Mexico, and Oklahoma. * Prepare detailed cost estimates at various stages of design and construction * Review drawings, specifications, and other documentation to ensure estimates reflect project scope * Collaborate with architects, engineers, and project managers to align cost expectations with design intent * Evaluate bids, proposals, and subcontractor pricing for accuracy and completeness. * Support change order evaluations and construction budget management * Assist in value engineering, identify cost\-saving opportunities, and present recommendations * Maintain historical cost data, unit pricing databases, and market trend reports. * Mentor junior estimators and participate in continuous improvement of estimating processes * Ensure all estimating activities comply with Parkhill’s QA/QC standards * Participate in internal and external meetings related to cost planning and construction services * Develop quantity take\-offs using digital methods * Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Architecture, Engineering, or related field preferred * Minimum 8 years of estimating experience in architecture, engineering, or construction services * Experience with large\-scale commercial or civic projects * Strong understanding of AEC industry, construction means and methods, materials, building codes, and project phases, especially during construction administration * Proficiency in estimating software * Excellent analytical, organizational, and communication skills * Proven ability to manage multiple estimates and deadlines simultaneously **Benefits and Perks** We offer a comprehensive benefits program that supports the whole person. jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer - Cloud Security
jobs.description: PagerDuty, Inc. (NYSE: PD) is the global leader in AI\-first digital operations. By automatically detecting, diagnosing, and remediating issues, the PagerDuty Platform orchestrates AI agents and automated workflows with context from over 750 integrations. Trusted by approximately two\-thirds of the Fortune 100 and nearly half of the Fortune 500, PagerDuty is the industry standard for organizations scaling resilient, autonomous operations. Notable customers include Chipotle, Cloudflare, Docusign, Fox, Nvidia, Salesforce, Spotify, Zoom and more. We are growing rapidly and hiring top talent with leading AI skills across engineering, sales, product, marketing, and beyond as we build the leading digital operations platform. . **Senior Security Engineer — Cloud Security (Platform, Identity \& Cryptography)** ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- PagerDuty is seeking a Senior Security Engineer to join our Cloud Security team, part of Security Engineering within the CTO organization. This is a preventive, platform\-focused role owning security posture across our multi\-account AWS environment and the Kubernetes platforms running on it, with deep responsibility for identity \& access management and cryptography (PKI and encryption). You'll partner with 30\+ engineering teams, shipping controls as code that roll out without disrupting engineering — including across our FedRAMP footprint. \*This role will require 2 days per week in our Atlanta office...\* ### **What you'll do** * Harden PagerDuty's AWS and Kubernetes environments against CIS Benchmarks, DISA STIGs, and FedRAMP Moderate baselines across a multi\-account, multi\-org footprint — proving results through evidence, config\-remediation tooling, and KPIs that track posture, identity, and encryption/PKI health so we know where we stand and where the gaps are. * Harden EKS clusters and the Istio service mesh against the CIS Kubernetes Benchmark, DISA Kubernetes STIG, and NSA/CISA hardening guidance. * Design and enforce Kubernetes RBAC, least\-privilege workload identity, and container supply\-chain controls (image provenance, admission control, runtime policy). * Own PKI and encryption standards across the environment — certificate lifecycle and management, KMS\-backed key management and rotation, TLS/mTLS (including within the Istio mesh), and encryption\-at\-rest and in\-transit requirements — and define the standards other teams build against. * Design and roll out Service Control Policy (SCP) guardrails and least\-privilege IAM/PAM across dozens of accounts and multiple orgs. * Lean into AI to unlock efficiency and velocity — consume agentic tooling in day\-to\-day work and build lightweight agentic solutions that streamline repetitive security work: posture triage, threat modeling, risk assessment, incident enrichment and investigation, compliance\-evidence generation, and detection tuning. * Shape detection strategy for the domains you own — Kubernetes/Istio, identity, and cryptography — authoring and tuning detections in our SIEM stack, defining what "good" coverage looks like for these domains, and threat hunting for container escape, lateral movement, anomalous mesh traffic, and identity or credential abuse. * Participate in the team's on\-call rotation, triaging and dispositioning cloud and Kubernetes threat alerts and acting as Incident Lead during incidents — driving containment, blast\-radius/exposure analysis, and post\-incident review. * Automate security controls as code using Terraform and Python — including Kubernetes policy\-as\-code and tool\-to\-tool integrations that reduce manual work. * Partner closely with our AppSec and GRC teams — aligning platform controls with secure\-development needs and translating hardening, identity, and encryption work into audit and compliance evidence. ### **Additional responsibilities** * Mentor and guide teammates on platform, identity, and cryptography security practices, and contribute to roadmap and annual planning. At the senior end of this role, you'll help draft external\- and auditor\-facing communication and represent the team in cross\-team planning. ### **Basic qualifications** * 5\+ years as a Security Engineer in an AWS\-native, microservice SaaS environment, with a strong focus on cloud infrastructure, container, and identity security. * Deep, hands\-on expertise securing Kubernetes and containerized environments — EKS, RBAC, Kubernetes admission control, network policy, and workload identity. * Container runtime and image security experience; familiarity with a service mesh such as Istio strongly preferred. * Strong, hands\-on expertise in PKI and cryptography — certificate lifecycle/management, TLS/mTLS, key management and rotation (AWS KMS or similar HSM/KMS), and encryption\-at\-rest/in\-transit standards. * Deep, hands\-on expertise with AWS security services, including but not limited to: IAM family, Organizations/SCPs, Secrets Manager, KMS,  Lisbon, London, San Francisco, Santiago, Sydney, Tokyo, and Toronto. They define not just our actions, but what it means to be Dutonian. People Leaders at PagerDuty are responsible for creating high performance environments that drive accountability. PagerDuty has four key dimensions that define our Leadership Impact: Lead Self, Lead the Team, Lead the Business, and Lead the Future. Our Manager Expectations serve as a practical guide for managers to understand their responsibilities, prioritize their efforts, and drive engagement and performance. **What we offer** As a global organization, our total rewards approach is competitive with industry standards and aligned with local laws and regulations. Learn more, including country\-specific offerings, on our benefits site. **Your package may include:** * Competitive salary * Comprehensive benefits package * Flexible work arrangements * Company equity\* * ESPP (Employee Stock Purchase Program)\* * Retirement or pension plan\* * Generous paid vacation time * Paid holidays and sick leave * Dutonian Wellness Days \& HibernationDuty \- companywide paid days off in addition to PTO * Paid parental leave: 22 weeks for pregnant parent, 12 weeks for non\-pregnant parent (some countries have longer leave standards and we comply with local laws)\* * Paid volunteer time off: 20 hours per year * Company\-wide hack weeks * Mental wellness programs * Eligibility may vary by role, region, and tenure **About PagerDuty** PagerDuty, Inc. (NYSE:PD) is a global leader in digital operations management. The PagerDuty Operations Cloud is an AI\-powered platform that empowers business resilience and drives operational efficiency for enterprises. With a generative AI assistant at its core, PagerDuty empowers teams to detect and resolve issues in real time, orchestrate complex workflows, and drive continuous improvement across their digital operations. jobs.title: Principal Escalations Engineer
jobs.description: Santa Clara, California, United States of America Product Engineering Ref ID: JR\-022130 **Our Mission** At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real\-world problems with cutting\-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place. **Who We Are** In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real\-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us! We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real\-time problem\-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes. **Job Summary** **Job Summary** Customer Engineering (CE) is an elite technical response team that sits at the high\-stakes intersection of Product Engineering, Systems Reliability, and Technical Support. In this role, you are the technical pivot point of the organization, serving as a "strategic bridge" that translates complex field signals into learning for a self\-improving AI support system and actionable engineering insights. You serve as the expert escalation point for an AI\-driven support ecosystem. When complex, novel, or systemic issues arise, you step in to diagnose defects and drive resolution alongside AI tools. With every interaction, you translate complex troubleshooting logic into structured playbooks, guardrails, and deterministic tool calls that agents can execute, ensuring that every resolved issue elevates our automation and drives permanent product improvements. You operate as a code\-aware escalation point for novel and systemic issues, driving root\-cause isolation, product serviceability fixes, and the agentic AI capabilities that empower our wider support organization. We target curious, high\-ownership Site Reliability Engineers (SREs) and top\-tier escalation engineers with deep customer empathy who thrive when supporting high\-stakes customer environments in crisis. On any given day, members of the team may work with cutting\-edge hardware and software projects early in the product lifecycle, develop technical guidance, assist with challenging customer escalations, replicate complex issues in our lab, evaluate customer network designs, or shape features for supportability that define the future of our products. **Key Responsibilities** * **Escalation Excellence \& Customer Engagement:** Drive top\-tier technical escalations through deep technical analysis and defect diagnosis. Act as a calm, authoritative technical lead when supporting customers in crisis, collaborating with Engineering on hotfixes and representing engineering during critical executive communications. * **Product Quality \& Serviceability:** Identify product serviceability fixes and embed serviceability into early product design phases, working with QA teams to address test gaps. * **Agentic AI \& Automation:** Accelerate customer issue resolution by defining autonomous AI troubleshooting workflows, function\-calling schemas, and guardrails integrated directly into customer co\-pilots. * **Enablement:** Author structured playbooks, guides, and tool definitions to empower first\-level human support engineers and AI agents to resolve complex issues faster. **Qualifications** **Qualifications \& Mindset** * BS/MS or equivalent technical degree (Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field). * 7\+ years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), systems engineering, or top\-tier technical escalation roles at a cybersecurity or network security vendor. * **Mindset \& Core Attributes:** Fast learner, highly curious, strong initiative, end\-to\-end ownership, and deep empathy for customers during high\-severity outages or technical crises. **Core Technical Skills** * **Networking \& Security Fundamentals:** Solid hands\-on understanding of L1–L7 networking, routing, switching, IPSEC, PKI, and SSL technologies. * **Debugging \& Infrastructure Troubleshooting:** Hardware, software, and cloud\-based troubleshooting for network security equipment; packet capture (PCAP) analysis via Wireshark, tcpdump, or similar tools. * **Workflow Logic \& Tooling:** Ability to translate complex troubleshooting steps into structured markdown guides, guardrails, and deterministic tool definitions for AI execution. **Preferred Skills \& Experience** * **Multi\-Cloud \& Advanced Security:** Hands\-on proficiency across multi\-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP), SASE, CASB, SWG technologies, as well as advanced packet crafting/replay tools. * **AI Infrastructure \& Agentic Concepts:** Practical exposure to AI concepts including skill insertion, RAG knowledge base curation, function\-calling schemas, evaluation benchmarks, and basic Python scripting for tool integrations. **Preferred Certifications** * CCNA / CCNP or equivalent vendor certifications. * AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate or equivalent cloud certification (GCP / Azure). \#LI\-MD2 **Compensation Disclosure** The compensation offered for this position will depend on qualifications, experience, and work location. For candidates who receive an offer at the posted level, the starting base salary (for non\-sales roles) or base salary \+ commission target (for sales/com\-missioned roles) is expected to be the annual range listed below. The offered compensation may also include restricted stock units and a bonus. $156,400\.00 \- $253,000\.00/yr **Our Commitment** We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com. Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics. This position is accountable for designing components and writing, testing and shipping code to production. Reporting to the Senior Director, Engineering, this role takes solution architecture and product requirements from prototype through production — writing full\-stack code, integrating Agentic AI and LLM\-based capabilities, and verifying AI\-generated code with the same rigor applied to human\-written code. jobs.title: Senior Paid Media Manager
jobs.description: Description: PRIME Corporate Services is seeking a Senior Paid Media Manager to own paid customer acquisition across every channel we buy. Reporting to the VP of Growth Marketing, this person is accountable for the performance of our paid media program: Google Search, Meta, and the emerging channels we have not built yet. You will own the accounts day to day, run the testing roadmap, own the conversion tracking that tells us whether any of it worked, and decide where the next dollar should go. Accountability in this role does not stop at the booked consultation. Working closely with the Sales team, you are also responsible for the quality of the traffic we buy and the orders it ultimately produces. Volume that does not convert is not a win here, and a channel that looks efficient on cost per lead but poor on closed business is a problem you are expected to find and fix. This is a hands\-on individual contributor role. You will build the campaigns, write the ad copy, brief Design on creative, implement the tracking with Engineering support, and read the results yourself. Analytical rigor is central to the role. A large share of this job is deciding what a number actually means: whether a CPA movement is signal or noise, whether a test has run long enough to read, whether a platform's reported conversions reflect real revenue. The best people in this seat are comfortable being the one who says the data does not support that conclusion yet, and equally comfortable acting decisively once it does. A significant part of this role is expansion. Paid channels are proliferating faster than most teams can evaluate them, and we want someone who can design a real test for a new platform, run it with discipline, and tell us honestly whether to scale it or kill it. That includes AI\-native inventory like ChatGPT Ads, where the targeting and optimization levers are limited and results depend far more on offer clarity and clean measurement than on platform sophistication. You will own how and where our paid budget gets deployed. Material shifts to the total go through an approval step, but the channel mix, the strategy behind it, and the calls about what we test and where we scale are yours to drive. **Who we are** -------------- Remember when every step of launching your dream felt like a mountain? Debt loomed, the tax code was a cryptic puzzle, and building a rock\-solid foundation seemed impossible. PRIME Corporate Services was forged from that very struggle \- by entrepreneurs who knew there had to be a better way. We are not just a faceless firm; we are a co\-pilot for founders, operators, and business builders navigating the chaos of growth. We help cut through red tape, simplify complex systems, and help entrepreneurs structure their business for long\-term financial freedom. From entity structuring to tax strategy to business credit and funding, we don't just protect businesses \- we help to scale them. Our team partners directly with high\-growth entrepreneurs and affiliate partners to drive measurable outcomes; more leads, more revenue, and stronger businesses. We deliver expert guidance and exceptional service at every stage of the business journey. **Our Mission:** We aim to serve, advise, and support entrepreneurs every day. **Why You'll Love Working Here** -------------------------------- * **Impact at scale:** Your work will shape the experience of thousands of entrepreneurs working with PRIME. * **Autonomy \+ Accountability:** You'll be trusted to lead, experiment, and deliver results — no micromanagement, just momentum. * **Collaborative Culture:** You'll work alongside creative thinkers, engineers, and business leaders who care deeply about customer success and innovation. * **Modernization Mission:** You'll play a key role in bringing advanced tech, analytics, and discipline to a growing organization — setting the foundation for the next generation of PRIME's digital ecosystem. **Benefits \& Perks** --------------------- * Competitive Compensation \+ performance based bonuses * Comprehensive Health Coverage \- Medical, dental, and vision * Paid Time Off \- Generous PTO, sick days, and paid holidays * 401k with Company match (we match up to 4%) * Parental Leave \- Paid leave for new parents * Impact\-Driven Culture \- Small team, big mission * Gym Pass \- Company sponsored access to local gyms * Free soda and snacks * Discounts on Cellular/Wireless bills * Robust Employee Resource Program with tele\-health and more Requirements: **Channel Management** * Own day\-to\-day management of Google Search, Performance Max, and Demand Gen campaigns, plus Meta campaigns across acquisition and retargeting * Own account architecture: campaign hierarchy, naming conventions, and account isolation across the Google Ads MCC and parallel Microsoft Advertising structure * Own keyword strategy, match type mix, search term mining, and negative keyword management * Own audience strategy, including Customer Match list segmenta d recommendations to marketing and executive leadership on a regular cadence **Accountabilities** -------------------- The Senior Paid Media Manager is accountable for: * Cost per acquisition against target ceilings and the volume of qualified consultations generated by paid media * Alongside the Sales team, the quality of paid traffic and the orders those consultations convert into * Overall efficiency of paid spend, including the identification and elimination of waste * Channel mix decisions and the quality of the reasoning behind them * Accuracy and completeness of conversion tracking, and the integrity of the data flowing back into every ad platform * Testing velocity, the analytical rigor applied to results, and the quality of documented learnings produced * Account hygiene and documentation, such that any competent marketer could pick up the accounts and understand them * Rigor of new channel evaluation, including success and kill criteria defined before spend begins * Accurate, timely, and honest performance reporting, including when results are bad **Minimum Education Requirements** ---------------------------------- * Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, Analytics, Statistics, or related field required * Equivalent demonstrated experience considered in lieu of degree **Minimum Experience Requirements** ----------------------------------- * 5 to 8 years managing paid media budgets, in\-house or agency side * Deep hands\-on ownership of Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager, including building campaigns and account structures from scratch rather than optimizing inside someone else's build * Demonstrated experience implementing conversion tracking, including Google Tag Manager, platform conversion APIs, and GA4 * Experience passing offline conversion data from a CRM back into ad platforms; Salesforce preferred * Track record of launching at least one paid channel from zero, including the measurement setup and the decision to scale or shut it down * Strong ad copywriting ability; you can write the test, not just brief it * Demonstrated experience designing and interpreting A/B tests, including sizing for statistical significance * Strong quantitative skills and advanced spreadsheet analysis, with genuine comfort working across large, messy, and conflicting performance datasets * Working knowledge of SQL, Looker Studio, or a comparable BI tool preferred * Experience marketing to small business owners, solopreneurs, or 1099 earners preferred * Experience in a regulated category such as financial services, tax, legal, insurance, or lending preferred Prior experience with ChatGPT Ads or other AI\-native ad platforms is not required. That inventory is new enough that nobody has deep expertise in it yet. What we are screening for is the ability to learn an unfamiliar platform quickly and evaluate it honestly. **Required Outside Training** ----------------------------- * Google Ads certifications, particularly Search and Measurement, preferred * Meta Blueprint certification preferred * Demonstrated proficiency with Google Analytics 4 and Google Tag Manager * Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets * Familiarity with Salesforce reporting and Zapier or comparable automation tooling **Physical Requirements** ------------------------- The work environment characteristics and associated physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job. * Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk, working on a computer, and taking phone calls * Must be able to lift 25 pounds periodically * Must be able to access and navigate each department at the organization's facilities * Travel (less than 10% annually) may be required for sales support, training, and/or professional development

jobs.description: **Introduction** ---------------- Are you skilled in project management, civil engineering, and surveying practices and seeking the ideal balance between office and field work? The ideal candidate should have a minimum of three (3\) years of related experience in public works engineering, project management, and land surveying/construction stakeout. Prince William County offers excellent benefits, including paid annual/sick leave, personal days, and medical/dental/vision/life insurance, as well as retirement plans. **About This Role:** This position is a vital part of a team that significantly impacts the lives of many people throughout the county. This bonus will be paid in two installments and is subject to all applicable tax withholding and reporting requirements. The first installment of up to $1,500 is payable upon the County’s pay date following the 90th day of employment, and the final installment of up to $1,500 will be payable on the pay date following the completion of your one\-year probation. We also offer great benefits including: * Retirement from the Virginia Retirement System (VRS) * 401a and 457 retirement savings and investment plans * Paid Annual Leave * Paid Personal Leave * Paid Sick Leave * Paid Holidays * Optional Group Medical and Dental Health Plans * Optional Group Life Insurance * An Employee Assistance Program (EAP) * Career Development Opportunities Full time positions with Prince William County Government qualify for Public Service Loan Forgiveness. **NOTE:** The above position description is intended to represent only the key areas of responsibilities; specific position assignments will vary depending on the business needs of the department. To view the class description in its entirety, Prince William County is an Equal Opportunity Employer. In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, the County will provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities and encourages both prospective and current employees to discuss potential accommodations with the employer. **SEE YOURSELF HERE!** Prince William County Government offers medical plans with corresponding pharmacy and basic vision coverage, as well as dental plans and a separate vision plan. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: Quadric is redefining edge AI with the industry's first General Purpose Neural Processing Unit (GPNPU), enabling developers to run both neural network inference and conventional C\+\+ code on a single programmable architecture. Our technology powers intelligent edge devices across automotive, industrial, robotics, and embedded systems. Founded in 2016 and based in downtown Burlingame, California, Quadric is building the world's first supercomputer designed for the real\-time needs of edge devices. Quadric aims to empower developers in every industry with superpowers to create tomorrow's technology, today. The company was co\-founded by technologists from MIT and Carnegie Mellon, who were previously the technical co\-founders of the Bitcoin computing company 21\. **The Opportunity** =================== You'll own the technical path from customer evaluation to silicon design and win on a genuinely novel architecture, the Quadric Chimera GPNPU, which runs everything from CNNs to LLMs to arbitrary C\+\+ on one core, with no fallback processor. Unlike a FAANG solutions role, you'll work the entire stack: quantization, custom kernels, and compiler and your fingerprints will be on chips that ship in cars, cameras, and network appliances. At a Series C company, every design win has outsized impact. Our FDEs also build with frontier agentic tooling (Claude Code–based agentic workflows) — you won't just be supporting the product, you'll be inventing how edge\-AI field engineering is done. **What You'll Do** ================== Own the Technical Path to Design Win * Convert 2–3 active customer evaluations into committed design wins by getting customer workloads running at target latency and accuracy on Chimera. * Port customer workloads onto Chimera — architect, adapt, profile, and write custom kernels when required. Embed with Customer Engineering Teams * Work on\-site and remotely with customer engineering teams: debug failures, hit benchmark targets, and guide model\-architecture tradeoffs. * Drive evaluations forward end\-to\-end, from first technical conversation through design win. Build the Agentic FDE Toolkit * Codify what you learn into reusable assets — SDK skills, porting playbooks, and agentic content — so each subsequent engagement moves faster than the last. * Build applications and benchmark collateral that support future customer engagements. Close the Loop Internally * Partner with engineering and product teams to relay customer learnings and shape the roadmap. * Contribute skills and playbooks to Quadric's growing agentic FDE toolset. **What Success Looks Like** =========================== Within your first 6–12 months, you'll: * Convert 2–3 active customer evaluations into committed design wins on the Chimera platform. * Build deep fluency across the Chimera stack — quantization, custom kernels, and compiler tooling — well enough to unblock customers independently. * Establish reusable SDK skills and porting playbooks that measurably shorten the next engagement's timeline. * Become a trusted technical partner to customer engineering teams, known for translating ambiguous requirements into shipped results. * Help define and refine Quadric's agentic (Claude Code–based) FDE workflow — there's no existing playbook yet; you'll help write it. **What We're Looking For** ========================== **Required** * Strong C\+\+ and Python; has written performance\-critical code for a constrained target (DSP, NPU, GPU, or embedded SoC). * Systems\-level performance intuition — memory bandwidth, data movement, cycle\-level reasoning — and can read a profile and know where the time went. * High agency and independent problem\-solving; jobs.description: **Company:** ------------ Qualcomm Technologies, Inc. **Job Area:** ------------- Engineering Group, Engineering Group \> Multimedia Systems **General Summary:** As part of Qualcomm’s Low\-Power AI (LPAI) Systems group, this role focuses on performance optimization, data\-path and power analysis, and architecture of embedded AI subsystems, with emphasis on XR and ambient use cases. The engineer will drive power\-efficient system design and analysis across DSP/AI subsystems by analyzing power\-performance trade\-offs and enabling optimizations across software and hardware for on\-device AI. **Key Responsibilities** * Analyze and optimize performance and power of LPAI subsystem (DSP, eNPU, memory) with focus on XR and always\-on AI workloads. * Support system integration, benchmarking, and commercialization of LPAI solutions across Mobile, XR, Compute, and IoT platforms. * Perform detailed data\-path and memory\-access analysis (cache, SRAM, DDR) to identify bottlenecks impacting performance efficiency. * Drive ambient system workload partitioning, software optimizations, clock/BW voting, and data reuse strategies. * Collaborate with HW, SW, and PdM teams to review low\-power feature roadmap. * Execute lab\-based power measurements, correlate silicon data with modelling. * Document performance and power analysis, competitive analysis findings, and architectural recommendations for internal stakeholders. **Minimum Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 6\+ years of Systems Engineering or related work experience. jobs.description: **JOB** **TITLE:**BIOS Firmware Engineer – Level 1 **FLSA:**Exempt position **LOCATION**: Fremont, CA (Onsite) **SALARY:** **Job Summary:** The BIOS/UEFI Firmware Engineer is responsible for the architecture, design, development, and debugging of Unified Extensible Firmware Interface (UEFI) and Basic Input/Output System (BIOS) firmware for computer systems. This role focuses on the critical firmware that initializes hardware and boots the operating system, ensuring compatibility, performance, and security from power\-on. This position is part of the Engineering Services team, which works across departments to support the engineering and operation teams with technical expertise in electronics, operational software, and systems integration. **Duties/Responsibilities:** * Design, develop, and maintain UEFI/BIOS firmware using languages such as C and C\+\+. * Contribute to all phases of the UEFI boot process, including Security (SEC), Pre\-EFI Initialization (PEI), and Driver Execution Environment (DXE). * Support new hardware bring\-up and debug complex hardware\-firmware interactions involving CPUs, memory, and other components. * Ensure correct and efficient initialization of hardware interfaces, including DDR memory, PCIe, SATA, USB, and other peripherals. * Optimize boot performance and implement firmware security features such as Secure Boot, Intel Boot Guard, and Trusted Platform Module (TPM) integration. * Collaborate with hardware engineers to interpret schematics and datasheets, ensuring firmware properly controls and configures hardware platforms. * Use debugging tools such as JTAG, in\-circuit emulators, and logic analyzers to diagnose and resolve boot and hardware issues. * Participate in code reviews, maintain technical documentation, and work with hardware and operating system (OS) developers to address compatibility challenges. **Required Skills/Abilities:** **(Example of skills set)** * Proficiency in C/C\+\+ programming for embedded systems. * Strong knowledge of UEFI architecture (EDK2 framework), x86 architecture, and platform boot processes. * Familiarity with hardware interfaces such as PCIe, SPI, I²C, and USB. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to debug hardware\-firmware interactions. * Effective verbal and written communication skills; able to work independently and in team settings. * Preferred Skills/Abilities * Experience with scripting languages such as Python for automation. * Knowledge of firmware security standards (e.g., NIST SP 800\-193\) and secure boot processes. * Experience debugging boot\-related issues using low\-level debuggers and analyzers. * Familiarity with System Management Mode (SMM), Advanced Configuration and Power Interface (ACPI), Intel Firmware Support Package (FSP), or Intel Firmware Image (IFWI). **Education and Experience:** * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field. * Minimum of 1 year of hands\-on experience in BIOS/UEFI firmware development. **Physical Requirements:** **(Example of requirement)** * Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer. * Ability to access and navigate various departments within the organization’s facilities.

progressively responsible engineering experience**. * Advanced knowledge of transmission line design, equipment, materials, and construction practices. * Demonstrated ability to lead engineering activities for medium\- to large\-scale capital projects. * Strong proficiency with **PLS\-CADD or comparable transmission modeling tools**. * Experience developing or improving engineering standards and technical specifications. * Ability to mentor engineers, coordinate multidisciplinary work, and resolve complex engineering issues. **Lead Engineer** Serves as a senior technical authority for complex transmission engineering initiatives and system\-wide engineering practices. **Typical qualifications include:** * Approximately **10\+ years of progressively responsible transmission or power delivery engineering experience**. * Expert\-level knowledge of transmission line design, materials, equipment, standards, and industry practices. * Demonstrated leadership of technically complex or requirements, and design practices. * Ability to advise engineering leadership and project teams on complex technical, reliability, risk, and regulatory matters. * Demonstrated ability to mentor senior engineers and develop technical capability across an engineering organization. **What We’re Looking For** * Experience designing or supporting **high\-voltage transmission lines and associated infrastructure**. * Knowledge of transmission structures, conductors, hardware, clearances, loading criteria, and related components. * Ability to read and develop plan/profile drawings, engineering drawings, one\-line diagrams, and technical documentation. * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and engineering problem\-solving skills. * Experience supporting projects through design, procurement, construction, and commissioning. * Knowledge of electric utility engineering practices and applicable industry standards. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * Ability to work environments. **Preferred Qualifications** * Professional Engineer (**PE**) license or Engineer\-in\-Training (**EIT**) certification. * Master’s degree in engineering or a related technical discipline. * Electric utility or transmission owner/operator experience. * Experience with **AutoCAD** or related engineering design applications. * Experience developing transmission engineering standards, material specifications, or equipment requirements. **Work Environment** The position combines engineering office work with periodic field and project\-site activities. Portable nuclear power with rapid\-deploy capability can replace similar\-sized diesel generators and provide critical asset support for hospitals, data centers, remote sites, and military bases. Radiant’s unique, practical approach to nuclear development leverages modern software engineering to rapidly deliver safe, factory\-built microreactors that use existing, well\-qualified materials. Founded in 2020, Radiant is on track to test its first reactor at the Idaho National Laboratory this summer, with initial customer deliveries beginning in 2028\. Radiant is seeking a highly motivated Thermal Engineer to join the team. **Responsibilities:** * Develop and execute thermal analysis and CFD to evaluate design and performance of Kaleidos systems. * Document analysis results to communicate clear and actionable outputs. * Expand CFD capabilities, accuracy, and efficiencies via methods and workflow development projects. * Own pipeline for producing analysis geometry from mechanical design CAD * Develop methods and calculations to support and build confidence in lower\-fidelity thermal analysis methods. **Qualifications:** * BS or MS in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or related discipline. * Graduating in December 2026 or Spring 2027\. * A high level of independence in solving challenging engineering tasks is preferred. * Ability to seek out resources and proactively ask questions to finish projects through completion effectively, accurately, and timely. * Ability to work in a fast\-paced startup environment with a proactive and collaborative attitude. * Genuinely excited for our mission to rapidly deploy nuclear microreactors to remote locations requiring abundant, clean energy. * Knowledge of reactor physics will provide useful context but is not necessary. * Prior internship experience helpful but not required. **Benefits and Perks** ---------------------- * Stock: Substantial incentive stock plan for all full\-time employees. * Medical: 100% up to base silver level plan for employee \+ 50% dependents, offers up to Platinum plans. * One Medical: Sponsored memberships for employees and their dependents. * Vision: 100% top tier plan coverage \+ 50% for dependents. * Dental: 100% top tier plan coverage, orthodontia extra, 50% for dependents. * Voluntary life, accident, hospital, critical illness, commuter and FSA/HSA are offered as employee contributed benefits. * 8\-weeks of paid parental leave for all parents. Additional paid pregnancy leave for CA employees. * Daily catered lunch. Free snacks and drinks. * Flexible PTO policy. Remote workday allocation. * Company and team\-bonding events, happy hours and in\-person camaraderie. * Beautiful El Segundo headquarters close to the Pacific Ocean. **Total Compensation and Benefits** Radiant compensates people for impact and invests in those who continue to raise the bar. Radiant’s new hire compensation package includes base salary, substantial equity grants, and comprehensive health benefits. Total compensation and level are determined through a rigorous evaluation of interview performance, experience, education, and qualifications, and are designed to support continued growth as scope, responsibility, and impact expand at Radiant. The best of today’s advanced reactor builders don’t wait for job postings. They join the winning team. If that’s you, contact us directly for immediate opportunities: recruiting@radiantnuclear.com. *We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.* *This position involves access to technology that is subject to U.S. export controls. Any job offer made will be contingent upon the applicant’s capacity to serve in compliance with U.S. export controls.* Compensation Range: $105K \- $130K
