jobs.title: Student Interest Form - INDOT Career Opportunities
jobs.description: Date Posted: Sep 1, 2026 Requisition ID: 483378 Location: Indianapolis, IN, US, 46204 **Work for Indiana** ==================== Begin a fulfilling career with the State of Indiana by joining one of the largest employers in the state, offering a range of opportunities across 60\+ agencies. At the state, you'll find competitive compensation, a robust benefits package and a commitment to work\-life balance. Most importantly, you'll have the chance to make a real and measurable impact on the lives of Hoosiers across Indiana. **About the Indiana Department of Transportation:** The Indiana Department of Transportation (INDOT) provides a dynamic workplace that serves Indiana citizens, improves our state’s quality of life, and enhances its economic opportunity. INDOT has several innovative programs and projects, including Public\-Private Partnerships, Green Initiatives, and cutting\-edge uses of materials and assets. As part of the State of Indiana, INDOT offers a competitive total compensation package, as well as outstanding work/life balance. Whether you are an established professional in the transportation field or just starting your career, INDOT has exciting and challenging opportunities for you. **Student Programs Overview:** **Graduate Opportunity** * **Graduate Engineer Development Program (GEDP)** GEDP is a one\-year Indianapolis\-based rotational program that focuses on developing technical problem\-solving and leadership skills. Engineers will spend time in each of INDOT’s engineering departments and upon completion of the program, will transition into their choice of assignment at INDOT; based on availability of positions, supervisor assessments, and the engineer’s preference. The goal of the GEDP is to support the engineer’s ability to learn as much about on\-the\-job civil engineering as possible, as well as fostering professional development and connecting the engineer with INDOT’s wide network of civil engineering professionals. The GEDP is designed for INDOT’s future leaders. **We’re looking for entry\-level civil engineers who aren’t done learning, who want to start their career by contributing to the bigger picture. Does that sound like you? If so, we’re looking for you!** **Opportunities for Current Students** * **Governor’s Summer Internship (GSI)** The Governor’s Summer Internship (GSI) is Indiana’s statewide initiative that gives college students meaningful hands\-on experience working with INDOT and other state agencies. This program gives students an opportunity to work alongside INDOT professionals and explore careers in public service. INDOT offers the following summer internships, civil engineering, project management, communications, finance, human resources, information technology, legal services, real estate and more. * **INDOT Engineering Scholarship (IES)** The INDOT Engineering Scholarship (IES) program is designed to support and develop future civil engineers who want to make a meaningful impact on Indiana’s transportation infrastructure. Each year, INDOT awards a select number of scholarships to students enrolled full\-time in ABET\-accredited civil engineering programs across the state. Recipients receive $3,125 per semester or $2,083 per trimester, totaling $6,250 per academic year. They may receive up to five years of support, with no more than two years applied toward graduate studies. **Program Locations:** * **Graduate Engineer Development Program (GEDP):** Indianapolis * **Governor’s Summer Internship (GSI):** LaPorte, Fort Wayne, Vincennes, Seymour, Crawfordsville, Greenfield, INDOT’s Central Office (Indianapolis) and additional satellite locations. * **INDOT Engineering Scholarship (IES):** Statewide placements across Indiana, depending on internship assignment and division needs **Benefits of Full\-Time Employment with the State of Indiana:** The State of Indiana offers a comprehensive benefit package for full\-time employees which includes: * Three (3\) medical plan options (including RX coverage) as well as vision and dental plans * Wellness Rewards Program: Complete wellness activities to earn gift card rewards * Health savings account, which includes bi\-weekly state contribution * Deferred compensation 457(b) account (similar to 401(k) plan) with employer match * Two (2\) fully\-funded pension plan options * A robust, comprehensive program of leave policies covering a variety of employee needs, including but not limited to: + 150 hours of paid New Parent Leave and up to eight weeks of paid Childbirth Recovery Leave for eligible mothers + Up to 15 hours of paid community service leave * Combined 180 hours of paid vacation, personal, and sick leave time off * 12 paid holidays, 14 on election years * Education Reimbursement Program * Group life insurance * Referral Bonus program * Employee assistance program that allows for covered behavioral health visits * Qualified employer for the Public Service Loan Forgiveness Program * Free Parking for most positions Free LinkedIn Learning access * **Equal Employment Opportunity:** The State of Indiana is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to recruiting, selecting, developing, and promoting employees based on individual ability and job performance. Reasonable accommodations may be available to enable individuals with disabilities to complete the application and interview process as well as perform the essential functions of a role. If you require reasonable accommodations to complete this application, you can request assistance by contacting the Indiana State Personnel Department at jobs@spd.IN.gov. **Nearest Major Market:** Indianapolis

jobs.title: Advanced Manufacturing Engineer
jobs.description: **Relocation assistance is available for this position.** **Who We Are** Stored Energy Systems (SENS) is an award\-winning manufacturer of premium quality power conversion products located in Longmont, CO. In business for over 50 years, SENS is the market leader with a proven track record of providing highly reliable battery chargers, DC power systems, and related products to industrial markets. For more information on our company please see our web site at www.sens\-usa.com. **View the SENS Product Catalog** **Summary** SENS is looking for a hands\-on Advanced Manufacturing Engineer to identify, develop, and implement technologies that fundamentally improve how our products are built and how our factory operates. This role will turn emerging manufacturing technologies into practical, scalable production solutions that improve safety, productivity, quality, material flow, capacity, and operator effectiveness. This is an execution\-focused engineering role. The Advanced Manufacturing Engineer will turn opportunities into working production solutions by developing and testing concepts, building business cases, selecting and managing vendors and integrators, and leading projects through design, implementation, validation, and production handoff. The role will work closely with Continuous Improvement, Manufacturing Engineering, Production, IT, Quality, Safety, and other functions to advance our manufacturing capabilities through technology. **Responsibilities*** Lead advanced manufacturing projects from concept through production implementation, including requirements development, technical evaluation, proof\-of\-concept, business case/ROI, vendor selection, design, implementation, validation, and production handoff. * Develop and implement automation solutions for manufacturing and assembly processes, including robotics, collaborative robots, automated tooling and fixtures, machine vision, sensors, controls, and other production technologies. * Develop digital manufacturing and smart factory solutions that connect people, equipment, materials, and production systems, including automated data collection, digital Andon and material triggers, dashboards, system integration, and real\-time production visibility. * Develop and implement technologies that improve material flow and operator effectiveness, including automated material handling, pick\-to\-light systems, digital replenishment, electronic Kanban, augmented reality, and other visual or digital production tools. * Evaluate, prototype, and apply emerging manufacturing technologies such as machine learning, predictive maintenance, IIoT, augmented reality, advanced sensing, autonomous material movement, and other technologies; rapidly prove concepts and scale successful solutions into production. * Develop technical specifications and manage equipment suppliers, automation vendors, and system integrators; lead equipment design reviews, FAT/SAT, installation, commissioning, qualification, validation, and production handoff while ensuring solutions meet production, quality, reliability, and machine safety requirements. * Establish KPIs and performance requirements for advanced manufacturing projects and measure results against productivity, labor efficiency, quality, capacity, reliability, cost reduction, and return\-on\-investment targets. * Partner with Continuous Improvement and Manufacturing Engineering to evaluate prioritized opportunities and determine where automation, digitalization, or advanced technology can deliver the greatest operational impact. **Required Qualifications*** Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience in a similar role. * Relevant education, training, or experience in electrical engineering, manufacturing engineering, industrialization, product engineering, or a related technical field. * Ability to read, interpret, and understand electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, mechanical drawings, BOMs, and other engineering documentation. * Experience developing manufacturing documents, such as work instructions, BOMs, material lists, wire lists, or similar production documentation. * Strong understanding and working knowledge of electrical assembly, wiring, manufacturing processes, and design for manufacturability principles. * Strong hands\-on troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to work directly with production teams in a manufacturing environment. **Preferred Qualifications*** Hands\-on experience programming or integrating PLCs, robotics, collaborative robots, machine vision, sensors, industrial controls, or automated equipment. * Experience with manufacturing system integration, APIs, SQL, Python, industrial communication protocols, or production data architectures. * Experience implementing smart factory or Industry 4\.0 technologies such as Internet of Things, connected equipment, automated data collection, augmented reality, machine learning, or predictive maintenance. * Experience with automated material handling technologies such as AGVs/AMRs, pick\-to\-light, electronic Kanban, digital replenishment, or other intelligent material\-flow systems. * Experience developing and justifying advanced manufacturing projects through ROI, labor savings, capacity improvements, quality improvements, and other measurable operational benefits. **Location:** Longmont, CO **Base Compensation:** $103,000 \- $146,000 is the projected annual base salary range for this role and will be determined on the candidate’s overall qualifications and experience. **Bonus:** This position is eligible for an annual bonus based on individual and company performance. **Closing Date:** October 15th. While we expect to keep the position open through this date, the posting may be extended or closed early based on applicant volume and hiring needs. **Onsite Perks*** Free gym with 24/7 access * Free Electric Vehicle charging * Breakfast and Lunch Café * After hours Grab \& Go snacks * Basketball court * Walking paths **Benefits*** Paid Time Off * Paid holidays * Medical insurance * Dental insurance * Vision insurance * Short\-term and long\-term disability * Life insurance * 401(k) plan with immediate vesting * Employee referral program At SENS, our culture is rooted in a set of core values that reflect who we are and how we work. In a recent 2025 poll, our employees identified the values that best define us: *“Innovative”, “Respectful”, “Inviting”, “Flexible”, “Collaborative”, and “Growth Driven”.* Our team describes us as a dynamic, forward\-thinking company where everyone has the opportunity to thrive. We pride ourselves on being an equal opportunity employer, fully dedicated to fostering inclusion and diversity. We welcome all applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic. We hope you're interested in making a difference with us. Even if you don't feel that you meet every qualification listed in this job description, we still encourage you to apply.

jobs.title: Senior Server Engineer, Data Products
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Strava SF **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Hybrid **Department** -------------- TechnologyEngineering **Compensation** ---------------- * $180,375 – $200,850 • Offers Equity This range reflects base compensation only and does not include equity or benefits. Your recruiter can share more details about the full compensation package during the hiring process. At Strava, we know our employees are the most important ingredient to our success, and our compensation and total rewards programs reflect that. We take a market\-based approach to pay, and pay may vary depending on the department and your location. Salary ranges are categorized into one of three zones based on a cost of labor index for that geographic area. We will determine the candidate’s starting pay based on job\-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. We may modify these ranges in the future. For more information, please contact your talent partner. **About Strava** ---------------- Strava is the app for active people. With over 200 million athletes in more than 185 countries, it’s more than tracking workouts—it’s where people make progress together, from new habits to new personal bests. No matter your sport or how you track it, Strava’s got you covered. Find your crew, crush your goals, and make every effort count. Start your journey with Strava today. Our mission is simple: to motivate people to live their best active lives. We believe in the power of movement to connect and drive people forward. We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to join the Data Products team at Strava. The Data Products team sits at the core of Strava's AI strategy, turning Strava's unique community and activity data into reliable, reusable, enriched datasets that power experiences across the app. The team operates at the intersection of data engineering, ML platform engineering, and server engineering, building the pipelines and platform layer that let our proprietary embeddings, algorithms, and models reach athletes at scale. As a Senior Data Engineer, you'll build and operate the pipelines and access layer that turn raw data, algorithms, and models into production\-ready data products used across the app. You'll work closely with ML engineers, data scientists, and product teams to ship data products with strong reliability, freshness, and clear contracts, and you'll contribute to the self\-serve tools that make these products easier for other teams to build on. ***We follow a flexible hybrid model that translates to more than half your time on\-site in our San Francisco office — three days per week.*** **What You’ll Do:** ------------------- * ***Build for a Well Loved Consumer Product****: Work at the intersection of Geo and fitness to launch and optimize product experiences that will be used by tens of millions of active people worldwide* * ***Build and Operate Data Products:*** *Develop and maintain the pipelines, APIs, and platform tooling that expose Strava's derived data products, including embeddings, ranking artifacts, clustering outputs, and enriched activity streams, as reliable, well\-documented internal products.* * ***Contribute to Self\-Serve Tooling:*** *Build components of the self\-serve interfaces and golden paths that let product and CUJ engineering teams use core data products without deep ML or data engineering expertise.* * ***Own End\-to\-End Data Product Delivery:*** *Drive projects end\-to\-end, from pipeline design and artifact schema through production deployment and monitoring, ensuring correctness, freshness, and reliability of the data products you own.* * ***Collaborate Across ML, Data Engineering, and Product:*** *Work closely with ML engineers on integrating model outputs into durable, versioned artifacts; partner with Data Platform on compute patterns and cost efficiency; inform product teams on how to consume and leverage these capabilities.* * ***Build from a rich dataset****: Explore and use Strava’s extensive unique fitness and geo datasets from millions of users to extract actionable insights, inform product decisions, and optimize existing features* **You Will Be Successful Here By:** ----------------------------------- * ***Treating Data Products as Products:*** *Bringing engineering rigor, versioning, contracts, SLAs, monitoring, and deprecation paths to data artifacts and ML insights you own, so downstream teams can depend on them.* * ***Owning Your Work End\-to\-End:*** *Taking accountability for the reliability and correctness of the systems you build in production and their adoption by downstream teams, while staying aware of adjacent workstreams so dependencies and timing don’t stall the team’s momentum.* * ***Collaborating Across Disciplines:*** *Working fluidly with ML engineers, data engineers, data scientists, and product managers to align on artifact semantics, evaluation standards, and consumption patterns.* * ***Contributing to the Standard:*** *Helping establish best practices for data product development and operational health, and mentoring junior and mid\-level engineers on the team. You love to stay current on emerging practices in backend and data engineering and apply them pragmatically, favoring what actually moves the team forward over novelty for its own sake.* * ***Being passionate*** *about the work you are doing and contributing positively to Strava's inclusive and collaborative team culture and values.* **What You’ll Bring to the Team:** ---------------------------------- * *Experience building and operating complex, data\-intensive backend systems in production at scale, with a track record of breaking large technical problems into well\-scoped, executable work.* * *Demonstrated experience building access layers, platform tooling, or internal developer products ideally for large scale data or ML systems with a strong instinct for contract design, versioning, and self\-serve patterns.* * *Experience building and maintaining production data pipelines and batch/stream workflows using technologies like Spark, Kafka, Flink, Iceberg, Snowflake, or similar.* * *Proficiency in backend service development on cloud environments (AWS preferred), using Python, Scala, Go, or equivalent. Solid understanding of distributed systems and containerized infrastructure (Kubernetes, Docker).* * *Comfort taking technical ownership within a project or team: making design trade\-offs, coordinating with collaborators, and mentoring junior engineers and peers.* * *Eagerness to engage with ML concepts such embeddings, classification outputs, model evaluation, GenAI integrations. Bonus points if you are already an ML practitioner.* * *Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively with cross\-functional partners.* **Why Join Us?** ================ Movement brings us together. At Strava, we’re building the world’s largest community of active people, helping them stay motivated and achieve their goals. Our global team is passionate about making movement fun, meaningful, and accessible to everyone. Whether you’re shaping the technology, growing our community, or driving innovation, your work at Strava makes an impact. When you join Strava, you’re not just joining a company—you’re joining a movement. If you’re ready to bring your energy, ideas, and drive, let’s build something incredible together. Strava builds software that makes the best part of our athletes’ days even better. Just as we’re deeply committed to unlocking their potential, we’re dedicated to providing a world\-class, inclusive workplace where our employees can grow and thrive, too. We’re backed by Sequoia Capital, TCV, Madrone Partners and Jackson Square Ventures, and we’re expanding in order to exceed the needs of our growing community of global athletes. Our culture reflects our community. We are continuously striving to hire and engage teammates from all backgrounds, experiences and perspectives because we know we are a stronger team together. Strava is an equal opportunity employer. In keeping with the values of Strava, we make all employment decisions including hiring, evaluation, termination, promotional and training opportunities, without regard to race, religion, color, sex, age, national origin, ancestry, sexual orientation, physical handicap, mental disability, medical condition, disability, gender or identity or expression, pregnancy or pregnancy\-related condition, marital status, height and/or weight. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. California Consumer Protection Act Applicant Notice Compensation Range: $180,375 \- $200,850

jobs.title: Lead CAD Designer
jobs.description: **Position Summary** The primary focus of this position is to develop detailed layout and assembly drawings via 3D/CAD (SolidWorks) in support of Swagelok Texas Mid\-Coast's Assembly Solutions department. System designs must meet customer requirements, specifications, and manufacturing constraints based on the design intent communicated by the technical sales department and/or the customer. This position also serves as the department's SolidWorks license and PDM administrator and is accountable for ensuring drawing quality and design efficiency across the team. This position does not include direct personnel management responsibilities. **Expectations** * Provide technical leadership for CAD processes, systems, standards, drawing quality, and design efficiency across the team * Coordinate directly with engineers, technical advisors, and customers to understand project requirements * Interpret P\&IDs, equipment layouts, process flow diagrams, specifications, bill of materials, and GA drawings with respect to customized packaged equipment system designs * Produce Approval Drawings using layouts and section views with BOM's, callouts, and dimensions * Create and modify library parts * Generate electronic P\&IDs * Review scope documents and specifications for verification of design against the design intent and customer requirements * Demonstrate ability to execute designs on complex projects * Lead and conduct model reviews in accordance with department processes * Administer SolidWorks software licensing – manage seat allocation, activations/deactivations, renewals, and vendor coordination to ensure the design team has uninterrupted, cost\-effective access to required tools * Manage the SolidWorks PDM (Product Data Management) system – own vault structure, file organization, user permissions, workflow states, and data integrity; serve as the primary point of contact for PDM issues and improvements * Ensure drawing compliance – audit and maintain drawings, models, and documentation to confirm alignment with the Swagelok Texas Mid\-Coast quality system requirements and applicable standards * Maximize drawing efficiency – develop, document, and champion templates, design tables, standard library content, and best practices that reduce cycle time and improve consistency across the design team * Support the desired culture and work environment of the department * Any other responsibility as assigned by Swagelok Texas Mid\-Coast **Position Requirements** **Education** * Advanced education in drafting/design required * Associate degree in a related field preferred * SolidWorks certifications preferred **Experience** * Minimum of 5 years SolidWorks experience required * 3 years relevant CAD designing \& drafting experience with fluid systems and sheet metal * Experience with tube routing, sheet metal, design tables/configurations \& weldments * Prior experience administering SolidWorks PDM (or comparable PDM/vault system) strongly preferred * Experience managing software licenses/seats in an engineering or design environment preferred **Skills** * Builds and maintains effective working relationships with other designers and departments * Creates 3D models and layouts including mating surfaces, finding correct library parts, performing extrusions, creating assemblies, exploded view diagrams with BOM's * A self\-starter and highly skilled SolidWorks designer capable of performing all design and SolidWorks modeling tasks required for delivering production\-level drawings to purchasing and production departments with minimal direction or supervision from engineers and managers * Capable of producing customized designs and layouts with basic knowledge of technical applications, maintenance, operation, and clearance constraints * Advanced proficiency in using 3D modeling tools (SolidWorks required) including: + Part and assembly files + Tube routing, sheet metal, and weldment features + Configurations and design tables * Advanced proficiency in using 2D drawing tools (SolidWorks required) including: + Drawing files + Blocks * Working knowledge of SolidWorks PDM administration, including vault permissions, workflows, and data management * Strong knowledge of process and instrumentation diagrams (P\&IDs) * Working knowledge of quality system requirements as they apply to engineering drawings and documentation * Must be detail oriented * Proficient in Word, Excel, Outlook, and Teams **Scope of Position** Physical Requirements: Office environment. This position requires keyboarding and sitting for long periods of time. **Why Swagelok Texas Mid\-Coast?** STMC offers a challenging, dynamic environment where innovation thrives. We provide opportunities for growth, development, and career advancement. Join our team and become part of an industry\-leading company committed to providing top\-tier fluid and gas handling solutions. **What we offer:** * Competitive salary plus company bonus plan * PTO * Medical/Life Insurance * 401(k) with company match * A warm, collaborative culture with highly engaged associates * A professional work environment with the opportunity to contribute to meaningful customer solutions We Value Our Associates At STMC, we know our success depends on the people behind it. We value associates who take pride in their work, support one another, look for ways to improve, and understand how their individual contribution affects our customers and the success of the entire team. We are committed to providing an environment where associates can **learn, contribute, grow, and be part of a team that takes pride in serving our customers and representing Swagelok quality every day.**

jobs.title: Senior Platform Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ Sydecar is on a mission to transform the world of private markets. Our goal is to make these markets more accessible, transparent, and liquid, and we're achieving this by revolutionizing the way investment vehicles are created and executed. At Sydecar, we're not just a platform; we're a trusted partner in venture capital. We're dedicated to simplifying and standardizing the private investing experience, empowering capital allocators to discover and support visionary entrepreneurs who are shaping the future. Our platform is designed with ease and efficiency in mind. We take care of all the behind\-the\-scenes tasks, from automating banking, ensuring compliance, handling contracts, managing taxes, to streamlining reporting. This leaves investors the freedom to concentrate on what matters most: making valuable deals and nurturing meaningful relationships. Join us at Sydecar, as we lead the charge in revolutionizing private investing. **About the Platform Team** --------------------------- The Platform Team owns the shared foundations — developer productivity, core services and infrastructure, release and test automation, and security — that lets all of engineering ship safer, faster, and at scale. We're a multiplier: we build paved roads and enable product teams, not product features. **The Opportunity** ------------------- As a Senior Platform Engineer, you'll build the systems and tooling that raise the floor for every engineer at Sydecar. You'll join a collaborative, high\-trust team that values ownership, thoughtful execution, and a sustainable pace. jobs.title: Principal Application Engineer- Emulation
jobs.description: Austin, Texas, United States **Category** Engineering **Hire Type** Employee **Job ID** 18801 **Base Salary Range** $160000\-$240000 **Date posted** 09/16/2026 ### **We Are** Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. ### **You Are** You have spent years deep in emulation platforms, the kind where a single debug session can stretch across hardware, software, and verification layers, and you have learned that the hardest part is not running the emulation, it is making it run fast enough to matter. You think in workflows, not features. You know the difference between a setup that demos well and one that actually closes verification for a complex SoC on schedule, and you care deeply about that difference. You are comfortable walking into a customer site where the emulation run is failing in ways that make no sense on paper, and walking out three hours later with a root cause, a fix, and a plan to prevent it from happening again. You do not wait for perfect documentation. You dig into the platform, ask the right questions, and move. Leading comes naturally to you, not because you have the title, but because people trust your judgment. You push back when a verification strategy is going to hit a wall in three months. You mentor without making it feel like mentoring. At Synopsys, you will work with customers who are building the chips that power everything, and the emulation strategies you design will determine whether they hit their tapeout or slip by quarters. ### **What You'll Be Doing** * Lead technical engagements with customers deploying ZeBu or other emulation platforms, diagnosing performance bottlenecks, debug issues, and workflow inefficiencies that block verification progress * Design emulation strategies for complex SoC and ASIC projects, defining partitioning approaches, testbench integration, and bring\-up sequences that actually work under real project constraints * Collaborate directly with Synopsys R\&D teams to escalate product gaps, influence roadmap priorities, and validate new features against customer use cases before they ship * Develop and deliver technical training sessions, workshops, and best practice guides for customer engineering teams and internal application engineers * Troubleshoot critical emulation failures in live customer environments, working across hardware, RTL, testbench, and software layers to isolate root cause and restore productivity * Mentor junior applications engineers on emulation methodologies, debugging techniques, and customer engagement strategies, building the team's technical depth and customer impact ### **The Impact You Will Have** * Accelerate verification closure for customers building AI accelerators, automotive SoCs, and hyperscale processors, cutting months off their schedules through smarter emulation strategies * Expand ZeBu adoption across new customer segments by proving out use cases, building reference flows, and demonstrating measurable ROI in real project contexts * Shape the emulation product roadmap by translating customer pain points into actionable R\&D requirements that improve performance, usability, and scalability for the entire user base * Build long\-term technical partnerships with lead architects and verification managers at top semiconductor companies, becoming their trusted advisor for emulation and verification strategy * Reduce customer escalations and support load by creating reusable methodologies, automation scripts, and documentation that solve recurring problems once instead of repeatedly * Strengthen Synopsys' reputation as the emulation platform that does not just run, but runs fast enough and stable enough to be the backbone of verification for the hardest chips in the industry ### **What You'll Need** * 10\+ years of hands\-on experience with hardware emulation platforms such as Synopsys ZeBu, Mentor Veloce, or Cadence Palladium, including deployment, debug, and performance optimization * Deep proficiency in hardware description languages including Verilog, SystemVerilog, and VHDL, with the ability to read, debug, and optimize RTL for emulation * Strong understanding of verification methodologies including UVM, constrained random testing, and coverage\-driven verification in the context of emulation environments * Solid grasp of SoC and ASIC architecture, including subsystem integration, interconnect protocols, memory hierarchies, and software/hardware co\-verification flows * Experience with scripting languages such as Python, Perl, or TCL for automation, flow development, and data analysis in emulation and verification contexts * Proven ability to debug complex interactions across RTL, testbenches, emulation hardware, and embedded software, isolating issues that span multiple domains * Experience with customer\-facing technical roles such as field applications engineering, customer support engineering, or technical consulting, with a track record of solving hard problems under pressure ### **Who You Are** * You can walk into a war room where emulation is down and the tapeout is in six weeks, assess what is actually broken versus what people think is broken, and get the team focused on the right fix * You explain a complex emulation partitioning tradeoff to a verification lead in two sentences without losing the nuance, and you know when to go deeper and when to move on * You do not need to be the smartest person in the room, but you are the one people turn to when the problem is ambiguous, the pressure is high, and the path forward is not obvious * You push back when a customer asks for something that will not actually solve their problem, and you do it in a way that builds trust instead of burning it * You stay current on verification trends, emulation technology, and industry shifts not because someone told you to, but because you are genuinely curious about what is next and how it changes the game ### **The Team You'll Be Part Of** You will join a dynamic and diverse team of principal engineers and applications specialists focused on delivering world\-class emulation and verification solutions. The team collaborates closely with customers, product R\&D, and other engineering groups, fostering innovation and driving technical excellence. Together, you will shape the future of hardware verification and accelerate the development of next\-generation semiconductor technologies. LI\-CM\-1 At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability. In addition to the base salary, this role may be eligible for an annual bonus, equity, and other discretionary bonuses. Synopsys offers comprehensive health, wellness, and financial benefits as part of a competitive total rewards package. The actual compensation offered will be based on a number of job\-related factors, including location, skills, experience, and education. Your recruiter can share more specific details on the total rewards package upon request. The base salary range for this role is across the U.S.

jobs.title: Senior/Associate/Assistant Civil Engineer (Water Resources & Regulatory Affairs)
jobs.description: **Description** --------------- **The Position** Turlock Irrigation District seeks a qualified Civil Engineer to assist in all aspects of the District’s water augmentation program, with a particular emphasis on groundwater recharge and recovery. Since its inception, the District has relied upon the conjunctive use of surface water and groundwater to meet the needs of the growers and communities it serves. To augment and optimize its water supply, the District seeks a motivated self\-starter to help in all aspects of developing groundwater recharge and recovery projects. While the design and construction of water infrastructure facilities will be a component of the position, the District is seeking an individual with prior knowledge and experience in groundwater resource projects and programs to be responsible for a range of assignments, including: * Assessing the planning, funding, permitting, design, engineering, and technical reporting of groundwater recharge and recovery facilities. * Assisting in the preparation of technical information for the State Water Board for the District’s recent, and potential future, water rights applications. * Coordinating with internal departments, external consultants and contractors, and regulatory agencies to ensure all work products align with District goals and compliance with applicable codes and regulations. * Preparing relevant documents, lead meetings, and conduct presentations to a variety of audiences, including internal staff, the District’s Board of Directors, and various regulatory agencies. **JOB SUMMARY** Under general direction from the Civil Engineering Department Manager, to plan, direct, and perform professional engineering work related to the design, construction, and maintenance of irrigation related facilities and miscellaneous project requests from other divisions/departments within the Turlock Irrigation District. **DISTINGUISHING CHARACTERISTICS** **Senior Civil Engineer** is the advanced professional level class in the Engineer series. Positions assigned to this classification are distinguished from the Associate Civil Engineer classification by the performance of the more complex engineering assignments. In addition, positions assigned to this class have responsibility for all projects within their functional area as well as responsibility to provide technical and functional supervision to assigned personnel. **Associate Civil Engineer** is the professional level class in the Engineer series. Positions assigned to this classification are distinguished from the Assistant Engineer classification by having responsibility for major projects. In addition, this classification has responsibility for providing engineer’s stamp and signature on drawings in conformance with government code and regulations. **Assistant Engineer** is the entry\-level class in the Engineer series. Assistant Engineers are assigned to work on projects under guidance of experienced engineers. Positions in this class will usually perform most of the duties required of the Associate Civil Engineer, but are not expected to function at the same skill level and usually exercise less independent direction and judgment in matters related to work procedures and methods. The class is distinguished from the Associate Civil Engineer by the performance of more routine duties according to established procedures. **Examples of Duties** ---------------------- **DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** Design and produce working drawings and specifications for the construction of related water and electrical structures as needed. Prepare reports and recommend policies and practices to the Assistant General Manager Water Resources and Regulatory Affairs, General Manager and the Board of Directors. Represent the District at public meetings. Prepare project RFQ(s) and recommend selection of bids and consultants. Coordinate the work of consultants and public and private construction of District facilities. Review survey descriptions, parcels and subdivision maps. Prepare and monitor the Civil Engineering Department budgets. Perform economic and feasibility studies. jobs.title: Principal Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: **GROW WITH US:** Tandem Diabetes Care creates new possibilities for people living with diabetes, their loved ones, and their healthcare providers through a positively different experience. We’d love for you to team up with us to “innovate every day,” put “people first,” and take the “no\-shortcuts” approach that has propelled us to become a leader in the diabetes technology industry. **STAY AWESOME:** Tandem Diabetes Care is proud to manufacture and sell the Tandem Mobi system and t:slim X2 insulin pump with Control\-IQ\+ technology — an advanced predictive algorithm that automates insulin delivery. But we’re so much more than that. Our company’s human\-centered approach to design, development, and support delivers innovative products and services for people who use insulin. Because many of our own team members live with diabetes, or have a loved one impacted by diabetes, the work is personal, and we are committed to the cause. Learn more at tandemdiabetes.com **A DAY IN THE LIFE:** The Principal Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) is responsible for the reliability, availability, and performance of the company's production systems. This role leads day\-to\-day production support and incident response and progressively replaces reactive firefighting with engineered SRE practice: SLOs, observability, on\-call design, runbooks, and automation. It also advances infrastructure automation (Terraform/IaC), CI/CD reliability, disaster recovery, and security and compliance readiness in partnership with cross\-functional teams. The role works with a distributed team that includes offshore consulting partners and is expected to raise their capability and independence; success is measured as much by what the team can do without the Principal SRE as by what the Principal SRE delivers personally. The Principal Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)'s at Tandem are also responsible for: **Production Support \& Incident Management** * Leads day\-to\-day production support: intake, triage, prioritization, escalation, queue health, and change execution. * Establishes consistent support practices across a distributed team, including shift handoffs, ticket quality standards, and clear ownership of open issues. * Leads incident management end\-to\-end: incident command, stakeholder communication, and blameless postmortems with corrective actions tracked to closure. * Participates in and coordinates response activities for production security incidents, partnering with Security teams to contain threats, restore services, validate controls, and implement corrective actions. * Owns on\-call strategy: rotation design, escalation paths, alert tuning, and tooling (e.g., PagerDuty, New Relic), with explicit goals of reducing alert fatigue and building coverage that works across time zones. Participates as a senior escalation tier for high\-severity incidents. * Builds runbooks that standardize response to common failure modes and enable first\-line resolution by engineers who did not build the system. **Reliability Engineering \& Observability** * Defines and owns SLIs and SLOs for critical services, using them to guide monitoring, alerting, and reliability priorities. * Drives systemic reduction of MTTD and MTTR through better instrumentation, alerting, diagnostics, and automation. * Converts recurring support burden into permanent fixes, automation, or documentation rather than absorbing it as ongoing manual work. * Establishes and maintains technology currency and lifecycle management practices for production platforms, ensuring cloud services, Kubernetes clusters, operating systems, runtimes, and infrastructure components remain supported, secure, and aligned with organizational standards. Proactively identifies and mitigates End\-of\-Life (EOL), End\-of\-Support (EOS), and technology obsolescence risks. * Owns business continuity and disaster recovery readiness for production platforms, including backup and recovery strategies, recovery testing, failover capabilities, recovery runbooks, and adherence to defined RTO/RPO objectives. **Infrastructure Automation \& CI/CD** * Leads infrastructure automation with Terraform, ensuring infrastructure is version\-controlled, modular, reusable, and auditable, working within and improving existing patterns where they are sound. * Eliminates toil through automation, reducing manual, repetitive operational work across the team. * Adds reliability guardrails to CI/CD pipelines (automated rollback, change\-risk checks, progressive delivery) with the teams that own them. **Operational Governance and Compliance** * Maintains production systems in accordance with applicable regulatory and compliance requirements, ensuring audit readiness and the ongoing effectiveness of access management, change management, logging, vulnerability remediation, patch management, and other operational controls. * Maintains documentation and evidence supporting business continuity and disaster recovery controls, including recov /Azure/GCP Professional or Architect level) preferred. * 10\+ years in Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, or infrastructure engineering, including: + Leading production support, incident management, and postmortem practice. + Managing production cloud infrastructure as code (Terraform or equivalent) at scale. + Operating and improving CI/CD pipelines in a production environment. + Designing, executing, and testing disaster recovery plans. + Partnering with security teams on production security and compliance posture. * 2\+ years mentoring or technically leading other engineers, including engineers who are remote, offshore, or contracted through a partner organization. **COMPENSATION \& BENEFITS:** The starting base pay range for this position is **$165,000 to $185,000** annually. Base pay will vary based on job\-related knowledge, skills, experience and may also fluctuate depending on candidate’s location and the overall job market. In addition to base pay, Tandem offers a competitive compensation package that includes bonus and a robust benefits package. Tandem offers health care benefits such as medical, dental, vision available your first day, as well as health savings accounts and flexible saving accounts. You’ll also receive 11 paid holidays per year, a minimum of 20 days of paid time off (with accrual starting on day 1\) and you will have access to a 401k plan with company match as well as an Employee Stock Purchase plan. Learn more about Tandem’s benefits here! **YOU SHOULD KNOW:** Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable state and local Fair Chance laws and regulations. A conditional offer of employment from Tandem is contingent upon successful completion of a pre\-employment screening process comprised of a drug test (excluding marijuana) and background check, which includes a review of criminal history information. Tandem has good cause to conduct a review of criminal history information of candidates for this position, as this role may involve access to proprietary, sensitive and/or confidential information, including customer protected health information. This review is required to ensure that individuals in such roles uphold high standards of trust and integrity so as to protect the interests of our customers, employees, and stakeholders. **WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE:** At Tandem, we believe joy fuels excellence. That's why we've built a workplace that celebrates your achievements and supports your well\-being. Our team thrives on pushing boundaries and fostering growth, all while maintaining a spirit of fun and camaraderie. This is just one of the ways we stay awesome! Explore the benefits and reasons to love Tandem at https://www.tandemdiabetes.com/careers. **BE YOU, WITH US!** We embrace the value that every single one of us brings to the table. But sometimes we forget that when we don’t meet 100% of a job description’s criteria – maybe you’re feeling that way right now? We encourage you to apply anyway. Because we want you to be you, with us. Tandem is firmly committed to being an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, disability, sex, race, religion or belief, gender identity or expression, marriage/civil partnership, pregnancy/maternity, or sexual orientation. We are an inclusive organization, and we welcome applications from a wide range of candidates. Selection for roles will be based on individual merit alone. **REFERRALS:** We love a good referral! If you know someone who would be a great fit for this position, please share! **APPLICATION DEADLINE:** The position will be posted until a final candidate is selected for the requisition or the requisition has a sufficient number of applications. Make a move that matters. Join Tandem Diabetes Care, where we're turning challenges into triumphs every day and where your talents will help shape a healthier, happier tomorrow. \#LI\-KT1 \#LI\-Remote

jobs.title: Global Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Location:** United States \- Minneapolis, MN **Hours:** Monday – Friday; **Pay:** $72,800 \- $109,500 With more than $1B in revenue, Tennant Company is a globally recognized leader in the cleaning equipment industry. For the past 150 years, we have been passionate about developing and manufacturing innovative and sustainable solutions for our customers. At Tennant Company, we are committed to stewardship and creating a cleaner, safer and healthier world. With manufacturing, operations and sales, service, and support functions across the globe, your journey at Tennant can take you places you never expected. **PURPOSE/SCOPE:** The Global Data Science \& Business Intelligence Team is focused on building an agile global Center of Excellence that supports strategic planning, roadmap development and deployment, global standards, and operating model governance in alignment with business and company objectives. The Global DSBI Team enables key strategic priorities and initiatives that improve operational excellence, cost management, customer satisfaction, and Tennant’s competitive position in the marketplace. The **Data Engineer** will reside within the Global DSBI Team and support the data engineering, reporting, and analytics needs of Global Supply Chain and North America Business Unit (NABU) customers. This role will work under the direction of senior team members to build, maintain, validate, and improve data pipelines, data models, and reporting datasets that support supply chain/NAUB performance management, cost analytics, and business decision\-making. The role will partner with cross\-functional stakeholders to gather requirements, clean and transform source data, troubleshoot data quality issues, and develop reliable data assets that make information easier to access, understand, and act on. The **Data Engineer** will also support process improvements, system projects, and strategic initiatives by helping translate business needs into scalable data solutions that strengthen Global Supply Chain and NABU capabilities. **GENERAL RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Support the development, maintenance, and validation of data pipelines, datasets, and reporting models used by Global Supply Chain and NABU customers. * Assist with collecting, cleaning, transforming, and integrating data from multiple source systems to improve data accessibility, reliability, and usability. * Partner with senior team members to build and enhance data models, semantic layers, and reporting datasets that support supply chain performance, cost analytics, and operational decision\-making. * Develop and maintain Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, SQL, and other analytics assets in alignment with established team standards and business requirements. * Perform data quality checks, reconcile outputs to source systems, and help troubleshoot issues related to data accuracy, completeness, refresh failures, and reporting inconsistencies. * Analyze supply chain and NABU data to identify trends, performance gaps, process constraints, and opportunities for improvement. * Translate business requirements into clear technical tasks, data logic, and reporting deliverables with guidance from senior data engineering and business intelligence team members. * Create and maintain documentation for data sources, transformations, business rules, report logic, and support processes to improve knowledge sharing and long\-term sustainability. * Support process improvement, system implementation, and strategic supply chain/NABU initiatives by preparing data, building analytical outputs, and validating results. * Collaborate with cross\-functional stakeholders to understand reporting needs, explain data outputs, and help ensure insights are actionable for non\-technical users. * Follow data governance, security, change control, and development best practices when creating or modifying data assets. * Continue developing technical knowledge in data engineering, business intelligence, Microsoft Fabric, SAP S/4HANA, Databricks, and related tools to strengthen the team’s long\-term analytics capabilities. **REQUIRED EXPERIENCE \& EDUCATION:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or Data Analytics/Science required (Master’s preferred), with an associated technology\-related minor such as Data Analytics, Statistics, Information Systems, Management Information Systems, Business Analytics, or a related field. * 1\-3 years of related experience in data analytics, data engineering, business intelligence, statistics, supply chain analytics, or a related technical field; internship, co\-op, academic project, or applied business experience may be considered. * Foundational knowledge of data analysis, statistical methods, data modeling, data transformation, and data validation concepts. * Working knowledge of SQL and at least one analytical or statistical programming language, such as Python, R, or a similar tool. * Experience or coursework using business intelligence, database, or analytics platforms such as Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Power Platform, Excel, cloud data platforms, or similar technologies. * Ability to collect, clean, transform, reconcile, and interpret structured data from multiple sources to support reporting and business decision\-making. * Basic understanding of data pipelines, semantic models, reporting datasets, and data quality controls preferred. * Exposure to ERP, supply chain, procurement, manufacturing, logistics, or SAP S/4HANA data preferred. * Ability to translate business questions into data requirements, analytical logic, and clear reporting outputs with guidance from senior team members. * Certifications or continuing education in Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, SQL, Python, data analytics, data engineering, or related technologies preferred. **REQUIRED INTERPERSONAL \& BEHAVIORAL SKILLS:** * Demonstrates curiosity, analytical thinking, and attention to detail when working with data, business requirements, and reporting outputs. * Communicates clearly with technical and non\-technical stakeholders to understand needs, explain findings, and ask effective follow\-up questions. * Builds positive working relationships with Global Supply Chain, NABU, and cross\-functional partners through responsiveness, professionalism, and follow\-through. * Applies a continuous improvement mindset by identifying opportunities to make data processes, reports, and documentation more accurate, repeatable, and efficient. * Demonstrates learning agility and a willingness to develop new technical skills, business knowledge, and supply chain understanding. * Works effectively in a team environment, accepts feedback, and collaborates with senior team members to solve data and reporting challenges. * Maintains ownership of assigned tasks by managing priorities, meeting deadlines, escalating risks when needed, and following established standards. * Demonstrates integrity and sound judgment when working with business data, confidential information, and data governance requirements. **Total Compensation \= Pay range \+ Benefits** Posted salary ranges are made in good faith. Tennant Sales and Service Co. reserves the right to adjust ranges depending on the experience/qualifications of the selected candidate as well as internal and external equity. The salary range reflects both entry into the role and future growth. Total Compensation \= Base Salary \+ Benefits Benefits \= A comprehensive benefits package including multiple medical plan options, 401(k) with a 100% match up to 6%, paid vacation time, up to 8 paid company holidays and 3 personal holidays per year, dental and vision coverage, wellness rewards, robust family support programs, company‑paid disability and life insurance, and a full Employee Assistance Program. **Defining Our Employee Value Proposition** At Tennant Company, we… **Discover** fulfilling work with opportunities for growth and meaningful recognition. **Drive** the quality and innovation our customers rely on in our products and services. **Connect** with people who care about each other, our brands and our communities. These are the principles that define how our employees experience Tennant Company, make Tennant a great place to grow your career, and are at the core of our legacy and future. Together, they serve as guideposts for working with our customers, our partners and one another. Begin your journey with us. Let's reinvent how the world cleans. **Equal Opportunity Employer** Tennant Company is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are made on the basis of individual skill, ability, reliability, productivity, and other factors important to performance. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, creed, religion, sex, national origin, physical or mental disability, age, veteran status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, genetic information, gender identity, or any other basis protected by state or federal law or local ordinance.

jobs.title: Manufacturing Technician
jobs.description: **Manufacturing Engineering Technician** **JOB DESCRIPTION** **Location** Tenneco, Blacksburg, Virginia **Department** Manufacturing Engineering **Reports To** Plant Engineer Manager **FLSA Status** To be determined by Human Resources **Position Summary** ==================== The Manufacturing Engineering Technician provides hands\-on technical support for manufacturing processes, tooling, equipment, and continuous improvement activities. This position is responsible for implementing process improvements on the production floor and assisting with daily machine, tooling, quality, safety, and equipment concerns. The employee may be responsible for an entire project, from design through installation and implementation, or for an assigned portion of a larger project. The position works closely with Engineering, Production, Maintenance, Quality, Environmental Health and Safety, and Continuous Improvement personnel to improve safety, quality, delivery, productivity, equipment reliability, and cost performance. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** ========================================= **Process and Equipment Improvement** ------------------------------------- * Monitor and control existing manufacturing processes. * Apply mechanical, technical, and design skills to improve manufacturing processes, tooling, equipment, and workflow. * Identify, implement, document, and evaluate process improvements within the employee’s level of responsibility and technical capability. * Communicate process changes and improvement results to affected departments. * Participate in continuous improvement teams, problem\-solving groups, and plant improvement initiatives. * Use constraint\-management principles to identify and address production bottlenecks and maximize process output. * Assist in troubleshooting and resolving daily machine, tooling, equipment, and process problems. * Support root\-cause analysis and corrective actions for recurring equipment or process concerns. * Support preventive and predictive maintenance initiatives to improve equipment availability and reliability. **Project and Design Responsibilities** --------------------------------------- * Manage assigned projects from design through installation, validation, training, and implementation, or complete assigned portions of larger projects. * Develop or assist with equipment, tooling, fixtures, gauges, material\-handling devices, and manufacturing\-layout improvements. * Create, revise, and maintain engineering drawings, equipment layouts, process documentation, and technical specifications. * Coordinate equipment installations, modifications, trials, and production launches. * Work with suppliers, contractors, Maintenance, Production, and Engineering personnel during project implementation. * Prepare Authorization Requests and Expenditure Authorization Requests, including ARs and EARs, as required. * Document process improvements through engineering drawing changes, procedure revisions, work instructions, and other controlled documentation. **Training and Technical Support** ---------------------------------- * Identify technical training needs within the assigned manufacturing area. * Assist with developing technical training materials and programs. * Train employees affected by new equipment, tooling, procedures, or process changes. * Provide technical guidance to operators, production supervisors, maintenance employees, and other affected personnel. * Provide technical support as requested by the supervisor. **Safety and Environmental Responsibilities** --------------------------------------------- * Promote continuous improvement in safety and environmental performance. * Ensure equipment is designed, installed, modified, or repaired in a manner that maintains or improves safety and environmental performance. * Respond immediately to safety concerns and take appropriate action when unsafe conditions are identified. * Provide technical support for correcting plant safety deficiencies within the assigned department. * Follow all company environmental, health, and safety policies, programs, work instructions, and procedures. * Participate in safety investigations, audits, risk assessments, corrective actions, and equipment\-safety reviews as assigned. * Stop and report any activity that presents a safety risk or does not comply with company requirements. * Wear all required personal protective equipment. **Education** ============= **Preferred** ------------- * Associate degree in Engineering Science, Machine Design, Manufacturing Technology, Mechanical Engineering Technology, or a related technical discipline. * Equivalent technical education, apprenticeship training, or directly related manufacturing experience may be considered. **Experience** ============== **Required** ------------ * Four years of experience in machine operation, setup, troubleshooting, tooling, or manufacturing\-process support. * Demonstrated technical design, fabrication, in r position materials, tools, parts, drawings, or equipment weighing up to 35 pounds. * Operate computers, measuring devices, hand tools, equipment controls, and other technical instruments. * Possess the visual capability necessary to read engineering drawings, computer screens, measuring devices, labels, work instructions, and equipment\-control displays. * Communicate effectively in person and through available communication devices in a manufacturing environment. * Wear required personal protective equipment, including safety glasses, hearing protection, safety\-toe footwear, gloves, and other task\-specific protective equipment. * Work safely around moving machinery, industrial vehicles, automated equipment, material\-handling systems, and production processes. **Work Environment** ==================== * Work is performed in both office and active manufacturing environments. * Regular exposure may include noise, heat, vibration, dust, industrial materials, moving equipment, automated machinery, and varying production\-floor conditions. * The employee must comply with posted safety requirements and operational controls while working in manufacturing areas. * Occasional off\-shift, weekend, shutdown, or overtime support may be required for equipment installations, process trials, production interruptions, and project implementation. * Travel within the facility and limited business travel may be required. **Quality, Safety, and Environmental Accountability** ===================================================== * All employees have the authority to perform their assigned duties and address the responsibilities associated with their positions. * The employee is authorized and expected to support and enforce applicable product\-quality standards and quality systems at the Blacksburg facility. * The employee is authorized and expected to support and enforce Environmental, Health, and Safety rules, regulatory requirements, corporate directives, programs, and systems. * The employee must follow applicable local work instructions and Quality Management System procedures consistent with current IATF 16949 requirements. * The employee is accountable for complying with the company’s safety expectations, including refusing to tolerate or permit unsafe conduct that could result in an occupational injury or illness. * The employee must understand the hazards associated with the position and follow established controls to minimize those hazards. * All accidents, injuries, near misses, hazards, and unsafe conditions must be reported promptly in accordance with company procedures. * The employee must comply with the facility’s Environmental, Health, and Safety Management System and support established objectives and targets. * Each employee has the authority and responsibility to stop and report an activity that is unsafe, violates company policy, or does not conform to applicable quality or environmental requirements. **Skills and Training Inventory** ================================= A current skills and training inventory must be maintained for the position in accordance with the facility’s document\-control and training procedures. The controlled template for the Salaried Employee Skills \& Training Inventory List is FCD\-1601\. The employee is responsible for completing all required safety, environmental, quality, technical, and job\-specific training. **General Disclaimer** ====================== This job description describes the general nature and level of work performed by employees assigned to this position. It is not intended to be a comprehensive listing of every responsibility, duty, qualification, or working condition. Management may modify job responsibilities and requirements based on operational needs, organizational changes, and the qualifications of the selected candidate. The company will consider reasonable accommodations that enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the position’s essential functions.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Artificial Intelligence Engineering
jobs.description: **Our company** At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI. **What You’ll Do** We are looking for a **Senior Manager – AI Platform** to lead the development and evolution of our next\-generation platform powering autonomous, AI\-driven agents. This role is ideal for a leader who combines **data science expertise and technical depth**, **agentic platform thinking**, and **strategic execution** to scale a distributed system that enables reasoning, planning, memory, and tool use at runtime. As the Senior Manager, you will be responsible for driving product and data science strategy, overseeing a multidisciplinary team of engineers and data scientists, collaborating with AI/ML research and product teams, and ensuring that the AI Platform is performant, extensible, and production\-ready. Job Responsibilities: * **Lead the engineering and data science roadmap** for the AI Platform, ensuring architectural scalability, reliability, and seamless integration with LLMs, data science pipelines. * Partner with product, data science, research, and engineering teams to define requirements for capabilities such as predictive modeling, memory, planning, multi\-agent collaboration, and tool orchestration. * Drive the design and implementation of core platform services including API gateways, vector store integrations, RAG pipelines, and data science experimentation frameworks. * Oversee integrations with third\-party tools, internal data science services, and infrastructure platforms to enable real\-world agent execution and model deployment at scale. * Guide the team in applying best practices in cloud\-native development, distributed computing, observability, and security. * Manage, mentor, and grow a high\-performing team of backend engineers, data scientists, and AI platform specialists. * Ensure alignment between platform capabilities and evolving needs from AI product lines and downstream applications. * Drive technical excellence through code and design reviews, system reliability practices, and collaboration across engineering functions. * Contribute to the long\-term vision and strategy of how agentic workflows, powered by data science and machine learning, will operate at scale across the organization. **What makes you a qualified candidate** * 12\+ years of experience in software/platform engineering or data science, with 3\+ years in engineering management or technical leadership roles overseeing AI\-driven initiatives. * Proven experience building and scaling distributed systems or cloud platforms in production environments. * Strong technical background in backend development, APIs, infrastructure, or platform architecture. * Hands\-on experience with AI/ML platforms, LLM integrations, and demonstrated background in data enterprise software systems that run in either AWS Cloud or GCP Cloud environments using technologies such as AWS managed services such as ECS, Lambda, SQS, SNS, S3, API Gateway, DynamoDB, OpenSearch, with a backing relational and/or NoSQL databases using ORM libraries such as sqlaclhemy. * Experience developing microservices with RESTful API and/or grpc to exchange data via JSON, XML, and other data exchange formats. * Experience integrating with Okta and additional 3rd party systems * Experience working in an agile development environment with methodologies such as SCRUM or Kanban. * efficient and accurate code reviews of AI\-generated code. * 2\-5 years of experience building enterprise software systems that run in a Production AWS or Google Cloud environment. * 1\-2 years of working with a CI/CD pipeline using Git, GitHub, and GitHub Actions (or similar tools). * Cloud development or architect certification is a plus. * Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Microsoft Azure is a plus. **Be Part of One Team, One Purpose.** At **Emmes Group**, we’re shaping the future of clinical research—**where human intelligence meets cutting\-edge technology** to drive meaningful advancements in healthcare. About Us For more than 140 years, The University of Texas System has improved the lives of Texans — and people all over the world — through education, health care, and research. The System consists of nine academic institutions, four health institutions, and The University of Texas System Administration. The institutions of the UT System employ more than 160,000 faculty, health care professionals, researchers, support staff, and student workers. The UT System Administration is primarily based in Austin, Texas. It supports the missions of the System's thirteen institutions by providing financial, legal, planning, purchasing, government relations, communications, development, and other central services. Serving a growing state, the UT System Administration strives to provide a welcoming, supportive work environment that embraces different perspectives \- not only because it enables the organization to be stronger, creative, and thoughtful, but because it is the right thing to do. To that end, UT System Administration embraces state laws on military and former foster children employment preferences. Purpose of Position Designs, codes, tests, implements, and supports internally developed application software for all areas of RISC Services including the Risk Management, Information Security, and Systemwide Compliance offices at UT System Administration. Makes recommendations towards the development of new code or reuse of existing code or modules. Serves as analyst responsible for technical analysis, documentation of business requirements, system analysis, and system configurations. Essential Functions Develops and maintains systems and software using Microsoft SQL Server, ASP.Net (C\#), JavaScript, and other technologies. Conducts application design, coding, testing, validation and implementation for complex applications, and application code reviews. Maintains applications software and collects and reviews performance monitoring information as needed. Designs complex software systems that address broad technical or scientific needs. Interfaces with clients, vendors, and other UT Institutions to facilitate the appropriate exchange of information and data. Research available solutions and integrate them into existing computing environments. Provide end user training on application software and may develop user manuals. Other duties as assigned. Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities Strong written and oral communication skills. Strong interpersonal skills. Strong attention to detail. Demonstrated analytical problem\-solving abilities. Demonstrated ability to translate complicated business logic into code. Ability to work both independently and in a team\-oriented, collaborated environment with technical and non\-technical users. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration or a related field and 5 years of related work experience. One year of college (30 semester hours) may be substituted for one year of the required experience on a year\-for\-year basis, allowing up to a maximum of 4 years substituted experience. This position requires the ability to maintain the security and integrity of UT System Administration and it's infrastructure. Preferred Qualifications Two years of professional experience developing web applications using C\# with ASP.Net Web Forms or MVC, as well as JavaScript/jQuery. Experience querying and designing databases with Microsoft SQL Server Management Studio, utilizing stored procedures and/or Entity Framework to interact with the data. Knowledge of ADA requirements and application security. A knowledge of responsive design techniques for mobile\-friendly applications Experience gathering requirements, and documenting and testing complex technical processes. Experience developing and documenting work requirements, rules, workflows, reports, and presentations for automation projects. Experience with performing data analysis and/or data validation. Exceptional analytical, multi\-tasking and problem\-solving skills. Self\-managed and highly motivated with a strong drive for delivering high quality results. jobs.title: Sr. Unity Developer
jobs.description: Topgolf is looking for a Senior Unity Developer to join our Games team and help lead the next generation of interactive experiences played by millions of Guests across our venues. This role sits at the intersection of game development, real\-world sports, connected venues, and large\-scale entertainment technology. You will lead the design and architecture of Unity\-based games and experiences that run in Topgolf bays, using ball\-tracking data, venue systems, real\-time scoring, and engaging game mechanics to create fun, social, competitive gameplay. You will lead a small group of engineer’s day to day, partner closely with game designers, artists, UX/UI designers, QA, product owners, and platform engineers, and act as the primary technical voice for the Games team, from roadmap through national rollout. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Architect, develop, and optimize Unity games and interactive experiences for Topgolf venues, making key technical decisions for the systems you own. * Design gameplay systems, UI, animation, scoring, camera behavior, effects, and game\-state logic that other engineers can build on. * Lead integration of Unity games with internal Topgolf services, APIs, tracking systems, configuration tools, and venue hardware. * Partner with designers and product owners to translate ambiguous game
