jobs.description: **Employee Type:** Full time **Location:** IL Oak Brook **Job Type:** Information Technology **Job Posting Title:** Application Developer, Business Applications \& Process Automation **About Us:** TreeHouse Foods is a leading manufacturer of private label packaged foods and beverages, operating a network of over 20 production facilities and several corporate offices across the United States and Canada. At TreeHouse Foods, our commitment to excellence extends beyond our products and revolves around our people. We are investing in talent and creating a performance\-based culture where employees can do their best work and develop their careers, directly impacting our mission to make high quality, affordable food for our customers, communities, and families. We hope you will consider joining the team and being part of our future. Named one of America’s Best Large Employers by Forbes Magazine, we are proud to live by a strong set of values and strive to "Engage and Delight – One Customer at a Time." Guided by our values— **Own It, Commit to Excellence, Be Agile, Speak Up, and Better Together.** We are a diverse team driven by integrity, accountability, and a commitment to exceptional results. We embrace change, prioritize continuous learning, and foster collaboration, transparency, and healthy debate. Together, we set each other up for success to achieve enterprise\-wide goals. **What You Gain:** * Competitive compensation and benefits program with no waiting period – you’re eligible from your first day! * 401(k) program with 5% employer match and 100% vesting as soon as you enroll. * Comprehensive paid time off opportunities, including immediate access to four weeks of vacation, five sick days, parental leave and 11 company holidays (including two floating holidays). * Leaders who are invested in supporting your accelerated career growth, plus paid training, tuition reimbursement and a robust educational platform – DevelopU – with more than 10,000 free courses to support you along the way. * An inclusive working environment where you can build meaningful work relationships with a diverse group of professionals. Take advantage of opportunities to build on our team\-oriented culture, such as joining one of our Employee Resource Groups. * Access to our wellness and employee assistance programs. **Job Description:** ***About the Role:*** We are seeking a self\-starting Application Developer, Business Applications \& Process Automation, based out of our corporate office in Oak Brook, IL. This role will design, build, and continuously evolve enterprise\-grade applications across our low\-code/no\-code and automation platform stack. While our current stack is anchored in Quickbase — it includes work with tools such as Microsoft Power Automate, SAP Integrations, RPA, AI agents, and whatever platform best fits the next problem. The Developer will also build AI capability into applications and workflows — surfacing intelligent automation, agents, and AI\-assisted decisioning where they add real value. The Developer will also use AI coding tools to move faster and take on more than a traditional developer workload would allow. This is a product ownership role, not a project execution role — the Developer will own their applications as living products with feature roadmaps and release cycles. Success requires the ability to quickly learn new tools and working alongside AI in both directions, as well as the ability to work closely with business stakeholders, acting as a change agent for automation and digital adoption, bringing a strong bias for action to everything you build. ***You’ll add value to this role by performing various functions including, but not limited to:*** Product Ownership \& Agile Delivery * Own a product’s roadmap, adoption, iteration cycle, and long\-term health beyond initial go\-live * Operate within Agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban) participate in sprint planning, backlog grooming, stand\-ups, and retrospectives; break large initiatives into shippable increments * Act as a self\-starter with a bias for action by proactively identifying gaps, inefficiencies, and opportunities, developing solutions, gathering feedback and driving them through to completion with minimal oversight. * Serve as a change agent, championing automation and digital adoption across teams, influencing stakeholders, and driving process modernization even amid resistance Technical Development * Design, develop, maintain, and optimize low\-code/no\-code business applications, workflow automations, and integrations that improve business processes and enable efficient data exchange across enterprise systems * Perform data modeling, ETL/data migration, troubleshooting, and system optimization activities to ensure application performance, reliability, and data integrity * Document technical solutions and continuously expand expertise in emerging platforms, integration methods, and automation technologies to support evolving business  LM APIs, agent frameworks) as part of the broader TreeHouse automation fabric * Use AI coding assistants and agentic developer tools (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot Studio, GitHub Copilot) to move faster, explore unfamiliar platforms, and take on a heavier workload than manual development alone would support Important Details: * This role is a full\-time, hybrid role based out of our corporate office in Oak Brook, IL. * The anticipated compensation for this position ranges from $63,500\.00 \- 95,300\.00 USD annually. This is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, specific competencies, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, shift, travel requirements, sales or revenue\-based metrics and business or organizational needs. For certain roles, the successful candidate may be eligible for annual discretionary merit compensation award, bonus and equity pay. You’ll fit right in if you have: * Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent demonstrated aptitude and practical experience * 1–4 years of professional experience in application development, scripting, or low\-code/no\-code platforms — no deep QuickBase background required * Hands\-on experience with at least one of the following: a low\-code/no\-code platform (QuickBase, Power Apps, Out Systems, Mendix, Airtable, ServiceNow, Appian, etc.), a scripting/programming language, or database and relational data concepts * Exposure to, or genuine interest in learning, Agile/Scrum or Kanban ways of working * Basic understanding of REST APIs, JSON, and how systems integrate * Experience using AI coding assistants (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, or similar) to help build, debug, or learn, and to multiply output * Demonstrated experience working in, or strong interest in, a product ownership capacity (owning solutions end\-to\-end) rather than purely task/project execution * Proven track record of taking initiative and driving work independently, even in unfamiliar territory * Strong problem\-solving skills and ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions * Good communication skills; comfortable working with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders * Experience with the broader Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power BI, Power Automate, Dataverse) * Familiarity with SQL and database design * Hands\-on SAP integration experience (e.g., data migrations, middleware, or API\-based connections) * Formal Agile certification (CSM, PSM, SAFe) a plus * Background in business analysis or process improvement (Lean/Six Sigma a plus) * Prior experience in a citizen\-developer or hybrid technical/functional role Experience with RPA tools or other automation platforms * **Your TreeHouse Foods Career is Just a Click Away!** Click on the “Apply” button or go directly to www.treehousefoods.com/careers to let us know you’re ready to join our team! *At TreeHouse Foods, we embrace diversity and inclusion for innovation and growth. We are committed to building inclusive teams and an equitable workplace for our employees to bring their true selves to work to help us “Engage and Delight – One Customer at a Time”.* *TreeHouse Foods is an Equal Opportunity Employer that prohibits discrimination or harassment of any type. jobs.title: Electrical Engineering Manager
jobs.description: **Position Title:** Electrical Engineering Manager **Requisition ID:** 1876 **Position Location:** Fairfax, VA / Sterling, VA **Position Reports To:** Senior Director, Hardware Engineering **Supervises Others:** Yes At Trident Systems Space Electronic Systems (SES) division, we believe in the power of using strong engineering principles to drive innovation and solve complex problems. We foster a culture of rigorous engineering and continuous improvement, leveraging the full knowledge of our organization through collaborative product development processes that include design and peer reviews. We combine our expertise in space electronics with right\-sized development processes to create innovative, high\-performance space\-based electronic systems that meet our customers' evolving needs. We are a mission partner supporting DoD, Intelligence Community, and Civil space customers. We develop complex, radiation effects mitigated, designs that balance competing requirements in modern space programs, delivering cutting\-edge solutions that enable our customers to achieve more in space. **Position Summary** The Electrical Engineering Manager is responsible for leading and developing a team of electrical design engineers supporting Trident’s advanced electronic systems, including space computing, embedded processing, and high‑reliability electronics. This role combines technical leadership with people and project management to ensure successful execution of current programs while building the capabilities needed for future products. The Electrical Engineering Manager oversees staffing, performance, technical quality, and process adherence within the electrical engineering discipline. The ideal candidate has a strong background in board‑level electrical design (digital, mixed‑signal, and/or power), experience in aerospace or high‑reliability environments, and a demonstrated ability to lead teams delivering complex hardware from concept through production. **Duties and Responsibilities** Technical and Project Leadership * Provide technical leadership for the electrical engineering discipline across multiple projects. * Oversee and support architecture, design, analysis, and verification of complex electronic hardware, including processor/FPGA\-based boards, power electronics, mixed signal interfaces, and supporting circuitry. * Ensure use of rigorous engineering practices, including requirements definition, design analysis (e.g., WCCA, derating, SI/PI evaluation), design reviews, and thorough documentation. * Review and approve key technical artifacts such as schematics, PCB layouts, analysis reports, and test procedures. * Support root\-cause analysis and corrective actions for hardware issues discovered during integration, environmental testing, and production. People Management and Development * Manage a team of electrical engineers, including performance management, goal setting, coaching, and career development. * Conduct regular one on ones, mid year and annual performance reviews, and provide candid feedback and guidance. * Identify training, mentoring, and cross training opportunities to strengthen individual capabilities and overall team depth. * Support succession planning and talent development to ensure continuity of critical skills. * Foster a collaborative, transparent, and accountable team culture aligned with Trident’s values. Resource Planning and Execution * Plan and allocate electrical engineering resources across programs to meet scope, schedule, and budget commitments. * Collaborate with program managers, systems engineers, and other functional leads to develop realistic engineering plans and task estimates. * Monitor progress against plan; proactively identify and resolve resource, technical, or schedule risks. * Coordinate priorities across multiple projects, balancing near term demands with long term capability development. Process, Quality, and Continuous Improvement * Ensure adherence to Trident’s engineering processes, standards, and configuration management practices. * Lead or participate in design and peer reviews to drive technical quality and knowledge sharing. * Identify opportunities to improve tools, methods, and workflows within the electrical engineering discipline (e.g., simulation practices, design templates, checklists). * Promote data driven decision making and continuous improvement based on lessons learned from development and test. Cross Functional and External Engagement * Work closely with mechanical, FPGA, software, systems, test, manufacturing, and quality teams to ensure integrated, producible hardware solutions. * Support business development activities by contributing to technical proposals, BOE/ROM estimates, and customer presentations. * Serve as an electrical engineering subject matter expert in customer and supplier interactions, design reviews, and technical interchange meetings. * Collaborate with supply chain and manufacturing to support design for manufacturab perience in electrical/electronic hardware design and development OR 7\+ years with a graduate degree. * Demonstrated experience leading or owning complex board level designs from concept and architecture through schematic, PCB layout oversight, bring up, and verification. * Experience with high\-speed digital, mixed signal, or power electronics design (e.g., processors, FPGAs, DDR, PCIe, Ethernet, DC/DC conversion, PoL regulation). * Hands on experience with lab debug and characterization using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, power supplies, and related instrumentation. * Prior experience providing technical direction or leading small engineering teams or projects. * Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities. * Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to clearly explain technical decisions to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. **Preferred Qualifications** * Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field. * Experience in aerospace, defense, or other high reliability electronics domains (e.g., spacecraft, launch vehicles, avionics, missiles, or similar systems). * Familiarity with radiation tolerant or radiation effects mitigated electronics for space environments. * Experience with SI/PI analysis tools and methods (e.g., HyperLynx, Sigrity, SIwave). * Experience with VPX, SpaceVPX, VITA standards, or other modular embedded computing architectures. * Prior line\-management experience (hiring, performance reviews, salary planning). * Experience with configuration management and PDM/PLM tools. * Experience supporting customer technical reviews, proposals, and new product introduction. **Pay Information** Full\-Time Salary Range: $113,000 \- $211,000 Please Note: Actual compensation offered will be determined based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant experience, skills, education, certifications, internal equity, business considerations, and geographic location where applicable. **Benefits** Hired applicants may be eligible for benefits including but not limited to: * Health benefits + Medical + Dental + Vision + Basic life with AD\&D + Short term disability + Long term disability + Ancillary (Voluntary life with AD\&D, accident, critical illness, hospital, and pet) + Spending accounts (HSA, FSA, and DCFSA) * Paid time off * Holidays * 401(k) (including company match) * Tuition reimbursement * Leaves (Parental, maternity, and military) * Annual discretionary bonus (for eligible roles) *Trident Systems reserves the right to change or assign other duties to this position.* *Trident Solutions is an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. To request reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, please contact* *recruiting@tridsys.com**.* *Pay Transparency: The contractor will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor’s legal duty to furnish information. 41 CFR 60\-1\.35(c)*

We operate at the intersection of high\-scale engineering and deep financial intelligence. Our team processes millions of transactions in real time, turning complex Open Banking signals into seamless payment experiences. We pride ourselves on a culture of intellectual curiosity, technical excellence, and extreme ownership. **About the role** Trustly guarantees payments in North America. Every approval decision drives revenue for Trustly and for our customers, and every one of them also carries risk and loss. We are looking for a portfolio risk leader to own that balance across our business domains and to turn risk management into a growth driver, in partnership with our commercial and customer service teams. This function owns segment risk management, the customer\-facing risk solutions consulting team, and risk operations and compliance. You will partner closely with Risk Data Science, Risk Product and Risk Engineering, who own the risk models and the engine your decisions will run on, and you will be the senior risk voice with our executive team and our largest customers. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ OWN THE LOSS AND APPROVAL OUTCOME * Own consumer transaction loss, merchant credit exposure and approval rates across customer segments. * Decide where to tighten and where to loosen, grounded in loss attribution, and balance approval rate against loss. * Own change control on the decision set: rules, thresholds, score cutoffs and non\-standard deal terms carry a quantified loss and approval impact before launch. Define guarantee tier eligibility and the economics behind each tier. * Monitor return performance against network rules and internal limits, across unauthorized, administrative and funding\-related return reasons. SET THE RULES AND UNDERWRITING STANDARDS * Own rules and thresholds across segments, including the per\-merchant risk settings in the risk engine. * Set and document merchant underwriting criteria: onboarding, KYB standards, merchant risk tiering, monitoring triggers and offboarding. * Establish the merchant approval authority framework in partnership with Finance and Commercial. * Direct incident response for major risk events, including the escalation path into Legal, Commercial and our banking partners. LEAD RISK DISCUSSIONS WITH CUSTOMERS * Set risk appetite and pre\-authorization requirements early in a deal so they shape the terms. * Present the risk position and the trade\-off on the largest and most complex deals: approval rate and expected loss. * Own the risk inputs into pricing: expected loss by customer, guarantee tier recommendation, and the exposure and collateral terms on non\-standard deals. * Partner with Customer Success to bring the risk view into customer meetings and quarterly business reviews. Provide regular risk reporting and propose remediation where return performance drifts. * Be accountable for customer risk relationships at executive level. LEAD THE FUNCTION AND PARTNER ACROSS TRUSTLY * Build and develop the team across segment risk management, customer\-facing risk solutions consulting, and risk operations and compliance. * Run risk execution end to end: merchant underwriting operations, the alert and manual decision queues to SLA, representment, recovery and collections, and first\-line compliance execution with controls testing. * Set the agenda for the Risk Committee, and present loss performance, emerging risk and the case for any change to senior and executive stakeholders. * Partner with Risk Data Science on how model scores are used in the rules, and with Risk Product and Ris ------------------ * 12\+ years in payments, lending or banking risk, including at least 5 years leading teams across more than one function. * Ownership of a loss budget and an approval rate target at the same time, with a track record of improving approval rate while holding loss within budget. * Direct experience setting rules and thresholds in a real\-time decisioning environment where model scores drive the decision. * Merchant underwriting depth: KYB, beneficial ownership, financial statement review, exposure modeling and industry risk. * Experience overseeing risk operations at scale: decision queues to service levels and first\-line controls. * Presenting and defending a risk position with customer executives and with your own executive team, including risk terms inside a commercial deal. * Experience standing up or rebuilding a risk function, including hiring the team. PREFERRED * Bachelor's degree in economics, statistics, mathematics, engineering, finance or a related field. MBA or a graduate degree in a quantitative discipline is a plus. * ACH or EFT domain expertise. Depth in one or more of gaming, telco, utilities, insurance or financial services. * Collections, recovery and representment run as loss mitigation, with measured recovery rates. * Familiarity with model risk governance and independent validation in financial services. * Experience working with ODFIs or payment processors on risk matters. Applications for this role are accepted on an ongoing basis. **LOCATION \& WORKPLACE** This is a hybrid role based out of our San Francisco or New York hubs. We look for team members to be in the office Tuesday through Thursday. Please note we **SALARY RANGES IN US\-BASED ROLE POSTING** Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Recruiters can share more information with applicants about the specific salary range for preferred locations during the hiring process. Please note that the compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include other perks and benefits. **WHAT WE OFFER** At Trustly, you will have the chance to solve meaningful challenges alongside some of the brightest minds in FinTech. Together, we are shaping the future of payments in an environment that celebrates curiosity, collaboration, and innovation. You will be challenged and empowered to grow, making a real impact every step of the way. Our team is as diverse as the global footprint we serve, with colleagues across Silicon Valley, the U.S., Canada, Brazil, Europe, and beyond. At Trustly, we foster a workplace where everyone feels they belong—a place where teamwork thrives, ideas flourish, and we never forget to have fun along the way. We offer innovative perks and benefits packages that include: * Flexible paid time off \& generous PTO accrual plans * Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and other insurances * FSA \& HSA plans for medical and dependent care * Home office set\-up allowance * Internet stipend * Retirement plan match for 401k and RRSP * Gender\-neutral paid parental leave, and more! We build products that power seamless, affordable, and enjoyable customer experiences by building sophisticated distributed systems and AI\-powered optimizations to scale products for hundreds of millions of global users. **What you'll do** In this role, you will build products powered by scalable distributed systems and advanced AI solutions. Your work will optimize user experiences across multiple verticals, such as grocery and food, while fostering sustainable business growth. Key responsibilities include: * Architecting and launching products to power key consumer experience and business outcomes. * Overseeing full project lifecycles spanning initial scoping, offline evaluation, experimental testing, production deployment, and post\-launch maintenance. * Designing, tuning, and enhancing systems and algorithms to operate at scale. * Partnering with cross\-functional stakeholders across product management, operations, and data science. **Basic Qualifications*** Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics or related field, with 4\+ years of full\-time engineering experience. * Proficiency in at least one programming language such as Python, Go, or Java * Experience in building and productionizing innovative end\-to\-end ML systems. * Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively with cross\-functional partners * Strong sense of ownership to drive projects end\-to\-end **Preferred Qualifications*** Track record of designing and delivering large\-scale consumer products * Demonstrated leadership skills, with experience in mentoring and guiding junior engineers. Proven experience in experimental design and causal inference * For New York City, NY\-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $202,000 per year \- USD $224,000 per year. jobs.title: On-site Agentic AI Engineer
jobs.description: ***About Us*** **United Contractor Services (UCS)** is a national specialty subcontractor and a Top 50 Walls and Ceilings contractor in North America. We self\-perform commercial interior construction across metal framing, drywall, acoustical ceilings, EIFS, stucco, painting, and Division 8 \& 10 Specialties. As we continue to grow across multiple markets, we're looking for an Agentic AI Engineer to help us continue our growth. **This is a full\-time, on\-site position based in our Kennesaw, GA office. It is not a remote or hybrid role. Relocation assistance is not offered for this position; candidates should be able to reliably commute to Kennesaw from day one.** ***About the Role*** ==================== We operate a portfolio of businesses united by a single belief: technology, applied well, is a competitive advantage. We run a modern stack\-Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, Azure (Functions, Table Storage, Entra Domain Services), Procore, and custom integrations built on Make.com and the Microsoft Graph. We are now investing in agentic AI as a first\-class capability across our operating companies, and we are hiring an Agentic AI Engineer to build it. This is a builder role. You will design, ship, and maintain production AI agents that automate real business processes\-document intake, data extraction, system\-to\-system synchronization, internal copilots, decision\-support tools, and workflow orchestration\-across multiple business units. You will work directly with the Director of Technology and have a clear line of sight from problem to deployed solution. We are not looking for a PowerPoint AI strategist. We are looking for someone who writes the code, ships the agent, and owns the outcome. ***What You'll Do*** ==================== * Design and build production agentic AI systems: tool calling, multi\-step reasoning, sub\-agent orchestration, memory, retrieval, and human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints. * Partner with leadership and operators across our business units to identify high\-value automation opportunities and translate them into shipped agents. * Build and maintain integrations across our existing stack\-Microsoft Graph, Entra, SharePoint, Teams, Procore, Azure Functions, Make.com, and third\-party APIs. * Develop rigorous eval pipelines and observability for every agent in production\-cost monitoring, quality tracking, failure\-mode detection, and regression testing. * Implement secure agent identity and authorization patterns: managed identities, service principals, OAuth2 flows, least\-privilege Graph permissions, and audit logging. * Establish and uphold AI governance standards across our entities\-data handling, model selection, prompt management, version control, and rollback procedures. * Document architectures and decisions clearly so the systems you build outlive any single engagement. * Stay current on the agentic AI landscape (Claude, OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio, LangGraph, MCP, etc.) and make pragmatic platform recommendations. ***What You Bring*** ==================== **Required** ------------ * 3–5 years of professional software engineering experience, with at least 1 year shipping production AI/LLM systems (not prototypes, not demos). * Strong proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript. * Hands\-on experience with at least one major agent framework or SDK: Anthropic Claude SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, LangGraph, Vercel AI SDK, Semantic Kernel, or Azure AI Foundry. * Real experience building and interpreting eval harnesses. You can show us how you measure whether an agent is working. * Working knowledge of the Microsoft cloud stack: Azure Functions, Microsoft Graph API, Entra ID app registrations, OAuth2, and managed identities. * Backend and integration engineering chops: REST APIs, webhooks, queues, state management, and authentication patterns. * Strong written communication and the ability to explain trade\-offs to a technical leader making investment decisions. * Comfortable working on\-site in Kennesaw, GA. **Strongly Preferred** ---------------------- * Production experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Automate, or Azure AI Foundry. * Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers or comparable tool\-server architectures. * Familiarity with retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) over enterprise document stores (SharePoint, OneDrive, Confluence, etc.). * Experience working in a multi\-entity or multi\-tenant environment with cross\-cutting identity and data concerns. * DevOps/IaC exposure: Bicep, Terraform, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps pipelines. * Familiarity with construction\-tech (Procore, Bluebeam, etc.) or with verticalized SaaS integrations. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Cybersecurity or compliance background\-particularly around AI governance, data classification, or zero\-trust principles. * Open\-source contributions to agent frameworks or developer tools. * Prior experience as the first or second AI hire at an organization. ***How You'll Be Measured*** ============================ * Time\-to\-production for new agents and automations. * Measurable business impact: hours saved, cycle time reduced, error rates lowered, revenue accelerated. * System reliability: uptime, eval pass rates, cost efficiency, and incident response. * Quality of the engineering foundation: maintainability, documentation, security posture, and knowledge transfer. ***Why This Role*** =================== * Direct reporting relationship to the Director of Technology\-no layers between you and decisions. * A real budget for tooling and platforms. You won't be told to do agentic AI on a free tier. * A modern, well\-managed stack to build on, not a tangle of legacy systems. * Scope across multiple operating companies\-you will see and shape work that touches many parts of the business. * The ability to point at production systems and say 'I built that.' ***Compensation \& Benefits*** ============================== Competitive base salary commensurate with experience, plus a full benefits package including health, dental, vision, retirement, and paid time off. We invest in our people through ongoing learning budgets, conference attendance, and dedicated time for skill development. ***How to Apply*** ================== Send a resume and \-more importantly\- a short note describing one agentic AI system you've shipped to production. We want to know: what did it do, what were the hardest parts, how did you evaluate it, and what would you do differently? Links to public repos, write\-ups, or recorded demos are strongly encouraged. Cover letters are not required; the project description is. *United Contractor Services is an Equal Opportunity Employer.*

jobs.title: Software Development Manager - Modernization
jobs.description: **JAVA MODERNIZATION \& APPLICATION TRANSFORMATION** Lead the teams to build the next\-generation warehouse management platform. **Who We Are:** United States Cold Storage owns and operates one of the most complex temperature\-controlled logistics networks in North America. Every day, our systems coordinate the storage and movement of food on a national scale across a network of state\-of\-the\-art distribution centers, including multiple highly automated warehouse facilities. We continue to advance our core warehouse and logistics platforms. Our current focus is on modular, event\-driven, API\-first, and cloud architecture. We are also strengthening site reliability engineering and responsible AI practices to improve system reliability and engineering productivity. This investment supports continued innovation and operational excellence across our facilities. If you want to build durable systems that operate in the physical world at scale, this is the opportunity. **The Role:** The Software Development Manager \- Modernization will lead multiple engineering teams responsible for modernizing US Cold’s warehouse management platform. This role requires a highly technical software leader with deep experience in Java application development, enterprise architecture, and large\-scale application modernization. Your teams will incrementally transform a large, production Java monolith built with Spring and Hibernate into an API\-first, event\-driven microservices architecture on Microsoft Azure. You will remain actively involved in architecture discussions, technical design reviews, code reviews, and engineering decisions. You will help teams make sound tradeoffs that balance delivery speed, reliability, security, and long\-term maintainability. You will partner closely with Architecture, Platform, Site Reliability Engineering, Quality Assurance, Product, and business stakeholders. You will also own team performance, execution, hiring, vendor accountability, and delivery outcomes while serving as a credible technical voice with senior leadership. This role blends technical architecture with traditional people management. The successful candidate must be able to challenge designs, guide implementation, assess code quality, and lead engineers through complex modernization work. **What You Will Own:** * Manage two engineering teams of approximately 3–6 engineers each, including a new internal team and an established European\-based consulting team. * Build and staff for the new internal team, define the technical hiring bar, and own the full hiring process. * Lead and own delivery performance for both teams. * Provide coaching, performance feedback, and career development for the internal team. * Establish measurable objectives and key results at the team and individual level. * Own roadmap execution, delivery outcomes, technical quality, and production readiness. * Champion standards for architecture, observability, reliability, and operability. * Communicate technical decisions, tradeoffs, risks, and resource needs clearly to leadership. * Drive alignment across Architecture, Platform, Quality Assurance, and Product. * Create an environment of accountability, clarity, and continuous improvement. **Technical Environment:** * Legacy enterprise Java monolith using Spring and Hibernate, backed by Oracle, actively being decomposed into microservices. * Java and Spring Boot services deployed to Microsoft Azure. * Cloud\-native, API\-first, event\-driven architecture and distributed systems. * Relational and fit\-for\-purpose non\-relational data stores. * Multi\-region high availability for operationally critical systems. * Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and Ansible. * Jenkins and GitHub Actions for continuous integration and delivery. * Observability using Dynatrace and Azure Monitor. **What We’re Looking For:** * 10\+ years of software development experience with 5\+ years of leadership experience. * Demonstrable experience in modernization of monoliths to microservices. * Expertise in the Java ecosystem: Spring, Hibernate, etc. * Strong understanding of system design principles including 12\-factor app methodology, observability, and performance optimization. * Experience with Azure or a similar cloud platform. * Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field. Master’s degree preferred. **Why This Role Is Different:** You will: * Inherit an established team while building a new internal engineering team. * Play a lead role in a highly visible project to modernize the warehouse management platform that drives US Cold. * Combine people leadership, delivery ownership, vendor management, and meaningful technical involvement. * Build systems whose performance affects real\-world warehouse and logistics operations on a national scale. **Compensation \& Structure:** * Salary Range: $160,000\.00 \- $190,000\.00/yr. * Bonus Eligible * Location: Hybrid, Camden, NJ * Travel: Less than 10% * Reports to: Associate Director, Software Development **Operational Context:** This role is primarily technical and office\-based, with occasional interaction in operational environments depending on system needs. **Benefits Include:** If annual hours are attained, these benefits may apply. Medical, Dental, Vision, Prescription, Legal Insurance, Pet Discount, Critical Illness, Accident Insurance, Hospital Indemnity, Long Term Care \+ Permanent Life Insurance, Identity Theft Protection, Short Term Disability Insurance, Long Term Disability Insurance, Supplemental Disability Insurance, Basic Life Insurance, Accidental Death and Dismemberment Insurance, Supplemental Life Insurance, Supplemental Spouse Life Insurance, Child Life Insurance, Loan Solution, Health Flexible Spending Account, Dependent Flexible Spending Account, Telemedicine, Virtual Primary Care, Prescription Savings Plan, Prescription Specialty Copay Assistance Program, Weight Management Program, Chronic Condition Management, Care Navigator Program, 24/7 Nurse Line, Expert Medical Opinion, Precious Additions Maternity Program, Health Advocacy, Employee Assistance Program, Digital Cognitive Behavioral Therapy, Digital Physical Therapy, Behavioral and Mental Health Platforms, Auto and home discount program, Secure Travel Protection, Discount Programs, 401(k) plan, Education Assistance, Paid Time Off, Referral program \& Commuter Benefit (NJ ONLY). **Physical \& Operational Context:** May require physical effort associated with using the computer to access information, or occasional standing, walking, lifting needed to carry out everyday activities. Effective communication, vision, and hearing are essential for safety and productivity. Operate scanners, tablets, radios, phones, computers, and other essential equipment as required. Additional work hours may be requested by management to help manage employee production, projects, and/or special events. Engage in frequent personal interaction and communication. Attend in\-person meetings and/or training on a regular basis. Possess strong arithmetic and reading skills. Follow verbal instructions, written instructions, and company policies. Work independently and coordinate with others. Fast\-paced environment, managing stress and meeting productivity standards. **Additional Information:** Job functions may vary based on the area of operation. This description outlines the most common tasks required for the job. Reasonable accommodation may be provided to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential duties. This job description may not encompass all tasks necessary to complete the role. \#INDIT Equal Opportunity Employer This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: **The opportunity** ------------------- At Unity, we’re shaping the future of real\-time 3D development by enabling creators to harness intelligent, autonomous systems. Our next\-generation agentic AI \- goal\-directed, adaptive, and capable of reasoning and planning in dynamic environments \- is transforming how games and simulations come to life. We’re looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to lead the development of these foundational AI systems within the Unity engine, empowering creators to build smarter, more responsive in\-game agents and simulations. Your work will directly drive innovation, allowing developers and designers to integrate sophisticated AI behavior seamlessly into their worlds. This role is perfect for someone passionate about pushing the boundaries of AI, multi\-agent systems, reinforcement learning, and intelligent decision\-making in complex, real\-time environments. **What you'll be doing** ------------------------ * Design, implement, and scale AI agent systems in Unity environments that enable goal\-directed behavior, task planning and execution, and environment\-aware decision\-making. * Develop reusable agentic frameworks \- such as planning modules, memory systems or policy adaptation layers \- that creators can extend in their own projects. * Develop AI models for the Unity AI agentic system. The AI models perform various tasks for building Unity games. * Integrate Machine Learning models seamlessly within real\-time game engine constraints, optimizing for latency, compute, and determinism. * Lead high\-impact initiatives, including hierarchical reinforcement learning for scalable behaviors, AI planning and goal inference frameworks for NPCs and simulations, and agent memory and world modeling systems for persistent, believable behavior. * Collaborate across internal and external teams to unlock innovative use cases in gaming, simulation, and interactive storytelling. * Contribute to the long\-term vision and roadmap for Unity’s agentic AI offerings, ensuring modularity, usability, and performance across platforms. * Establish and champion best practices for model quality, simulation\-based evaluation, and ML/AI safety within real\-time systems. * Mentor engineers and researchers while cultivating a technical culture of innovation, excellence, and collaboration. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * Advanced degree (MS or Ph.D.) in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Robotics, or a related field—or equivalent practical experience. * 5\+ years of hands\-on experience developing ML systems in production, ideally within real\-time or interactive environments. * Strong background in one or more of the following: reinforcement learning, fine\-tuning, decision\-making under uncertainty, AI planning, or multi\-agent systems. Additionnal Information : Base Salary Range: We determine the base salary range for this role based on your primary work location: Zone A: $188,200 \- $244,600 Zone B: $167,200 \- $217,300 Zone C: $148,700 \- $193,300 *This range reflects the anticipated base salary for this position. Beyond base salary, this role may be eligible for equity awards and participation in our company incentive plans (such as annual discretionary bonuses or sales commissions). The final offer amount will depend on several factors, including geographic location and the candidate’s relevant experience, professional background, and skill set.* **Benefits** At Unity, we want our team members to thrive. We offer a wide range of benefits designed to support well\-being and work\-life balance. Please note: Benefits eligibility, specific offerings, and coverage vary based on the country and employment status. While specific benefits vary, here are some of the ways we strive to take care of our eligible team members globally: Comprehensive health, life, and disability insurance \| Commute subsidy \| Employee stock ownership \| Competitive retirement/pension plans \| Generous vacation and personal days \| Support for new parents through leave and family\-care programs \| Office food snacks \| Mental Health and Wellbeing programs and support \| Employee Resource Groups \| Global Employee Assistance Program \| Training and development programs \| Volunteering and donation matching program **Life at Unity** Unity \[NYSE: U] is the world’s leading game engine, powering play for more than 3 billion consumers each month. The top mobile games in the world, the most played PC indie titles, the most innovative console games, and virtually all of the top XR and Web Games are developed, deployed, and grown in Unity. Unity also enables teams across industries like automotive, manufacturing, and healthcare to design, simulate, and collaborate in 3D — closing the gap between ideas and reality. For more information, please visit www.unity.com. *Unity is a proud equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment and celebrate our employees across age, race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or any other protected status in accordance with applicable law. jobs.title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: **The opportunity** We are building the next generation of AI\-driven game experiences — generative world models, neural rendering, and multi\-modal understanding that turn images, text, and 3D primitives into interactive worlds. As our Staff Machine Learning Engineer, you will be a core technical leader bringing state\-of\-the\-art computer vision and multi\-modal models — transformers, diffusion networks, vision\-language models (VLMs), and JEPA\-style architectures — from research into robust, production\-grade systems. This is a deeply hands\-on, high\-impact role. You will help define the modeling and\\ deployment strategy, drive architectural decisions across the ML stack, and mentor a team\\ of senior and mid\-level engineers. jobs.title: Senior Campus Wireless Engineer
jobs.description: Location Charlottesville, Virginia, United States of America Category Information Management, Services \& Technology The Rector \& Visitors of the University of Virginia Job Id R0087487 Job Type Full time JOB DESCRIPTION **Senior Campus Wireless Engineer** =================================== **Department Overview** ----------------------- University of Virginia Information Technology Services (ITS) supports UVA’s academic, research, clinical, and administrative missions by providing secure, reliable, and innovative technology services. The Enterprise Infrastructure division designs, operates, and continuously improves the enterprise platforms used across the University. ITS values results, teamwork, innovation, excellent customer service, and fosters a supportive environment where employees are encouraged to share ideas and bring their authentic selves to work. Benefits for eligible employees include multiple health plan options; dental, vision, and life insurance; flexible spending accounts; 22 days of paid time off annually plus 12 or more paid holidays; eight weeks of paid parental leave; short\-term disability coverage; and tuition and professional\-development support. **Position Summary** -------------------- The University of Virginia is seeking a **Senior Campus Wireless Engineer** to design, deploy, optimize, and maintain high\-performance wireless networks across UVA’s large, multi\-building campus environment. This position plays a critical role in providing reliable, secure, and scalable wireless connectivity for academic, administrative, research, residential, and guest users. The Senior Campus Wireless Engineer will lead wireless design and optimization efforts, troubleshoot complex network issues, and collaborate with network operations, information security, facilities, vendors, and other University partners to deliver a high\-quality wireless experience. The successful candidate will join UVA Information Technology Services and contribute to the continued evolution of the University’s enterprise network infrastructure. This role offers the opportunity to work on wireless technology at significant scale while supporting a diverse range of environments, including classrooms, offices, research facilities, residence halls, event spaces, and other University facilities. The successful candidate will bring strong wireless networking expertise, a solid understanding of radio frequency (RF) principles, and experience supporting complex enterprise or campus environments. **Responsibilities** -------------------- ### **Wireless Network Design and Deployment** * Design and implement campus\-wide wireless networks, including RF planning, coverage design, and capacity analysis. * Conduct predictive and on\-site wireless site surveys to validate network performance and determine optimal wireless access point placement. * Deploy, configure, and support wireless access points, controllers, cloud\-managed platforms, and related network infrastructure. * Develop wireless solutions that support high\-density, academic, research, residential, administrative, and guest environments. ### **Operations and Optimization** * Monitor wireless network health and performance and proactively identify opportunities to improve connectivity, reliability, and capacity. * Diagnose and resolve wireless issues including RF interference, roaming challenges, coverage gaps, and performance degradation. * Perform RF optimization, channel planning, and transmit power adjustments to improve network performance and the end\-user experience. * Maintain accurate wireless network documentation, topology diagrams, configuration information, and asset inventories. ### **Troubleshooting and Technical Support** * Provide Tier II and Tier III support for complex wireless network incidents and service issues. * Partner with service desk and field support teams to troubleshoot and resolve wireless connectivity concerns. * Diagnose issues related to authentication, DHCP, DNS, roaming, RF interference, network access, and wireless client connectivity. * Collaborate with information security teams to ensure wireless environments align with University security standards and industry best practices. ### **Infrastructure Management** * Administer wireless controllers, cloud\-based wireless management platforms, and network monitoring and management tools. * Manage wireless infrastructure firmware and software lifecycles and coordinate system upgrades and maintenance. * Monitor infrastructure capacity, reliability, and lifecycle needs and make recommendations for improvements and future investments. * Coordinate with technology vendors on technical support cases, hardware replacements, upgrades, and new product capabilities. ### **Collaboration and Project Support** * Participate in campus construction, renovation, expansion, and technology projects requiring wireless connectivity. * Collaborate with facilities teams, architects, contractors, enginee network security fundamentals. * Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex wireless and network connectivity issues. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and organizational skills. * Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across technical and non\-technical teams. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Professional wireless certifications such as CWNA, CWDP, CWSP, or relevant vendor\-specific certifications. * Cisco, Aruba, Juniper/Mist, or other enterprise networking certifications. * Experience supporting high\-density wireless environments such as auditoriums, stadiums, residence halls, classrooms, or large event spaces. * Experience supporting wireless connectivity for Internet of Things (IoT) devices and other specialized endpoints. * Familiarity with network automation and scripting technologies such as Python or Ansible. * Experience administering cloud\-managed networking platforms. * Experience working in a higher education, research, healthcare, or similarly complex distributed environment. * Experience contributing to large infrastructure, construction, or renovation projects. **Physical Demands** -------------------- This is primarily a sedentary position involving extensive use of computers and network management tools. The position may occasionally require walking throughout University facilities, accessing network equipment locations, or participating in on\-site wireless assessments and site surveys. **Position Type \& Work Location** ---------------------------------- This is a full\-time position with the University of Virginia. The position requires regular work on Grounds in Charlottesville, Virginia, due to the hands\-on nature of wireless network design, troubleshooting, deployment, and site survey responsibilities. Specific work arrangements will be discussed during the recruitment process. **About UVA** ------------- The University of Virginia is an iconic public institution of higher education, boasting nationally ranked schools and programs, distinguished faculty, a major academic medical center, and a proud history as a renowned research university. UVA is located in beautiful Charlottesville, Virginia, a setting that combines the amenities and cultural attractions of a vibrant college town with the natural beauty of the surrounding Blue Ridge Mountains. **Application Timeline** ------------------------ Review of applications will continue until the position is filled. **Additional Requirements** --------------------------- The selected candidate will be required to complete a background check prior to their first day of employment. This position may require occasional work outside of standard business hours to support network maintenance, upgrades, troubleshooting, or critical University operations. **How to Apply** ---------------- Please apply online, by searching for requisition number R0087487 . Complete an application with the following documents: * **Resume** * **Cover Letter** Upload all materials into the resume submission field. You can submit multiple documents into this one field or combine them into one PDF. Applications without all required documents will not receive full consideration. **Internal applicants:** Search and apply for jobs on the UVA Internal Careers website. **Reference Check Process** --------------------------- References will be completed through UVA’s reference\-checking process. Candidates asked to participate in a reference check will be requested to provide five references, with at least three completed references required. **Contact** ----------- For questions about the application process, please contact University Human Resources through AskHR. *The University of Virginia is an equal opportunity employer. All interested persons are encouraged to apply, including veterans and individuals with disabilities. Learn more about* *UVA’s commitment to non\-discrimination and equal opportunity employment**.*

jobs.description: Streaming TV is no longer just a brand awareness channel. It’s becoming a core part of the performance marketing mix, alongside search and social. Vibe.co is building the platform that makes TV work like the rest of the acquisition stack: targeted, measurable, and optimized for results. Vibe.co is an **Audience First Streaming TV Advertising platform** that gives marketers the tools to reach the right audiences, optimize campaigns in real time, and understand what’s actually driving business outcomes. With hyper\-targeted segmentation, AI\-powered recommendations, real\-time optimization, and incrementality measurement, Vibe brings the precision and accountability of digital advertising to the biggest screen in the house. Today, more than 12,000 brands use Vibe.co to reach 120 million\+ households. And in August 2026, Vibe.co became a Walmart company, opening up a new chapter for the business and the industry. With Walmart’s first\-party data and purchase signals now part of the Vibe platform, advertisers can connect TV advertising to real\-world transactions and measure the impact of CTV with a level of precision previously associated with platforms like Google and Meta. **This is a unique moment to join Vibe.** With Walmart’s scale, data, and reach behind us, we’re building the next generation of TV advertising and creating a more measurable, performance\-driven future for the channel. **About the Role** ------------------ You'll join the Integrations team, the connective tissue of Vibe's platform, reporting to the Engineering Manager. The team owns everything flowing in and out of Vibe: measurement and attribution integrations, audience connections from CRMs and CDPs, and reporting pipelines. This role exists because we're building a first\-class Developer Platform: opening Vibe's full capabilities as a public API so external partners can build on top of us. Criteo is the first partner live on it. Three reasons to want this: * You'll be one of the most senior engineers on Integrations, setting technical direction for a team that's still small enough for one person's decisions to shape it * You'll own the foundational architecture for a platform external partners are already building against * AI\-augmented development is the expectation here, not the experiment **What You'll Do** ------------------ **Build and ship integrations** * Design and implement production\-grade integrations with external platforms: CRMs, CDPs, measurement vendors, data partners * Own integration projects end to end, from scoping through production, with full accountability for outcomes * Work directly with external partners to define, validate, and evolve data contracts **Developer Platform** * Drive the architecture of Vibe's public API: account, advertiser, and campaign management endpoints built to scale * Build the documentation, monitoring, and tooling that makes the developer experience genuinely good * Contribute to the MCP gateway and authentication layers that expose Vibe's capabilities externally **Reliability and scale** * Find the weak points in existing pipelines and lead the rebuild * Set the standard for code quality on the team: your reviews move the bar, not just the diff * Use AI tooling to accelerate your own output and raise the team's **Technical leadership** * Set engineering norms and technical direction as the Integrations team grows * Weigh in on architecture decisions across the team, not just your own projects * Partner with the Engineering Manager on technical direction and hiring calibration **What You Need** ----------------- * 8\+ years building production backend systems: APIs, data pipelines, distributed services at scale * Strong TypeScript backend experience * Direct ownership of a major project, start to finish, not just a contributor role on someone else's * AWS and Terraform experience, with real architectural decision\-making, not just implementation * A high\-ownership background: startup, scale\-up, or anywhere you couldn't hand the hard problems to someone else **Nice to Haves** ----------------- * Third\-party integrations experience: ETL, webhooks, REST/GraphQL APIs * Python/C\+\+/Rust, alongside your TS work * Experience designing or contributing to developer\-facing platforms or public APIs * Startup experience (\~300 people or fewer), current or past. Doesn't need to be your most recent role **Our Values** -------------- At Vibe, we run on three values: Impact, Ambition, and Urgency. We tie every goal to a real business outcome, think 10x rather than settling for good enough, and move daily rather than waiting for perfect conditions. You'll thrive here if you own outcomes without needing direction, default to action, and hold yourself to results, not effort. This is a high\-performance environment with high\-performance rewards: you'll work alongside people who push you, with real ownership over hard problems in a market that's moving fast. If that sounds like the best version of your career, we want to meet you. **What We Offer** ----------------- *For candidates in New York, NY, the pay range for this role is $195,000–$265,000\.* At Vibe, we want you to build something, own something, and grow fast. We measure results, not hours. * **Parental leave.** Paid leave for all parents. * **Annual offsite.** The whole team, once a year, somewhere worth the trip. **Our Interview Process** ------------------------- We respect your time. Here's exactly what to expect: no surprises, no ghosting. * **Recruiter screen.** 30 min. We'll share context; you'll share yours. * **Manager Interview.** 45 min with your future manager. Your experience, your projects, your approach. * **Product Interview.** 30 mins with the Product Manager for this team. We want to hear about how you've worked cross\-functionally in previous roles. * **Technical assessment.** 90 min. Code review exercise plus applied questions, including how you use AI in your workflow. Real problems, not tricks. * **Bar raiser.** 30 min with a senior leader to ensure we're holding a consistent, high bar. * **Offer.** Fast. We don't let good decisions sit. **Equal Opportunity** --------------------- Vibe is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Research Engineer, Institute for Software Integrated Systems
jobs.description: The Research Engineer is part of the Institute for Software Integrated Systems at Vanderbilt University and is a key individual contributor responsible for assisting with the development, integration, and maintenance of discipline\-specific software systems, web\-based applications, and engineering tools to support project and research goals. This position involves engineering and software design, web application development, cloud integration, maintenance, and experimentation as directed by the Principal Investigator. Reporting directly to the Principal Investigator, the Research Engineer regularly collaborates with a multidisciplinary team including Research Engineers, Research Scientists, Graduate Students, and stakeholders to accomplish project\-specific goals. **About the Work Unit:** The Institute for Software Integrated Systems conducts basic and applied research in the area of systems and information science and engineering. Applications of its technology span a wide range of software intensive systems from small embedded devices, through real\-time distributed systems, to globally deployed complex systems. Software is increasingly essential to the functions of these systems, and it is also the primary means of adapting them to their environments and users. Our research interests lie in the theoretical foundations, modeling, design, engineering, and educational aspects of these systems. **Key Functions and Expected Performance:** Development: 40% * Assist with modeling and analysis of discipline\-specific engineering problems. * Design, develop, and maintain web\-based applications, APIs, and interfaces supporting research and project goals. * Assist with cloud development, deployment, and integration of AI\-driven and data intensive applications. * Contribute to the development and maintenance of discipline\-specific software systems and engineering tools. * Perform engineering and software design, implementation, testing, analysis, maintenance, or experimentation as directed. Project Management: 30% * Prepare high\-quality technical documentation for project deliverables, including software, web systems, and APIs. * Maintain expertise in emerging technologies and modern web frameworks relevant to project goals. * Collaborate effectively with team members using version control systems and collaborative development platforms (e.g., GitHub). * Recommend, implement, and adhere to technical standards and best practices, including secure coding and responsive web design principles. Collaboration and Communication: 30% * Provide technical input for evaluating project direction and progress. * Create and deliver progress reports and presentations to project staff and stakeholders. * Share research findings, development processes, and technical knowledge with the Principal Investigator and research team. **Supervisory Relationships:** This position does not have supervisory responsibility; this position reports administratively and functionally to the Principal Investigator. **Education and Certifications:** A Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related engineering discipline is necessary. **Experience and Skills:** The following skills are necessary: * Practical knowledge of programming languages such as Python, Julia, MATLAB, or similar languages. * Experience with cloud computing platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP). * Experience with Docker. * Proficiency in software system development, modeling, and systems engineering. * Ability to design, implement, test, document, and maintain both backend and frontend software (React, FastAPI, Flask, Node.js). * Familiarity with deploying and interacting with databases (MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis). * Experience with modern software development environments (e.g., VS Code), version control (Git), and CI/CD pipelines. * Ability to adapt quickly in high\-paced research environments with evolving goals. * Experience working in teams of varying sizes (small to large research or development projects). The following skills are preferred: * Experience with research activities aligned with the Institute’s focus areas. * Experience with AI (machine learning and planning) technologies. * Experience with optimization theory and methods * Knowledge of model\-based engineering principles and software architecture design. * Strong communication skills for working with researchers, graduate students, and stakeholders. * Ability to produce high\-quality technical documentation for web\-based and software deliverables.

jobs.title: Field Service Technician
jobs.description: **Field Service Technician \| Allentown, PA \| Hatchery and Fresh Produce Packaging Automation** Are you an experienced Service Technician who values independence and flexibility? At **Viscon Group** we believe in technology that truly makes a difference. Within Hatchery Automation, we are one of the global market leaders in intelligent automation solutions for hatcheries. In Pennsylvania, we are looking for technicians to support some of our key clients over the long term with the commissioning and operational support of our systems. You will be based at home and travel directly to customer sites. We will provide everything you need: high\-quality tools, training, remote support. If required: flights, hotel accommodation, and a daily allowance. Based in PA, but travel across the US / Canada will be required. Travel will typically be 2\-3 weeks per month of your time. **Position Summary** As a technical specialist, you will remain closely involved with the customer throughout the lifecycle of the system, from commissioning to end\-of\-life. Based on scheduled visits, you will regularly monitor performance and carry out preventive maintenance. This enables you to build strong relationships and act as our ambassador on site. Our advanced technologies improve both operational efficiency and animal welfare. For instance, we can detect whether an egg is viable, determine its gender, and even vaccinate the chick while it’s still inside the egg. Your focus will be on mechanical and basic electrical work. Knowledge of PLCs is an advantage; our experienced Remote Support Engineers based in Poland, the Netherlands, or through our partners provide additional support. Responsibilities · Perform and assist in system installations and commissioning. · Conduct preventive maintenance and inspections at customer sites. · Serve as the primary point of contact for technical issues and maintenance. · Document service tasks, incidents, and suggestions for improvement. · Transfer knowledge and instructions to operators and customer maintenance staff. · Contribute actively to customer satisfaction through clear communication and a service\-oriented approach. What Your Future Colleague Says "Viscon is a company that dares to stumble. Every month I see new innovations, which makes the work exciting and never boring. We’re not afraid to experiment. I feel involved, and it’s great that my opinion is valued.” Jeffrey, Commissioning Engineer **Benefits** At Viscon, you’ll be part of an innovative and growing organization that makes a global impact with smart technological solutions. We take good care of our employees and offer: · Competitive all\-in salary. · Daily expense allowance. · Car allowance or alternative. · Travel reimbursement. Company Credit Card · For assignments far from home: flights and hotel accommodation. In addition, we offer · A varied and responsible role within a financially stable, internationally expanding company. · Room for personal development. · Opportunities for international travel and career growth if that’s your ambition. **Requirements** · Completed technical education. For instance: Associate degree in Mechatronics, Industrial Technology, Electrical Technology, or Mechanical Engineering. Technical Trade School Certificate in Industrial Electrical/Controls Technology. Electrical Journeyman Licence. Military Experience in Industrial Electrical Maintenance / Automation. * 1–5 years of related experience in machine startup, repair, and maintenance, ideally with industrial automation, poultry hatchery, or food processing equipment. · Experience with commissioning and/or service in industrial environments. · A self\-reliant, responsible mindset with strong problem\-solving skills. · Excellent communication and organizational abilities. · Fluent English speaker. Some Spanish would be a bonus. · Flexible availability, including willingness to work varying shifts and be on call. **Why Choose Viscon?** Work in a dynamic and international environment where no two days are the same. Our culture is open, energetic, and team\-focused. Your contribution helps us improve the global food chain, while giving you the space to grow and develop. At Viscon Group, we are passionate not only about technological innovation in agro\- and food processes, but also about the positive impact these innovations have on our world and our health. Through our advanced machines, software, and integrated solutions, we enable more sustainable and efficient production and distribution of fresh food, flowers, and plants. Our solutions help reduce food waste, improve food quality, and optimize production processes. With cutting\-edge technology, we aim to make agriculture more scalable, profitable, and environmentally friendly, while contributing to human health and well\-being. Ready to help us transform the world of hatchery automation? Apply now and help us build the future. Pay: $70,000\.00 \- $80,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Cell phone reimbursement * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Life insurance * On\-the\-job training * Opportunities for advancement * Paid time off * Vision insurance Experience: * Field service: 3 years (Required) License/Certification: * Mechanical / Electrical Qualification? (Required) Location: * Athens, GA (Preferred) Willingness to travel: * 75% (Preferred) Work Location: On the road

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Summary** =========== Vital Services is seeking a talented and experienced Mid\-Level Software Engineer to join our growing Application Engineering department. This is an extraordinary opportunity to be a part of, and play an integral role in, the expansion of our Information Technology team. The core focus of this role is to write clean, secure, and highly efficient code that successfully implements functional requirements, ensuring rapid features delivery and high system reliability across active product and T\&M client queues. **Roles \& Responsibilities of the Software Engineer** ====================================================== * **Feature Implementation \& Delivery:** Writing well\-structured, testable, and maintainable application code that fulfills documented user stories and technical design specs. * **Defect Resolution \& Support Execution:** Investigating, triaging, and patching software bugs and performance issues efficiently across SaaS platforms and custom client applications. * **API \& Data Flow Execution:** Building and consuming secure web services, endpoints, and third\-party API extractions based on the patterns outlined by the Architect. * **Code Quality \& Testing Discipline:** Participating actively in peer code reviews, adhering to organizational standards, and writing comprehensive unit and integration tests. * **Sprint Hygiene \& Operational Visibility:** Estimating assigned tasks accurately, updating Jira tickets daily, and actively raising dependencies during sprint ceremonies to protect velocity. **Skills \& Experience of the Software Engineer** ================================================= * **Professional Core Experience:** 3\-6 years of verified full\-stack or backend software engineering experience operating within an agile team ecosystem (experience in multi\-client agency or SaaS environments is a plus). * **Technical Stack Proficiency:** Solid proficiency in C\# languages and core object\-oriented programming methodologies in a Microsoft tech stack environment. * **Database Conversance:** Clear comfort writing optimized queries and interacting with relational or non\-relational database engines (e.g., SQL/MySQL). * **Version Control Mastery:** Complete fluency with Git workflow mechanics, branching strategies, and handling merge conflicts cleanly. * **Implementation Mindset:** A strong track record of taking well\-defined, abstract functional requirements and successfully transforming them into live, working software capabilities without needing extensive architectural oversight. **Success Metrics of the Software Engineer** ============================================ * **Individual Sprint Say/Do Ratio:** \>\= 80% predictability on completing committed sprint tasks and feature points. * **Code Review Turnaround Time:** Review and provide actionable feedback on peer pull requests within an average of \< 24 hours to prevent pipeline blockages. * **Post\-Deployment Defect Leaks:** Maintain a threshold of \< 2 critical execution defects or breaking bugs introduced to production environments per quarter. * **Jira \& Time\-Tracking Accuracy:** 100% weekly compliance on task logging, feature estimations, and accurate time log entries. **Compensation \& Culture** =========================== * Salary Range: $95,000 – $115,000 (Mid\-Level) \- *Final offer will be commensurate with experience and technical assessment results.* * Hybrid Flexibility: We value our culture in our offices in Allen, TX and Oak Ridge, TN, but offer a flexible hybrid or remote schedule based on team project needs rather than a rigid clock\-in / in\-office requirement. * Growth Path: This position was created by a team member's promotion. We actively invest in our engineers' career trajectories into senior engineering or architecture roles.
