jobs.title: Manager, Cloud Automation Engineering
jobs.description: ***Together we fight for everyone’s opportunity for a better financial future.*** We will do this together — with customers, partners and colleagues. We will fight for others, not against: We will stand up for and champion everyone’s access to opportunities. The status quo is not good enough … we believe every individual and every community deserves access to financial opportunities. We are determined to support both individuals and communities in reaching a better financial future. We know that reaching this future depends on our actions today. Like our Purpose Statement, Voya believes in being bold and committed to action. We are committed to a work environment where the differences that we are born with — and those we acquire throughout our lives — are understood, valued and intentionally pursued. We believe that our employees own our culture and have a responsibility to foster an environment where we all feel comfortable bringing our whole selves to work. Purposefully bringing our differences together to positively influence our culture, serve our clients and enrich our communities is essential to our vision. **Are you ready to join a company with a strong purpose and a winning culture? Start your Voyage –****Apply Now** **Manager, Cloud Automation Engineering** **Role Overview** Voya's Infrastructure Engineering organization is modernizing how cloud infrastructure gets built, changed, and governed across Azure, AWS, and OCI. Terraform and Ansible/AAP automation already run production workloads today — VM lifecycle and disaster\-recovery failover, capacity management, and GitOps\-driven application delivery — but much of that automation grew organically, without the version control, peer review, and audit trail that a regulated financial services environment requires. This role owns closing that gap: replacing ungoverned, direct\-to\-production automation patterns with a secure, auditable, and genuinely usable cloud automation platform. **Get to Know the Opportunity** As Manager, Cloud Automation Engineering, you are a builder\-operator hybrid: hands\-on architect and contributor to the pipelines and platforms your team runs, and the people leader accountable for their delivery and growth. You will personally design and help build the CI/CD architecture for Terraform, Ansible/AAP, and GitOps (ArgoCD) — version\-pinned artifact promotion, policy\-as\-code gates, and DTAP segregation — while also running forensic audits of the current estate to quantify risk and build the evidence base for remediation. You'll partner directly with security, compliance, and audit stakeholders to map every pipeline gate to a named control (SDLC\-2, CP\-054, CP\-064, ITAM\-3, SOC\-12, Source Code Protection Standard), and you'll lead and grow a team of cloud/platform engineers who share that same builder mindset. **The Contributions You'll Make** **Cloud Automation Architecture \& Engineering** * Architect and personally build the Terraform (anchored on the shared\-module repo) and Ansible/AAP pipelines spanning Azure, AWS, and OCI, replacing live branch\-sync and direct\-apply patterns with version\-pinned, gated promotion. * Design and implement GitOps delivery via ArgoCD/OpenShift GitOps, moving self\-syncing application patterns onto a discrete build\-and\-gate stage. * Define reference architectures, module/role standards, and reusable shared\-module conventions — CI, CODEOWNERS, branch protection, semantic version tagging — enforced across every consumer repository. **SDLC Pipeline \& Compliance Engineering** * Own end\-to\-end remediation of the Terraform uplift and Ansible greenfield rebuild: committer\-limit enforcement, branch protection and peer review, version\-pinned promotion across Dev/Test/Acceptance/Prod, and independent release\-owner approval gates ahead of production. * Build and mature the security tooling stack: static analysis and policy\-as\-code for Terraform (linting, cloud\-config scanning, OPA) and for Ansible (lint, Molecule, container/CVE scanning), plus software composition analysis and secret scanning across the estate. * Stand up SIEM and audit\-trail coverage for Git activity, plan/apply and job\-execution events, and secrets access; own the formal exception process where tooling choices deviate from the enterprise standard. * Close artifact\-provenance gaps: SBOM generation and signed\-artifact publishing for every build that reaches production. **Governance, Audit \& Risk Reduction** * Run forensic, evidence\-based audits of live IaC estates — repository inventory, collaborator and committer counts, CI coverage, secrets hygiene, tag and version currency — to quantify governance gaps and build the business case for remediation or rebuild. * Identify and close shadow\-repo and personal\-namespace automation risk; consolidate automation onto sanctioned, org\-owned repositories. * Partner with Change Management, Release Management, and the Change Advisory Board to map pipeline gates to formal  ing as both an individual contributor writing production code and pipelines, and a people leader accountable for team output. **Nice to Have** * Experience with modern SIEM/observability stacks beyond traditional log\-management tools. * Familiarity with Red Hat OpenShift GitOps or equivalent enterprise Kubernetes platforms. * Experience standing up a greenfield automation platform from scratch, not only uplifting an existing one. * Background contributing to, or leading formal IT control audits or SOX\-adjacent evidence packages. **Compensation Pay Disclosure:** Voya is committed to pay that’s fair and equitable, which means comparable pay for comparable roles and responsibilities. The below annual base salary range reflects the expected hiring range(s) for this position in the location(s) listed. In addition to base salary, Voya offers incentive opportunities (i.e., annual cash incentives, sales incentives, and/or long\-term incentives) based on the role to reward the achievement of annual performance objectives. Please note that this salary information is solely for candidates hired to perform work within one of these locations, and refers to the amount Voya Financial is willing to pay at the time of this posting. Actual compensation offered may vary from the posted salary range based upon the candidate’s geographic location, work experience, education, licensure requirements and/or skill level and will be finalized at the time of offer. Salaries for part\-time roles will be prorated based upon the agreed upon number of hours to be regularly worked. $114,480 \- $170,070 USD**Be Well. Stay Well.** Voya provides the resources that can make a difference in your lives. To us, this means thriving physically, financially, socially and emotionally. Voya benefits are designed to help you do just that. That’s why we offer an array of plans, programs, tools and resources with one goal in mind: To help you and your family be well and stay well. **What We Offer** * Health, dental, vision and life insurance plans * 401(k) Savings plan – with generous company matching contributions (up to 6%) * Voya Retirement Plan – employer paid cash balance retirement plan (4%) * Tuition reimbursement up to $5,250/year * Paid time off – including 20 days paid time off, nine paid company holidays and a flexible Diversity Celebration Day. * Paid volunteer time — 40 hours per calendar year **Critical Skills** At Voya, we have identified the following critical skills which are key to success in our culture: * **Customer Focused**: Passionate drive to delight our customers and offer unique solutions that deliver on their expectations. * **Critical Thinking**: Thoughtful process of analyzing data and problem solving data to reach a well\-reasoned solution. * **Team Mentality**: Partnering effectively to drive our culture and execute on our common goals. * **Business Acumen**: Appreciation and understanding of the financial services industry in order to make sound business decisions. * **Learning Agility**: Openness to new ways of thinking and acquiring new skills to retain a competitive advantage. **Equal Employment Opportunity** *Voya Financial is an equal\-opportunity employer. Voya Financial provides equal opportunity to qualified individuals regardless of race, color, sex, national origin, citizenship status, religion, age, disability, veteran status, creed, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, or any other status protected by state or local law.* **Reasonable Accommodations** *Voya is committed to the inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, Voya will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment,* *please* *reference* *resources for applicants with disabilities**.*

jobs.title: Senior Engineer, Applications Engineering (APC)
jobs.description: **Company Description** At WD, our vision is to power global innovation and push the boundaries of technology to make what you thought was once impossible, possible. At our core, WD is a company of problem solvers. People achieve extraordinary things given the right technology. For decades, we’ve been doing just that—our technology helped people put a man on the moon and capture the first\-ever picture of a black hole. We offer an expansive portfolio of technologies, HDDs, and platforms for business, creative professionals, and consumers alike under our Western Digital®, WD®, and WD\_BLACK™. We are a key partner to some of the largest and highest\-growth organizations in the world. From enabling systems to make cities safer and more connected, to powering the data centers behind many of the world’s biggest companies and hyperscale cloud providers, to meeting the massive and ever\-growing data storage needs of the AI era, WD is fueling a brighter, smarter future. Today’s exceptional challenges require your unique skills. Together, we can build the future of data storage. **Job Description** The Senior Engineer,, Applications Engineering (APC) is responsible for developing, implementing, and sustaining Advanced Process Control (APC) systems—including run‑to‑run (R2R) control and fault detection \& classification (FDC)—to improve manufacturing yield, process capability, cycle time, and equipment productivity. The role requires close collaboration with process, equipment, and IT engineering teams to deploy scalable APC solutions, advance automation initiatives, and drive continuous improvement across wafer manufacturing operations. As part of the industry’s transition from traditional feedback‑based APC to AI‑augmented, model‑driven control, the Senior Engineer will help integrate predictive and data‑driven methods that more accurately identify process drift, reduce variability, and minimize scrap. These next‑generation APC capabilities leverage machine learning, virtual metrology, and advanced equipment analytics to enhance system stability and responsiveness. The Senior Engineer plays a critical role in enabling these AI‑enhanced manufacturing capabilities while ensuring stable, high‑quality, and efficient wafer production. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES** * Implement APC solutions in collaboration with Process Engineering, Equipment Engineering, IT, and external partners. * Lead APC/automation projects through production release and quantify improvements against baseline metrics. * Perform data analysis to develop and optimize FDC models for real‑time fault detection. * Configure and deploy new control strategies and automation recipes; support recipe management and specification database setups. * Develop and tune R2R control models using feedback and feed‑forward algorithms. * Create advanced FDC models for scrap prevention, tool matching, predictive maintenance, and condition‑based maintenance. * Conduct system integration testing for R2R, FDC, and automation host systems. * Maintain R2R and FDC systems; monitor controller/model performance and initiate continuous improvement activities. * Increasing use of predictive maintenance and health‑monitoring models leveraging FDC \+ ML to identify faults earlier and reduce unplanned downtime. * Troubleshoot system issues and support system recovery during failures. * Participate in roadmap planning for future APC and automation capabilities. * Work effectively in a fast‑paced, cross‑functional environment and model continuous improvement behaviors. **Qualifications** **REQUIRED\-Must Have The Following** * **BS/MS in Engineering (Computer, Electrical, Chemical, Industrial, Mechanical), Applied Physics, Operations Research, Data Science or Statistics.** * **Experience with semiconductor R2R control and FDC systems.** * Strong analytical and programming skills; proficiency with statistical analysis and ML tools such as JMP, Python, and multivariate analysis platforms. * Knowledge of semiconductor processing technologies and equipment. * Solid understanding of IT systems, including: + Linux system administration and shell‑based workflow, + Windows OS, + SQL Server \& SQL queries, + Networking, + SECS/GEM communications, and + Data acquisition systems. SKILLS * Experience applying large language models (LLMs) or AI‑assisted engineering workflows for data analysis, troubleshooting support, automation scripting, documentation generation, or accelerating APC/FDC model development. * Effective verbal and written communication skills with project‑management experience. **Additional Information** Western Digital is committed to providing equal opportunities to all applicants and employees and will not discriminate against any applicant or employee based on their race, color, ancestry, religion (including religious dress and grooming standards), sex (including pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions, breastfeeding or related medical conditions), gender  re every individual can thrive through a sense of belonging, respect and contribution. Western Digital is committed to offering opportunities to applicants with disabilities and ensuring all candidates can successfully navigate our careers website and our hiring process. Please contact us at jobs.accommodations@wdc.com to advise us of your accommodation request. In your email, please include a description of the specific accommodation you are requesting as well as the job title and requisition number of the position for which you are applying. Based on our experience, we anticipate that the application deadline will be 12\-17\-2026 **(**3 months from posting), although we reserve the right to close the application process sooner if we hire an applicant for this position before the application deadline. If we are not able to hire someone from this role before the application deadline, we will update this posting with a new anticipated application deadline. \#Ll\-TD1 **Compensation \& Benefits Details** * An employee’s pay position within the salary range may be based on several factors including but not limited to (1\) relevant education; qualifications; certifications; and experience; (2\) skills, ability, knowledge of the job; (3\) performance, contribution and results; (4\) geographic location; (5\) shift; (6\) internal and external equity; and (7\) business and organizational needs. * The salary range is what we believe to be the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range and this range is only applicable for jobs to be performed in California, Colorado, New York or remote jobs that can be performed in California, Colorado and New York. This range may be modified in the future. * If your position is non\-exempt, you are eligible for overtime pay pursuant to company policy and applicable laws. You may also be eligible for shift differential pay, depending on the shift to which you are assigned. * You will be eligible to be considered for bonuses under **either** WD’s Short Term Incentive Plan (“STI Plan”) or the Sales Incentive Plan (“SIP”) which provides incentive awards based on Company and individual performance, depending on your role and your performance. You may be eligible to participate in our annual Long\-Term Incentive (LTI) program, which consists of restricted stock units (RSUs) or cash equivalents, pursuant to the terms of the LTI plan. Please note that not all roles are eligible to participate in the LTI program, and not all roles are eligible for equity under the LTI plan. RSU awards are also available to eligible new hires, subject to WD's Standard Terms and Conditions for Restricted Stock Unit Awards. * We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid vacation time; paid sick leave; medical/dental/vision insurance; life, accident and disability insurance; tax\-advantaged flexible spending and health savings accounts; employee assistance program; other voluntary benefit programs such as supplemental life and AD\&D, legal plan, pet insurance, critical illness, accident and hospital indemnity; tuition reimbursement; transit; the Applause Program; employee stock purchase plan; and the WD Savings 401(k) Plan. * **Note:** No amount of pay is considered to be wages or compensation until such amount is earned, vested, and determinable. The amount and availability of any bonus, commission, benefits, or any other form of compensation and benefits that are allocable to a particular employee remains in the Company's sole discretion unless and until paid and may be modified at the Company’s sole discretion, consistent with the law. **Notice To Candidates:** Please be aware that WD and its subsidiaries will never request payment as a condition for applying for a position or receiving an offer of employment. Should you encounter any such requests, please report it immediately to WD Ethics Helpline or email compliance@wdc.com.

jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer 2
jobs.description: **About the Team \& Role** The WEX Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team is looking for individuals passionate about developing software and solutions focused on observability, incident response, reliability and performance, operational excellence, and compliance. The team will be part of the Platform Reliability organization which supports our internal stakeholders included in our Corporate Payments line of business. As part of the Platform Reliability organization you’ll have the opportunity to solve complex challenges and improve the quality of life of our engineering teams as well as our ability to service our customers. Your expertise will empower our teams to build resilient systems that meet the demands of a rapidly evolving digital landscape while fostering a collaborative environment focused on growth and excellence. As the only major U.S.\-based manufacturer of kitchen and laundry appliances, the company is driving meaningful innovation to meet the evolving needs of consumers through its iconic brand portfolio, including Whirlpool, KitchenAid, JennAir, Maytag, Amana, Brastemp, Consul, and InSinkErator. In 2025, the company reported approximately $16 billion in annual net sales \- close to 90% of which were in the Americas \- 41,000 employees, and 35 manufacturing and technology research centers. Additional information about the company can be found at WhirlpoolCorp.com. **The team you will be a part of** ---------------------------------- The Software Engineering team designs, develops or coordinates development/troubleshooting or debugging of moderately complex software programs for enhancements and new products. Performs high\-level design/modeling to convert stakeholder needs into software solutions. Develops software and tools in support of design, infrastructure and technology platforms. Determines hardware compatibility and/or influences hardware design. Develops the architectural guidelines, specifications, and technical standards and communicates to stakeholders.**This role in summary** ------------------------ We are looking for an experienced Full Stack Embedded Technical Lead Engineer to guide the design, development, and delivery of embedded systems across the full technology stack — from low\-level firmware to system integration and testing. This role blends deep hands\-on technical expertise with team leadership, mentoring, and cross\-functional collaboration. The ideal candidate is a strong engineer first, and a natural leader who can guide a team through complex technical challenges while keeping projects aligned with business goals. **Your responsibilities will include** -------------------------------------- **Technical Leadership** * Provide technical leadership for full\-stack embedded software development, from low\-level firmware through operating\-system services and application\-level software. * Define software architecture, technical solutions, interfaces, and design approaches for complex embedded systems. * Lead technical discussions, design reviews, code reviews, and architecture decisions. * Own technical decision\-making across hardware/software boundaries, ensuring robust, scalable, and maintainable solutions. * Identify technical risks, dependencies, and gaps, and drive them to resolution. * Drive best practices in coding standards, testing, and documentation. **Embedded Software Development** * Design and develop embedded software and firmware using C and C\+\+. * Work with embedded operating systems such as Linux, RTOS, Android/AOSP, or similar platforms. * Develop across multiple layers, including device drivers and hardware interfaces, firmware and middleware, OS services, application\-level software, and communication/connectivity interfaces. * Analyze system performance, reliability, memory usage, CPU utilization, and other embedded\-system constraints. * Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve complex system\-level issues across firmware, OS, and application layers. * Champion automation of build, test, and deployment pipelines to improve engineering efficiency. **Cloud \& Connected Systems (Preferred)** * Understand how embedded products interact with cloud infrastructure and connected services, with working knowledge of AWS preferred. * Understand device\-to\-cloud communication, APIs, telemetry, OTA software updates, and connected\-product architecture. * Collaborate with cloud, mobile, data, and cybersecurity teams where embedded and cloud systems intersect. **Team Leadership \& Collaboration** * Provide technical direction and hands\-on guidance to a team of embedded and full stack engineers. * Mentor and coach engineers, supporting their technical growth and career development. * Work closely with hardware, electrical, systems, controls, test, product, and QA teams to integrate software with the overall product and translate requirements into technical solutions. * Participate in and help shape agile ceremonies (sprint planning, stand\-ups, retrospectives) to keep the team productive and on track. * Communicate technical risks, trade\-offs, and progress clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Evaluate new tools, technologies, and processes to keep the team's practices current and competitive. **Minimum requirements** ------------------------ **Embedded Systems \& Firmware** * Strong background in embedded systems architecture and firmware development * Experience working with microcontrollers/microprocessors and embedded hardware platforms * Solid understanding of embedded operating systems (e.g., RTOS, embedded Linux, Android/AOSP, Zephyr) * Experience with low\-level programming, device drivers, middleware, and hardware/software integration **Programming** * Expert\-level proficiency in C/C\+\+ * Working knowledge of Python for scripting, automation, and tooling (preferred) **Testing \& Quality** * Hands\-on experience with unit testing, integration testing, and module/system\-level testing * Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills across hardware and software layers * Familiarity with test automation frameworks and continuous testing practices **Preferred skills and experiences** ------------------------------------ * Exposure to cloud infrastructure, particularly AWS (e.g., IoT services, device connectivity, data pipelines) * Understanding of DevOps/CI\-CD practices as applied to embedded development * Basic knowledge of AI/ ML, Gen AI software development productivity tools **What we offer** ----------------- Generous benefits package, Whirlpool employee discount, fitness \& educational reimbursement programs, kitchenettes, and more! Saint Joseph/Benton Harbor locations: Beautiful, recently renovated office space, Barista Bar, biking/walking trails, and access to The Eddy \- Early Childhood Center (depending upon availability \- additional costs required). **Additional information** -------------------------- Whirlpool’s Ways of Working Our goal is to provide an environment that helps you bring your best to Whirlpool every day. While employees in this role work in\-person Monday through Friday. We offer flexibility and industry\-leading time\-off benefits that will help you balance what’s important at work and at home, including: * **Always On Flexibility** \- You will have the autonomy to manage personal, family, and outside\-of\-work commitments as needed. * **Two\-Week Work from Anywhere** \- Minimum of one\-week increments for a total of two weeks per year. * **Sabbatical** \- Four weeks paid leave after every five years of service. Connect with us and learn more about Whirlpool Corporation See what it's like to work at Whirlpool by visiting Whirlpool Careers. Additional information about the company can be found on Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube. Whirlpool Corporation is committed to equal employment opportunity and prohibits any discrimination on the basis of race or ethnicity, religion, sex, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, age, physical or mental disability, veteran status, or any other category protected by applicable law.

jobs.description: **Your work days are brighter here.** We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun\-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. We build the AI platform layer that powers code generation, AI\-assisted code review, agentic workflows, and enterprise\-wide developer tooling. We own the MCP registry and gateway that connects Workday's developers to AI capabilities, and we build the technical guardrails that operationalize how AI is used responsibly across the company. If you want to do high\-impact AI infrastructure work in enterprise software, we'd love to hear from you. **About the Role** The Workday AI Tools team is looking for a senior engineer who thrives at the intersection of AI, platform engineering, and developer experience. You'll design and build systems that thousands of Workday engineers rely on every day \- from LLM gateways and MCP server infrastructure to AI\-native agents and compliance tooling. You'll help define how we integrate emerging AI capabilities into our platform, and you'll be a technical anchor on a team that moves fast and takes quality seriously. You'll also work directly with the engineers using these tools \- through office hours, Slack support, and our Champions program \- and your work will be shaped by their feedback. experience building or integrating with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.) and familiarity with prompt engineering, evaluation pipelines, and model selection tradeoffs \- Robust understanding of AI security principles and responsible AI practices \- including prompt injection, model misuse, data leakage risks, output validation, and operationalizing policy guardrails in production AI systems \- Genuine excitement about being on the leading edge of AI \- you follow new model releases, tooling shifts, and emerging frameworks closely, and you bring that energy into what the team builds Other Qualifications \- Hands\-on experience designing and building AI agents, including fluency with agentic frameworks and patterns such as ReAct \- and practical experience shipping agents that are reliable in production \- Experience building MCP servers, Claude skills, or similar tool\-use integrations that extend AI capabilities to real workflows \- Comfort designing REST APIs and service\-oriented architectures \- Experience with container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker) and deploying services to cloud environments; experience with workflow orchestration tools and infrastructure\-as\-code is a plus \- Understanding of enterprise security patterns: authentication, - Exposure to observability tooling \- logging, metrics, tracing \- and a habit of building systems jobs.title: Lead Product Manager, Bellwether
jobs.description: Product ManagementMountain View, CA (HQ) **About the Team:** Our team – Bellwether – operates at the intersection of machine learning, geospatial data, and pressing issues with enterprise customers, governments, and more. Our team is focused on creating transparency into physical risk. We focus on severe weather manifestations of climate change, such as wildfires, and aim to use a wide range of data and analytics to better understand and predict what these events could mean for communities and businesses across the globe. We do this through the detection and classification of the features and patterns of the natural and built worlds, the application of cutting\-edge machine learning, and the redesign of the full geo\-ML workflow. This work extends into development and production\-level work as well, as Bellwether also has a number of products that are live with customers. The result: tools and models that allow a range of industries to better leverage earth observation insights. **About the role:** As a Lead Product Manager at Bellwether, you will drive the evolution of our core product suite and take complete ownership of all model, agent, and platform components for Bellwether. In this highly technical role, you will help shape how financial services and government customers leverage AI. You will work closely with internal users and customers to prioritize their complex requirements and ship valuable features / workflows to the Bellwether platform. You will collaborate deeply with the engineering, research, and cross\-functional teams to ensure our agent architecture and data infrastructure remain ahead of model capabilities, establishing Bellwether as the most robust and intelligent platform in the space. As model intelligence accelerates, the ultimate form factor of agentic systems and scalable data platforms remains unwritten. We seek a highly technical product leader who combines deep architectural understanding, a genuine passion for platform engineering, and strong product intuition. You should be equally comfortable discussing advanced agent behaviors and data pipelines with world\-class researchers, debugging user workflows, and presenting product strategy to executives. **How you will have 10X impact:** * Develop and maintain clear, inspiring product vision, roadmaps, segmentation, and value proposition across our key verticals * Have a strong point of view on how agentic system, data ontology and enterprise AI models are evolving * Lead deep\-dive discovery with key stakeholders in the insurance, capital markets, and resilience sectors to turn complex climate modeling into intuitive risk measurement and mitigation workflows. * Create experiences that inspire confidence, delight and accelerate our end users, and encourage adoption and trust across industries * Working closely with our researchers, engineers, designers, and partners to guide development and bring our roadmap to life during the product lifecycle: * + Represent the voice of the market, our partners, and customers + Maintain focus on roadmap priorities + Manage and scope sprints and releases + Propose creative solutions to technical issues and challenges * Develop clear, concise product documentation * Create materials and give presentations that evangelize and articulate product vision, roadmap, and value propositions to technical and non\-technical audiences, both internally and externally * Understand and monitor the market and ecosystem for physical risk \- including insurance, reinsurance, capital markets, and more **What you should have**: * Combined 10\+ years of professional experience spanning product management and engineering, including at least 1 year in a hands\-on engineering role. Ideally, you transitioned from a highly technical discipline (e.g., Software Engineering, Computer Science, or Data Science) early in your career, or you bring entrepreneurial founder experience or product leadership that culminated in a successful company acquisition. * Proven track record of success in platform or enterprise product management. You have demonstrated tangible, measurable business results utilizing either a product\-led (PLG) or sales\-led (SLG) growth strategy (or a hybrid of both). * Deep domain expertise in cloud infrastructure and platform architecture (familiarity with technologies like Databricks, CoreWeave, Splunk, Snowflake, etc., is highly valued). Candidates with consumer\-product backgrounds are encouraged to apply, provided you directly own the underlying core platform or infrastructure components. * Hands\-on experience utilizing Generative AI tools to optimize product workflows, accelerate PRD development, enhance Product\-to\-Engineering alignment, and rapidly prototype wireframes or feature concepts. * A deeply technical mindset coupled with the ability to navigate a highly cross\-functional environment, seamlessly bridging complex engineering architectures with executive business strategies. **It’d be great if you also had these:** * Experience in startups or small\-team environments * Experience with Google’s AI tools and platforms * Familiarity with geospatial data (e.g., satellite imagery, GIS), climate science, or catastrophe modeling. * Experience with Google Cloud and enterprise deployments Prior success in productizing research or innovation\-stage prototypes. * Writing samples or public\-facing documentation that demonstrate clarity and technical fluency The US base salary range for this full\-time position is $240,000 \- $338,000 \+ bonus \+ benefits. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your location during the hiring process. jobs.title: Director, Applied AI
jobs.description: ZoomInfo is where careers accelerate. We move fast, think boldly, and empower you to do the best work of your life. You'll be surrounded by teammates who care deeply, challenge each other, and celebrate wins. With tools that amplify your impact and a culture that backs your ambition, you won't just contribute. You'll make things happen–fast. You'll lead the team that builds the intelligence every ZoomInfo AI agent reasons over — what's true about companies and the people in them, how they relate, and what they're buying. This role owns the B2B data graph strategy end to end, from training data through model serving, blending classical machine learning and data science with LLM and agentic systems. You'll set the technical bar for a small, senior team while staying hands\-on, shipping code and prototypes alongside the engineers you lead. **What You'll Do** * You will extend ZoomInfo's B2B data graph into the long tail, making it the most comprehensive and accurate resource available, including companies with little public footprint. * You will lead the team's work on agent memory, distinguishing what a user has supplied from what a system of record already owns. * You will choose the right method for each problem — classical machine learning, language models, or code — based on measured evidence, and stop work that won't pay off. * You will define the evaluation bar for the team's models and agents, building evaluation datasets, regression gates, and experiment designs that make quality claims trustworthy. * You will own inference cost, latency, and capacity as core disciplines alongside model quality, including build\-versus\-buy and distillation decisions. * You will hire and develop machine learning engineers, data scientists, and research engineers, growing senior engineers into technical leaders. * You will represent the team's work across product, platform, security, and legal, and present results and their limits clearly to executives. * You will set the standard for how the team uses agentic coding tools, pairing precise specifications with rigorous code review. **What You Bring** *Must\-Have:* * You have significant, demonstrated experience building and shipping production machine learning systems, and you lead by building alongside your team — capability matters more than years. * You have a track record of hiring and developing senior machine learning engineers and data scientists against a high bar. * You stay hands\-on today: shipping code, prototyping independently, and using agentic coding tools daily with rigorous review. * You bring deep classical machine learning and data science expertise (supervised learning, feature engineering, statistical inference, experiment design, strong SQL) alongside production LLM and agentic systems, with the judgment to choose between them, including setting evaluation standards such as leakage\-safe validation and calibration. * You have owned inference cost, latency, and capacity alongside model quality, including build\-versus\-buy decisions, and you communicate results and their limits clearly to executive stakeholders. *Preferred:* * You bring entrepreneurial experience — founding a company, or taking a product from inception to paying customers as a founding or early engineer. * You have experience in propensity modeling, ranking and retrieval, clustering, or entity resolution at scale. * You have worked on web\-scale language processing over multilingual, noisy text, knowledge graphs, or user memory for agents. * You have experience with post\-training and distillation, open\-weight model serving, or AI governance and safety practices (ISO/IEC 42001, NIST AI RMF). \#LI\-Remote \#LI\-VC1 **About us:** ZoomInfo (NASDAQ: GTM) is the Go\-To\-Market Intelligence Platform that empowers businesses to grow faster with AI\-ready insights, trusted data, and jobs.title: QA Analyst II
jobs.description: ### **ABOUT THE POSITION** Performs quality assurance activities including assignments of new product developments and sustaining efforts for current Aiphone products with considerable latitude for action and decision making. Responsible for tests, evaluations, and analysis of bug reports. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** include the following. Other duties, responsibilities, and activities may change or be assigned at any time with or without notice. To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. * Performs new complex product developments including making test plans and performing tests for both software and hardware. This is a hands\-on position with focus on QA testing. * Writes test plans and test cases from user's point of view based on approved concept design. * Performs test and verification to evaluate products and systems. * Verifies design documents to ensure the development process is in accordance with the company standards. * Analyzes issues from fields and provides engineers with information to fix the issues. Oversees issues, analyzes the trend of issues, and provides Engineering feedback to reduce the issues. **Additional Responsibilities** include the following: * Performs shipping inspections based on the initial failure rates. * Verifies quality of manuals and suggests corrections. * Assists engineers to provide efficient document control. * Provides quality assurance supports to internal and external customers. Prepares guidelines and support by describing operational, testing, troubleshooting methods, and procedures. * Updates job knowledge by studying test methodologies, automation, software, and hardware; participating in educational opportunities; reading professional publications; maintaining personal networks; participating in professional organizations. **Inter\-relationship** Relationship of position with internal, lateral and external groups. Interacts with co\-workers as a team member to understand goals of a team, report progress and issues, obtain expert inputs, and contribute information. Interacts with vendors, suppliers, and manufacturers as needed. Interacts with Engineering Manager if any expectations are unclear or assistance is needed to meet job requirements. **PHYSICAL DEMANDS:** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this Job, the employee is regularly required to lift and/or move up to 20 pounds. The employee is regularly required to sit for long periods of time; walk; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; balance; bend and reach with hands and arms; and talk or hear. Occasionally required to climb ladders, stand, stoop, kneel, squat, crouch, or crawl. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus. **WORK ENVIRONMENT:** The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. This position may occasionally require exposure to chemical hazards and to the production site where certain conditions require the use of personal protective equipment (PPE), such as safety glasses and gloves. Company will provide PPE and training. For the most part, ambient room temperatures, lighting and traditional office equipment as found in a typical office environment. This position may require occasional off\-site visits for tests in different locations. **GENEROUS BENEFITS:** * Base salary with guaranteed bonus and performance bonus potential * Health benefits * Generous 401K match * Additional benefits ### **POSITION REQUIREMENTS** *The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.* **EDUCATION AND RELATED EXPERIENCE:** * Bachelor’s degree in software, computer science, or math is preferred. * Minimum 2 years experience in quality assurance. * Experience in software development, hardware development, performing product safety tests and/or working on translation is preferred. * Familiarity with various testing such as regular case test, irregular case test, test matrix, long\-run test, stress test, regression test, and test automation is preferred. **REQUIRED COMPETENCIES:** To perform this job successfully, an individual should have knowledge of: * Excellent written and oral communication skills required. Must have strong problem\-solving skills and communicate persuasively. * Has knowledge of commonly used concepts and practices about engineering such as designing, implementing, testing, analyzing, and documenting and the security industry. * Proficient in Microsoft 365 (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and SharePoint) and computer networks. * Has basic knowledge of project management. * Steady paced, able to work consistently with many distractions. Must be able to work within a team and independently. Must be able to maintain an organized schedule with competing priorities, executing plans within scheduled deadlines. * Acts in ethical and professional manner at all times with colleagues, customers, and vendors, representing the highest standards of Aiphone behavior.

jobs.title: Agentic AI Solution Engineer
jobs.description: CORAS is a growth\-stage company delivering cutting\-edge, AI\-powered decision intelligence to the Department of Defense and other federal organizations. Our primary clients include the U.S. Navy Program Offices, PEOs (Program Executive Offices), and Pentagon\-level Portfolio and Requirements Offices. We thrive in a dynamic environment and are looking for proactive, customer\-facing professionals who are energized by fast\-paced problem solving, empowered to lead, and excited to make a tangible impact. **Role Overview:** CORAS is seeking an Agentic AI Solutions Engineer to help customers design and deploy intelligent decision workflows using the CORAS Enterprise Decision Management platform. In this role, you will work directly with mission stakeholders across the Department of Defense to translate complex operational challenges into AI\-enabled decision solutions. You will configure data models, build intelligent dashboards, and implement agentic workflows that automate analysis, generate insights, and support mission\-critical decision making. This is a hybrid role combining solution engineering, analytics, and AI workflow design. Successful candidates are comfortable working with modern enterprise platforms (Power Platform, ServiceNow, Salesforce, etc.), integrating data sources, and configuring automated decision agents that help organizations move from static reporting to intelligent, AI\-driven operations. The ideal candidate is part solutions engineer, part systems thinker, and part customer advisor, someone who enjoys translating complex problems into practical, deployable solutions in dynamic mission environments.**Key Responsibilities:*** Engage directly with mission stakeholders to deeply understand analytical requirements, strategic priorities, and operational challenges. * Leverage experience with tools like Power BI, Power Platform, ServiceNow, or Salesforce to create user\-driven, scenario\-based solutions. * Assist in setting up what\-if scenarios, AI agents, and automated workflows to support predictive and prescriptive decision\-making. * Present accurate, consistent, and reliable data analysis processes to optimize decision\-making. * Act as a trusted advisor to end\-users, guiding them through system capabilities, troubleshooting, and ensuring adoption. * Champion data best practices and thought leadership, keeping abreast of industry innovations in analytics, AI/ML integration, and visualization techniques. * Troubleshoot data\-related challenges with CORAS customers and prospective end users. * Provide guidance and support to users, helping them maximize the benefits of CORAS. * Collaborate with the CORAS development team to enhance product capabilities based on frontline user feedback and evolving customer needs. * Drive the continuous improvement of data processes, standards, and methodologies, contributing to CORAS’s growth as a best\-in\-class decision intelligence platform. **Qualifications:*** Customer\-facing experience working on technology or analytics implementations — consulting, pre\-sales engineering, customer success, or product support. * Skilled with modern enterprise platforms such as ServiceNow, Salesforce, Quickbase, Appian, Smartsheet, or Power Platform (esp. Power Apps/Automate) and/or BI tools like Qlik, Tableau, or Power BI—especially when applied to building use\-case\-driven workflows, dashboards, or customer\-facing solutions. * Basic familiarity with data pipelines and scripting languages (such as SQL, Python, PowerShell, or JavaScript) is a plus – especially for configuring automations, transforming data, or supporting integrations. * Comfortable with iterative, agile delivery, and working in dynamic customer environments (especially federal/DoD a plus). * Familiar with data integration, transformation, and quality assurance across spreadsheets, cloud systems, APIs, and structured/unstructured data. * Experience with AI/ML\-enriched platforms, enterprise digital transformation initiatives, or large language models (LLMs), including prompt engineering, is a strong plus. * Effective communication skills to convey complex insights to diverse stakeholders. * Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a dynamic environment. **Benefits:*** Competitive compensation package and performance\-based incentives. * Comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits. * Flexible work arrangements, including hybrid work options. * Opportunities for continuous professional growth and development. * Collaborative and inclusive work environment. * Exposure to cutting\-edge technologies and innovative projects.

jobs.description: JOB DESCRIPTION At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts. Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet. Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all. **\*****\* This role cannot offer any form of visa sponsorship \*\*** --------------------------------------------------------------------- **About the team and the role:** -------------------------------- At eBay, we create trusted experiences that connect millions of buyers and sellers around the world. Behind those experiences is a platform that must be fast, reliable, and efficient at scale. The Traffic team plays a critical role in making that possible by transforming production telemetry into the insights and systems that help eBay’s platforms perform at their best. As an AI Analytics Engineer on the Traffic team, you will design and operate data products and analytical systems that explain, forecast, and optimize traffic behavior across eBay’s platforms. You will work across engineering, SRE, platform, application, and product teams to turn logs, metrics, traces, and traffic events into trusted datasets, scalable pipelines, and ML\-ready features. This is an opportunity to work on high\-impact challenges at the intersection of analytics, software engineering, and platform reliability while growing in a collaborative, modern data environment. **What you will accomplish:** ----------------------------- * Turn large\-scale telemetry and traffic signals into high\-quality datasets and data products that improve visibility, trust, and decision\-making across the organization. * Build scalable data and feature pipelines that power AI and forecasting use cases, including anomaly detection, incident prediction, capacity forecasting, and traffic attribution. * Deliver dashboards and analytical experiences that help teams understand latency, availability, error rates, saturation, regional behavior, and routing changes across the platform. * Use statistical and analytical techniques to identify meaningful patterns, quantify impact, and uncover the drivers of traffic and reliability outcomes. * Improve confidence in data by implementing quality checks, validation, freshness monitoring, lineage\-minded practices, and alerting for critical analytics workflows. * Collaborate across Traffic Engineering, SRE, Platform, Application, and Product teams to connect production telemetry with customer experience, platform efficiency, and long\-term scalability. **What you will bring:** ------------------------ * Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field, or a Bachelor’s degree in a related field plus 2\+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, ML data pipelines, or similar work. * Strong programming skills in Python and SQL, with experience in data modeling, debugging, and building reliable batch and/or streaming workflows. * Solid understanding of data warehouse or lakehouse concepts, distributed processing fundamentals, and Linux basics. * Familiarity with logs, metrics, and traces, and an understanding of how observability data can be used to improve platform performance and reliability. * Experience with technologies such as Spark, Databricks, Flink, Airflow, dbt, BigQuery, Snowflake, Kafka, or similar data and infrastructure tools. * A thoughtful, collaborative approach to problem\-solving, with interest or experience in SLI/SLO reporting, incident analytics, performance attribution, or traffic\-related infrastructure concepts. \***\* This role cannot offer any sort of visa sponsorship \*\*** **Additional Details** The base pay range for this position is expected in the range below: $80,800 \- $143,600 Base pay offered may The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a target bonus and restricted stock units (as applicable) in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits (including 401(k) eligibility and various paid time off benefits, such as PTO and parental leave). Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment. If hired, employees will be in an “at\-will position” and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets, and behind every fast, seamless experience is a foundation of technology built for scale, reliability, and innovation. The Traffic team is a critical part of that foundation. They build and evolve the systems that help power experiences across eBay’s global platform, ensuring high performance, resilience, and security at scale. This team works on meaningful technical challenges that directly influence customer experience, platform health, and business impact. As a Full Stack Engineer \- Traffic, you will help shape the next generation of applications and services that support eBay’s traffic ecosystem. This is a full\-time opportunity for an engineer who enjoys solving complex problems across the stack — from architecting scalable backend systems to building intuitive front\-end experiences. You will work closely with product managers, architects, and cross\-functional engineering partners to deliver high\-quality solutions that improve platform capabilities for teams and customers around jobs.title: Network Engineer
jobs.description: Network Engineer Remote Long\-Term Contract with Potential for Permanent Hire **Core Duties \& Responsibilities:** Deliver post\-sales engineering implementation services for network solutions across a range of products and offerings, including defining requirements, building implementation plans, designing end\-to\-end systems, staging equipment, creating and testing configurations, and deploying software and/or hardware network solutions across multiple locations. Continually research and apply knowledge of market and industry trends and benchmarks to identify, recommend, and implement best practices, methodologies, and relevant analytics. Continuously build upon technical and non\-technical skills through various learning avenues, with an emphasis on expanding expertise in operating systems, networking infrastructure, and related products and services. Meet financial performance goals within area of responsibility, taking corrective measures as necessary. Recommend and implement improvements to methodologies, core competencies, and processes within deployment engineering to maintain consistent, high\-quality product and service delivery in line with company objectives and client expectations. Cultivate and strengthen a client\-focused environment centered on anticipating, identifying, and resolving problems. Proactively remove obstacles to meeting client expectations, document issues and resolutions in a timely manner, and consistently meet client satisfaction goals along with internal and external SLAs. Consistently support and advocate for initiatives that improve, streamline, automate, and enhance daily service delivery operations and the overall client experience. Build collaborative relationships across operations and all levels/departments of the organization to carry out deployment engineering responsibilities and support company priorities. Use established escalation and exception processes and systems to report on current performance and suggest areas for improvement. Meet performance goals set by leadership for relevant Key Performance Indicators. Take on additional responsibilities as assigned by management. **Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities:** Accountability – Understands the connection between individual job duties and broader organizational objectives, and carries out responsibilities with these larger goals in mind. Goes beyond core job requirements to suggest improvements to overall operations, and takes personal ownership of the organization's success. Customer Focus – Prioritizes meeting the needs of internal and external customers in a way that ensures satisfaction. Considers the effect on external customers when making decisions, setting policies, or performing job duties. Watches for emerging trends that may influence customer needs, and seeks innovative ways to improve service delivery, boost efficiency, and reduce costs. Business Acumen – Evaluates situations and events through a business lens to make decisions aligned with the organization's strategic goals. Uses technology to support better decision\-making and provide cost\-effective management tools. Aligns policies for a unified business approach, and promotes stronger collaboration and communication across departments. Decision Making – Makes sound decisions by combining analysis, knowledge, experience, and judgment. Identifies core issues by examining underlying symptoms. Addresses immediate concerns tied to major problems while developing long\-term solutions. Has a strong track record of accurate, well\-informed decisions, and applies effective decision\-making strategies during high\-pressure situations. Results Focused – Strives to meet or exceed internal and external performance standards, and is passionate about continuously improving service delivery. Sets and upholds high performance expectations for self and others in support of the organization's strategic goals. **Education \& Experience Requirements:** Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Management Information Systems, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field—or equivalent relevant experience. At least 5 years of experience in engineering deployment roles involving complex client requirement assessments, solution design, and implementation within the technology services sector. Familiarity with Change Management processes and procedures, including the ability to gather end\-user requirements and compile documentation that aligns with existing standards within set timeframes. Prior post\-sales engineering experience with network solutions, including defining requirements, developing implementation plans, designing end\-to\-end systems, staging equipment, creating and testing configurations, and deploying software and/or hardware network solutions across multiple locations. Preferred certifications: Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP), Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA), Arista ACE, or similar. Experience working in a production Data Center environment, including hands\-on management of routers, switches, firewalls, global and local load balancing, DMZ configurations, and a solid understanding of DDI. Strong networking skills across industry\-standard technologies and infrastructures, including cabling, LAN, WLAN, and WAN. Extensive experience with routing protocols such as BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, along with subnetting and route aggregation techniques. Demonstrated switching expertise in datacenter environments, including the Nexus product line, spine\-and\-leaf architecture, Cisco ACI, and Arista CLOS. Strong end\-to\-end process thinking, with proven experience in designing business processes and workflows. Strong problem\-solving and systems analysis abilities, with a track record of success in root cause analysis, effectiveness measurement, and related documentation. Proven history of continuously building knowledge of technology, market, and industry trends, with success in identifying, recommending, and implementing best practices and methodologies. Ability to collaborate effectively across all functional teams to optimize product and service offerings, creating a seamless experience for internal and external clients, with a track record of prompt and accurate issue resolution. Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), Outlook, SharePoint, ERP systems, service delivery management tools, and related cloud\-based technologies.

jobs.description: AI Growth Engineer — AI Agents, Video Generation \& Social Media **About Us** Ideatrix is building AI\-native consumer products, starting with **AI Wolves**, an AI\-powered social deduction game featuring AI Hosts, AI Players, AI Assistants, dynamic gameplay, and advanced LLM\-driven interactions. We’re looking for a hands\-on builder who combines engineering, creativity, and marketing instincts to help people discover and play our products. You’ll build AI\-powered marketing systems, create promotional videos, manage social media accounts, and develop tools for influencer outreach. **What You’ll Do** * **Build AI marketing agents:** Develop workflows for content research, campaign planning, copywriting, content repurposing, and performance analysis. * **Create promotional videos:** Use AI video generation and editing tools to outreach, track responses, and manage collaborations. * **Connect content to growth:** Track views, engagement, clicks, installs, and player conversion to understand what drives results. * **Prototype and ship quickly:** Use AI coding tools to build internal tools, dashboards, and integrations that improve marketing productivity. * **Own experiments end\-to\-end:** Take ideas from concept through execution, measure results, and improve the next iteration. **Who We’re Looking For** **Product and Growth Sense** * Understands how to turn product features into compelling stories and campaigns. * Can identify target audiences and propose creative ways to reach them. * Balances speed, content quality, and measurable outcomes. * Takes ownership and makes progress with incomplete information. **AI\-Powered Development** * Uses AI coding tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, or Gemini. * Can quickly learn unfamiliar tools and frameworks. * Enjoys building practical AI agents and automating repetitive workflows. * Reviews and tests AI\-generated outputs for accuracy, quality, and reliability. **Technical Skills** * Strong programming ability in Python, TypeScript, or JavaScript. * Experience with Git, GitHub, REST APIs, and third\-party integrations. * Familiarity with LLMs, AI agents, structured outputs, and tool calling. * Experience with workflow automation, social media APIs, analytics, or creator relationship management systems is a strong plus. * Experience with MCP, RAG, vector databases, or full\-stack development is a plus. **Content and Social Media Skills** * Comfortable creating short\-form videos, writing hooks and captions, and adapting content to different platforms. * Experience with AI video, image, voice, or editing tools. * Interested in managing social accounts and engaging directly with players and creators. * Able to write personalized influencer outreach and organize follow\-ups. * Understands the importance of authentic engagement, brand consistency, and platform rules. **What We Value More Than Years of Experience** * Product and growth thinking * Creative experimentation * Fast learning and execution * Ownership and clear communication * Working systems and published content * Measurable results **Bonus Points** * Personal AI projects, automation tools, or open\-source contributions. * A portfolio of promotional videos or social media campaigns. * Experience growing a social account or online community. * Experience with influencer partnerships, affiliate programs, or game marketing. * Startup, hackathon, or consumer AI experience. **CPT / OPT Support** We can support CPT, OPT, and STEM OPT extension requirements for eligible candidates, subject to applicable program and employer requirements. **How to Apply** Share your résumé and examples of what you’ve built or grown—AI agents, automation workflows, GitHub projects, videos, social accounts, or marketing campaigns. Tell us what you owned and what results you achieved. Pay: Up to $7\.25 per hour Expected hours: No less than 20\.0 per week Benefits: * Flexible schedule Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Consultant
jobs.description: monday.com is the AI work platform powering the most ambitious teams. 250,000\+ customers across departments use us to bring people, workflows, and AI agents together on one flexible platform where AI doesn't just assist, it executes. We move fast, build things that matter, and foster an ownership\-driven culture where you're empowered to shape how organizations work and outpace their competition. Our team is growing and we are looking for a Forward Deployed Consultant to join our Professional Services team! In this role, you will train, advise, and consult with customers to optimize their use of the monday.com AI work platform during the course of AI transformation, implementation, and managed services engagements. You will design and build the AI\-native solutions that get them there, configuring the agentic workflows, automations, and reporting their business relies on. You will run engagements both independently and as part of a delivery team collaborating with deployment strategists and engineers. Please note that this is a hybrid position with three days/week in our **Atlanta** office. **About The Role** * Lead AI transformation and implementation engagements for monday.com customers, designing and building tailored solutions using agents, vibe\-coded applications, and other advanced capabilities of the monday AI work platform. * Build strong relationships with client stakeholders, running the discovery that uncovers their desired business outcomes, and ensure successful adoption of the solutions you deliver across their organization. * Consult on business process design, mapping how work moves through a customer's organization and recommending the process changes that should be made before the solution is built. * Design sophisticated workflows and relational data structures within the monday.com platform to solve complex business cases, partnering with technical resources for data conversions, integrations, and agentic engineering. * Actively leverage monday AI and external Generative/Agentic AI tools to accelerate solution design, automate complex business logic, and deliver intelligent workflows for our customers. * Act as the project manager on standalone engagements, building and executing on project plans that ensure deliverables stay on\-time and on\-budget, and delivering defined scope alongside a deployment strategist on larger ones. * Run online webinars, training sessions, consultations, and one\-on\-one demos that show customers how our product capabilities translate into business value. * Produce the documentation, walkthroughs, and exit artifacts for your engagements that allow customers to operate, maintain, and extend what you built independently. * Represent the voice of the customer by advocating for their needs and influencing the product development roadmap. * Contribute the patterns and reusable assets you develop in the field back to our shared asset library. **Requirements** * 5\+ years of experience as a forward deployed consultant, implementation consultant, solutions consultant, or technical project manager in enterprise software. * Experience leading software implementation or managed services projects that required hands\-on build and system configuration in project management, CRM, service desk, or collaborative work management software. * Fluency in Generative and Agentic AI tools, with a strong understanding of how to leverage AI in streamlining work productivity and building intelligent workflows and agents. * Familiarity with what keeps AI reliable in production, including human review, checking outputs, and knowing when a deterministic automation is the better answer. * Strong problem solving skills, rooted in computational thinking, systems design, and an understanding of relational data structures. * Business process design and consulting experience, with the business acumen to frame an engagement around customer outcomes, and the judgment to read the implicit problem behind an explicit request. * Working knowledge of integration platforms (make.com, Zapier) sufficient to configure lightweight integrations yourself, with foundational knowledge of APIs (GraphQL) and MCP a plus. * Strong customer\-facing and presentation skills with the ability to establish credibility with client stakeholders and executives, and to clearly articulate technical topics to a non\-technical audience. * Ability to rapidly learn and take advantage of new concepts, business models, and technologies across a changing set of customers and industries. * Detail\-oriented with strong project management skills, comfortable running engagements independently and working across several at once. * Superb written and verbal communication skills, with a positive attitude, empathy, high energy, and the ability to take initiative and adapt. * BA or BS degree preferred. **What** **monday.com** **can offer you:** * Join a customer\-obsessed team where transparency and ownership are how we actually operate \- not just things we put on a wall * Work on a multi\-product suite powered by advanced AI, where what you ship reaches hundreds of thousands of customers worldwide * Competitive salary, benefits, bonus potential, and equity eligibility for many roles — we believe people should share in our success * Grow fast through a dedicated L\&D team, AI workshops, bootcamps, and internal hackathons \- the industry moves quick and so do we * A collaborative, global culture backed by Employee Resource Groups and workplace teams across New York, Tel Aviv, London, Munich, Warsaw, Tokyo, Sydney, and more *Visa sponsorship for this role is currently not available.* *monday.com* *is proud to be an equal\-opportunity employer. We hire talented individuals, regardless of gender, race, ethnicity, ancestry, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, military or veteran status, cultural background, religious beliefs, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.* *For Atlanta\-based hires only: Compensation Range: $123,000\-$156,000 base salary, subject to standard withholding and applicable taxes. In addition to base salary, the role includes opportunity to receive and/or earn a discretionary bonus and/or equity based on Company’s plans and in accordance with Company’s policies. Compensation finally awarded to the candidate will be commensurate with the candidate’s skills and experience. Compensation ranges for candidates in locations outside of New York City may differ based on the cost of labor and such additional factors for such other locations.* \#LI\-Hybrid Compensation Range: $123K \- $156K

jobs.title: Photonics Sensing Architect
jobs.description: Our mission at Oura is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award\-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles. Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office. We are looking for a collaborative, impact\-driven Photonics Sensing Engineer who will help engineer, evaluate, and design new optical technologies. You will be working closely with our Director of Hardware Sensing out of the San Francisco office to help define, validate, and translate requirements alongside hardware and cross\-functional stakeholders. ### **What You Will Do:** Sensor Architecture \& Design * Define, prototype and validate new sensors (optical like raman, spectroscopy, photoacoustic, QCL etc) for low\-power wearable platforms. * Translate sensing requirements into robust hardware specifications aligned with product goals. * Development \& Integration * Lead integration of optical sensors into Oura hardware, ensuring calibration, noise management, power efficiency, and high\-quality signal acquisition. * Design and execute sensor characterization and validation tests from prototype through production. Cross\-Functional Leadership * Collaborate with firmware, algorithm, and systems teams to ensure accurate motion data feeds into Oura’s signal processing and machine learning stacks. * Contribute to product planning and sensor roadmap discussions based on performance feedback and technology advances. Testing \& Validation * Develop and maintain rigorous test methodologies, metrics, and automation frameworks for motion sensor performance evaluation. * Analyze sensor data to diagnose edge cases and performance bottlenecks and define corrective actions. Supplier \& Partner Coordination * Engage with sensor vendors, partners, and manufacturers to assess technology options, secure components, and optimize integration into mass\-production workflows. * Documentation \& Communication * Produce clear technical documentation of sensor designs, trade studies, test plans, and performance metrics. * Present findings and recommendations to engineering leadership and cross\-disciplinary stakeholders. This is a hybrid role out of our San Francisco office. ### **What you'll bring** * 5\+ years of optical and electrode sensor or similar sensor design and integration roles. * Experience with optical and electrode sensors, and low\-power embedded sensor interfaces. * Strong background in sensor characterization, signal quality analysis, embedded systems, and data integrity practices. * Excellent analytical problem\-solving and written/verbal communication skills. * Collaborative mindset with experience working across hardware, firmware, and analytics teams. ### **Benefits** At Ōura, we care about you and your well\-being. Everyone here at Ōura has a ring of their own and we are continually looking to improve employee health. **What we offer:** * Competitive salary and equity packages * Health, dental, vision insurance, and mental health resources * An Ōura Ring of your own plus employee discounts for friends \& family * 20 days of paid time off plus 13 paid holidays plus 8 days of flexible wellness time off * Paid sick leave and parental leave Ōura takes a market\-based approach to pay, which may vary depending on your location. US locations are categorized into tiers based on a cost of labor index for that geographic area. While most offers will be closer to the starting range, successful candidates' pay will be determined based on job\-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, internal peer equity, and market conditions. These ranges may be modified in the future. Region 1: $216,000 \- $255,000 We are not considering candidates residing in the following states: Alaska (AK), Delaware (DE), Iowa (IA), Mississippi (MS), Nebraska (NE), South Dakota (SD), West Virginia (WV), and Wisconsin (WI). Oura is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Individuals seeking employment at Oura are considered without regard to age, ancestry, color, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, mental or physical disability, national origin, protected family care or medical leave status, race, religion (including beliefs and practices or the absence thereof), sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. We will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. We will work to ensure individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Disclaimer: Beware of fake job offers! We’ve been alerted to scammers posing as ŌURA recruiters, especially for remote roles. Please note: * Our jobs are listed only on the ŌURA Careers page and trusted job boards. * We will never ask for personal information like ID or payment for equipment upfront. * Official offers are sent through Docusign after a verbal offer, not via text or email. Stay cautious and protect your personal details. To all recruitment agencies: Oura does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, Oura employees, or any other organization's location. Oura is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.
