The ideal candidate has direct production experience securing AI systems, understands the adversarial attack surface against LLMs and agents, and can design and implement the technical controls that manage risk across the full AI stack. **Responsibilities** * Assess and address the AI and LLM attack surface in production environments: prompt injection (direct and indirect), data leakage through model output, insecure tool use, jailbreaking, and model supply chain risk. * Deploy, configure, and operate AI gateways and LLM proxy layers with centralized control: model allowlists, per\-team API keys, rate and budget limits, centralized audit logging, and inline input/output guardrails covering prompt injection, sensitive data egress, credential leakage, and unsafe output. * Design and implement governance frameworks for agentic systems and MCP (Model Context Protocol) tooling: registries, approval workflows, runtime policy enforcement, and identity and authorization patterns for non\-human identities. * Implement OAuth\-based access, token lifecycle management, and scoped tool permissions for AI agents operating with least\-privilege principles. * Extend zero trust controls to AI workloads across identity, device, network, application, and data pillars — with Azure preferred (Entra ID, Defender for Cloud, Key Vault, Purview, Conditional Access). * Build monitoring and detection for AI systems: prompt behavior analysis, tool invocation patterns, anomalous output detection, and data movement. * Conduct AI red team and adversarial testing using PyRIT, Garak, or equivalent tooling to identify vulnerabilities before adversaries do. * Lead shadow AI discovery programs to identify unsanctioned AI applications and browser extensions across the enterprise. * Perform third\-party AI vendor security reviews and assess M365 Copilot security posture including oversharing remediation and sensitivity label enforcement. * Advise clients on AI governance frameworks including OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, MITRE ATLAS, NIST AI RMF, and relevant compliance standards. * Perform tasks as assigned **Requirements** * 7 or more years of security engineering experience, with at least 2 years directly securing AI, ML, or GenAI systems in production environments. * Demonstrated hands\-on experience with LLM and agent attack surfaces: prompt injection, jailbreaking, data extraction, capability chaining, and supply chain risk. * Experience deploying or operating an AI gateway, LLM proxy, or centralized AI control plane with production\-grade input/output guardrails and audit logging. * Familiarity with agentic AI risk classes: excessive agency, capability chaining, tool and memory poisoning, and unsafe autonomous action. * Experience implementing identity and authorization patterns for non\-human identities in an AI or service\-oriented context. * Strong cloud security background with Azure preferred — Entra ID, Defender for Cloud, Key Vault, Purview, and Conditional Access. * AI red team experience using PyRIT, Garak, or equivalent adversarial testing tools. * Proficiency in Python with experience working with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI) and security evaluation tooling. * Knowledge of OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, MITRE ATLAS, and NIST AI RMF. * Certifications preferred: CISSP, AZ\-500, SC\-100, or CCSP. jobs.title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer
jobs.description: Location: New York, New York, United States **About Turing** ================ Turing’s mission is to accelerate superintelligence to drive real economic progress. Headquartered in San Francisco, Turing works with frontier AI labs to generate high\-quality datasets, reinforcement learning environments, and frontier research benchmarks that improve model capabilities in software engineering, enterprise knowledge work, and advanced STEM reasoning. In software engineering, Turing is the largest and longest\-running data provider in the category. Turing also works with Fortune 500 enterprises across financial services, life sciences, healthcare, retail, automotive, and CPG to build and deploy end\-to\-end agentic AI systems inside mission\-critical workflows. By operating on both sides, Turing closes the loop between frontier research and enterprise deployment, turning real\-world deployment signals into better data, evaluations, and more capable models. Learn more at www.turing.com. **Role:** Forward\-Deployed AI Engineer — Enterprise AI **Location:** New York City **Experience Level:** 8\+ years **Compensation:** $200,000–$250,000 base salary \+ equity **Work Model:** In\-office, typically three to five days per week, depending on client requirements **Why Join Enterprise AI?** --------------------------- Enterprise AI is a distinct business unit within Turing, operating with the speed, focus, and ownership of a rapidly scaling startup. When it comes to applied AI in the workplace, you’ll define the frontier by building beyond it. You’ll join the initial team of Forward\-Deployed Engineers, shaping how we work while solving enterprise\-grade problems for the world’s leading enterprises. As a Forward\-Deployed AI Engineer, you’ll own outcomes end to end—from identifying high\-value customer problems and shaping architecture to building production systems and working directly with senior client leaders. You’ll develop generative AI solutions in the real world, driving measurable impact and return on investment within large institutions. Enterprise AI is intense, intellectually challenging work. It won’t be for everyone, but it may be **exactly the challenge you’re looking for.** **As a Forward\-Deployed Engineer, You Will** --------------------------------------------- ### **Find the Problem Worth Solving** Work directly with customers to navigate ambiguity, uncover high\-value opportunities, challenge assumptions, and translate complex business needs into clear technical direction. This requires curiosity and business acumen as you discover business workflows and jointly define the outcomes an AI solution should drive. ### **Build Beyond the Frontier** Architect and build production AI systems, from multi\-agent workflows, orchestration, tool use, context engineering, memory and state, and retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) to the APIs, data pipelines, integrations, and distributed systems that make them reliable at scale. ### **Own the Outcome** You won’t simply be given a list of responsibilities—you’ll have the authority to own the outcome for your client and make a real\-world impact through your work. You’ll lead solutions from discovery through deployment and measurable impact while staying hands\-on and owning evaluation, observability, security, reliability, latency, scalability, and cost. **The Anti\-Sell** ------------------ **High ownership and intensity:** This role requires exceptional ownership and accountability. You’ll work with clients who have uncompromising expectations for quality, making this a demanding environment—and an ideal proving ground for people who seek difficult, high\-impact challenges. **Client\-first and in\-office:** Our work is client\-first, which means in\-person collaboration may be required either at the client site or at our planned Manhattan office near Madison Square Park. Depending on your assignment and client needs, you should expect to work in person three to five days per week and be based in the New York City area or within a reasonable commuting distance. **You’ll help write the playbook:** Enterprise AI operates like a startup. You may not always have an established process or playbook because you’ll be expected to apply your expertise, judgment, and technical depth to create one. **Our Forward\-Deployed Engineers Typically Have** -------------------------------------------------- **Deep production engineering experience:** Typically 8\+ years building and operating sophisticated software systems, with expertise in Python, backend systems, APIs, databases, distributed systems, system design, and cloud infrastructure. **Hands\-on agentic AI experience:** Experience building production LLM and agent systems using orchestration, tool use, context engineering, memory and state, retrieval, and multistep workflows. **End\-to\-end systems ownership:** A track record of taking complex systems from architecture through deployment and scale, with a practical understanding of evaluation, observability, reliability, security, guardrails, latency, scalability, and cost. **Exceptional customer and technical leadership:** The ability to enter unfamiliar environments, earn trust quickly, navigate ambiguity, challenge assumptions constructively, and communicate effectively with senior engineers and business executives. **Client\-ready communication:** The ability to explain technical concepts clearly, navigate ambiguity, work with stakeholders, and remain calm under pressure. **Don’t Meet Every Qualification Yet?** --------------------------------------- If you don’t meet every qualification for this role, we encourage you to apply to our **Forward\-Deployed AI Engineer (In Training)** opportunity. This role is designed for high\-potential software engineers and full\-stack developers who are building the production engineering, applied AI, and client\-delivery skills required to become Forward\-Deployed AI Engineers at Turing. **Values** ---------- * **We are client first:** We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value. * **We work at Start\-Up Speed:** We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection * **We are AI forward:** We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity. **Advantages of joining Turing** -------------------------------- * **Work at the frontier of AI**, helping the world’s leading AI labs improve their most advanced models by building expert datasets, RL environments, and first\-of\-a\-kind benchmarks. * **Contribute to leading\-edge AI research** and showcase your work at top conferences such as ICLR, ICML, and NeurIPS. * **Bring frontier AI innovation to the enterprise**, applying lessons learned from leading AI labs to solve real\-world business challenges. * **Collaborate with and learn from exceptional colleagues** with deep AI experience from Google, Meta, Amazon, and other leading technology companies. * **Move at the pace of AI innovation**, with the speed, ownership, and impact of a startup. Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Turing Akademia is an eight\-week intensive development experience for high\-performing software engineers and full\-stack developers who are close to being ready for forward\-deployed work. Through hands\-on technical training, production\-oriented projects, and direct feedback, you'll strengthen the skills required to build reliable AI systems and deliver solutions in complex client environments. Enterprise AI is intense, intellectually challenging work. It won't be for everyone, but it may be exactly the challenge you're looking for. **As a Forward\-Deployed Engineer, You Will** --------------------------------------------- ### **Find the Problem Worth Solving** * Work directly with customers to navigate ambiguity, uncover high\-value opportunities, and use curiosity and business acumen to understand their workflows and jointly define the business outcomes an AI solution should drive. ### **Build Beyond the Frontier** * Architect and build production AI systems—from multi\-agent workflows, orchestration, tool use, context engineering, memory and state, and retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) to the APIs, data pipelines, integrations, and distributed systems that make them reliable at scale. * Complete your first placement in Turing Akademia, building and demonstrating these capabilities through intensive, hands\-on work. ### **Own the Outcome** * You won't simply be given a list of responsibilities—you'll have the **authority to own the outcome for your client** and make a real\-world impact through your work. * Present your work to stakeholders, manage expectations, explain technical decisions, and respond constructively to pushback. * Lead solutions from discovery through deployment and measurable impact while staying hands\-on and owning evaluation, observability, security, reliability, latency, scalability, and cost. **The Anti\-Sell** ------------------ * **High ownership and intensity:** This role requires exceptional ownership and accountability. Your first placement in Turing Akademia will be demanding, fast\-paced, and feedback\-heavy, preparing you for clients with uncompromising expectations for quality. * **Client\-first and in\-person:** Our work is client\-first, which means in\-office collaboration may be required either at the client site or at our planned Manhattan office near Madison Square Park. Depending on your assignment and client needs, **you should expect to work in person three to five days per week and be based in the New York City area or within a reasonable commuting distance.** * **You'll help write the playbook:** Enterprise AI operates like a startup. You may not always have an established process or playbook because you'll be expected to apply your expertise, judgment, and technical depth to create one. **Our Forward\-Deployed Engineers Typically Have** -------------------------------------------------- * **Strong production engineering experience:** Typically 5\+ years as a software engineer or full\-stack developer building production or near\-production systems. * **Strong technical foundation:** Experience with programming, APIs, databases, backend systems, cloud infrastructure, and software development practices. * **Client\-ready communication:** The ability to explain technical concepts clearly, navigate ambiguity, work with stakeholders, and remain calm under pressure. * **Ownership and learning agility:** A history of taking initiative, solving unstructured problems, responding well to feedback, and learning new technologies quickly. Prior experience with AI, LLMs, RAG, or agentic systems is helpful but not required. Your first placement in Turing Akademia is designed to build those skills. **Values** ---------- * **We are client first:** We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value. * **We work at Start\-Up Speed:** We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection * **We are AI forward:** We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity. **Advantages of joining Turing** -------------------------------- * **Work at the frontier of AI**, helping the world's leading AI labs improve their most advanced models by building expert datasets, RL environments, and first\-of\-a\-kind benchmarks. * **Contribute to leading\-edge AI research** and showcase your work at top conferences such as ICLR, ICML, and NeurIPS. * **Bring frontier AI innovation to the enterprise**, applying lessons learned from leading AI labs to solve real\-world business challenges. * **Collaborate with and learn from exceptional colleagues** with deep AI experience from Google, Meta, Amazon, and other leading technology companies. * **Move at the pace of AI innovation**, with the speed, ownership, and impact of a startup. Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. For applicants from the European Union, please review Turing's GDPR notice here.
